events.description:
The Back Alley Cinema (located appropriately enough behind the Black Rock City Self Service Abortion Clinic) has been providing literally dozens of burners with nightly entertainment, intermittently, since 2009.  Now a part of the Cult of the Magic Lady!

Come plop yourself down on a couch... or on a fellow burner... or on a fellow burner ON a couch..  Enjoy fresh popped corn in the middle of nowhere.  Programming varies but, with a library of terabytes of entertainment onhand, is bound to be... entertaining to someone.  Bring a friend!  Or two!  Maybe even three, but let's not overdo it, we usually don't have THAT much room.

events.title: Planned Playahood Clinic / Office Hours
events.description:
A rotating roster of our finest clinicians and doctors will offer varied advice and services. Plus free condoms with every referral!

* Second Aid: There there. I'm sorry that happened. Are you feeling better?

* Bad Sex Advice: Yes, that rash does look nasty. Probably you should have it amputated.

* Playa Naming: Get a new playa name prescribed.

* Relationship Advice: You really do need some help, you know!

* “Pregnancy” tests. (“Yes, sir, you’re pregnant. Congratulations! Here’s a shot!”)

* Life Goal Broker Services: Come up and tell our '80s power brokers what you've always wanted and been having trouble making happen and we, as super-awesome power brokers, will help you make it happen. Part negotiators, part super-wingmen, we get the deal done.

Ceremonies are also available for those wishing to renew vows, express gratitude, or publicly celebrate joyful separation. Sunday is the biggest day for our popular wedding services, but available by appointment throughout the event -- come visit our bar and ask about weddings. Last year we provided personal playa rituals to many happy couples, often including hand-made wedding rings, music, drinks, witnesses, heartwarming vows, ice cream sandwiches postnuptial, and more.

events.title: Rebirth Your Burn: The Birth Canal
events.description:
Join us anytime in a ritual to un-fuck your burn. Planned Playahood is proud to present our new birth canal, for you to shed the sins of yesterday and be reborn unto the dust. Spend a meditative moment in our womb of a dome, then climb into the canal and be delivered! Squeeze your way through and start the rest of your new life! It won't hurt...much. Our nearby bar, The Rusty Speculum, is open from noon to midnight. Please B.Y.O.S (Bring Your Own Sins).

Participants navigate an obstacle course of contraception devices through the interior orifice and twisty turns of the birth canal, reproducing something that we all have in common: that moment we entered into this self-reliant dusty life. Swat a sperm-shaped tether ball, pass through a leaky condom, jump over a big freakin’ bible, through a coat hanger, climb a set of stairs to nowhere, chill in the womb. 
Culminates in a slide through a giant vagina where you are re-birthed near the bar and greeted with heckling encouragement and a possible spank on the bottom from a genuine playa doctor. During clinic events, our camp members will guide canal visitors: If you need lube or a slap on the ass we are there for you. But the experience stands alone at any time of day or night. The love canal loves to be explored.

events.title: Stardust Self-Commitment Ritual

Commit to unconditionally love yourself in a Stardust Goddess led sacred soul vow ceremony. Consummate your White Night dedicated to selfdom inner light with a procession to Temple. Open yourself to your one precious life. Feel the self-love in your heart ignite and spread like wildfire to all those beautiful souls you meet during your voyage through Burning Man and beyond!

What to know:

> Invite your tribe, come with a soulmate or soul sister, or join on an individual quest. All are welcome.

> Dawn yourself in your most expressive white regalia to share your light. 

> Carry a light to shine your way through your experience.

Your Stardust Goddesses will guide you in vows that will glow with your self-proclaimed purpose. Providing yourself and the world with a enlightened troop committed to make all they touch brighter.

Free your light. Shine bright. Commit to self-care this special night!

Symbio is a Burning Man camp built on the essence of symbiosis—a close-knit family of Playa-loving souls who support and uplift one another. Rooted in connection, collaboration, and radical self-expression, we create a welcoming home for our community while fueling the journey of our beloved mutant vehicle, Dirty Owl. More than just a camp, Symbio is a dynamic fusion of energy, creativity, and support, embodying the magic of the Playa through shared experiences and unforgettable adventures.
Home of the Dirty Owl and Dr Hoot

We are a multicultural, multilingual, multidimensional community deeply rooted in the conscious ecology of Burning Man. A hive of change makers fueled by creative passion and love. Living in symbiosis with the earth as we learn to tune our bodies to the rhythms of the universe. Our efforts are to be in service of the earth and humankind as a whole. We invite you to dive in with a purpose to evolve our awareness based human flourishing and to live in symbiosis with all sentient beings.

Step into our Middle eastern-inspired oasis, where we offer a welcoming space to unwind, connect, and experience culture. events.title: Sunrise n Coffee Farewell, forgiveness, acceptance
events.description: Sunrise n’ Coffee n’ Burn story exchange for newbies /Farewell, forgiveness and acceptance group discussion. Some coffee after your all night Man Burn party? Yeah we thought so! Tonight is the Temple Burn and for many it is the spiritual heart of the burn. It has been a week of magic, beginnings and much loss and farewell in the Temple. Even for virgin burners the loss of Larry Harvey leaves an impact on your life experience. All day meditation and quiet discussions about the nature of our community, its support of its members and the tolerance and acceptance needed by ourselves and others. Burners are a unique people, which needs to be disseminated into the larger world. it starts however, between two people and grows from there. Burning Man is peopled by all countries, all races, all faiths or none, all ages, and a rainbow of lovers. Each is welcome and each is equal on the top of our penthouse. Join us for an embrace, a loving remembrance of Larry Harvey and a send-off of this year's magnificent Temple.

events.title: Sunset Meditation, tolerance and acceptance group
events.description: The Playa Penthouse is a tall viewing platform above the normal activity, where solace and peace can be found as the sun goes down on another day. At this point, mid-burn, we gather to share a quiet time and close another day on the Playa. Meditation, or quiet discussion about tolerance and acceptance, both of others and of self, will be the subject talk. Many of us on the Playa, both vets and newbies struggle with how others perceive themselves and others. Many are in states of transition, in relationships, in gender, profession, or simply finding acceptance. We try and express to others how magic they are and give others a mirror in which to view who they really are, with pride and dignity. Sometimes, finding just one other person on earth that see you this way, is enough to keep us going.

events.title: Be Master/Mistress of Stones: The Art of Fresco!
events.description: We’re BAAAAACK! By popular demand, Mr.+Ms. Mudd are again hosting our fresco classes for Burning Man 2018, this time at the BoatHOUSE classroom at Black Rock City Welding and Repair! Our greeting: Come and get PLASTERED! ;o) We invite you all to “Becoming the Master/Mistress of Stones: The Arts of Buon Fresco!” Our host theme camp, Black Rock City Welding & Repair (Thank You for having us! ;), welcomes you all to their location for these wonderful fresco workshops/classes. Here’s the scoop: Apprentices will learn the various old time techniques to create a fresco (block) from scratch to take home. Participants will learn to recreate various historical mixtures that compromise the surfaces of the block, complete with plastering, cartooning, and finally, the stages of painting the actual fresco with pigments. The result? A beautiful, yet portable and tangible, aged piece of buon fresco that becomes your memento of inspired learning at Burning Man. ;) Upon completing your fresco block, you will receive a Playa Master of Arts certificate, authorizing you to be plastered anywhere on the playa! All materials are provided, simply bring yourself, and enjoy this wonderful, enduring art process that is ‘old as time.’  >>>>>That’s NOT all! We’re offering an unique community event; we invite everyone to participate w/ your hearts+energy: on the playa, we offer you our rocking ‘Paper Boats’ teeter totters for creation of wonderful music+inspiration for your soul. The Blurb: #Land Pirates Ahoy! ‘Paper Boats’ be Rockin’ Waves; you Scalawags get to Work— HEAR Music Created by Motion and Winds that Lash About! Decks be scrubbed with Words Learned! DETAILS: There be CHRISTENINGS+Glowing Baby Boat Launchings to HONOR our man Larry Harvey, Mateys! Bubbly cider+water served to all #Land Pirates that attend! (Bring yer cups while supplies last! ;) Find us—Join us on Sunday, August 26, 2018 7-8pm

events.title: Tiki Bar Libations
events.description:
Come join our visually stimulating authentic looking Tiki bar and swinging hammocks and enjoy 1 of 5 different island drinks or enjoy a Kava  tea and meet each other and chat!    We have a few camp members attending the bar and some hanging out at the bar to visit, as our  guest approaches we will ask for ID if they request an alcoholic island drink.  They can slide up and sit on a bar stool for a drink or tea and hang out there visiting or they can sit on a couch or climb into a hammock in the shade located just beside the bar.  We get a lot of new friends hanging out for hours!
    Not everyone is into drinking alcohol so for them we have this awesome herbal elixir alternative, kava tea.  Kava is a drink from the Pacific Islands and is a very large part of island culture.  We offer the tea as a way to maintain maximum inclusivity with all our neighbors and potential visitors who are not drinking alcohol.  Kava is an herbal elixir made from a root that makes you feel deeply relaxed.

How lovely, resting and chatting in our well located shaded hammocks, easily seen and set up so you can watch the world go by and cool off in the shade.  This is an island of chatting, sipping, and swinging hammocks, and yes, some napping does occur at times.

events.description:
Connection is nourishment for the heart and soul. In this guided experience we cultivate embodied presence, and savor the delicious exploration of the space where we meet through eye contact, moments of silence, and heart-felt sharing. Perfect for those craving deep human connection and a supportive environment.

Be you.  Be what you love.  Be free.
The Heart of Now is one of the most powerful transformational experiences anywhere, and has touched the lives of thousands of individuals, helping bring them clarity, healing, connection, and greater joy.

We believe that each individual has within them all the wisdom and energy they need to create what they want and to fully live their dreams. The focus of our workshops is giving each person the opportunity to listen deeply to themselves, noticing what they want and feel in each moment, and to do this not only with themselves but with others. Within an open structure, each individual finds their own path to awareness and healing.

events.title: Fuego’s Organic Snow Cones, No Mercy Karaoke & DJs
events.description:
CAMP FUEGO is thrilled to be coming back in 2022 to 6:30 & B with over 200’ of interactive frontage space! We are delighted to bring you all of these fun things!  
Camp Fuego’s NEW offerings include: the opportunity to lie down in our Ego Death Coffin and put some FUN in the funeral for your ego death, a giant one-line Fuego portrait and broadcasting our stage to all of BRC at 88.3 FM.
Fuego is pleased to again host our No Mercy Karaoke where singers agree to be gonged off the stage “by any person, at any time, for any reason or no reason at all.” And gonged they will be as 9 out of 10 singers are gonged off within a few bars. No hard feelings. Participation allows access to our air conditioned backstage lounge where you can sip on Patrone or Black Label. At Camp F.U. Ego, we encourage you to F*ck Your Ego.
Fuego’s Bar serves the playa’s ONLY super large organic snow cones. Real fruit died to bring you that cool delishousness. Spike it with booze, get a drink to order, have a cold home brewed beer or hard cider at one of the best bars you will find in BRC. 
Our stage is hosts DJs spinning dance parties daily. Contact us to sign up for a set! We’ve got all the equipment. Walk up with your music and tear it up. We also host an open mic and will give musicians special priority to take the stage.
Because we’re fun, we have a misting system, slack line, hula hoops, balance boards and a stage & bar open all day and most the night. Because we’re chill, we have a big ass hammock, chairs, lots of shade and a fire pit at night. Because we’re kind, we have 24-hour water and Gatorade. 
Our namesake is Fuego, a life-sized stretched barbed wire horse with flames from her eyes and mane.
Fuego is proud to be hosting the art car https://antidysentery.com which will be broadcasting LIVE at 88.3 FM all over BRC from a radio tower at Camp Fuego. The art car will be pumping tunes, shooting fire, lighting up a storm and broadcasting near you as it does its thing all over the city!

history.description:
Fuego's No Mercy Karaoke Bar hosts a full top shelf bar & Karaoke Stage with "No Mercy" and "Mo' Mercy" karaoke parties and prizes.  Neighbors love Fuego's Karaoke Stage because "No Mercy" means any listener can end any unpleasant sound at any time--a missed note, fade to dance music! "Mo' Mercy" means well-keyed voices chime in, mic volumes magically adjust and the performance sounds great! 
Fuego's Stage also invites guests to an Open Mic and hosts DJ dance parties, spoken word and musical performances.
Camp Fuego's namesake is its Art Installation, "Fuego", an arresting life-sized stretched barbed-wire prancing HORSE with flame effects coming from her eyes and mane. 
https://www.facebook.com/campfuegoburningman/

events.title: James Joyce - Finnegan Wakes on the Playa 2017
events.description:
Help us re-awaken mythical giant Tim Finnegan, the archetypal Everyman from James Joyce's epic novel Finnegans Wake.  We are asking Burners to radically participate on the Playa in 2017 by reading a single page from Chapter 6 of Joyce's masterpiece on camera.

This will be our second year filming a chapter of Wake at Burning Man. In 2016, we filmed 121 Burners perform chapter 7 (Shem the Penman) of Wake. Here are a few short clips from last year's episode:

https://youtu.be/50hbiUY87W0

Please choose the page you'd like to perform this year from chapter 6 of FW at this link:

http://www.finwake.com/1024chapter6/1024finn6.htm

You can also bring along your favorite piece of music on your phone to accompany your reading if you like, and we will run the audio for your performance thru our mixer.

The final goal of our Finnegan Wakes project is to provide the world with the first ever complete edition of Finnegans Wake on film, performed by Burners from around the world.

We'll be posting updates at the FB group in this posting regarding when and where we'll be filming performances around BRC so please join the FB group for updates. This year, Finnegans Wake on the Playa will be based in the Dream-Land of Camp Fuego at 6:15 and H.

The complete episode (chapter 7) from 2016 can be viewed here:
https://youtu.be/yReE0yoVTSE

history.description: KARAOKE, OPEN MIC, TOP SHELF BAR, ORGANIC SNOW CONES! Camp Fuego invites 2016 Renaissance travelers into a free-thinking and personally expressive environment of striking art, prolific libations, songs of the heart and bold human acrobatics.  Fuego, a life-sized flaming stretched barbed wire horse, halts would-be passers by with her prancing form and fire-blazing eyes and mane. Top shelf drinks, Italian sodas and organic snow cones pour at our very danceable bar. Beautiful voices crone karaoke from the stage with 4 open mics.  Bodies gyrate with DJ NIKO from Verbier, Switzerland, and display perfect human form on the 24/7 slack line.  Minds, ages and cultures meld in the air-conditioned hookah lounge. Prizes are awarded for special performances on the Fuego Stage.

events.title: KARAOKE and open mic daily at Camp Fuego!
events.description: KARAOKE at Camp Fuego, daily Monday through Friday at the 6:00 Plaza @3:15 location.  Serving the best organic snow cones on the Playa.  Play “Mo' Mercy or No Mercy Karaoke". If you to sing Mo' Mercy Karaoke, talented singers stand by on 3 additional mics to jump in and sing the song with you to makes sure the 6:00 Plaza is filled only with the most beautiful sounds of song. Ambitious singers can opt for No Mercy Karaoke, where they sing solo or duet and a panel of judges will either award them a prize for a beautiful song or CUT THEIR MIC and fade back to dance music if anything less. Oh yes, it can get brutal, but it's all love and fun on the playa!

history.description: Tower of Slackjaw is one of the tallest climbable structures on the playa with the best views of the 3:00 sector and beyond.
Tower of Slackjaw is one of the tallest climbable structures on the playa with the best views of the 3:00 sector and beyond.
Tower of Slackjaw.  Best climbing and view from outer 3:00 area.

The Tower Of Slackaw  is an interactive art piece/observation tower shaped vaguely like a spaceship or a virus. The 60 ft tower is absolutely stunning and has serves as a beacon for many a burner, to find their way home in the outer 3:00 sector,  Along with being an exceptional vantage point for photography and observation, WE provide a unique space to converse with real people from around the world. Sun rise and sunset are stupendous. We have bicycle parking stands, lots of dust and some the best views of the Burn and surrounding mountains, this side of the Pecos. Open 24 - 7, we are celebrating the 50th anniversary of the First Folks on the Moon and the 71st anniversary of the the UN Universal Declaration of Human Rights with the dedication of the tower as Transquility Base.

KAHVE (meaning café in Turkish) is an Anatolian-inspired camp serving coffee from 10am-2pm as well as coffee ground readings. We are a stylistic sanctuary for wary travelers on their journey throughout the desert. Find shade among plush pillows, pithy lounges and Turkish lanterns. Enjoy the atmosphere and ambient music while admiring the intricate art pieces. Find a safe haven in one of our Bedouin-styled cabanas to relax and enjoy your beverage.

KAHVE is a sanctuary to provide relief from the hustle and bustle of the stimulating playa. Come by anytime you need a place to chill, relax, take a nap.. or briefly lose yourself in an Anatolian dream.

events.title: Buffer Bush is Buffin' Brilliant! Bbbbbbrrr...
events.description: The buffer bush is a circular fur-covered soft platform with 7 flexible arms coming out of its center. At the end of each one of these arms, effortlessly suspended in mid-air, floats an industrial-grade trigger-pull-controlled variable-speed car buffer. These buffers hang at the ready, waiting for you to use them to massage your friends’ sorenesses away. So many people have a sedentary lifestyle these days - going outdoors for a week can make your joints and muscles ache! Especially after long days of biking around the playa, this happy surprise of a camp-tech massage-cuddle-puddle gift has proven to be extremely popular, with people often coming back or sending their friends to come check it out.

Ware sailor; here there be aliens, and we be registering everyone of them on the planet Tarwater’s temporary island. We’re setting down on the floating sea and setting up our alien registry, complete with self-serve bowling, an eye-opening ring toss, rides in the H.M.S. Kuru, and music by Lord Xibalba — drop by and tell us what planet you’re from.

On the planet Tarwater, salvage isn t just a way of life; it’s the only form of art. Tarwater Camp is where everyone who is an alien, (and who isn’t?), can get their complementary toe-tag, their ass or other body parts stamped with the official Tarwater stamp, (bearing the motto Muttum Non Habemus), or bowl in our spacious one lane bowling alley, or leave an offering at the Altar of the SubModern Computer god, or display your talents and acquire meaningful yet worthless trinkets by performing on the Voluntary Art Victim Stage, or just relax in the comfort of shade and windbreaks.

history.description:
Stoop serves top-shelf neighborly vibes and creates a community space where everyone belongs. Stoop is my 22' foot converted box-truck and is my full-time, tiny home on wheels. And I bring my home and everything that it has to offer to the Burning Man community. I literally get to go to Burning Man in my living room—and so I want my home to be a gift for others. 

As the name Stoop suggests, it is a traveling porch—a space where neighbors can gather, share stories, and offer each other some wisdom they've learned on their journey. Oh, and fresh pour-over coffees, blueberry pancakes, grilled cheeses, and cocktails.

history.description: Camp Wineaux provides a total wine experience with unique, interactive wine tasting events such as blinded tasting and vertical tasting as well as educational (and drinking) events hosted by our camp sommelier, Wine Wench.  We also offer a medieval-theme dust-free chill tent to hang out in. Monday afternoon- "So You Want To Be a Somm?" and blinded tasting; Wednesday afternoon - Wine Appreciation Overview and somm curated tasting; Friday - Friday Finale - vertical tasting of a premium Napa red blend.

events.title: So You Want To Be a Cork Dork?
events.description: Join our sommelier, Cork Dork, & learn what it means & takes to be a somm, how to go about it, & of course drink wine.  Includes how to open a bottle, smell, taste and compare wines.

events.title: Blinded Price-Point Wine Tasting - Whites
events.description: Find the "Holy Grail" of wine - that elusive inexpensive bottle that can compete with the most premium of wines and can be proudly brought to any occasion (as well as drunk daily without going broke)! You will taste four blinded white wines from different price-points and vote for your favorite while learning from our somm, Cork Dork. You might be surprised what you find when the blind is broken.

events.title: Blinded Price-Point Wine Tasting - Reds
events.description: Find the "Holy Grail" of wine - that elusive inexpensive bottle that can compete with the most premium of wines and can be proudly brought to any occasion (as well as drunk daily without going broke)! You will taste four blinded red wines from different price-points and vote for your favorite while learning from our somm, Cork Dork. You might be surprised what you find when the blind is broken.

events.title: Overview of Wine Making, Tasting and Pairing
events.description: Join our somm, Cork Dork, & learn the basics of wine making, tasting & pairing in our dust-free medieval tent. There will be plenty of amazing wines to taste as you "study".  This class is followed by a Cork Dork curated tasting of Old and New World wines.  Test what you learned in class...or just drink and have fun!

events.title: Sommelier Curated Old and New World Wine Tasting
events.description: Join Cork Dork in comparing Old vs New World wines in her personally curated event.  Taste a selection of wines from across the globe and appreciate the differences.  What do you like best?  And why?  Here you will likely find wines you have never tried, or even heard of.

events.title: Friday Finale - Napa Premium Wine Vertical Tasting
events.description: The Wineaux finale! Taste one of Napa's most premium wines in a vertical tasting of five vintages-2001, 2003, 2005, 2006 & 2007. Compare the differences and appreciate the changes due to weather, varietals, time, etc. The best wine ever served in BRC? We think so...no exaggeration!  Relax in our dust-free medieval tent and have another taste, or three.  We'll be here until it's gone.

events.title: Art Abstract Expressionist Movement  by J. Pollock
events.description:
There is no right or wrong approach to Art. Your path is personal. 

This is the day to dance your paint brushes away. Express yourself by moving the brush through the air without touching the canvas! One sweet inspiration to create together, and color your mood.

The workshop is organized and led by Nermina de Wildt, Founder of City3D, 3D Visual Architectural studio based in London, UK and Barcelona, Spain

events.title: The Physiognomy of Jokes
events.description:
The usual perception is that jokes are based on negative stereotypes and prejudices contributing even largely to negative stereotyping between diverse groups. Still, we enjoy them a lot! Where is the line? 

This experiential workshop will provide space for participants to understand the usual structure of jokes, get familiar with communication aspects and explore how they could be used positively in promoting better relations between people. 

The workshop is organized and led by Marko Paunovic, Founder and CEO of Out of the Box International.

events.title: Effective Communication of Emotions and Boundaries
events.description:
Puma will share how to express your emotions with "I statements", so that you can let your camp mates know how you feel without starting World War III. A simple extension will add how to set boundaries so that other people know when they are crossing over one of your comfort barriers.

"It's your responsibility to let other people know how you feel when they're stepping on your toes" - Rosalyn Bruyere

events.title: Flying High and Being Spiritually Grounded
events.description:
Walking the human path while being able to fly at will throughout the higher realms is part of our natural design. From gazing mindlessly out through the window in elementary school classrooms, to blissful meditations, or exploring the universe via medicine journeys as adults, we need to be free to consciously travel out-of-body. We are residents of many dimensions. To function and contribute in the everyday frequencies, we need to be grounded but not limited. If we can achieve even a brief moment of higher consciousness we have the ability to recall the experience, regenerate it via appreciation, and reenter these same spiritual realities using creative imagination. This also means that we can dial our conscious awareness back down in order to focus on the physical world and appreciate its finer aspects. 
This is the life of the “householder” who visits the Mountain Temple of higher consciousness and brings its wondrous vibrations into the local village or city as a balanced human being. 

www.higherselfdiscovery.com

events.title: Group Hands-On Energy Healing
events.description:
The process is simple: a person gets up on the massage table and is surrounded by 3-5 "healers", who envelope the person in an energetic cocoon - it's a wonderful experience! A guide operate as a kind of "air traffic controller" during hands-on-healing sessions, while teaching the process to the others around the massage table. No previous experience is necessary...and you can learn the basic technique in about 30 minutes. Come join us if you need some help, would like to experience it, or would like to be part of the healing team :-)

We'll be repeating this event at:
- 2:00 pm on Tuesday
- 10:00 am on Wednesday
- 1:00 pm on Friday
- 12:00 pm on Sunday

Please help us in sharing and promoting this event :-)

This was a hugely popular event when Craig taught this mini-workshop at Burning Man a number of years ago. There were over 80 people - standing room only - despite being located on the outer circle. Don't miss it!

"I 'see' more of the human energy field when I'm with Craig than at any other time. He 'pumps' up his own energy field to make it easier to see." - Mark Lorentzen

This event will repeat again at 11:00 am on Saturday.

Please help up by sharing & promoting this amazing experience :-)

events.title: Intro to the Chakra System
events.description: Puma will outline the physical, emotional, mental, and spiritual aspects...as well as the 5 - 7 developmental tasks...of the seven major chakras. This will be an interactive lecture, with a few experiential processes.

events.title: Opening the Third Eye
events.description:
Clairvoyance (clear vision) is a natural soul talent. Most people spend a good deal of energy trying to ignore the images that flood their internal screens, clutter their minds and stir up their emotions. But throughout the ages, there will always be creative people who practice opening the third eye in order to see into the depths of this world and to explore other dimensions. Craig will teach powerful ways of opening up one's awareness to higher vision to receive insight and to shine with healing light.
This workshop will offer practical techniques for developing an enhanced ability to see psychically while being supported by intuitive sensing, the inner voice, and sensory feelings for verification. You will also learn methods for seeing energy, viewing facial changes that reveal past lives, perceiving spiritual beings, and gazing into a portal to higher dimensions - all with your eyes wide open. 

www.higherselfdiscovery.com

events.title: Opening your Heart
events.description:
A powerful mini-workshop with Craig Junjulas. Just as opening the third eye center can bring about amazing positive changes in a person’s personal and spiritual life, the act of opening the heart center can bring about an increase in understanding, compassion, empathy, self healing and enlightenment. An open heart allows you to feel protected without shutting down your emotions or closing yourself off to others. By expanding your heart and filling your aura with light, you are actually more protected and more open to the higher frequencies in any environment. Metaphysical techniques and energy demonstrations for bringing the body, mind and spirit into heart centeredness will be offered. 
www.higherselfdiscovery.com

events.title: Psychic Abilities in Everyday Life
events.description:
Craig Junjulas teaches psychic development techniques used to train professional psychics and healers and awaken our natural intuitive abilities to be used in everyday life situations. Everyone has psychic abilities. Psychometry (receiving psychic impressions from an object) can be used to choose antiques, but also to choose the right avocadoes that will be perfect for the weekend’s guacamole. Topics: Photo reading, auras, healing, spirit communication, journeying out of body. 

www.higherselfdiscovery.com

events.title: Releasing Energy Blocks
events.description:
Develop your own methods for releasing old energy patterns in your subconscious mind, aura and physical body. Craig Junjulas shares techniques for gradually releasing the compressed energy that blocks us from our higher potential. Advanced souls, star people, wisdom seekers, light workers, consciousness explorer, burners (or whatever creative people are called these days) brought down an abundance of past life talents (merit) at birth. Needing to hide these spiritual powers from society, they also brought down problems from the past lives, and chose childhood experiences, to block and hide these powers until ready to use them level-by-level. 

www.higherselfdiscovery.com

events.title: Slapdash Sesshin
events.description:
Hello! My playa name is Turtle.

Burning man is amazing. You'll find yourself running around, completely absorbed by the flashing lights and the chaos, and yet completely unable to experience it all. Do you ever feel like you never quite got what you wanted, that you kept missing this or that you'd promised yourself to do? I do, and I love it.

I propose we set aside a time at the Harmonic Convergence Camp to sit together in silence, and in an intentional abandonment of pursuit. I did it once last year. I practically kidnapped a couple people who were spontaneous enough and kind enough to play along with the silliness. It was quite fun. Immediacy, right?

I'm no zen master but I can give you a couple simple pointers if you've never meditated before. I think it will be rejuvenating, relaxing, and pleasantly weird.

events.title: Working with Spirit Guides
events.description:
We are all connected to the same Source of all life, but as individuals, the experience of contact with inner guidance and spiritual beings will be different for everyone. Whether we consider these forms of intelligence to be higher aspects of our own selves or independent entities, the challenge is the same: how do we access and validate this wisdom? Our spiritual guides communicate with us through intuition, and we only need to refine our ability to receive. Craig will teach his unique methods, which include powerful ways of opening up one’s awareness to the realm of divine guidance. You will learn to trust the, information you receive, to control and direct your psychic energy and to explore new ways of creative problem solving.

For more info, see:
www.higherselfdiscovery.com

history.description: Long a refuge from the fierce realities of the BRC’s cutthroat private sector of gifting, Black Rock University is poised to serve, figuratively, as both a tent pole and a beacon lamp in an era plagued by dust storms of uncertainty. The traditional happy hours and intramural sports will be provided.

Black Rock University is a diverse campus of fun-lovers who continue to optimize the equation between community work and good times. We welcome all types of strangers, and invite them to join us in creating body art, performance, protest, recreation, parades, and libations. Go Fighting Dust Flamingos! Black Rock U!

Fear and Hope…Black Rock University responds to these throughout our curriculum which is based on the Future Studies equation pioneered by Dr. M. Mao in the late 1980s. The symbolic Ivory Tower which stands both literally and figuratively at BRU communicates this idea and its meaning: Hope x Fear = Change – Power + Vacation Time.

PICK A CARD

Anonymous Village is a supportive community to help burners stay sober in the challenging environment of the playa and BRC. Members staff the Village hospitality tent and lead recovery meetings in communal meeting space. Recovery Yoga is available daily at 10:30am in the Yoga tent.  We offer a daily meeting schedule including meetings of AA (Alcoholics Anonymous), NA (Narcotics Anonymous), Alanon, SAA/SLAA, FA/OA, CoDA, MA, and PIR.  We also host sober camping as well as a separate area for Alanon's and recovery friends/allies.  We also offer "AnyA" meetings daily that offer an inclusive environment for people recovering from addiction to "ANY" behavior or substance. We welcome curious burners who want to learn about how we burn sober.

events.title: Authentic Relating Games- with Shera
events.description:
How we communicate shapes our world.

Whether it’s with friends, partners, or coffeeshop strangers, our lives are a weave of the interactions we facilitate. Authentic Relating Games are a collection of extensively tested, masterfully led experiences that give players a hands-on taste of both the joy and skills of interpersonal connection leading to trust, vulnerability, connection. 

A traditional Games Gathering has 10-40 participants, and takes you through a series of interactions that are designed to:

Highlight and train body awareness
Create deep connection
Boost empathy
Strengthen community
Be fun!


We challenge you to listen and reflect in realtime, to share your emotional state, to notice and reach into your desire, and to become self-aware within connection. From meditative depths of presence and ecstatic heights of joy, to somber melancholy and heart-pounding fun, we guide an experience all the way through the human condition.

Our players walk away with a profound sense of well-being after being seen, heard, witnessed and validated.  Come participate in the experiment.

events.title: Live Monster Painting
events.description:
I will be live painting monster characters that represent all people. I will incorporate messages that align with one of Burning Man's core values (radical inclusion). I find this value resonates with me and what I am working on showing in my art. I will also use bright colors to symbolize the energy of the wonderful people that make Burning Man what it is. During the live painting I will allow the opportunity for others to include their art within the piece. I find it makes the art much more meaningful when others add their magic and energy to a piece. I hope to bring inspiration, love and make people feel seen by doing this event. Looking forward to being a part of this wonderful experience that is Burning Man. 

I am an artist from Burlington, Vermont. I paint monsters with bright colors and short phrases/ messages that people can relate to. Making art has been a rewarding journey through how many people my art has reached and inspired. The connections that I've made through my work brings so much light to my life. My favorite form of creation is making murals and collaborations. Combining talent and allowing space for others to incorporate their work has led to the most beautiful pieces of art, and I hope to do more of this kind of collaborative creation. I truly believe that we are all creators and have this ability within us, sometimes all we need is encouragement, and someone to believe in us so we can believe in ourselves.

events.title: One-on-One Personal Dream WeavingSessions
events.description: Personal dream weaving is another term for the psychological process of dream working, dream analysis, or dream interpretation. This process involves the intertwining of words, images, ideas and concepts through a process of active imagination, associative reasoning, and intuition, which often yields a more powerful experience of one’s reality. In this powerful 30-45 minute individual dream weaving session, you learn to serve as the Dream Weaver,practicing the weaving and integration of threads between the conscious and the unconscious psyche through your own personal dream material, imaginative visions, or psychedelic experiences.{Deb*} serves as a gentle facilitator to this evolving process, enabling you to weave a bridge between the everyday world and the dream world through the potent connections that arise. Uncover insights and a deeper understanding of who you are, who you desire to be personally, vocationally, and within your relationships, and the footprints you wish to leave behind. (By Appointment Monday-Friday)

events.title: Weave One, Welcome One Dreamcatcher Workshop
events.description: Dreamcatchers are a fascinating Indigenous Peoples tradition.  Although many tribes had dream catchers, the Ojibwa (Chippewa) people may have originated the tradition, according to some historians and ethnographers. These researchers note that the Ojibwa word for the dream catcher is "asabikeshiinh,” which translates to "spider." The spider is associated with the ‘web of life,’ in that each and every individual has the ability to weave their own life and choose their own pattern, knowing that some paths will be easy and some are meant to be challenging. The dream catcher is known to be a symbol of protection, while the web, according to legend, connects each person to nature and the Great Spirit. Learn how to design and craft your own dreamcatcher as you free your mind and beat the heat during this relaxing workshop.Weave something beautiful to leave behind as a gift, while welcoming one designed by another. {Wednesday 11a-3p. All materials and facilitation provided by Deb*}.

history.description: Camp HIGHKU is a zen-inspired oasis offering shade, hydration, and good vibes to weary travelers. Step through our iconic torii gate into a tranquil space where you can cool off with ice-cold lemonade and coconut water, relax under misting shade structures, and connect with fellow Burners. Our serotonin workshops, led by medical professionals and Zen practitioners, provide meaningful conversations and wellness insights. With a welcoming atmosphere, chill music, and thoughtful gifting, Camp HIGHKU is a refreshing retreat where you can rest, recharge, and reconnect before heading back into the dust.

events.title: Kids Memorial Making Workshop
events.description:
Temple Homage, a camp of temple builders and guardians, is offering a workshop for children. Come join us at the Black Rock Explorers Headquarters located in Kidsville (5&E) to create a memorial art offering. There will be storytelling, and supplies to make a memorial. 

You can help your kid take your memorial to the temple on your own time. Or Temple Homage can collect your kid's memorial and bring it to the temple for you.

Friendly reminder: A parent or guardian must accompany child to all Black Rock Explorer events.

events.title: Burning Man Live Kids Episode: Playa interviews
events.description:
Calling all kid reporters! Burning Man Live, Burning Man Project’s in-house podcast, is teaming up with the Black Rock Explorers to support an all-kids episode of Burning Man Live, and we’re going to record it in Black Rock City.

That’s right, kids are going to take over the mic, become roving reporters and ask Black Rock Citizens the questions they want answers to.

Join us in Kidsville for the kick-off meeting and then strike off into the city to record some interviews!

events.title: Darkwad Patrol Light Distribution in Kidsville
events.description:
"Darkwad Patrol" distributes lights to dark burners and abandoned bikes. And they need the help of the Black Rock Explorers (and their caregivers) to protect the citizens of Black Rock City. Darkwad Partol would like to give the gift of "the light", by sharing light kits for distribution.

Come to Black Rock Headquarters located in the center of Kidsville to receive a light kit. First come, first served. One kit per kid (Adult must be present for pick up.) No shaming when gifting.

You will be able to gift lights to fellow burners who are unlit or poorly lit and would also leave blinky lights attached to dark, unattended bikes. At 6:30, Shireen will share the story of how the light kits came to be and provide instructions on gifting them to “dark Burners.”

Light kits
Each pouch is a flat zippered bags with a DEPUTY Darkwad Patrol sticker on the side. 9” x 4.5” Kids can personalize or gift as is. Kids are welcome to take one light from the bag to place on their own bikes. 

Friendly reminder: A parent or guardian must accompany child to all Black Rock Explorer events.

events.title: The Talk
events.description: Having that first talk about substance use is never easy, but we can make it easier! Join Mitchell Gomez from DanceSafe (with your older teen or without) for a talk that emphasizes harm reduction, rational and factual information, and healthy decision-making. Abstinence-only drug education programs like D.A.R.E. have been shown to statistically increase hard drug use in those who go through them, but there is a better way. It’s never too early for the talk! In the center of Kidsville (bring an extra chair or two!)

Kukeri are people wearing elaborate self-made fur costumes and hideous animalistic masks. Every year at the beginning of spring Kukeri dance to scare away evil spirits and bring joy, happiness and prosperity for the whole village throughout the year. 
In addition to just having the festive and carnival-like appearance, we have infused our ancient MUTANT PET with a modern soul - mixing ancient bagpipe melodies and live drum beats with various electronic music styles.

KUKER GROUNDSWELL CAMP. 
The RITUAL DANCERS named KUKERI have been inseparable part of the Balkans and more specifically of Bulgaria for thousands of years and represent the idea of people putting hideous animalistic masks and dressing up in elaborate self-made fur costumes every year at the beginning of Spring season to scare away evil spirits and bring joy, happiness and prosperity for the whole village throughout the year.
Behind the camp is a team of community builders and music and arts festival organizers, who will teach some old-time line-dances - long semi-circle chains of people holding hands and dancing under the accompaniment of Bulgarian gaida (bagpipe), mixed with modern methods of self-expression - electronic beats, contemporary musical instruments and new technology gadgets.

Dusty Taint Juke Joint
Inspired by 1940s Negro Juke Joints, our space blends music, games, and drinks—where passersby can unwind after a long day on the Playa. More than a party, it's a multi-cultural, sexually diverse gathering that sparks conversations and new friendships.

As the sun sets, we toast the night with laughter, connection, and games that push boundaries. Cards, parlor games, and themed gatherings keep the vibe lively in a relaxed, informal setting.

In a world of hate and noise, we stand for love and unity, celebrating cultures, embracing differences, and learning from one another. At Dusty Taint Juke Joint, we don't just party—we strive to build a better Burning Man community.

Our camp is a playground for the free-spirited and a home base for nomads with a thirst for connection and adventure. We're a global tribe of dream-chasers and boundary-pushers, supporting each other to live our best lives; from the peaks of New Zealand to the shores of Thailand, and everywhere in between.  We are solid as a community and feel that the space we hold between us can inspire other Burners to live courageously and less conventionally, as we all aim to do, as a community together. Join us, where every moment is a chance to shake up the soul and sprinkle a little more magic into the burn.

history.description: Our camp is a playground for the free-spirited and a home base for nomads with a thirst for connection and adventure. We're a global tribe of dream-chasers and boundary-pushers, supporting each other to live our best lives; from the peaks of New Zealand to the shores of Thailand, and everywhere in between.  We are solid as a community and feel that the space we hold between us can inspire other Burners to live courageously and less conventionally, as we all aim to do, as a community together. Join us, where every moment is a chance to shake up the soul and sprinkle a little more magic into the burn.

history.description: Soul Shakers is a global community of nomads from a secluded beach on Koh Phangan island in Thailand where yoga, meditation & conscious living are the norm. This tropical paradise has brought together like-minded souls from around the globe & we are coming to Burning Man to bring some of the practices, interests and ceremonies that are the DNA of our island life to the playa. We hope to inspire others to live more courageously, compassionately, consciously, and less conventionally, and aim to shake some souls with our music, dance, yoga, and conscious workshop offerings.

history.description: Burn and Dye! Spin the Wheel of Remorse, drink some cold Texas wine, dye a silk scarf. What could be better?

Dye a silk scarf! Drink wine! Have a snow cone or margarita in our huge monkey hut! OR visit the Mermaid Bar and enjoy a tropical rum concoction. Spin the Wheel of Remorse! We bring all the supplies needed so you can create your own piece of functional art (a silk scarf is an excellent dust mask). Lounge in our shade while drinking an icy beverage and play board games with new friends. The Wheel of Remorse has entertained our neighborhood for six years now and also features a kid friendly side. Our "line tenders" look for kids in line and immediately bring them to the front of the line, flip the wheel around, and give the kiddos a kid friendly task to complete from the wheel. We love kids and invite you to bring your kiddos to play with us.

| Tea blending workshops | Mead Tastings | Honey Tastings | Bee-keeping Expertise |

history.description: Our camp provides on-playa counseling services, offering burners a space to process emotions, navigate conflicts, and reconnect with their experience in a meaningful way. In addition to one-on-one support, we create opportunities for self-guided reflection through interactive spaces like a zen garden, a walkable labyrinth with an inspiration chest at its center, and a Zen Tent for journaling, art, and quiet contemplation. The Spanktuary is an immersive and inclusive camp dedicated to the exploration and celebration of the art of spanking within a consensual, respectful, and fun filled environment.  Our camp is a haven for enthusiasts of all experience levels, from the curious novice to the seasoned practitioner.  The Spanktuary offers a space where participants can delve into the multifaceted aspects of spanking.  We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming and judgment-free zone where individuals are encouraged to have fun as they explore their desires!  Equipped with various  accoutrements such as paddles, whips and bare hands,  participants can choose to spank or to be spanked. Have your spanking with bacon, whipped cream or a shot. Come one, come all to celebrate everyday just like it's a holiday. We bring the spirit of celebration to the playa with our life-sized billiards game.
Beyond the game, our camp invites burners to engage with interactive installations:  
New Year's Resolution Board – Share your dreams and intentions for the year ahead.  
Love Letter Board – Leave anonymous messages of love and appreciation for fellow burners.  
Día de Muertos Wall – Honor and remember loved ones by adding their names and messages.  
Christmas Exchange – Leave a small gift, take a small gift—embracing the joy of giving.

events.description:
Join us for lessons in tickling. Bring a partner or friend to enjoy the experience. We will be calling on volunteers to help demonstrate if you desire. Space may be limited!

Kelli Lynn Sage (aka Warcry) and Bagelfather are here to talk about tickling in our lives, whether it is playful, sensual, or as a power exchange dynamic. As we go through the class, we welcome volunteers to come up and be a demo for some of our lessons. All contact will be consensual and negotiated with safe words in use at all times. We will start with our introductions and then go around the room for short introductions of our participants depending on how many are in attendance. We will cover our experiences with tickling and why we enjoy it. We will go from the sensual side to the erotic and move on to power exchange dynamics covering tickling in various scenes, including using tickling for an interrogation scene! It doesn’t matter if you are a novice, experienced, or just curious. All levels of experience are welcome! If you look to be under age, please make sure you bring a photo ID for verification as this is an 18 or over event.

Spinny's Playground is a re-imagination of Sticky's Playground, a Burning Man camp designed to rekindle the childlike joy of physical challenge and play. As kids, we naturally tested our limits for fun, but as adults, we often lose that instinct, turning movement into a means to an end rather than a source of joy. At Spinny's, playfulness reigns through mega-sized playground structures, type-2 fun experiences, and extreme schoolyard games hosted by our Recess Hall Monitors. From 360-degree see-saws and a spinning bar to rope climbs and dance floors, we invite burners to rediscover the thrill of movement on the playa. Created by a passionate crew of artists, engineers, and dreamers from Reno, Nevada. We don't stop playing because we grow old—we grow old because we stop playing.

history.description: 3SP (Third Space Place) is your dusty, comfy front porch/living room combo serving as a Black Rock City "third space" — a relaxing, community spot offering a real sense of welcome and belonging beyond one's dwelling ("first space") and one's workplace ("second space"). As with any true third space, guests can stop by, relax, ask for directions, chat, or PARTICIPATE in one of 3SP's events focusing on all kinds of issues: being introverted on Playa; navigating the world as a stutterer/stammerer; identifying unconscious biases; Native-American appreciation versus appropriation; relaxing with essential oils or a camera obscura mediation; and more. We've been around since 2015 and we've got campers from DC, NYC, Minneapolis, Philly, Portland, LA, and beyond. Come on by!

events.title: White Wednesday Wedding Dress Parade
events.description:
For 10 Years we have hosted the Fabulous Wedding Dress Parade. Over 200 gather for our dress-up party with champagne, chivalry, and shenanigans followed by our annual Parade to the Man. We provide over 200+ wedding dresses and all necessary accessories in one of  Camp P3s largest yearly opportunities for inclusion.  

Liquored up and gussied down, we parade!  Bar stops and shenanigans grow as our numbers rise before we hit the Esplanade. Our annual marriage ceremony ensues; bestowing our radically open and dusty vows followed by an "Enforced Divorce Clause" (on Monday) allowing a few days to consummate vows. Thusly committed- we march on towards the man and think about what we have done.

history.description:
Camp P3: is a family, our family, misfits as they may be.  We believe in synergy, love, compassion, friendship, and that each morning should start with good coffee and/or a Bloody Mary. 

What does the P3 Stand for well you get to decide for some it's Princess Party Palace, for other Passionate Prometheans Stealing Playa Fire, Puros Pinchy Pendejos, Peoples Party Place, Purely Positively Perverse, or Perversion of Positive Perspective.  Each year at burning man our camp and each individual goes through a metamorphosis giving unprecedented access to and insight about the upper range of human experience.  Regardless of your definition Camp P3 it is incubating a movement to storm heaven and Steal Fire. It's a revolution of human possibility.

This year for the 8th year in a row, we be hosting the Wedding Dress March on White Wednesday! You must join us for our annual Wedding Dress Wednesday Parade! We start with ceremony to de-corks the first champagne bottle, followed with a group toast and a dancing procession to the chapel. Who gets married….does it really matter? We have dresses and champagne!  Do you like to play dress up?  Stop by and as one of our "fashion-istas" to dress your from our endless opportunities in our boutique!  Each morning we embrace the day with Nitro Coffee and a Bloody Mary Bar or join us for a spectacular evening of bourbon tasting.  One may stop by and see the "Now-A-Saurus", the most rare of mutant vehicles.

events.title: Consent FRIES; Consent, becomes the 11 principle
events.description:
Bringing back to the Playa
U-Turn and Schamane will be presenting their signature class all about the communication you want to have each time you settle in with a play partner(s) in a sexual situation.  These TED style talk: “Consent FRIES” (Freely Given, Reversible, Informed, Enthusiastic, and Specific) will benefit every burner.

events.title: Sunset  Bourbon and Bitters
events.description:
Let “Rogue Silver” of Deep Playa show you the possible…

While the best way to drink Bourbon is ‘the way you like to drink it’... Our resident expert, “Rogue Silver” of Deep Playa, is ready to shine the educational limelight deep into a selection of beautifully crafted bottles.  Ripples of spice, sweet fruit, fresh oak, hints of sweet coffee, light caramel, corn tortilla, dry apple peel freshness, and honey are only a few of the flavors awaiting your shivering tongue… and that’s just the Bourbon. A world within a world opens up with the addition of Silver’s profound range of bitters. Find A dynamic range of flavors accessible within each Bourbon as unique craft bitters drive individual flavors into neighboring dimensions and beyond.

events.title: Heart-Opening Hatha Yoga
events.description: “Love and compassion are necessities, not luxuries. Without them, humanity cannot survive.” - Dalai Lama. LuvClub will be hosting three days of grounding and intentional Hatha yoga practice. In this age of over-stimulation and distraction, it's vital that we find time to bring some awareness to ourselves; to nurture ourselves and cultivate a sense of love and compassion for our own bodies and minds. Combining physical postures with conscious breathwork and an inward focus, LuvClub's Hatha yoga classes will help you to restore a sense of balance and stability. Each class will finish with a guided meditation, moving you towards a deeper state of consciousness from which to reconnect to your source. We'll send you back out into the Playa with your heart open, firmly rooted in yourself.  BYO mat, water, and an open mind

Our Sunset Disco Party offers a place to feel the luv as the last of the sun-drenched day disappears behind the mountains. In the twilight, LuvClub comes to life with Disco - the music of a decade intoxicated with the joy of the party.  Disco tunes and drink specials (like our camp’s LuvPotion elixirs) designed to give you a place to start the evening as you bring in your boogie night.  Don't forget your LuvLicense for entry (expedited processing available - show your junk).

Gigsville embodies decades of Burning Man history, mixing a spirit of playful anarchy with a deep commitment to inclusion. Renowned for our legendary fuckery, we create a space where creativity and rebellion flourish. Here, every form of individuality is celebrated, from seasoned burners to wide-eyed newcomers. Our ethos is built on challenging norms and embracing everyone with a penchant for mischief and a heart for community. Expect the unexpected: from mind-bending installations to spontaneous performances, all wrapped in our trademark humor. Gigsville: where history, hijinks, and heartfelt acceptance collide.

Gigsville originally started as the whirligig village at Burning Man in 1998.  Since then, this community of over 300 people has become an active, year-round group of fuckos dedicated to the finer points of jackassery and better living through death.  All over the world you will find citizens of Gigsville, but their primary hangouts are in Northern and Southern California.

Gigsville is the whirligig village at Burning Man, established in 1998. Designed and built by its residents, we have had theme camps, events, and have tried to create a small freaky town atmosphere to the large city that is Black Rock City.

The community of Gigsville will be hosting its annual That Thing in the Desert retreat between August 29th and September 2nd 2002 in Black Rock City, NV. Come sing, dance or drop your pants! All participants welcome – Gigsville is a No Media zone.

Designed and built by its residents, we have theme camps, performances, art projects, events, and have tried to create a small freaky town atmosphere in Black Rock City. Gigsville has camped on the Esplanade at Burning Man for the last 3 years. In 2001 we plan to move back a few streets, increase our camping space, and let our creativity expand even further.

After last years success, Gigsville is ready to reign again. They have theme camps (Temple of Atonement, Gift Camp, Camp Skynyrd, The Delightful Paintbrush, Sandalla, Dish Camp, Pole Camp, Camp Digital, The Last Outpost, Storm from the East, Prom Camp), Interactive Art (Gateways, Dancing Gig-men, a Good Vibes VooDoo Doll), Public Games (Black Rock Electrical Parade, Gigsville Drag Races, He-man competition (to contrast), Radio Controlled Demolition Derby, Community potluck dinner, Homecoming Dance) and more! events.description: We will hold a session for Burners to come together and do a quick-writes. We will share the prompt and a relevant quote at the start of the session and then start the clock. Past topics have included Curiosity & Chaos, Death, Pleasure & Pain, and Ambition. When time’s up, there will be the option to read what we have written to the group, soliciting feedback if desired. We will gift Prototopia notebooks and pens to participants. This is a weekly event in one of our SF communes, and find that it is a way to experience a side of your community members that daily interactions rarely surface.

history.description: Prototopia gives you a space to come think, express, and communicate as humans with humans, while exploring what that means in the context of technology and artificial intelligence. Come share your ideas and stories of how to create a real-life utopia, sit down for a coffee date and connect with a perfect stranger, learn the 10 Burning Man Principles by interacting with our robot companions, or simply join us for our nightly gratitude circles.

events.title: Prototopia Salons
events.description:
Let’s hold space for ideas that, even if they seem conceivable only on Playa, strive to create change in the default world. Do you have an idea how to fix, replace, redesign, rethink, or praise our current system? Please put your name down on the speakers' list. In the spirit of rapid prototyping, we’ll be rapidly iterating: each talk is 5 minutes long, 2 minutes mandatory Q&A.

These talks are a reminder that when contemplating our collective future, we should aim high while celebrating the fact that the journey can occur gradually, that the road is long and steep, and that we might never arrive at the end. But that’s okay because in the end, everything is good. If it’s not good it’s not the end.

As a student at Robot University, you will attend 10 classes to learn radical inclusion, gifting, decommodification, radical self-reliance, radical self-expression, communal effort, civic responsibility, leaving no trace, participation, and immediacy via robotics. 

Take Turing tests, win Roomba races, and guess when your job can better be done by a robot - fun!

If you pass Asimov's final exam, graduation awaits you!

history.description:
Our camp this year is inspired by the 2003 movie "The Triplets of Belleville."

Our installation will center around one scene in particular. In the scene, 4 Tour de France cyclists, abducted by the mafia, are smuggled into an underground gambling ring. Each cyclist is put onto a bike-like machine in front of a crowd of bettors. Each machine drives a miniature statue; the faster the cyclist pedals, the farther the statue goes along the "course". In the film, whenever a statue falls behind, the cyclist powering him is "taken out back" and you hear a loud bang. 

We'll be recreating this scene. You can ride up, hook up your bike, and see if you can get your horse to the finish line first. Any cyclists that fall behind will be "taken out back" and shot with a water gun.

To the side of the main event, we'll have a playa dome where cyclists can change into vintage jerseys. We'll even have an area for anyone who wants to shave their legs like a TRUE CYCLIST.

events.title: Burning Man Ultramarathon
events.description:
What: The Seventh Annual Burning Man Ultramarathon.

How: Pull on your running sneakers, grab a bottle of water or hydration pack, your favorite energy snacks, and hit the playa for one of the most unique and insane 50ks out there. Wear whatever you love best while running – whether that’s a tutu, sports bra and tights, or nothing at all.

Where: Black Rock City (Nevada – exact location info here)

When: Tuesday, August 30th, 2016, 5 a.m.

Who: You! Burners and ultrarunners of all types!

Why: Because it’s fun. Because it’s insane. Because it’s the ultimate high. Because you want to challenge yourself. Because we are working on really rad finishers’ presents! Because the race is a party! Because you don’t mind people chasing after you with bottles of whiskey while you run!

What else: Pink Lightning Camp will be the race headquarters, start, finish, and aid station. Stop by to view the big map, results, ask questions, use our foam rollers and running sticks, or just hang out with some friendly folks. During the race, we’ll have cocktails, fun, music, and lots of cheering. Have your friends come to the healthiest party on the playa! Come on by to volunteer, hang out, pace, or run!

M4M, M4W, W4W, W4M, platonics, and casual encounters... any messages posted throughout the week will be collected, archived, and the "best of" subjected to dramatic readings!  Themes may run from sweet, to spicy, maybe a bit salty... so the crazy ultramarathon runners (and non-runners) at Pink Lightening camp will be serving up suitably-themed cocktails: one sweet, one spicy, and one salty at all times.  Even if you haven't posted in the hopes of finding your own "missed connection," join us!  Costumes and impromptu re-enactment is strongly encouraged.

No yoga experience is necessary. If you have a mat or a towel, bring it. We will have some extras (but not enough for everyone). Bring some water.

This is open to everyone at Burning Man, not just runners.

Apo-the-neum (place of divine elevation) is a visual, sonic and haptic instrument intended to "transport" visitors through participatory immersion. Comprised of two nested chambers made of back-to-back LED nets (13,940 nodes in all), Apotheneum presents multiple canvases for collaborating visual artists and an immersive sound system for collaborating sound artists. Measuring 40 x 40 x 40 feet, Apotheneum's cubic antechamber envelops a thirty-foot "inner sanctum" that opens to the sky and is anchored by a 24-foot pressure-sensing "bed" on which visitors are invited to recline, and be transported.

At night, evoking aspects of the natural world—wind, fire, lightning, rain, stars, gravity, people and animals—Apotheneum encourages inward contemplation through multi-sensory somatic immersion.

Castra Ursi is pioneering a fully solar-powered, efficient, and inspiring camp model while showcasing the future of sustainable infrastructure on Playa.

This year, we bring The Ursas, two large, interactive, illuminated bear sculptures powered entirely by solar energy. Our camp will also serve as a hub for renewable energy education, offering a behind-the-scenes look at large-scale solar systems for camps and public art.

We are excited to promote the integration of art into the city, demonstrating how sustainable, interactive artworks can shape urban spaces. Through live demonstrations and discussions, we'll explore the future of fuel-free energy solutions at Burning Man and beyond.

Castra Ursi aims to lead and accelerate the future of what Burning Man's camps must become. It is a camp that is simultaneously efficient and comfortable, informative and inspiring, and one that is powered entirely by renewable energy.

Castra Ursi will provide public charging for participants' devices and small electric-powered mutant vehicles and will host several panels  engaging in topics specific to renewable energy on-playa and renewable energy powered public art.

history.description: Come hang out in this retro 1950s-era kitchen where you can meet Deaf Granny.  If she likes you, she might give you cookies and juice.  And she will make you laugh while teaching you some signs and cultural proclivities and a thing or two about communicating strictly in visual, as opposed to auditory, space.  If she is in the mood, maybe you will get PB&J or a shot of tequila.  Watch out, though -- if you're naughty, she may spank you and cuss you out in ASL or make you sweep the floor.  But never forget Deaf Granny loves you and you won't leave without a hug and stretched-out... comfort zone.

IPOW-Indigenous People of World wants to bring Indigenous people and allies from around the world together to share their stories and life experiences. The basis of the camp is to create a place to share Indigenous culture and educate all who want to join our camp or events to learn. This camp will be a place to spread different cultures and teachings from all over the world for all that want to learn. We are honored by our Two Spirit community that support and are an integral part of our camp. The camp will be safe space for all Indigenous people for all over the world and allies. It is a place where people can learn and share traditions, foods before and after colonization, games, languages, and music. We will host interactivity events-based food and the gathering of people.

Kentucky Fried Campers only need one spice, and that's the spice of life. And if you want some, join us any time of day or night. We begin each morning with the best hot breakfast in Black Rock City; a shot of good Kentucky bourbon served with a fried baloney sandwich. Afternoons you'll find us relaxing in our Olde Kentucky Dome, crafting, napping, music making, perhaps a bit of gossiping, and lots of just watching the Black Rock City whirled go by. Fried baloney sandwiches & bourbon shots served gingham style with a heaping helping side of Southern Hospitality.  You won't wanna miss the Whoreshoe Derby, Kentucky Fried Cotillion and late-night KFC Cock Fights in our olde Kentucky Dome!

We bring gentile Kentucky hospitality, combining elements of sweet down home with a sprinkling of agro/punk for spicing up the scene. Start your morning with a gourmet fried bologna sandwich to coat your stomach. Add a shot of KY Bourbon to rinse the Playa from your throat. Guests are welcome 'round the clock in our Old Kentucky Dome, with plenty of fun activities from yoga, spa treatments, crafting, storytelling, music playing, & just good ole socializing. Our dome is cool & shaded during the day & stocked with plenty of warm blankets & cuddle spots for cool nights in BRC. Everyone is welcome to join us mid-week at our illuminated Kentucky Fried Cotillion! Don't miss the fastest minute in BRC sports with the annual Whoreshoe Derby! HEYY!

history.description:
As longtime citizens of Black Rock City, we've seen how Burning Man catalyzes transformation in those who fully embrace it.

PlayAlchemist was born from a dream: to create a space that deepens this journey—a container for activation, co-creation, and personal alchemy.

Through immersive programming day and night, we foster exploration, introspection, and connection. At its heart stands the Pyramid—a 71-foot-high, 111-foot-base structure—both a crucible of alchemy and a beacon of higher consciousness.

Inside, participants journey through the seven stages of alchemy, while outside, the seven days of Burning Man mirror this transformation, uniting individual and collective evolution.

As citizens of Black Rock City for several years, we observed how the ingredients of Burning Man caused a transformation in all who experienced it. 

PlayAlchemist was born out of a dream to bring the gift of a campus designed to further enable deepening of this experience, a container for activation and co-creation of Alchemical personal transformation. 

PlayAlchemist contributes to the interactivity of Burning Man through immersive programming day and night, and the Pyramid is a physical representation of this crucible; of alchemy and of higher consciousness. 

Once inside this 71 ft high, 111 ft base great pyramid, you are initiated to embark on an internal journey of personal transformation through the seven stages of alchemy; while outside, the seven days of Burning Man unfold.

Welcome to the SoundCloud. Your cloud-themed portal to high-vibe frequencies and dreamy beats. We’re a crew of sound enthusiasts serving up elevated sounds from our cozy, cloud lounge. Float with us through ambient bliss, deep grooves, and healing vibrations on the fluffiest clouds in the multiverse.

We are an eclectic collective of sound therapists, healers, ceremonialists, psychedelic therapists, musicians, DJs, and sound enthusiasts, united by a deep love for vibration, frequency, and connection. From meditative sound journeys to soulful beats and heart-opening ceremonies, we offer a full spectrum of sonic experiences designed to uplift, align, and inspire.

At our dreamy cloud-themed lounge on the playa, you’ll find a sanctuary to relax, vibe, and recharge — wrapped in soft textures, loving energy, and surround-sound goodness. We also roam the dust in style aboard Claudius, our custom cloud art car, sharing healing frequencies and danceable grooves wherever we float.

Whether you’re seeking stillness, movement, or just good vibrations, SoundCloud is here to carry you — gently, playfully, and powerfully — on waves of sound and spirit.

history.description:
Common Ground is a collaborative community of individuals from all walks of life, seeking to enhance the profound Burning Man 2015 experience with a variety of spiritual practices, primarily yoga and meditation. 

On camp site will be a large yoga tent, equipped with props, singing bowls and sound system. Common Ground will host 1 sunset and 1 sunrise daily classes on camp premises, of vinyasa, kundalini and restorative practices. Our Deep Playa Yoga Project will send out the camp's art car, The OMobile, to pick up interested yogis out into the depths of the desert for one pop up class at a random hour each day. 

The yoga tent will be available for meditation throughout the day, and an additional tent equipped with essential oils and Ayurvedic concoctions will serve as a massage parlor for all to enjoy.

history.description: Come experience Burning Man on many levels at Camp Touch This by climbing onto our 3- Story Cuddle Puddle and Lounge.  If you are afraid of heights, come dance it out with us at one of our afternoon frozen drink parties.

Stop by to climb the scaffolding and gain a different perspective on your day - or maybe your life, lock up a naughty friend in our camp jail, or dance it out with us at one of our afternoon frozen drink parties.

This misbehaving camp has fun planning adventures and misadventures all week. Do you have any naughty or misbehaving friends? If so, stop by and lock them up in the Camp Touch This Jail where you can get your mugshot and the full locked up experience. How will you post bail? CTT is the place to visit if you want to be locked up, take home a souvenir photo, or check out the creative kinetic bike sculptures.

events.title: Cop Day
events.description: Have you or your friends been naughty? Bring them by to be arrested and locked up in jail. Or, join our cop force, and help us find misbehaving burners. Our jail is open all day everyday, so bring your misbehaving friends by for the full locked up experience. Thursday is our special Cop Day where we patrol the playa streets all in good fun and humor. There is no shortage of burners that volunteer to get cuffed and arrested by our squad to get taken into custody.  The theme song from "CHiPs" and other old school, cop inspired tunes -- provides the soundtrack for our shenanigans.  As the Force travels from club to club we stop to issue citations for infractions committed by burners that demonstrate the need for "special guidance."

history.description: This year Camp Touch This will be hosting the "Green Energy Strip Club". We will be harnessing the sexual energy provided by the erotic beauty of dancing females (volunteers). Aroused members of the audience will not be charged any kind of entry fee, but will be required to channel their heightened libido-state into physical motion that will provide the power to run the lights, music, etc, creating a beautiful and erotic space for the dancers to enjoy.

Allow your reach to exceed your grasp at Camp Touch This, where we are 1/2 dead-serious and 100% totally ridiculous. Flamboyant Freaks from Far into the Future embark to reintroduce you to your Jojobabacacalala. Find your way into our BlackLight Kiva-Dome to experience your transformation through the Art, Music, Dance and Improv of fellow Burners. A very specific Future Prediction will be made for you according to your “Asstro-Illogical Whore-a-Scope”. With your newfound courage, allow yourself to be served “Ginnerators” from the Popes at our “Pope & Beer” bar. With your newfound True Soul Design, and in the disguise of a Pleasant Mother Pheasant Plucker, allow us to guide you to the Beaches of Djibouti. Watch out for the Darth Vader Landscaping Crew and the High Priest of Uranus. Meet Discharged members of the BRC Military. Bring a suitcase with you from the default world of any “baggage” you may have, and together we will burn it all forever. All this taking place in the middle of the “Critical-need-for-Tits” bike parade – where we will again transform – this time into a gang of milk hungry oversized toddlers. Live in the moment, use your imagination and interact! Get crazy or be lazy.

Come for the coffee and stay for the fun! Test your skill on our 10' Hooker & Pegger game, enjoy an erotica reading, or throw a dildo to drench your buddy! Don't forget to take a complimentary porno mag while you're at it.

events.title: Intro to Vipassana Guided Meditation
events.description:
Intro to Vipassana meditation, using a recording from the original teacher SN Goenka. It is a somatically-based concentration form of meditation that is often taught in multiple day retreats. In the first course we lay the foundation of the practice.

Vipassana can be translated as “Insight,” a clear awareness of exactly what is happening as it happens. This form of meditation, focuses on seeing things as they are. It comes from Theravada, which is Buddhism’s oldest school of thought. This meditation will offer recorded guidance from the S.N. Goenke, one of the foundational teachers of this form of meditation from India.

events.title: Buddhist Recovery
events.description: Buddhist Recovery is a community of people who are using the practices of mindfulness, compassion, forgiveness, and generosity to heal the pain and suffering that addiction has caused in our lives and the lives of our loved ones. We are a Buddhist-oriented, nontheistic recovery program that does not ask anyone to believe anything, only to trust the process and do the hard work of recovery. No previous experience or knowledge of Buddhism is required. This program provides a systematic approach to recovering from all forms of addiction.

events.title: Removing The Masks Of Patriarchy Workshop
events.description: This is an opportunity to reflect on how the day-to-day requirements of living in our culture and being accepted have suppressed our natural self-expression. So often, we suppress the joy of following our own inner compass based on our values in order to survive being in our patriarchal world. By removing these masks and self-suppression tactics (like removing layers of an onion) we experience ourselves closer and closer to our purest and self-expressed core of who we are.
