events.title: Buddhist Chanting: Nam Myoho Renge Kyo
events.description: Join us in the Lotus Dome for the daily recitation of Nam Myoho Renge Kyo and morning gongyo (the practice of chanting two chapters from the Lotus Sutra). In the Lotus Sutra, Shakymuni Buddha revealed that every human being can attain enlightenment in their present form. Through chanting Nam Myoho Renge Kyo, one can create a state of unshakable happiness. Buddhism is a practice and everyone is welcome to join. Each day after chanting, together we will study a Buddhist concept, answer questions, and share experiences. Novices, new practitioners, and curious souls welcome.

events.title: Yogananda Energization and Prayer for World Peace
events.description: Together let us become “Awake and Ready” with Paramhansa Yogananda’s Energization Exercises & Prayer for world peace.  Prepare your mind and spirit for another uplifting day on the Playa!  Yogananda claimed the purpose of exercise was to awaken an inner energy source.  His series of energization exercises were designed to bring both energy and calm.  The exercises “purify the bloodstream and recharge every cell with cosmic energy.” The aim is to gain increased awareness and control over your life force and to identify more with the soul than the body.  This event happens just before yoga and meditation at Buddha Camp and is a great way to wake up and prepare your body and mind for those sessions.  All the exercises are done from a standing position and anyone, regardless of fitness level, can benefit.  Following the exercises we will repeat together, Yogananda's Peace and Harmony Prayer for World Peace.  This event is 30 minutes long.  Come join us!

events.description: Join us in the Lotus Dome for the daily recitation of Nam Myoho Renge Kyo and morning gongyo (the practice of chanting two chapters from the Lotus Sutra). In the Lotus Sutra, Shakymuni Buddha revealed that every human being can attain enlightenment in their present form. Through chanting Nam Myoho Renge Kyo, an individual is able to awaken this enlightenment the Buddha revealed and reveal their own Buddha nature. A practitioner of this Buddhism, through chanting and study, can transform their life and create a state of unshakable happiness, overcoming the sufferings of birth and death. Buddhism is a practice and everyone is welcome to join. Each day after chanting, together we will study a Buddhist concept, answer questions, and share experiences about the practice and its application to our daily life. All are welcome to join us. Novices, new practitioners, and curious souls welcome.

history.description: Welcome to our hammock oasis, where ethereal visions of community unfold beneath the swaying sails of wonder and delight. Here, vibrant hammocks create a mosaic of color, gently cradling souls seeking solace and connection. Sunlight filters through, casting playful shadows while laughter dances on the breeze. Friends share stories and dreams, weaving together their hopes in a tapestry of shared moments. Aromas of herbal teas swirl around as spontaneous music resonates, inviting everyone to join in harmony. The atmosphere is charged with kindness, where creativity flourishes and inspiration flows like a river. In this haven, every heartbeat aligns, celebrating the beauty of togetherness and the magic that emerges when spirits unite with love.

In the heart of the desert, where dust dances with dreams, lies a hidden oasis known as the Hang-Out that embodies the spirit of the Burn. Here, souls intertwine amidst swaying hammocks and planted seeds awaken. Boundaries blur in this transcendent space. Desert winds carry ancient tribal beats and whispers of experiences to be found. 

Come, embrace the allure of this oasis, surrendering to the whispers of the desert. Experience our unique euphoria, enlightenment and a recharge of your soul and body.

it retreats into itself, an elusive camp providing nature's most relaxing environment—shaded hammocks, theopsiadelic as they rustle in the wind. In the language of ethereal syllables and innuendo, as individuals discuss the many adventures that have befallen them since they first set eyes on this dusty land. come find your respite…perhaps your soul.

Daytime on the playa is a hot affair, and finding a spot for a few comfortable moments can be a bit of a challenge. There is no better way to sail the dusty seas than nestled in one of the swaying hanging hugs that are the hammocks at the Hang Out. Strung elegantly from the support structure of the camp's sizeable shade structure, anchored to the mighty girth of the pre-apocalyptic Beast, our hammocks will provide you with the reset you need. Relaxing to the sounds of one of the best playlists on the playa (on the planet? Maybe?!), rejuvenate your soul in the company of the hardy and amiable souls that make the Hang Out one of the most quality, albeit perfectly simple experiences at Black Rock City.

After a long night of hunting vampires and dodging intergalactic marauders in the seedy spaceport known to some as BRC.  The glowing crystals that illuminate the city begin to fade as the Day Star climbs above the mountains.  It is time to rest.  From high and low, everyone knows that there is no better way to chill on the playa than a cool, shaded hammock.  Come ye unto the Hang Out.

The playa is a heavy load to carry, we know.  There is much work to do.  Inter-dimensional neverlands of sublime witchery don't just dance themselves into existence.  Someone has to stack the vibes.  Someone has to wire skulls onto shit.  And after a day/night/day of labors, you need to recharge.  Come ye then unto the Hang Out.

events.description:
The bar is open! Park your bike in our plentiful Ski adorned Bike Racks (leave your skis there too), and belly up front and center to the ShotSki Bar for a shot of ice cold FireBall (the perfect Burner Libation) from one of our fantastic friend-making official SHOTSKIs. It's a wonderful combination of spicy fire and cool refreshment.
Have 1 friend? We have a 2 person shotski! 
Have 2 friends? We have a 3 person shotski!
Have 3 fiends? We have a 4 person shotski!
Have 3 friends and want to meet 3 more- perhaps some cute sparkleponies? We have a 6 person shotski!
Have 11 friends? We even have a TWELVE PERSON SHOTSKI!
Have no friends but want to make friends? Our camp of veterans and newbies will join you and entice other burners to be part of the action while we bring a bit of this traditional Sierra fun to the Playa.
You don't want to miss the Avalanche when ALL 5 Shotskis (yes I said all 5 shotskis) are raised at the one time! You've heard the stories and they are all true - but bring your ID because we want to keep the Ski Patrol happy, and the slopes safe.  
While visiting, don’t miss out Shotski Snow Bunny Photo Booth perfect to take pics and selfies in to remember your great time at our camp! We have all the accessories to make your photo on the Playa memorable, complete w/ Skis, Boots, Poles, Bunny Ears and more! Try your balance on our Playa Skis,  or just look cute in our various sets of bunny ears. Includes a great backdrop for your pics.

We've got lots of shade in the Chalet Lounge to protect you from that midday sun glaring off the snowpack- not to mention provide shelter from the wind and dust if a storm brews. Our gigantic king bed crowned with a Ski Headboard in the "chalet loft" is the best place to relax after a day of avoiding moguls in deep playa. Grab a board game or just a chair. Like all alpine getaways, it's the time spent relaxing and laughing with friends that can be the most memorable.

history.description:
Black Rock City Animal Control.  Keeping the play safe from bunnies and other pesky animals since 2001.  
Home of the Tiki Tank art car too!

We proactively go out and play practical jokes on attendees.
We've been capturing people dressed like animals on playa since 2001 and have been losing a battle against the increasing bunny population...our mortal enemies.
We also are the original "You Won Burning Man" porto-potty prank, starting in 2002.  We've done "Tequila Pit Crew" (dressed as a pit crew timed how fast can you run in and lay down and have us feed you beer and tequila), "Demolition Enforcement Agency" (we had a wrecking ball art car and would service notices to camps then pretend demo them with fake dynamite by doing a countdown that ends in a dance number.  We've dressed as matadors to mess with cyclists and we hung fake security cameras in your showers last year.  Lots more  new shenanigans planned for this year as well.

Since 2001, Black Rock City Animal Control (BRCAC) has tagged and inoculated countless playa "animals," keeping the streets of Black Rock City safe and secure for all residents. BRCAC also continues its commitment to interactivity on playa with playful schticks residents have come to love such as Tequila Pit Crew, Chapstick Commandos, Bad Idea Camp, Morning Matadors, and BRCAC's quest to find the "Winner" of Burning Man with Trophy Camp.

BRC Animal Control will make collections of those pesky playa creatureswho are running free causing disturbances to camps, streets and or persons ofthe City. These captured animals will be documented and tagged for scientificresearch and easy recognition.  Some animals may need to be spayed/neutered orgiven shots.  Our trained staff will use the latest in animal reform practicesto allow these potentially dangerous animals the chance to be reintroduced tolife on the playa.  If our staff concludes that an animal has achieved reformedstatus they will be released and may have the opportunity to be adopted by/auctioned to a responsible Black Rock City citizen OR released to the playa in its natural habitat.

Red Nose District (RND) has been in existence, in one form or another since 1998. In 2013, we resolved to keep our hearts, minds, and noses RED from now until the end of time! RND has roots and participants in LA, SF, Santa Fe, NYC, Las Vegas, Pacific NW, Canada, Israel, France, & various states & countries around the world. Our members are involved in (or are lovers of) the circus arts, & work to bring our skills & talents to the playa in forms that allow for immersive & participatory experiences for citizens of Black Rock City. Notable past projects/activities include: High Chair Stilt Bar, PedalBump, Muse, Fire Wire, Wheel of Fortune, Zenobia Blanca stilt limo, Mega Mega, Bounce Back, stilt lessons, 30' swings, & circus variety shows of all forms! Come find us on the playa!

history.description:
For 19 years The Red NOse District has aimed to provide a place for the citizens of BRC to find the joy of Play without reservation. Giving all a reason & the support of family to get physically engaged, dressed up silly & laugh,  providing a feeling that is hopefully taken away & made part of every day life back in the default world.
FUN = Funny 
           Unique
           Nutty!! 
Stilts, Swings, a DIY Stage, Shade for laid back heckling, Fire Sculptures to snuggle up next to for Intimate nighttime Giggling, High Chair & Low Top Bars with Themed Cocktail Parties, Playground Gear Shenanigans Adult Style, Lessons & Movie Nights...
Come Visit, Learn, Play & Laugh, who knows you might wanna move in with us!  

https://www.rednosedistrict.com

events.title: Flamingo Parade, Show, & Extravaganza
events.description:
Stand tall, dahlinks! Calling all drag queens, divas, & pink birds of the wild! This is a radically participatory and self-expressive event of epic proportions!

Don your pink fluffy finest and join us for the inaugural Flamingo Parade! Come get flamingo-ed out @ High Chair Stilt Bar @ the Red Nose District from 3:30-5pm, enjoy pink drinks & a cabaret show on our stage from 5-7, & strut your SEXY pink stuff with us in fab-flamingo fashion out to Phoenicopterus Rex (https://www.facebook.com/phoenicopterusrex/), a giant pink flamingo idol in the dust! Strike that one legged pose, divas!

Musical Entertainment:

3:30-4:30pm - Joaquin Montoya (DJ Set)
4:30-5:30pm - Sara Nicole Glass (Live Music)
5:30-6:30pm - Meghan Rutigliano (Live Music)
6:30-7:30pm - Exxxplosivo
7:30-8:30pm - Ersinhan Ersin
8:30-9:30pm - DJ Ragbar






A dream is going to become a reality! A Flamingo Parade of epic proportions will take Black Rock City by fabulous pink FLOCK! 
and we want YOU. 

WE ARE SEEKING PERFORMERS FOR OUR CABARET SHOW! We'd love to hear about your act! 
https://goo.gl/forms/uM9YwcQWT01toQwx2



More details and a lineup to be announced! For now, dream up your flamingo personality and get ready to strut it! 

You BETTA work!

NOTE:
We encourage ALTERNATIVES to feathers. Feathers are moopy and are not welcome unless they are single feathers (not boas) sturdily attached to a headdress or something similar. See this blog post for some Leave no Trace do's and don'ts. https://journal.burningman.org/2014/06/black-rock-city/leaving-no-trace/feathers-are-moop-right-well-that-depends-on-you/

events.title: PEDALBUMP Derby Races under the BIG TOP
events.description:
RED NOSE DISTRICT presents PEDALBUMP Demolition Derby Races under the Big Top Circus tent. Is it a race? Is it a demolition derby? IT's BOTH! Or Neither. 

Several Riders PEDAL AND DRIVE head-to-head around a 60 x 90 foot track under the gorgeous CIRCUS TENT with LIGHTS, MUSIC and ANNOUNCERS! Our BUMPER CARTS are custom designed and one-of a kind! It's like driving your own personal pedal powered art car for 3 minutes or however long you last. The TENT is a SHADY OASIS in the DAY and a LIT-UP BEACON of fun at NIGHT!

 Winners of each race are determined by a mysterious mix of whatever the announcers at the time deem worthy. Is it the number of rear end or T-bone collisions you make happen? or maybe how many crashes you nimbly avoid with expert driving skills. Or maybe your winning attitude. Or your crazy costume. Maybe you cross the finish line first. Maybe you cross it last or not at all. You might still be a WINNER. We're betting on it! KIDS tall enough to pedal are welcome. Adults of ALL AGES brave or timid welcome. ALL Spectators welcome too! Come into the center ring and heckle your friends in the races!

PEDALING is FUN but BUMPING is EVEN BETTER! Seriously, the bumpers keep you safe and you will laugh your ass off with every bump, crash, skid or pass. 

We also welcome volunteers who want to help with PIT CREW duties! Wrangle the crowds, heckle the riders, keep the pedal carts repaired. Sign up for our newsletter on our FB page or just stop by anytime we are live on Playa!

events.title: STILT BAR COSTUMED COCKTAIL SUNSET PARTY
events.description:
ENHIGHTENED BEINGS OF LEISURE Infamous Costume cocktail party @ sunset daily @ Red Nose District! Come by on stilts (or off) to revel in the beauty of ENHIGHTENED BEINGS on the Esplanade. This year, our Stilt Bar crew celebrates with a variety of circus/carnival themes from around the world and throughout time! Bring your Playa Cocktail cup (and your ID) and stilt up  to our tall bar for a refreshing cocktail. Gaze upon the beauty of stilters in costume against the backdrop of the beautiful sunset. All non-stilters welcome too. Come in costume. Those stilters need some short people to gaze up at them in wonder and their bravery and dexterity!

MONDAY- Our traditional formal night we celebrate the origins of the circus with a Commedia Del Arte party! Think Masks, gowns, pantaloons, jessters and harlequin!

TUESDAY- Menagerie-Circus Animals and their Trainers-We realize animal circuses aren't PC but they are historical and the trainer costumes..well hilarious!

WEDNESDAY- Freaks, FUN HOUSE and Side Show Carnies. We KNOW you have a FREAK in there somewhere!

THURSDAY- Classic Clown Brigade! Be Whatever style clown you like. Happy, sad, joyous, mad, funny, magical, slutty, evil....All Clowns and Klowns welcome! SPECIAL GUESTS our own Professional Clown Brigade! 

FRIDAY- The Devil’s Carnival- remember this creepy 2012 Movie? (yeah we don't either) but it combines circus and the & 7 DEADLY SINS!...what could be better?? Lost souls enter The Devil's Carnival where they are each faced with the sins they committed in life.

history.description: It’s the return of the Red Nose District! Join us under the Big Top Tent for pedal-power bumper cars, high-wire hilarity, the Klownge, daily sunset themed costume cocktail parties at the stilt bar and low-rider minibar, fire sculptures, the notorious reclining esplanade peanut gallery, a performance stage for live music and all manner of carnival chaos.

Behold the Red Nose District, home to a mighty indie circus, performance and comfort collective comprised of Cirque Berzerk, Gooferman, Vau de Vire Society, the EnHightened Beings of Leisure, and Waffling Waystation. Shows Tuesday through Saturday nights, and daily afternoon world music dance parties, midway amusements, happy hour, and waffle breakfast, all open to the public.

Behold the Red Nose District, home to a mighty indie circus, performance and comfort collective comprised of Cirque Berzerk, Gooferman & Circus Metropolus, the EnHightened Beings of Leisure, Fringe, and TOTEM Massage and Chill. Shows Tuesday through Saturday, midway amusements, happy hour daily.

Behold the hope of the awake, the fear of those who sleep, the kaleidoscopic future of circus: the Red Nose District! Take a deep breath and dive into a wondrous world of intoxicatingly delicious performance, music, and art, the likes of which Black Rock City and the rest of this fine globe have never before been.

Vessels of Love is a sanctuary for the soul, offering a space of deep connection, healing and nourishment. We aim to be a calming space that can soothe friendly souls. Our sacred healing dome hosts shamanic rituals and heart-opening ceremonies. We also provide healing Amazonian elixirs and wholesome foods such as superfood popcorn to uplift the body and spirit. Step into the vessel and surrender to the flow of love.

Tierra Bomba brings a Latin American flair with a kick to the playa, infusing it with spicy flavors that transport you to a vibrant oasis. Our camp embodies the spirit of Latin hospitality, aiming to foster connections and create magical moments for all who gather under our roof. With open hearts and arms wide open, Bombito's mission is to share our unique blend of Latin culture with the Burning Man community, embracing everyone with the mantra: "Mi casa es tu casa."

Fueled by the energy of Latinos, heavily influenced by Colombian roots, Tierra Bomba is a camp that embraces diversity with open arms. We welcome people from all corners of the globe, including Mexico, Argentina, Italy, France, Turkey, Ghana, Pakistan, and beyond, creating a melting pot of cultures and experiences.

events.title: Salsita pa mi Gente
events.description:
Salsita pa mi Gente is one of three camp parties that Tierra Bomba throws each year. 

Honoring our latin roots, the “salsa for my people” party features classic hits that beckon Salsa and Cumbia aficionados to the dance floor.

Bombit@s will teach cumbia / salsa moves at sundown to visiting Burners lured in from the frontage

In every one of our parties, Burners are welcomed at the frontage of the camp by a team of “Acculturation Bouncers” and “Bike Valets”.

The “Bouncers” are empowered to improvise scripts to riff on the following themes that embody our dancefloor values:
1) Everyone is Welcome: (LGBTQ friendly + Anti-Racist stance)
2) Consent is key
3) “Hola” - our cultural icebreaker to invite a conversation about Latin America & The Global South
4) Open bar (1 MOOP per drink)
5) Civic Responsibility: Bike parking / Keeping neighborhood streets clean

events.title: Cafecito Fuel Station
events.description:
The Cafecito Fuel Station is Tierra Bomba's daily coffee offering to the Burners passing by. 

Inspired by a Colombian street coffee cart; a wood stall with coffee plantation props.

DIY Coffee Grinding Interactive Art Piece; custom-built stationary bicycle rigged to a mechanism that allows a Burner to grind their own beans. 

Visit on Pakilombian Monday to enjoy the Bomba Cortadito; a spiked espresso with milk and cardamom. Other cultural combos will fuse together unique offerings all week long!

Step-by-step process:
- Greeters flag burners from the road
- Baristas welcome guests and help them grind / brew while engaging in Coffee Connoisseur Quizzes & Shenanigans
- Burners are invited to sit in the common area of our camp, invoking the concept of Colombian “cafeterias”
- The Cafecito allows us to entice Burners further into our camp directly from the frontage

history.description: Fake Moon Factory is an international team of Burners dedicated to bringing art to Burning Man. Led by Australian artist Clayton Blake, the team has contributed monumental art to the event for four years, including the iconic "Perpetual Consumption" shopping cart sculpture in 2018. They have since exhibited significant artworks like "Containerisation" (2019), "Toxic" (2022), and the 26ft stainless steel rocket "Odyssey" (2023). In 2025, they return with their most ambitious project yet, "Vertica", a monumental, inhabitable, stainless steel sculpture that explores themes of progress, ambition, and the complex risks inherent to modern society.

Fake Moon Factory is an international team of extraordinary Burners working together with Australian artist Clayton Blake, to bring art to the playa. 
We have exhibited the iconic shopping cart sculpture titled "Perpetual Consumption" (2018), shipping container sculpture "Containerisation" (2019), and inflatable ball sculpture "Toxic" (2022).
Last year we created a 26ft stainless steel inhabitable rocket titled "Odyssey" (2023). 
Beyond the art, we had a nightly "launch" performance on playa and held artists talks daily in our camp hosting other prominent BM artists.
We are excited to be back in 2024 with our most ambitious project to date, "Sanctum". A 30ft tall inhabitable and interactive sculpture guaranteed to challenge and inspire.

history.description:
YOUniversal offers an Iranian / Persian Tea House - designed by Gregg Fleishman (Temple of Whollyness 2013).  We serve desert-friendly non-alcoholic teas and sherbets, along with exotic sweets and treats tried and true favorites from thousands of years of Iranian / Persian desert living and culture.

Since our camp consists of mostly veteran burners of Iranian / Persian descent, we are really good at two things, hospitality and food.

history.description: AdramaNation offers a well spring of peace and tranquility.  Get cleansed, get married, get hydrated, and/or release your drama at our Drama Dump/ Wedding Chapel/Tea Emporium.

Got drama? Dump it here and receive a release.  Spent all of your wedding money to come to Burning Man?  Get married at home on the playa! Legal weddings in a drama free zone.  You must contact us 6 weeks ahead of time to ensure we get all paperwork for NV laws.

events.title: Drama Dump & Wedding Chapel
events.description: Spent your wedding cash to go to Burning Man?  You can still get hitched!  We are gifting legal matrimonial services under our drama free love canopy. Services are by appointment only, and you must contact us at gravitybuttercup@gmail.com on or before July 16, 2017, so we can make sure that we can marry you in compliance with Nevada's laws.  Nevada places limits on the number of couples we can marry, so services are capped based on first come r.s.v.p.

history.description:
AYA OASIS is a sanctuary of connection, play, and transformation on the Playa.

We offer two realms: Tea Oasis for mindful brews and soul-deep conversations, and Nawi Oasis for nights of tribal rhythms and Afro-infused beats.

Here, we gather wanderers, dreamers, and creators to awaken hidden archetypes through music, ritual, and shared moments.

Our camp is a family where everyone contributes, supports, and inspires.
Come for the tea, stay for the vibes, leave transformed.

events.title: Heartmath: The Science behind Resiliency & Empathy
events.description: Want to explore the science and physiology behind why BRC feels like home? Ever wonder how others' energy affects you and vice versa? history.description:
Ukraine is very radical: we have gone through Chernobyl, we gave this planet its largest aircraft and two Klitschko brothers. It is important for us to introduce Ukraine as radically good. This means that we should dispense with references to our radical achievements, but don't go unnoticed! 

Cossacks, our heroic ancestors, really loved to fight. When the opportunity arose, the Cossacks gathered from all over Ukraine in a secret place and organized their life in a very strange way: think of something between a pirate's lair and the Shaolin monastery. 

As burners do, Cossacks from different regions of Ukraine settled camps together, and each camp was called 'Kooren.' This ancient word is saved as the name of one of the most remote areas of modern Kyiv called Kurenivka. So we call our Ukrainian camp Kurenivka!

While creating the mini statue, any clerk takes full advantage of his best managerial qualities: perseverance, diligence, patience and the so-called ‘creativity’.

The party is dedicated to ICO despite the fact that any currency is banned in Black Rock City. We love all types of currencies very much, but we don’t have any. Come and get your portion of true corporate culture and values!

Your partner can come watch, but this is primarily  a workshop  to empower women to learn to use simple hand tools to release their inner creativity. Costumes like this cost $$$ when purchased.  Make it as sexy as you dare. Yours is free to keep, and you'll be proud to wear it! Since each piece is custom formed for you, it will fit perfectly- large or small. history.description: Plaisance is French for "a concept of pleasantness in the moment."  We are a Faux French camp highlighting the greatness of everything French.  French Toast, French press coffee, French glacé cones (aka sno-cones), and the finest in cheap French wine. This is capped off by some of the finest fake French accents west of the Louisiana Purchase.  We offer many different educational and entertaining workshops (e.g., Ask a Drunk Lawyer), and afternoon refreshments on our Veranda.

history.description: Stardust Lounge is an eclectic pit stop for dusty travelers on their inter-playatary journeys. The three sections of the camp--the Casino, Spa, and Wedding Chapel--offer visitors a fun blend of rituals, games, and opportunities for self-care.

events.title: Cosmic Casino
events.description: At Stardust’s Cosmic Casino, visitors can play classic casino games or games of chance with our crew of space cadets, robots, Tarot card mystics, cult leaders, trash pandas, and more. We will once again host our popular game of chance, Shot Roulette. Take a chance and spin the wheel to decide your immediate destiny! Whether you meet your soulmate or have an encounter with MamaBird, you'll never be the same again.

events.title: Holy Meowtrimony 2.0
events.description: Calling all playa cats and kittens! Stop chasing those laser pointers and getting high on catnip -- and join us at the second annual all-cat wedding ritual, aka Holy Meowtrimony, officiated by the Cat Pope. Deck yourself out in your best cat-themed finery or cat costume- or simply channel your inner cat.

events.title: Lost in SPAce
events.description: Are the heat and the dust bringing you down? Visit the self-service Spa at Stardust Lounge to lift your spirits and pamper your body! Inside our SPAce of tranquility and peace, you will have the opportunity to wash your face/hands/feet and find lotions and creams to rejuvenate your cracked and tired skin. Other pampering treatments include moisture wipes to clean off that brutal dust and dirt of the playa, sunscreen, eye masks, comfortable lounge chairs and body pillows--and above all else, the chance to carve out some SPAce for yourself for self-care and healing.

events.title: Playa Weddings
events.description: Stardust Chapel will be open for weddings and annulments between Tuesday and Saturday. Our hours are noon -- dusk Tue-F and by appointment ONLY on Saturday. Visitors of all genders can experience the joy of matrimony in a (non-legally-binding) ritual. Choose Drunk Elvis, the Cat Pope, Eye Robot, or Judge Judy to officiate. Drunk Elvis or Mr. Stardust might then serenade you as we celebrate your nuptials in Vegas fashion.  Need your Playa wedding annulled? We'll do that too! Note: please feel free to contact us if you want to book the Chapel in advance for a special ceremony.

events.title: Robot Social
events.description: We welcome mechanicals and mortals alike to kick off the Burn! Let's oil our joints and get this party started! Here’s your chance to meet the Stardust crew and explore our many interactive offerings.

events.title: Robot Welding
events.description: Get your tin hearts pumping and your crankshafts cranking! It's time to marry your fellow robots at the first annual Robot Welding, presided by Eye Robot! Rude mechanicals, hosts, and paranoid androids all welcome! You'll never be a lonely cog in the cosmic wheel again! Ask us in advance about the secret Ratchet-lorette party on Tuesday night.

events.title: Changeover Chapel
events.description: You know what they say - "always be yourself, unless you can be a unicorn… then be a unicorn." Well, here's your chance to go on a journey of metamorphosis and renewal! Whether you're bored, existential, or simply curious about what it's like to be someone (or something) else, we will lovingly transform you into a brand-new you via our radical "changeover" ceremony. Yes, you can be a unicorn… or an alien, or even Elvis!

events.title: Cosmic CaSINo
events.description: This year, the Casino portion of Stardust Lounge has been re-imagined as "The Cosmic CaSINo" where visitors can encounter a crew of fun carnivalesque characters including space cadets, Tarot card mystics, cult leaders, trash pandas, Pikachu, Domo, and Drunk Elvis. We will once again host our popular game of chance, Shot Roulette. Take a chance and spin the wheel to decide your immediate destiny! Whether you meet your soulmate or have an encounter with MamaBird, you'll never be the same again. We will also have the classic casino table game Blackjack. Gamble with your very soul if you like!

events.title: Le Kafé Mornings
events.description: Step out of the morning sun and start the day right – Le Kafé style! Our cheerful, sexy servers in French maid regalia will jumpstart your body and mind with organic coffee and tea. Want a little breakfast treat? Nibble on pastries, biscotti, and maybe even some authentic French crepes. Don’t forget to bring your own cup!

events.title: Purr-catory

history.description: Swan Forest is the heart and soul of our camp, where creativity, community, and transformation come together. Named after both the Prodigal Swan and the Forest House art cars, our camp serves as a space for artistic expression, connection, and shared experiences. The Prodigal Swan, with its dynamic sound and light displays, invites exploration and interaction, while the Forest House brings a sense of nature and futurism to our environment. Together, these art cars provide a unique space for immersive experiences, where all are welcome to engage in a vibrant, inclusive community.

events.title: The Dusty Beavers’ Maple Taffy Stickeasy
events.description: Come all ye playa dappers, dames and ragamuffins and indulge in our beloved Quebecois spring ritual: the sugaring-off party. The Dusty Beavers will recreate the jovial, old-time Cabane à Sucre (Sugar Shack) tradition on the Playa. Maple syrup will be boiled to amber-hued perfection, drizzled on snow (crafted in secrecy, but with love), then artistically twirled into a sticky sweet gem-like glob. Don your dustiest glad rags to chill out in our maple-icious speakeasy and indulge your sweet tooth with nature’s sweetest sap. No beaver pelt trade expected or required in return. Come and experience this unique, sugar fueled ‘joie de vivre’.

At Elemental Studios, you don't need a Multi Pass to join in our camp's love of the movie Fifth Element. We invite all visitors (humanoid, alien or cyborg) to participate in our unique and 'Super Green' workshops. Each day is dedicated to an element; Earth (Mon), Wind (Tue), Water (Wed), Fire (Thur) and Love (Fri). Come relax under our shaded structure and light up humanity with your amazing creations. Instructions may be in the Divine Language. All materials provided while supplies last. Non-alcoholic, highly caffeinated bevvies available. Younglings or children at heart are always welcome. Come for the creative expression, stay for the community!

history.description: 2025 marks Hōme Camp's fourth year on playa and our vision for this year remains the same: to co-create a colorful, welcoming oasis at Burning Man. A home. A home of kindness, laughter and respect. A home where everyone contributes. A home where we eat great food and play great music. A home where we can kick back and relax amongst the chaos. Always clean, always nourishing, always light & colorful. And, of course, a home where we host our spa parties.
Home is an oasis on the playa where we invite your inner child to come dance barefoot and connect with new and old friends through taking care of one another.

Hōme (Camp) is an intimate canvas, a place to which friends, old and new, return.
Hōme "Sunset Spa at Hōme" Lounge is filled with vibey music, spontaneous treats and spa treatments (from fish foot baths and cold towels, to 'quick fix' neck and shoulder massages that will be offered by one of the many 'Homies' who hang out there). From 2pm - 6pm on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday friends (everyone obviously) will be able to pop in and enjoy a sunset spa treatment of their choice.

history.description:
We are the local diner and breakfast spot, and sometimes dive bar. Our camp members went to college together, and our favorite thing to do after a long night of drinking and ruckus was to get together the next morning at the local diner (the 'waffle shop'). The perfect recharge after a night of fun. Best of all though, we all enjoyed the camaraderie of hashing out details and reviewing the highlights of the night before. This ritual has followed us to the Burn, where our group has been informally hosting morning meals for our playa friends at our homestead. Everyone sits around in our cozy camp common area drinking coffee, eats a fantastic breakfast, and shares their experiences from the night before. 

Our gift is breakfast. Our ask is to share your adventures from last night.

Learn how to combine the intimacy of a comfy hug with the language of partner dancing. Harnessing the power of a popular partner dance from Brazil called Brazilian Zouk, we'll show you how to ascend with a partner into joyful movement bliss with Atom And Stephanie.

events.title: Brazilian Zouk Dance Social
events.description: Welcome to the world of Brazilian Zouk! We learn, we teach, we play all around the world. This is the most diverse of all Latin dances, stemming from traditional Lambada and making its way into every dance scene from hip-hop, to breakdancing, footwork, swing…etc. It flows with your natural body rhythms. Just tap into your own history, how you hear and feel the music and be able to communicate that to another person through your body language. Tell me the story of your day with you body. We will have teachers and students so come as you are, no partner necessary!!!

events.title: Vinyasa Flow with Breathwork
events.description:
10:00 AM (8/30): Vinyasa Flow w/Music - George
George combines techniques from various lineages of,Vinyasa, Iyengar, Ashtanga, Kundalini and Breathwork to bring together a unique practice that harmonizes the mind, body, energy, emotion and spirit. We will move through a series of postures that will open, expand and breakthrough to new depths within yourself. After this class you will walk away, thinking more clearly, feeling more deeply and be more in touch with your authentic self.

events.title: Yoga Breathwork
events.description:
Tuesday (8/30): 11:00 AM - Nour
Thursday (9/1): 10:00 AM - Nour

Breathwork is used as a tool to access parts of oneself that aren’t easy to get to on the surface. It’s a powerful self-exploration journey to the inner world. The process will put you in an expansive state of consciousness to access the inner healer, detect blocks and patterns that lie in the body, release unnecessary energy and reach deeper states of inspiration and clarity for more fulfilment and alignment in your life.

events.title: Find Your Flow with Tara
events.description:
8/31 @ 10:00 AM - Find your Flow with Tara 


We‘ll open the session with some grounding before we move on to some cosnscious movement. Come join us for an hour full of fun, connection, creativity and playfulness! You will feel more grounded and at the same time energized, more connected to yourself and other beautiful souls and ready for another amazing day on the Playa!


Description of me:
Tara is a certified movement facilitator based in
Zurich. Her dynamic movement practice helps
people express themselves, their state of mind,
feelings and thoughts with movement and dance.
She does this by guiding them and providing a
space where they can fully immerse into music
and allow their body to express itself. The goal is
to get totally out of your mind, release pent up
emotions, and connect fully with your body and
with others around you.

events.title: Healing Vinyasa Flow with Kyle and Ani

Healing. This is what Kyle & Ani hope their combination of smooth vinyasa style yoga + acoustic strings offer to you. And that the strength, balance, & flexibility that you'll discover - of body, mind, & spirit - are byproducts of this ancient art & science, not prerequisites.

events.description:
Jamrunner is a "Journey to the End of the Night" styled game (ie: zombie tag, spy tag). 

Between evading pursuers, there is an interactive story that will unfold the longer a player remains in the game. The more resources I have available to me, the more enriched I can make this experience. I will need LOTS of printed materials, including maps and dossiers.

If you'd like to join (or know a person/camp who can help) let me know! See below for details.

The story:
Businessman and Nevada oligarch, Randall "Buck" Thurlough, is about to deal a deathblow to decommodification at Burning Man. The Order of Greywater Cockatoos is waging a subversive campaign against this corporate takeover. You are a member of this underground movement led by the elusive culture jammer, Darwin Sandiego.

Be careful! Thurlough's influence has grown to the point that he has successfully installed his own hired muscle at the festival. Private contractors of the notorious Pike River Security Firm roam the playa. If they catch you, they'll coerce you into turning on your fellow operatives.

events.title: SPACEtalk: SPACE FOR BEGINNERS: 10 Top Facts
events.description:
Speaker:  Sarah Barker
Day & Time: Friday, 5:00pm

Overview: Join us as we take off on an adventure out of this world to discover ten incredible facts about space!

Bio: Sarah is an astrophysicist, science communicator, and science-advocate, committed to enthusing people about learning. She produces, directs, and writes for networks including National Geographic, Discovery, BBC, Disney+ and more. Her TV work has won her an Emmy. She is the also the author of, “50 Things to See in the Sky”.

events.title: SPACETalk: Space Telescopes and Cosmic Structures
events.description:
Speaker:  Katie Carolan
Day & Time: Friday, 5:30pm

Overview: Come discover the nature of our universe on the grandest scales. Katie’s talk gives us an introduction to cosmology, galaxy structure and formation, and more—all discovered in the last few decades thanks to our magnificent space telescopes. We’ll discuss how these telescopes are able to give us new vantage points and how they have painted the picture of the universe as we see it today.

Bio: Katie helps run the nightly public observing program at Griffith Observatory. She graduated this Spring with a BS in Astronomy from USC. She plans to pursue a career in astronomy science communication and public engagement.

events.title: SPACEtalk: CHASING ECLIPSES
events.description:
Speaker:  Michael Risch
Day & Time: Friday, 6:00pm

Overview: Solar eclipses are one of nature's most spectacular events. In this talk, Michael tells the story of how he became fascinated as a child and later made 7 trips to eclipses in remote regions of the earth. In addition to experiencing foreign cultures and landscapes, he was able to photograph rarely documented phenomena that are generated by the shadow of the moon. 

Bio: Michael is a professional observatory builder, amateur astronomer, landscape photographer, and eclipse chaser.

events.title: SPACEtalks: THE MAKING OF THE JAMES WEBB TELESCOPE
events.description:
Speaker:  Casey LaGrange
Day & Time: Friday, 4:00pm

Overview: Have you ever wondered how the next great space observatory was built and what it took to get to orbit? Casey will discuss the revolutionary components that allow Webb to function along with the journey that Webb took through manufacturing, testing, and launch to bring us the next generation of stunning views of the cosmos.

Bio: Casey has spent the last four years work on the James Webb Space Telescope managing hardware configuration and logistics, including supporting some launch preparations in French Guiana. Her passion for the space industry began at a young age, growing up near Johnson Space Center in Houston, TX. She has a Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management from Texas A&M University.

events.title: SPACEtalk: CLUES FROM COMETS
events.description:
Speaker:  Dr. David Reitzel 
Day & Time: Wednesday, 4:00pm

Overview: Clues from Comets illustrates the importance of observing carefully and demonstrates modern methods of solving a mystery as cryptic as the nature of comets. In this talk (suitable for kids), Dr. Reitzel investigates the process of using observations to understand cause-and-effect relationships between events, exemplified by our understanding of comets over time.

Bio: Dr Reitzel is an astronomer at Griffith Observatory. He has a Ph.D. in Astronomy and Astrophysics. He is also on board of directors of the non-profit Black Rock Observatory.

events.title: SPACEtalk: SLEEP AND DREAMS: Ask me Anything
events.description:
Speaker:  Dr. Eti Ben-Simon
Day & Time: Wednesday, 5:30pm

Overview: Ask a sleep scientist everything you wanted to know about sleep and dreams!

Bio: Eti is a neuroscientist and sleep researcher at the Center for Human Sleep Science in University of California Berkeley. Her work explores the social and emotional consequences of sleep loss on the human brain and body.

events.title: SPACEtalk: Talk: INVENTING REALITY
events.description:
Speaker:  Matt O’Dowd & Bahar Gholipour  
Day & Time: Wednesday, 5:00pm

Overview: This talk explores what physics and neuroscience tell us about the nature of the observer and how we construct models of the world.

Bio: Bahar is a health, science and tech journalist with a background in computer engineering and neuroscience. Her work has appeared in Scientific American, The Atlantic, The New York Times, BBC, WIRED, and many other publications. Matt is an Australian astrophysicist. He is an associate professor in the Physics and Astronomy Department at the Lehman College of the City University of New York and writer and host of PBS Space Time on YouTube.

events.title: SPACEtalk: The Cosmic Perspective
events.description:
Speaker:  Rohan Roberts 
Day & Time: Wednesday, 4:30pm

Overview: In our lifetime, we will see the first human beings walk on Mars. This talk covers the new mindsets, new perspectives, and new educational systems we need to develop as we prepare to become a multiplanetary species and extend our reach into the rest of the universe.

Bio: R﻿ohan is the director of the Dubai Science Festival.  He is the founder of several organisations and social movements, including, Intelligent Optimism, Café Scientifique Dubai and Awecademy. He is currently the Director of Innovation and Future Learning at GEMS Education. He is also the author of, “Cosmic Citizens and Moonshot Thinking: Education in an Age of Exponential Technologies.”

events.title: SPACEtalk: IMAGING SUPERMASSIVE BLACK HOLES
events.description:
Speaker:  Mimi Fuchs
Day & Time: Monday, 6:30pm

Overview: What do black holes look like? Astronomers have pondered these mysterious objects since the time of Einstein but have never been able to take a picture of one until very recently. Join us and learn about supermassive black holes and the ambitious effort to observe them with the Event Horizon Telescope.

Bio: Mimi Fuchs is a former telescope operator for the Maunakea Observatories and the Event Horizon Telescope. She received her B.S. in Astrophysics from Haverford College and MS in Systems Engineering from Drexel University.

events.title: SPACEtalk: A.I. AND ASTRONOMY
events.description:
Speaker:  Tannya Jajal
Day & Time: Monday, 6:00pm

Overview: In recent years, artificial intelligence has been increasingly used in astronomical research. Deep learning requires massive amounts of data, and astronomy is where AI comes into play. Tannya’s talk explores how machines can help the astronomical field do data analysis, such as, capturing new stars, new extraterrestrial planets, and even dark matter.

Bio: Tannya is a Dubai-based technology evangelist, A.I. Expert, and futurist. Through her work, Tannya encourages current and future leaders to explore the ethical and practical implications of exponential technologies on business, life and society at large. Tannya is an advocate of radical innovation, the rise of meaningful work in a post-automation world, and a proponent of educational reform.

events.title: SPACEtalks: FROM STARS TO CELLS… AND BEYOND
events.description:
Speaker:  Dr. Nathaniel Peters
Day & Time: Monday, 5:30pm

Overview: As humans in a macro world, we typically consider our universe macroscopically; modern astronomy is an extension of that perspective. However, if we turn our lens around, towards and into the microscopic, a whole new and exciting universe unfolds. In this presentation, Dr Peters will introduce us to some of the newest technological advances in light microscopy that modern scientists now use to probe the finest workings of cells and the molecules and processes within them. 

Bio: Dr. Nathaniel Peters is a cell biologist and microscopist at the University of Washington, where he manages the Keck Microscopy Center and trains scientists to use powerful, 3D-scanning, light microscopes. In his spare time, Dr. Peters is an avid birder and gardener and often transforms into Pan for Seattle art, dance, and music events.

events.title: SPACEtalks: THE MYSTERY OF CONSCIOUSNESS
events.description:
Panel:  Nir Lahav, Daniel Estrada
Moderator: Dina Fisher
Day & Time: Monday, 4:30pm
Overview: Consciousness is one of the most mysterious phenomena that we know in the universe. How can 1.5 kg of neurons in our brain experience the world, think, feel and know that they exist? Until today we lack a theory that explains consciousness. In this panel, scientists from different fields discuss this mystery.

events.title: SPACEtalk: URABLE WORLDS: Life in the Universe
events.description:
Speaker:  Dr. Bruce Damer
Day & Time: Wednesday, 6:00pm

Overview: In this talk, Dr Bruce will share discoveries from two decades of field testing of prebiotic chemistry at volcanic hydrothermal settings, stromatolitic and other evidence from early Earth geology, and the search for life on Mars and habitable exoplanets. 

Bio: Dr. Bruce Damer is an astrobiologist at UCSC working on the origin of life in planetary environments. His methods for achieving breakthrough insights have led to key innovations in spacecraft design, complexity theory and virtual worlds.

events.title: SPACEtalk: SURVIVING MARS: Planet #4
events.description:
Speaker:  Mikolaj Zielinski
Day & Time: Friday, 4:30pm

Overview: In this talk, Miko explores some of the challenges of getting to Mars and discusses the dangers of living on the red planet. 

Bio: Mikolaj Zielinski is a Polish-born but Dubai-based computer software engineer and wannabe astronaut. He was one of 100 global candidates shortlisted to embark on a mission to Mars organized by Mars One. Mikolaj completed a two-week training program at the Yuri Gagarin Cosmonauts Training Centre in Russia in 2001. In 2019, Mikolaj participated in a simulation of a Mars surface exploration mission organized by Astroland.

history.description: Black Rock Observatory is a mobile astronomical observatory dedicated to showing people just how amazing the universe is. Started at Burning Man in 2014, we have expanded beyond the borders of Black Rock City to educational institutions and events all along the West Coast.

events.title: Almost All Space Considered
events.description: Black Rock Observatory scientists space news, disaster reports, and cute animals when the robots get too scary. All questions welcomed, some answered!

events.title: Apollo 50th - Harder to Hoax
events.description: Did humans really go to the moon in 1969, or was it all a hoax?

events.title: Ask a Physicist/Neuroscientist
events.description: Did you ever wondered about the big questions? What is reality? What is time? Why do we sleep and dream? Come and see what does science have to say about these mysteries!

events.title: Chaos and entropy on the playa
events.description: Admiring the deep blue skies and timeless dust on the playa? Pondering about your purpose in life? Discussion with pretty pictures on what thermodynamics has to say about you and the Universe.

events.title: Cosmic Rays
events.description: What are Cosmic Rays? How to make your own cloud chamber.

events.title: Cosmic Revolutionaries and The Pale Blue Dot
events.description: An overview of the scales of the cosmos - with analogies to help us understand how big the universe actually is and how small we are relative it. The talk will also explore the ethical, moral, and philosophical implications of this on humanity.

events.title: Fire in the Sky: Art on Playa, Robot in the Sun
events.description: Humanity’s first mission to our star, the Sun, left our Earth just over a year ago on a hot August night in a burst of flame. How can you send a robot to the Sun, and is it really all that different from making art for the Playa? What is the Sun anyway? Why is it so hot, and can it be trusted? Can we have Life on Mars? Dr. Phyllis Whittlesey will attempt to answer all of these questions as she describes her experience making a spaceship that is hotter, faster, and closer to the sun than ever before.

events.title: Guidance Internal: Lessons From Astronauts
events.description: Rocket launch filmmakers MaryLiz Bender and Ryan Chylinski travel coast-to-coast documenting humanity’s grand adventure to space. During this immersive presentation, they’ll take you on a stunning journey to the forefront of space exploration — featuring the rocket launch experience and interviews with astronauts, scientists, artists, and philosophers who delve into the deeper meaning and human lessons derived from space travel. This is an exploration into how the rocket is re-shaping humanity and what role we all play in this journey.

events.title: Kids' Night
events.description: Bring the Kids. We'll show them Uranus.

events.title: LightSail 2
events.description: LightSail 2 was launched in June. Learn how solar sails work and how they will revolutionize the future of solar system exploration.

events.title: Matt O'Dowd from PBS Space Time presents "Wrong"
events.description: Science glorifies right. After all, its goal is to find the one, correct, true description of reality. But every good scientific theory is preceded by many gloriously bad ones. From the alchemy of Isaac Newton to Einstein's cosmological constant, our most brilliant thinkers have produced some of the most spectacular scientific nonsense. Today we celebrate the terrible ideas that were nonetheless vital steps in our quest for the truth. You gotta be wrong a whole lot before you get to be right.

events.title: Solar Eclipses Worldwide
events.description: Solar eclipses often take place in remote regions to which one would otherwise hardly travel. That's why you learn something new about the earth every time you travel to the eclipse. This presentation leads into the polar circle as well as to Indonesia, China and Australia.

events.title: Space Pants Space Dance
events.description: You bring the booze; we’ve got the ‘tang.

events.title: Space Talks
events.description: Get your nerd on: Hourly talks by leading astronomers & researchers on black holes, cosmic rays & everything space. Check Playa Events for details.

events.title: The First Picture of a Supermassive Black Hole
events.description:
"What do black holes look like? Astronomers have pondered these mysterious objects since the time of Einstein, but have never been able to take a picture of one..until now. Join us and learn about black holes and the ambitious effort to image them for the very first time using the Event Horizon Telescope.
"

events.title: The mystery of the brain and consciousness
events.description: Mind-bending discussions on consciousness lead by PhD Brain Scientists. We'll explore what is consciousness? How is consciousness impacted by meditation, sleep, dreams and psychedelics?

events.title: The Overview Effect, Awe, and Cosmic Wonder
events.description: Join Jason Silva as he talks about awe as an experience of such perceptual vastness you literally have to reconfigure your mental models of the world to assimilate it and how the overview effect experienced by astronauts in space is a boundary-shattering sense of revelation and global interconnectedness.

history.description: Black Rock Observatory is a mobile astronomical observatory dedicated to showing people just how amazing the universe is. Started at the Burning Man festival in 2014, we have expanded beyond the borders of Black Rock City to educational institutions and events all along the West Coast.

events.title: A traveler's guide to Mars
events.description: Eldar Noe is a planetary scientist at the Planetary Science Institute. He is an expert on the history and composition of Mars, and is a member of the Mars exploration Rover, Mars Science Laboratory, and Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter teams.

events.title: Almost All Space Considered
events.description: “Doc” Reitzel and guest panelists will bring you a playa-fied version of the hit space news show featured at Griffith Observatory each month. Just like the regular show, this one will be filled with all the latest news from around the cosmos, tales of doom and disaster on Earth, followed by cute animals to lift your spirit once again. We will leave plenty of time for audience Q&A, so come with your cosmological conundrums.

events.title: Astronomy Q&A and Discussion with Alex Filippenko
events.description:
Do you have questions about astronomy and various exciting recent discoveries such as exploding stars, black holes, the detection of gravitational waves, the discovery of thousands of exoplanets orbiting other stars, or anything else in the cosmos? Come to this Q&A session and general discussion!

One of the world's most highly cited astronomers, Alex Filippenko was the only person to have served on both teams that simultaneously discovered the Nobel-worthy accelerating expansion of the universe. 
Voted  UC Berkeley's ""Best Professor"" a record nine times, he appears frequently on TV documentaries and is addicted to observing total solar eclipses throughout the globe (16 so far).

events.title: Black Rock Observatory
events.description: Come join us for presentations, science experiments and general cosmological buffoonery from noon on.

events.title: Both kinds of Relativity
events.description: Anna Schooneveld, Masters Candidate at Cambridge University, will discuss both kinds of relativity.

events.title: Complex Patterns of the Universe
events.description: Have you ever wondered why a whirlpool in a stream, a hurricane and a spiral galaxy look so similar. Or how come seemingly complex behavior like snowflakes, ant colonies, human civilization and consciousness arise from the collective interaction of not-so-complex elements. Join us as we make a brief tour of the natural processes behind the complex patterns unfolding throughout the universe that extract order out of chaos.

events.title: Constellation Mythology from Other Cultures
events.description: Becca Priddy, science and robotics teacher from Portland, will be telling tales of constellations from other cultures from every part of the globe.

events.title: Cosmic Rays
events.description: What the hell is a cosmic ray? Learn the origin and history of the fastest objects in the universe and how to build a cloud chamber to see them!

events.title: Dark Energy and the Runaway Universe
events.description:
Alex Filippenko
We expected the attractive force of gravity to slow down the rate at which the Universe is expanding. But observations of very distant exploding stars (supernovae) show that the expansion rate is 
actually speeding up, a Nobel-worthy discovery. Over the largest distances, the Universe seems to be dominated by a mysterious, repulsive “dark energy” that stretches space itself faster and faster. Followed by an Astronomy Q&A at 5pm.

One of the world's most highly cited astronomers, Alex Filippenko was the only person to have served on both teams that simultaneously discovered the Nobel-worthy accelerating expansion of the universe. 
Voted  UC Berkeley's ""Best Professor"" a record nine times, he appears frequently on TV documentaries and is addicted to observing total solar eclipses throughout the globe (16 so far).

events.title: Kids Night: Story Telling
events.description:
"• Pluto Visits Earth by Steve Metzger (5-7 year olds): Pluto is not pleased when he learns that astronomers have downgraded him from planet to dwarf planet. He embarks on a fun and out-of-this-world adventure across the solar system to visit Earth and reclaim his planetary status.
• The Story of Stars by Neal Layton: (7-9 year olds): Learn about the stars and peoples' perspective on them from thousands of years ago to today. For example, did you know that the Ancient Greeks did a join-the-dots with the night sky? Or that the sun is our nearest star? Or that stars are born, live and die just like us?
• The Big Bang and Beyond by Michael Bright (9-12 year olds): Go all the way back to the Big Bang, explore our solar system, and learn all about the expanding universe."

events.title: Life in the Ecliptic
events.description: Dr. Steve Vance, astrobiologist, will describe the quest to understand oceans in the solar system, including their potential for hosting life.

events.title: Light Sail 2
events.description: Light Sail 2 is a solar sail spacecraft being launched by The Planetary Society in late 2018. Learn about what solar sails are, how they work, and how they can revolutionize the future of solar system exploration.

events.title: Mysteries of the Universe
events.description: An overview of some of the things we don’t fully understand about the Universe, including Dark Matter, Dark Energy, Gravitational Waves, Black Holes, the Big Bang, and the Heat Death of the Universe.

events.title: Peering into the Abyss
events.description: What do black holes look like and how do we study them? Astronomers have been contemplating these mysterious objects since the time of Einstein, but we've never been able to take a picture of one..until now. Join us for a conversation about black holes and the ambitious efforts taken to image and understand these cosmic curiosities. Mimi is an astronomer with the MaunaKea Observatories on the Big Island of Hawai’i. Known as “Aunty Mimi” among the island, she brings the joys of the universe to schools, libraries and local festivals in Hawai’i. After receiving her BS in Astrophysics from Haverford College, she worked in science education at the Franklin Institute in Philadelphia and the North Carolina Museum of Life and Science.

events.title: Questions from the Void
events.description:
The hopes, fears and ethics of contact.
The history of transmissions into space, the technology involved and what the possibilities of contacting an alien race might look like.
Originally born in the former Soviet Union, Ilya Barannikov is a designer and artist currently residing in Los Angeles. His vision is to bring the ethereal and tangible worlds together through art. For over 15 years, he has developed his skills in multiple disciplines, working in traditional processes as well as the experimental to create one of a kind pieces that attempt to marry the unseen realms. He has spread his vision across the globe and continues to be a prolific force in the visionary arts.

events.title: Take a long, Deep Breath
events.description:
With every exhale, the entire universe contracts, collapsing one's lungs and pressing upon every cell. From our atmosphere to our solar system and into our galaxy and beyond, every time we breathe out, the entire universe is affected. The weight of this realization is lifted when one takes a long, deep breath in
Kevin Russell is a futurist, foresight consultant, and techno-optimist. He is a keynote speaker, CDO of Foresight University, a foresight, and entrepreneurship teaching company.

events.title: The Monster in the Math
events.description:
Black holes are literal horizons to the universe, and in their strangeness they also exist far outside the horizon of human intuition. Although black holes haunted the mathematics of gravitational theory for centuries before their discovery, few believed that such bizarreness could exist in reality. The fact of their existence (in countless multitudes!) demonstrates that the mathematics of physical theory can be more trustworthy than intuition. 

Matt O'Dowd (astrophysicist and host of PBS Space Time) tells the tale of the black hole, and explores our incredible ability (through science) to discover aspects of reality utterly beyond observation or intuition.

events.title: The Pale Blue Dot
events.description:
"An overview of the scales of the cosmos - with analogies to help us understand how big the universe actually is and how small we are relative it. The talk will also explore the implications of this on our society.
"

events.title: We Are The Cosmos Thinking About Itself
events.description:
An overview of the evolution of the universe and life on earth to conclude how we are made of “stardust”. A philosophical astronomy talk on how we are not only in this universe, but the universe is in us.
Rohan Roberts is the director and lead astronomer at SciFest Dubai. He's the innovation leader at GEMS Education. He's a keynote speaker and serial entrepreneur and is the co-founder of several global movements including Intelligent Optimism, Cafe Scientifique Dubai, and Awecademy.

events.title: When Galaxies Collide
events.description:
A tale of two galaxies, separated by millions of light years, but drawn together by the unstoppable force of, yes, you got that right: Gravity! One galaxy is our own Milky Way, the other, Andromeda. Fated to collide and eventually merge. Come see pictures of the predicted galactic mash-up. Learn whether this sort of thing is common, and whether we should be worried, or not. Can the Sun possibly survive this collision? What implications do galactic collisions have for the fate of the universe? Does the big bang predict this, even? Finally we will hear about the lastest results from the Gaia mission on the eventual collision.
David “Doc” Reitzel works as an astronomer at Griffith Observatory in Los Angeles. His research interests include the formation and evolution of galaxies from the big bang to the present day.

The goal of Camp Raditude and its members, is to nurture and be stewards of the ritual creative spirit at Burning Man; mostly through their bellies, aiming to reach their hearts. Having seen nearly a decade of all the intricately magical, and incomprehensible large-scale art installations out on the playa, we know that it takes more than just the creator's imagination to make this art a success. No matter how many robots are brought to the playa each year, the key is that it takes a community; a multitude of specified hostesses, task masters, wing nuts, and daring humans to take a leap and come together in creative unity.

The goal of Camp Fer Sherbert and its members is to nurture and be stewards of the ritual creative overlord spirit of Burning Man. We do this by having frosty vegan superfood treats to support the hundreds of dedicated artists, volunteers, and citizens in Black Rock City who build large-scale art installations on the playa in the heat of the midday sun. Through our reverently ridiculous expression of this service over the last three years as a placed theme camp, we have created interactivity of new friends, lovers, international treat-enthusiasts, and learned that spontaneous love transcends all spectators into divine interactivity!

history.description:
Beware, weary travelers, the siren call of our dark corner of the playa: a haven for those who seek refuge from the cacophony of Burning Man. Enter the realm of the Death Ship, a shuttle to another dimension where time and space fold upon themselves. The air is thick with the scent of exotic librarians and the sounds of distorted steel, beckoning you to join us in our cosmic journey. Explore our mysterious corners, where strange and otherworldly creatures mingle with the mortals.
Beware, for the Death Ship is not for the faint of heart. Only those who dare to venture into our lair will find the ultimate reward: two room-temperature beef tacos... or an agonizing trip to the frozen underworld!
Behold the mighty Death Ship.  Stop by!  Take a ride!  Battle a mighty pan-dimensional serpent and be untethered from linear time!  We tried it.  Not too bad!

A ship for weary ghosts and the wanderers, the Blazing Death Ship is ready to ferry your spirit to the 9th World of Niflhel, where you will spend eternity being rent asunder by the great wolf Gorm and having your blood sucked from your body by the Dragon-Serpent Nithhogg -until the day comes to ride the great ship Naglfar to Asgard, to wage war on the gods.  Or you could have a drink at our bar, which is essentially the same experience.

history.description:
Hushville is a Burning Man village that is open to anyone who wants to camp with us, provided they abide by three rules:

1. No generators of any kind, of any size, at any time
2. No amplified sound
3. Leave No Trace! No trace of your presence or the presence of Hushville

Who Camps With Hushville?

We have a diverse population. While most of our campers come from the USA and Canada, many other countries are also represented. Some have been coming to Burning Man since the 90s; for others, it's their first year. Hushville hosts a number of theme camps, artists, musicians, BRC volunteers, art installation volunteers and just plain good people. So, if you're on your own or with a group looking to meet some GREAT people, we would love to have you come join us in 2023!

events.title: Anti M's Home for Wayward Art
events.description:
A chickenwire gallery dedicated to gifting small pieces of wayward art to participants, the Home for Wayward Art finds homes for Lost Art, Found Art, Bad Art, and Art which Needs a Loving Hug.  Participants choose a piece of art which speaks to them, fill out a short adoption card, and take the art home with them to keep.  Small paintings, prints, photography, and collages are the usual mediums, much is original work, it is hard to tell what you will find.  A Gifting Box is available for your perusal, and has swag, trinkets, and small useful items.
Open during daytime hours.  The Home is curated each morning, so every day there is something new.  Hours are after coffee until suppertime.  Closed in case of rain or wild stampedes.
Donations of non-MOOPY art are welcome, but please, no food or costumes or anything large which would be hard to transport.

history.description:
Black Rock yearbook Camp is where everyone should go to get their
Yearbook photos taken. We have a fun covered lunge area where all
playa citizens can come get a drink, relax and get their official
Yearbook photos taken!

During photo hours it is fun to meet playa citizens from all over the
playa and from all over the world. Later after Burningman is in our
memories you can go to blackrockyerbook.com and see your photos and
all those of your fellow playa citizens that came in. We also will
schedule photo shoots with camps and art projects to have a more
complete photo yearbook of the rest of the playa too!

Come visit us at: www.blackrockyearbook.com
One of the largest photography projects at Burning Man.  For over 12 years the Black Rock Yearbook has photographed over 10,000 Burners on playa and posted them in a Yearbook freely posted on our website.  Come by and see what was happening the year you were there.

Black Rock Yearbook - For 11 years the Black Rock Yearbook has been your place to get your exclusive playa yearbook photo taken.  Dress up and come by our lounge for your photo, a drink and to chill.  Check out our website to see our past yearbooks - www.blackrockyearbook.com

Bring your own sign or grab one of ours. We MUST choose LOVE!

events.description: Let us come together and march in the name of LOVE!!!  Shine your brightest rainbow colors or wear your magical wings. Lead by the Giant (Pea)Cock Car, we will march from Center Camp to the Man at sunset.  Make a sign or grab one of ours if you wish.  WE MUST CHOOSE LOVE!!!

events.title: Celebrate your 20+ years of burn with us!
events.description: Celebrating 20+ year of Burning Man with you! Howdy fellow burners! I'm Whee-zel, and as a founding member of (Camp) Yes Please, I am honored to have playa-mates celebrating my 20 Year Anniversary of attending Burning Man. Of course, there’s no “status” in how many times a person attends this amazing experience, but it sure is a great reason to party with y’all, and why keep all this fun to ourselves? So if you are a 20+ year Burner (or know someone who is), you’re invited (and your friends, really… who’s gonna keep track?) to be honored and celebrated at Yes Please. Please come by, have a drink, tell a story or two and be acknowledged for your amazing Burn-ification however many years you’ve attended! Yes Please!

If you need someone to talk to, come on by and chat with a certified sexologist, or other assorted, experienced, and well-informed campmates. We will listen and offer suggestions to get you through the week (and life!) 
[No guarantee that the booth won't be staffed by random poly burners.]

Look for the yellow booth - if no one is behind the counter, ring the bell and we’ll see what we can do for you.

events.title: Playawear 911: Reparo Fabulosa
events.description: Need help with your radical self-expression? Did your latest dust-up result in a rip, tear, or busted seam?  Are your britches bothersome or your camelback chaffing?  Do you just want to be creative in the shade for a while? Come on down to camp Yes Please at 8:00 & Eulogy,  sip something cool, and get craftsy with us. Whether you are simply in need of a needle and thread for radical self-repairs or everything is falling apart beyond your skill set, we're here to help. Our Big Box o' Dreams (Fabric Division) is stocked with the supplies you need to repair your playawear or finish that not-quite-playa-ready outfit. We're open anytime for self-fixes. If your gear is good, stop in and rummage through our treasure chest of trinkets to create your own playa-inspired jewelry.  Ask for Stitch or Mariposa for advice and assistance.

Black Rock Cinemas is pleased to announce the return of "Movies on the Playa" with new features and events.  We screen a selection of world class short films to entertain, amuse, challenge, inspire, educate and otherwise get the conversation kicked up a notch. Our large, air-conditioned Cinema Tent is perfect in the afternoon heat and our Outdoor Cinemas with fire pits and blankets are wonderful in the cool night air. We continuously screen 5-6 short films on a 75-minute loop. New films are presented every day. Be sure to check out our Late-Night Trash Cinema after 1:00am for an extra laugh. Films so bad, they're good. Check our schedule for special events and Red Carpet Premiers. Come enjoy the Playa's most underrepresented art form: film.

history.description: The most sizzling spot on the Playa, serving up a symphony of pancakes from 10AM-1PM daily, we've got all the toppings that could win a Michelin star in the land of dust and dreams. Groove to House beats with a plateful of pancake with maple syrup that flows like liquid gold and butter that slides smoother than our DJ's transitions. Choose from a lineup of toppings like Bananas & Nutella that's nuttier than our tracklist. Whip it good with Whipping Cream or dive into the savory side with Bacon & Eggs that'll make you question if you're at a gourmet brunch or a desert rave. Atlas is a community of volunteers, dreamers & doers who get together to create unforgettable experiences. This year we're bringing the xTent to Burning Man: a 7 Dimension Sensual Sound & Light stage that can host 400 guests with live DJ performances mixed with Fire, Water Misters, Fog, Wind, Lights, Lasers & Projection Mapped Walls.

We're a network of volunteers inspired by the 10 Principles of burning man, united in the pursuit of a more creative & connected world. We're on a mission to extend Burning Man's culture to our everyday lives.

Badlands is a live music open jam camp. 
Formed in 2011, we have always had a drum kit (or 3), amps, guitar, bass, keys, and a PA with microphones available for anyone that wants to come by and play. We have topless bartenders and bottomless drinks at our bar and a comfy shaded area with games and couches to relax, enjoy music and get out of the sun.

events.title: The Kaballah of Burning Man
events.description: What's exactly going on here? (Like, truly?) If you're having trouble grasping, accepting or even describing the magic and synchronicities that go down on the playa, you're not alone. And you're perfect for this conversation. Come learn how the (non-dogmatic) Kabbalistic perspective provides an eerily perfect model for thinking about Burning Man (as well as other forward-momenting, decentralized systems). Imbibe in some weird words and wisdom on how to bring this magic back to the default world, and to start mystically and tangibly as possible.

events.title: Experience Incendia
events.description:
Incendia is a concept borne of the love, appreciation for, and possibilities that lay within the nature of a simple flame. Marrying the worlds of design, art, and science, a breathtaking environment has been created, thanks to the mathematical grace and precision of the geodesic concept coupled with the application of a proprietary fire-capturing technique. 

The essence of Incendia lies in a unique manipulation of flame near it's zenith. Combusting gas is trapped beneath a fire-proof ceiling to cast a warm, illuminating glow downwards, captivating the fascination of all those below.  This effect provides an unparalleled ambience for gatherings large and small. 

Stepping into Incendia transports one to an exotic world accentuated with subtle geometric consistency and clever attention to detail. The senses are at once bombarded and embraced by the flames overhead, complemented by sophisticated lighting and a crisp sound system. Incendia's full setup features a stately 50' diameter geodesic dome, framed by five smaller domes connected via graceful archways.

events.title: HABITAT
events.description:
What is habitat loss & degradation?
Natural habitats are the physical, chemical and biological systems that support living things (i.e. plants, animals, fungi and microbes). More simply put, habitats are the places where these organisms live. Habitat is lost and degraded when natural or human-caused activities alter these places so that fewer species can live there. For example, when a section of forest is cut down and replaced with farmland or urban spaces, the living places of hundreds of species may be eliminated. 

Although natural events such as landslides and earthquakes do alter the landscape, they generally occur in isolated areas and healthy ecosystems are able to recover from them. Human-caused habitat loss, on the other hand, is altering ecosystems on a global scale, often causing destruction that is irreversible, at least on a time scale that is of interest to society. 

Habitat loss is not only a concern from the point of view of compassion for other species that share this planet. Humans are part of the great cycle of life on earth, and as such we depend on the overall function of natural systems for our own survival. Properly functioning natural systems create the air we breathe, break down our wastes, provide our food, purify our drinking water and ultimately supply all the materials we require for living. Each species plays an important role in its ecosystem. Habitat loss and degradation is the main threat to the world's endangered plants and animals, and is occurring at ever greater rates. 

Despite this sobering picture, habitat loss is not always an inevitable consequence of human activities. There are ways to limit our impact on natural systems, for example by using principles of "smart growth" in urban planning (see More Information). Nevertheless, major changes and efforts are required to address this critical problem.

events.title: Medicine
events.description:
The widespread destruction of tropical rainforest ecosystems and the consequent extinction of numerous plant and animal species is happening before we know even the most basic facts about what we are losing.

Covering only 6 percent of the Earth's surface, tropical moist forests contain at least half of all species. The abundant botanical resources of tropical forests have already provided tangible medical advances; yet only 1 percent of the known plant and animal species have been thoroughly examined for their medicinal potentials. Meanwhile, 2 percent of the world's rainforests are irreparably damaged each year. Scientists estimate that, at the accelerating rate at which rainforests are now being destroyed, as much as 20 or 25 percent of the world's plant species will be extinct by the year 2000.

Approximately 7,000 medical compounds prescribed by Western doctors are derived from plants. These drugs had an estimated retail value of US$43 billion in 1985. Seventy percent of the 3000 plants identified by the United States National Cancer Institute as having potential anti-cancer properties are endemic to the rainforest. Tropical forest species serve Western surgery and internal medicine in three ways. First, extracts from organisms can be used directly as drugs. For maladies ranging from nagging headaches to lethal contagions such as malaria, rainforest medicines have provided modern society with a variety of cures and pain relievers.
