events.title: The Birth of Jaguara
events.description:
JAGUARA is a collaborative project by an interdisciplinary collective of artists, designers, scientists, musicians, ancestral knowers, ecologists, communicators, teachers, technicians, and artisans from different areas of the American continent. 

We are uniting our voices and spirits to co-create a mutant-vehicle portraying a Jaguar emerging from the Amazon River. Through this artful celebration of the Jaguar, we want to raise awareness about the vulnerability of the main refuge of the Jaguar: the Amazon rainforest.

This powerful and sacred being emerges from the water to remind us, through music and light textures, of the vital beat of the jungle that pumps life to our continent and preserves the balance of global climate. 

Jaguara, the messenger from the rainforest, is calling us to join our hearts, voices, and actions towards the conservation of the home of the jaguar, for the sake of our own home, planet earth, and our own existence.

Water conservation is crucial. Industries have to be passionate enough in cleaning up littered waterways and minimize the impact of the operations on natural water resources. Implement water saving projects with monitoring and infrastructure investment. Working on watershed improvement projects will make a good change in the future.

Join some of the top minds and voices as they discuss these critical issues.

events.title: Harvesting carbon and storing it in hemp buildings
events.description: Leonardo knew about many of the uses of hemp ...  It's a soil remediator and one of the fastest growing, most useful biomass crops for manufacturing that you can farm.  Industrial hemp fibre crops harvest high volumes of carbon very quickly, so farming and building hemp housing is a very effective way to store carbon - each build locks up tonnes of it. The buildings are also thermally effective so you have reduced operational energy costs. The broad opportunities for value adding to fibre crops mean that wherever communities work together with farmers, they can potentially create major positive change.

events.title: TEDxBlackRockCity
events.description:
“Imagination is the only weapon in the war against reality.” ~ Lewis Carroll (1871)  “Through the Looking Glass, and What Alice Found There” 

To peer “Through the Looking Glass” is to seek alternative perspectives, to imaginatively approach a traditional problem or line of reasoning in order to illuminate impossible solutions. This often requires a willful transformation of ourselves — a creative shape-shifting — so that we see the world with new eyes, new senses, a new consciousness. It is only in this way that a new world reveals itself — as strange, yes, but perhaps also closer to world in which we dream.

In 2015, TEDx BlackRockCity will be an opportunity to open and reflect ourselves in new ways, to a new world, in which we are all transformed by ideas that matter.

events.title: Playa Choir Rehearsal
events.description:
The Playa Choir began many years ago as a small offshoot of members from the Jazz Cafe. Kathleen Hollingsworth, aka Madi, creates and directs the Playa Choir each year from scratch. This will be our 15th anniversary on the Playa!

Growing each year, the Choir now attracts 70-80 regular Burners from around the world, to join, rehearse, and create vocal music together – culminating in powerful performances on Sunday. The Playa Choir provides that connection to the “Something Other” that is often overlooked at Burning Man.

The Playa Choir has famously and movingly performed a wide variety of sacred and secular choral arrangements with featured soloists – accompanied by a talented band - and attracts crowds of 200 to 300 people for their now legendary Sunrise performance at the Temple, and again later that Sunday morning in their Dome. 

The Playa Choir is notable for a wide range of colorful characters in equally colorful garb. But don’t let appearances deceive you – many are experienced and talented musicians in their own right, who rehearse hard and bond together in an incredibly short period of time. Over the years, we’ve received feedback from hundreds of Burners that hearing and seeing the Choir perform at the end of an already amazing week, is the highlight of their overall experience!

The Choir is open to all Burners, regardless of experience, and is completely non-denominational and non-religious, but entirely spiritual, rewarding and fulfilling, especially for those who attend and participate in the Sunday 11:00 a.m. “service”. It’s the not-to-be-missed event of the entire burn!

The Choir rehearses Wed-Sat from 10:30am-12:30pm, and performs on Sunday – first at Sunrise at the Temple, and again later that morning in our Dome at 11:00am.

Your international Playa Choir welcomes all Burners to come and participate in a 4-part harmony of classic sacred and secular songs. With the full Choir and Band, it's a non-denominational, non-religious but entirely welcoming, spiritual and moving Service. This performance will also be broadcast live on BMIR!

events.title: The Temple Of Harmonics
events.description:
A sacred, peaceful, safe and inviting morning space in our beautiful Dome – our Cathedral, if you will – combined with soft pre-recorded or live acoustic music, and a small vat of fresh hot coffee nearby. Don’t forget your cup!
 
The stage is set for you. You are invited to drop in for caffeine and a comfy place to chill and get your day started. For bleary-eyed survivors, there’s always a pillow. Start a yoga session. Meditate. Write, draw or paint. Practice your aerial skills on our silks. Listen to the music. Dance if it feels right. Offer a massage on our table (or receive one). Bring and play an instrument.
 
Circle Sing together and share vocal improvisations. Use your talents to listen, share, and express yourself as parts of a greater whole. Feel the rhythmic pulse. Experience the sound’s different dynamics and layers. Open yourself to the music’s full breadth. Discern the wealth and variety of vocal timbres, and achieve a state of collective consciousness.

What makes Black Rock City incredible is there is no prescription for the “right” kind of interactivity. There are no predetermined interactivity categories. Your imagination and your creativity is the engine. This is a temporary city, an experiment every year. Because of that, you never know what to expect!

history.description: YES! explores the philosophy of saying "yes" as a catalyst for growth, connection, and authentic living. We believe in the power of wholehearted participation—and that a true "yes" comes from deep internal alignment. Sometimes, that means saying YES! to stillness, to rest, to solitude, or to a different path entirely. Our camp is a haven for adventurers, seekers, and anyone ready to engage with life from a place of resonance and presence. We celebrate the liberating energy of YES!—in all the forms it takes.

history.description:
The MOOP Museum, aka MoMu, features a curated display of the finest museum-caliber MOOP around. Our exhibit is always morphing. When our curators are on duty, MOOP collectors can bring us their finds for appraisal and intake into our collection. With small exceptions, everything on the walls is available for permanent loan if patrons see something they'd like to take home with them.

A few select, high-value MOOP items are part of our permanent collection and not available for loan. Our permanent exhibit also includes educational elements, art made from MOOP, and a spoken-word MOOP receptacle.

Our gift shop is stocked with handcrafted, high-quality items made with MOOP. We hope you'll find something you like to take as a souvenir of your visit.

BRCvr invited you to come play and learn about immersive technologies and storytelling. Learn about the BurnerSphere and how you can participate.

BRCvr was an official virtual Burning Man experience in 2020 and 2021. We brought a virtual version of Black Rock City; it was inclusive of its iconic art, camps, and, most importantly, its citizens into the virtual space when it was needed the most.  Using the experience of bringing the same spirit, culture and Principles of the real-world event into an interactive VR-first expression that cultivates conversation, connection, and community, we are now stewards of radical inclusion for remote burners, bringing them into our camp to directly interact with us on playa Within The Window.  Come make new friends at The Window!

The Society for Temporal Preservation consists of time travelers tasked with preserving the fabric of spacetime. Space time is like a cat though, it takes care of itself. This is good, because now we can leave a bowl of food out and ignore it while we visit Black Rock City. We serve as ambassadors of the temporally free, working to introduce Black Rock City to the magic (science) of time travel.
Our goals include:
- Exposing burners to the wonders (AND HORRORS!) of time travel
- Instilling a sense of hope and responsibility in regards to an individual's place in time
- Getting the anti-matter out of the carpet. That stuff is STICKY

events.title: Halloween Party
events.description: Halloween is coming to BRC early this year! Spooky fun music, candy, be sure to wear a costume!

events.title: Bounce off
events.description: Visit our bouncy castle and take your best shot before competing in the bounce off. Last one standing wins a prize! Music and drinking!

history.description: The Society for Temporal Preservation is a collection of time travelers dedicated to introducing Black Rock City to time travel and vice versa. Yes, we know what you did next summer.

events.title: Communist Party!
events.description: Ain't no party like a communist party, 'cause with communist party PARTICIPATION IS MANDATORY. Relive the glory days of the Eastern Bloc with our time-traveling submarine crew. The economy may be lousy, but the drinks are worth standing in line for.

events.title: Flower Crown Workshop
events.description: Come by and learn how to make flower crowns that are thick, sturdy and beautiful! All the materials that you need to make a crown will be provided. Feel free to bring your own fake flowers or plants if that suits your fancy. You will of course, get to keep your crown once you make it.

events.title: Goth Night
events.description: Join us as we embrace the darker elements of the human soul by listening to industrial music and rebelling against society. We will also sack Rome. We do time travel, so all goths are welcome.

events.title: Steampunk Space Program
events.description: Help us tear space-time a new one by introducing space travel to the Victorian era. Come for the merciless vacuum, stay for the rocket fuel.

events.title: Unbirthday Party
events.description: Everyone deserves a birthday celebration on the playa. As time-travelers we can make any day your birthday. Whether you want to celebrate your birthday from this year, next year, or twenty years from now, we got you. It's your birthday, so you can cry if you want to.

history.description: The Society for Temporal Preservation is a collection of time travelers who welcome other travelers from any when or where. In answer to your next question: yes, we do time travel.

The Society for Temporal Preservation consists of time travelers tasked with preserving the fabric of space-time. The society welcomes travelers from any era or dimension and specializes in assisting the temporally locked in altering their place within the framework of time and space.

The Society for Temporal Preservation consists of time travelers tasked with preserving the fabric of space-time. The society welcomes travelers from any era or dimension and is ready to assist the temporally locked in altering their place within the framework of time and space.

Won't you be our neighbor? A throwback to the American front porch born from the melting pot of different cultures and ethnicities; our front porch invites friendly greetings, recognition, acceptance, and fosters neighborly community. Come sit in our adirondack chairs and have a chat. We will be offering no-frills cowboy coffee in the mornings and ice cold lemonade in the afternoons. Grandma is eagerly awaiting your arrival so she can serve you some fresh apple pie. Stop by and visit our yard sale full of trinkets. No early birds!

Priscilla – the imperfect camp with Aussie roots and an international twist, where radical self-expression meets a bloody good time. We're the camp you know and love for our inclusive, high-energy parties like the infamous Rizzle Sizzle (snags done the Aussie way). Under our unmissable pink camo nets, we bring the chaos, the charm, and a solid dose of Who Gives A F*ck energy.

It's a place where strangers become family in no time, friends reunite in the dust, and memories are made that'll last long after the desert fades.

Come for the snags, stay for the sass.

Priscilla xoxo

events.description: Animals that don't look like animals, people that don't look like people.... it's a wild world out there! Let's take the safari to explore those fantastic creeps and dance the day away! We'll have a communal wardrobe and makeup artists, people that will make you feel fantastic and international electronic music acts to make you call 6:45 & G home for the day.

history.description:
Our trashy drag queens will spin you off the street and straight into our loving, weird and fabulous theme camp, Priscilla, Queen of the Doof!. Here you'll find yourself participating in our LipSync Battle, The Doof party, and our famously infamous DILDO OLYMPICS! We are a camp that comes from Australian each year that welcomes ALL people, and have the moto of 'wear whatever makes you feel fabulous at that particular point in your life, not something that you have chosen to fit in with what's seen as fabulous for other people'. We are open to all and we hope our way of living and thinking rubs off on you.
xoxo

Priscilla, Queen of the Doof! 
Wait, who is she and what is she Queen of?? 
She is a giant pink bus full of fabulous Australians! 
The Doof is Australian for electronic music party and all the color and sparkles that go along with the scene. 
Priscilla is a big pink party bus full of fantastic party people!

We want YOU to come watch, dance, sign yourself up, do yourself up and party until you are downright exhausted. See you there, baby xxx

events.title: The Doof!
events.description:
Condragulations, you have just stumbled upon The Doof! "Doof" is a term used in Australia that describes an electronic party. The Doof will be a party held in the day that combines House/Disco/Funk/Tech DJ's from around the world playing to you burners out of our BIG PINK BUS!
At Priscilla, we are known for our weird and wonderful bar service, our overly quirky and inclusive members and our ability to be able to make you feel like you're a drag queen in a desert (because honey, you are).

Olympus is the home of the gods! We are a Bay Area based Burning Man camp dedicated to self-expression, inclusivity, and the celebration of every individual. Since 2016, Olympus has always strived to help people discover the best versions of themselves, their inner god. There is no limitation in terms of mythology; gods from all cultures, times, and places are welcome. Olympians also create own mythologies if the spirit takes them. The only limit is one's imagination. The mission of Olympus is for every burner to foster radical self-love, self-expression, and a connection with their own divine spirit.

history.description:
A
Hunting party
Sometimes has a greater chance
Of flushing love and God
Out into the open
Than a warrior
All
Alone.

-  Hafiz

The Hunting Party is where movement and magic swirl wild forms in the dust. Exploring the mystical realms within and without, we stalk the many-faced prey of the One - we are the flock and the fledging, the church and the people, the dungeon and the steeple. We explore the ever-emerging edge of intimate truth and togetherness. Before, during, and after, we dance.

By day, we play with reverent abandon and reckless devotion in honor of each other - and what we create when we turn our heartbeams to a dynamic and fluid center. We serve homemade kimchi by the arched fingerful and deliver fresh, happy juices into keen mouths. By night, we play with spontaneity and serendipity, drunk only on the magic of connection and juice. The dome becomes a place to mellow out and venture into the frontierlands of mind, body, and spirit where we, the Hunting Party seek the We in You.

events.description: Feeling adventurous? Think you can handle a quest through the treacherous land of Black Rock City? Then the Vagabonds & Tagalongs Scavenger Hunt is for you! Some quest items will be silly, some reflective, some outright ridiculous. This perilous journey will challenge your creativity, courage, and perseverance as you battle the elements and experience all that the playa has to offer. Those who survive and return to V&T will be compensated in gifts and cherished as champions of the V&T community!

events.title: The Headless Way
events.description: What are you really? Forget what “they” told you you are, and get straight to the heart of what Zen masters and the mystics of all the great religions have been saying for millennia: you are not what you appear to be. From six feet away, you are a person. Up closer, you are a patch of cells, or closer, atoms. From farther away, you appear as humanity, or a planet. But, what are you at center, at zero distance? Only you are in the position to say. This fun workshop will point you to a truth which you need not take on faith, you can see it for yourself. The experiments and exercises conducted in this workshop will point you towards an experience so obvious, that despite its wonder and incredible implications, it is easily overlooked.  Change the way you see yourself (and the world) and change everything!

This is a meditation to move us back to our primordial state through silence. We

will go through simple guided meditation to initialize and neutralize our mind as

group during first half of the session. We will then go deeper into our inner space

and connect with our true individual nature through silence to reaffirm that we are

history.description: Cyberia - the coolest place on the playa, with a chillax dome and snow cone machines churning out frozen treats. Step out of the heat and join us for daily meditation, yoga, and Shabari classes.

events.title: Morning Calm Meditation with Jhana
events.description: Unlock the heart, the mind and begin your playa day with us.  Jhana will lead a morning meditation session based on True Meditation by Adya Shanti from the Bay area.   This is a meditation method that honors primordial silence that is within us.  No fancy mantras or visualization techniques or lotus position required.  All we need is our sincerity and willingness to close our eyes, breathe and surrender.  We will dive deeply into the collective silence allowed by the group and gain new perspectives and vantage points in life.  Come join us and let go of the things and ourselves that hindered us.

events.title: NRG In Motion Yoga with Alex & Alexandria
events.description: Stillness is an illusion, we are constantly moving at an atomic level.  Release your cosmic dancer with long flow vinyasa set to music.  These sequences are challenging but accessible, requiring you to leave your thoughts and mind at the door and become free to explore a sense of BEING in the moment.  Our mind has the capacity to limit our potential, are spirit the potential to set us free!

events.title: Ok, But First Yoga w/ Alex & Alexandria
events.description: Not sure if its still last night or this morning?  Come reset your body and find your way back to the present moment with a Vinyasa style yoga class set to music.  Explore the benefits of synchronizing breath and body to awaken your inner child before you hit the playa.

events.title: Shibari: Connection Through Restraint
events.description: Esinem & Nina, both of whom has studied with some of Japan’s most respected kinbakushi (rope masters), will show that shibari (Japanese rope bondage) is not just about knots but more about the effect you create by the way you use the rope. In this session, you will discover how it is a tool of communication by becoming an extension of your hands…and your will. Prepare to be amazed by the erotic and psychological effects of some of the techniques you will learn.

events.title: Siberian SnowCones w/ Cyberia
events.description: Come, come, come for a tasty treat of love and zeal for new friendship while supplies last. There is a good reason why our camp is named after Siberia.  We have some of the freshest and coldest snow cones on the playa.  Camp Cyberia is one of the most international and hippest camps around and we will play some international music, especially from Russia, Brazil, Turkey, Cyprus, and Korea while we hand out those awesome snow cones with 4 different flavors to choose from.   Either you will love our snow cones or you will love our camp members who are yogis, meditators, musicians, Japanese bondage-rope artists, DJs and historians.

history.description: Polaris of Black Rock City casts shadows of intrigue upon the surface of the playa surrounding it. This mosaic of luminance attracts curious pilgrims, to discover a spectrum of rainbow beams hidden within the structure. Polaris shall demonstrate to the viewer, the ubiquitous influence of light in our everyday lives.

At the edges of the far north Polaris exists as a life saving replenishment for all over-heated polar bears. Replenish your body, mind and spirit. Cool down, chill out and spend some time with ursus maritimus, the polar bear. Replenish life in the Polarium. Just follow the north star!

events.title: Quarks and Rec Trivia Night!
events.description: Welcome to Quarks and Recreation’s highly anticipated (we assume) Trivia Night, where you can put your knowledge to the test! Come explore a number of different subjects — STEM, history, pop culture, miscellaneous and more! — in a trivia competition to prove your proficiency! Compete with others to determine your fate — get ready for delicious rewards or face the consequences (let’s hope there’s no pickle juice involved!).

events.title: Scientists vs Zombies
events.description:
Ambling from its previous home at the Functional Nightmare Agency, “Scientists vs. Zombies” is one quarter RPG, half board game, three fifths puzzlehunt, and an eighth scavenger hunt as you play the roles of scientists, defending Black Rock City against the Waking Dead!  You’ll solve puzzles, go on wacky quests, play immersive games, and (unlike the rest of your playa adventure) try not to get bit. Every successful accomplishment gains you ownership of blocks on the big board of Black Rock, a lasercut map of our favorite dusty city. Who will spread their message (and definitely not disease) block by block from Esplanade to the airport? The maddest scientists with the strongest duct tape, of course!

A “Mentor” will run the game in camp from noon to 3pm every day to assign quests, confirm successful completions, bestow degrees, and spread each team’s influence onto the BRC map. Teams (or individuals) can pursue quests throughout the city all day and night, however!  Win the game and get a momento!  Lose and get a drink.

events.title: The Demon Core & Tickling the Dragon’s Tail

history.description: We are a diverse group of like minded individuals that started off as strangers and became family. By becoming each other's chosen family, we feel we can be open and honest regarding our mental, spiritual, emotional, and physical health and have helped each other work through past and present trauma on and off playa. By building community and trust within each other, we are able to connect through art, music, and self expression. The goal of our community is to show genuine connection, love, and support with each other that we may not normally obtain in our default lives. Through this action we strive to create a safe space for individuals to learn and grow into the best version of themselves.

history.description:
Its golden hour on the playa. You are excited for another night’s adventure but wonder, “just what do I do between then and now?”  Answer: come lounge on the coziest of couches, have a drink with a squirt of b-vitamin energy or some electrolytes and relax amongst your new-found friends at PG SQUIRT HOUSE. Good vibes, good music, and adult beverages featuring electrolyte squirts await you. 
This year PG Squirt House also feature a lecture series and poster session from our resident neuroscientists.  Want to know how psychedelics affect your brain, what happens to your brain as you age? Relax with a sangria and heckle our over-eager PhD’s. 
Always friendly and a little snarky, PG Squirt House is your Pre-Game playa oasis.

events.title: Scotch & Hop: Scotch Bar
events.description: Bringing out childhood memories and mixing them in with adult libations, comes Scotch & Hop. Combining the fun game of Hop Scotch with one of the most wonderful beverages to grace the planet, Scotch makes for an entertaining and social area where people from all areas, and even all ages (with Children, being the under-21 crowd,) creating a silly and fun set of events bringing out the child in all of us. The social events for Scotch & Hop take different types and games of Hop Scotch from all over the world, and have people jump around and play various forms of the game. Once a Black Rock citizen, who is over 21, has completed a game, they are invited in for a Scotch or Scotch cocktail. (And usually we include other adult-beverages.) Getting young and old, from all across the planet, together and playing Hop Scotch makes people remember the silliness of when they were kids. Also being able to have children be able to play along in the games opens up the experience to everyone.

history.description: Scotch & Hop a place for the young and old, silly and serious to have a good time and jump around. For the younger in the crowd we have treats so that they can relax after some hopping. It's a great place to get out of the sun and remember such a simple fun game.

history.description: Join us at the "I Love Elephants" camp to celebrate the majesty and wisdom of elephants. Our passion spans from the spiritual essence of Ganesh to the communal spirit of elephant herds. Immerse yourself in an projection experience of Samskara, the Android Jones masterpiece! Dive into daily yoga, sound baths, music, and enlightening talks. Unleash your creativity in the Yaari Tent of Glow, painting laser-cut elephants or exploring body art. Our focus is unconventional, but it underscores a vital lesson: elephants, in their unique compassion, teach us about love and the necessity of community. Engage with informative panels, meet dedicated elephant activists, and embrace the call to action. Be part of a movement for change. Join us at Burning Man for an unforgettable experience.

events.title: Fun Flow and Pillars of Yoga
events.description:
Fun Flow (Tuesday):
Class starts with a seat for inner connection through breath and a guided inner exploration, here we find our center and set our intentions, next we flow in to a warm up followed by a vibrating energy rising flow connecting movement with breath, winding down to explore deep relaxation in shavanasa, using practices of Yoga Nidra and breath work to support us in softening the heart, body and mind.

Pillars of Yoga (Thursday)
· Love / Self-love is where the practice starts from.
· Respect to each one’s individual uniqueness, each one’s body, time, breath, and state of mind, combining asana and breath to lead us to find that calm and quiet inner connection.
· Preparing ourselves for deep relaxation in savasana and meditation, to our connection to creativity, insights, inspirations and much more.
All these wonderful connections are so accessible to all and that is why I believe so strongly in the power of yoga.

events.title: Alchemy Game: Stir up our Highest Intentions
events.description:
Moving around the Medicine Wheel of elements, we stir up transformational energy & invite our higher selves to engage with our powerful intentions.

The Alchemy Game uses practical aspects of ceremony and stirs it up in extreme interaction. To begin, the Witch opens the circle by calling in the four directions, the earth and cosmos. The Witch leads a brief meditation to drop everyone into a similar frequency.
Participants are invited to identify an element (earth, air, fire, water) that embodies what they are “working on at this time.”

The alchemy game unfolds as the groups move around the Medicine Wheel of elements, creating together an expanding, playful expression of their Work. Finally we charge up and seal our Medicine Wheel with a Transformation Celebration in movement and sound.

events.title: Talk about Elephants, Philip Price
events.description: The Director of ElephantsNow.org will provide an overview of Asian Elephants and their plight, with stories and solutions. Philip Price is founder of ElephantsNow.org, and the "I Love Elephants" theme camp at Burning Man. Sixteen years a Burner, he believes the magic pill to save species will be found within the matrix of creative minds that attend this event. He has more than 20 years of activism toward saving Asian elephants. He is on the front lines - using documentary filmmaking, social media and consciousness raising as his primary tools. Fostering orphaned elephants and providing essential equipment to the front lines veterinarians and rangers in Asia is a major part of his organizations efforts.

events.title: Atma Yoga with Saul
events.description:
Atma in Sanskrit means the inner Self or Soul. It is the essence of who we truly are and the source of our energy, light and power. Yoga in Sanskrit means union, it is the natural state and condition of our being – body, mind, and Spirit are One. Atma Yoga is a style of yoga developed by Saul David Raye with the blessings of his teachers. It is a holistic and heart-centered approach to Yoga and the path of spiritual awakening that recognizes each of us as sacred channels of living, breathing Cosmic Energy. Atma Yoga draws on the teachings of Yoga, Bhakti, Tantra, Ayurveda and all forms of Universal light, love and wisdom.


The Intention of "I Love Elephants" offerings - Kirtan, Pranyama, Meditation, Ecstatic Dance, Sunrise Yoga, with some classic R&R and mindful techno mixed in, is to elevate the Burner spirit to an ever higher plane. We will immerse you into the spirit of Prana as we metaphorically travel into the richness of the human soul, thru the manifestations of Burning Man. Our connection to this temporal sacred space will be deepened through the movement arts. While facilitating sweet equanimity, our intention is to bring spaciousness to our soul - allowing ever deepening connection to the Prana surrounding us. 


Don't be one of those folks that leaves the Playa and says "what just happened?" Be in your body FULLY while here on the Playa....Don't miss the opportunity to really tune in. Embodiment of the Burner's Heart....Be Here Now.

We will follow the yoga with a guided meditation and an hour long ecstatic dance to set our intentions for the rest of the week. Feel free to join at any time! Meet at "I Love Elephants" and ride or walk to the nearby Playa.  Near Esplanade and 4:30

events.title: World Music with Jim Beckwith
events.description: Jim will mix mantra chants and English lyrics with a melodic and accessible tapestry of sound, exotic instrumentation and undulating rhythms. A compelling lyricist with a voice that soars from high to low with the greatest of ease, Jim is a devoted yogi and musician who focuses on Bhakti - the great yoga of the heart.

events.title: Yoga with Elephants, Facilitated by Joshua
events.description:
Joshua will bring the Playa home to your heart! The Intention of all of "I Love Elephants" offerings - Kirtan, Pranyama, Meditation, Ecstatic Dance, Sunrise Yoga, with some classic R&R and mindful techno mixed in, is to elevate the Burner spirit to an ever higher plane. We will immerse you into the spirit of Prana as we metaphorically travel into the richness of the human soul, thru the manifestations of Burning Man. Our connection to this temporal sacred space will be deepened through the movement arts. While facilitating sweet equanimity, our intention is to bring spaciousness to our soul - allowing ever deepening connection to the Prana surrounding us. 


Don't be one of those folks that leaves the Playa and says "what just happened?" Be in your body FULLY while here on the Playa....Don't miss the opportunity to really tune in. Embodiment of the Burner's Heart....Be Here Now.

history.description: We love Elephants and share our passion full time in the default world and live our elephant fantasies on the Playa. Ride our life-like elephant, as we take your picture, or even video you for inclusion in our fun website film! Enjoy jungle beverages like coconut water or beer. Draw elephants, trumpet for elephants and more. We have yoga! See our schedule in the program guide!. Meet our conservation group's director who is equally nuts for elephants. You'll love elephants even more as he shares stories over beverages and snacks. Oh, and we've been told our misting system is best ever on the playa! The misting equipment design is one of a kind!

events.title: Elephant Merry-go-round
events.description: Join our "I Love Elephants" crew and mount our carousel! Our life sized elephants are elevated on a high merry go round. You've never seen such a thing and neither have we....that's why we built it! Somebody had too!

events.title: Paint Your Love of Elephants
events.description: We love elephants, so much so that our local artist cooperative created a huge and beautiful mural of Asian Elephants and their habitat. We're displaying it beneath our elephant merry-go-round. We want you to be inspired to do your own artwork upon part of our 200 square feet of blank white canvas. While you're here - ride the merry go round, be misted by the best misting system on the Playa (it really is! many years in the making). Also, have a cold beer or coconut water in one of our community shade structures and let's talk about elephants!

events.title: Afternoon SnowCone and FireFries Party!
events.description:
Join with us in our huge shade tent for FireFries and SnowCones and bring yourself back to life after a hard night, hot morning and cool down before heading into the Playa heat, or anytime you need shade.
 Kids can jump the line and bring their elders with them if they are kindly kids.
Bring your campmates or an Artcar full of the tired and toasted, we have the room.
Just off 9:00 Plaza, we hope to see you there for our world class FireFries and the best SnowCones on the Playa.

  Unlike those camps that chip the ice, so the syrup rolls off the ice into the bottom of the cup into, , sticky stuff, We shave the ice into fine snowflakes that encapsulate the flavors into the icy snow.
And do we have flavors for us to choose from. Yes, for us to choose for you, because we know better what you really want.
You just say "Sweet, Sour, Fruity or Tropical", and we'll blend our flavors for your desire you never knew.
 up to six flavors on each Cone, and kids get a double cone with twelve carefully layered flavors to gently blend. We will make a cool down cone for an over heated kid anytime If we have the Ice and someone to do it. 
We take pride in our Snow and it takes a lot of effort to make it, so we don't provide it for your personal cup, just to melt and cool your watered down drink, so don't even insult us and ask.
We do delish Rainbow SnowCones in a paper cone. Not in your cup. A cup of colored snow just isn't a SnowCone.

You can use your SnowCone to cool down our FireFries, said to be the best in the world according to a visiting world traveler and they are back for you to enjoy.
They only come in one flavor, Hot. But the best hot flavor. If you like spicy, try the FireFries.

While at our camp feel free to ask about our contraptions and the Big Tent which has grown from a two wall shade for our tents to the huge shade space for way over four hundred guests a day. Come enjoy the shade anytime you need.

Look for our white corner tower, lit up at night.

events.title: Burning Man 2100 Planning Party!
events.description: It is never too early to plan for the day when even Black Rock reaches capacity and the BLM finally pulls the plug. Fortunately there's lots of empty space in outer space, and nuclear fireworks can be the very best kind. Join us for a relaxed discussion with appropriate libations as we figure out if Mars dust is worse than playa dust, if cometary ice delivery is practical, just when a rocket is a Mutant Vehicle, and what to do when you're on the moon and people STILL complain that the music is too damn loud!

events.title: Catching Out:  How to Hop Freight Trains
events.description: 35 year veteran railroad conductor and past boomer/hobo gives a tutorial on riding freight trains in the new millennium.  How to be safe on the rails, not get arrested, and enjoy a rugged adventure.   Hitchhiking sucks!   Freight trains don't go everywhere but they can get you far and fast toward your destination.  Having no destination is even better!   Learn what to carry with you, where to ride on a train, and how to keep a low profile.  Also learn how freight trains operate, where they stop, and how to find a 'friendly' railroad worker with whom to communicate.  Familiarize yourself with the 'Do's and Don'ts' of freight train hopping and discover the last shred of what real freedom means in America.

The Sire is limiting his time to 3 days only and only 4 hours per day: Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday from 12pm (noon) to 4pm.

DISTRIKT is a 501c3 Non-Profit music and arts organization, supporting an inclusive and diverse community of performers and artists through events, partnerships, community involvement, mentorship and relationship building. DISTRIKT was founded in 2010 based on the ethos of the Ten Principles of Burning Man, and over the past decade has evolved into globally recognized philanthropic organization.  

DISTRIKT is an ever-evolving organization with a core believe that it is important for us to have a strong connection and experience with the community that we celebrate.

Our mission is to leverage our wide community reach to support efforts focused on helping our community, our country and our planet.

events.title: Visualize An Amazing Future and Have It Come True
events.description: Join Camp Feel Good for a guided creative visualization meditation. Dr. Feelgood will help you picture your perfect day 10 years in your future. The process works by subconsciously shifting your decision making over the next 10 years eventually making your vision a reality. You don't know what that day looks like? Don't worry, most people don't, but your subconscious already knows what is important to get there. The more amazing and compelling the vision that you let emerge, the more you will be drawn to it. How? Most people make between 80 to 400 decisions a day. A rich, compelling visualization with a lot of sensory "hooks" can shift those decisions towards your perfect future because the right choices will feel "good.” We will start with a mindfulness of breath meditation, a gratitude exercise and then wake up the morning of your perfect day and explore it through a guided process. After, we will ask a few of those interested to share their visualization with the group. We look forward to sharing your future day together. Dr. Feelgood. The 45 Minute Meditation Session is 2PM on M-Tu, Th-Fr / 1pm on Weds.  For those in need of a deep dive in what you want out of life, we offer an Advice Booth Open every day!

events.title: Clown Trauma Support Group
events.description:
It has happened to us all.  You're having a great time, easy and happy, dancing through the weeds of your own small life, and suddenly -- a clown.  He's trying to be funny at you.  He's a burlesque.  Or a Bozo.  Or a body comedian.  You can't punch him because that would be wrong.  You can't cry because you're terrified.  And you can't laugh because the life has been sucked out of you.  So you push it down, deep inside.  Where the clown trauma festers in its own silent and pressurized tank of suppressed rage and fear.

These incidents have been seen with increasing frequency as clowning has infiltrated our community.  Clowns are easy.  Clowns are anonymous.  Clowns are everywhere.  And clowns are dangerous.  They are the death knell of participation culture, just as the deadbeats were the death knell of hippie culture.  They embody the cheap, the quick, and the easy, and they should not be allowed to take over.

Come to our shaded bar and snack on our snacks with us.  Learn the story of clowns, past, present, and future.  Drink your health in a clown-free zone.  Crush the red nose of clown oppression.  And embed a new mantra into your soul: 

I will never be clowned again.

events.title: Dad's Cereal Bar
events.description:
Yer burnin' daylight! Best wake up and c'mon by My Dad's House for a bowl of cereal to start the good ol' engine. We've brought all the milks & cereals you could possibly imagine (well, maybe not all of them, but certainly a lot)! 

Take it from your Dad, breakfast is the most important meal of the day. We're making sure everybody has all the fuel they need to make the most of our beautiful time at home on Playa. Feel free to swing on through in the morning, ditch the shit, and hang for a while in Dad's Garage. We'll put on the cartoons, your favorite ones, just for you! There are daily events happening at My Dad's House too—from poetry slams to comedy nights to live music jams to pool tournaments to slacklining to kink workshops to yoga classes to contact improv meet ups to dance parties to tattoo appointments to fatherly advice to kickball games to pizza parties—and we figured there're plenty of places to get a bloody mary, why not fill up the bellies with caloric wonderment and ensure you've got the fuel you need to get through the day! 

It's what your Dad wants for you, and around here, your Dad wants nothing but the best for everyone :]

events.title: Daddy + "Offspring" Sunset Boogie!
events.description:
Are you Burning with your Dad, Daddy, or Dad-like figure? RAD! Wanna come dance together at My Dad's House? Yea? EVEN RADDER! In that case, c'mon by My Dad's House for a sunset boogie! The soundtrack will be very much what you'd expect to hear in the garage of the hippest Dad you know—like if Jimmy Buffett and Steely Dan had a love child.

If, perhaps, you're seeking a new Dad to hold you, whisper sweet affirmations of paternal love in your ear, and dance with you like a lunatic... look no further! We have SO many Dads that are SO proud of you, your moves, your grooves, and we can't wait to wiggle like silly little beans as we embrace our first sunset of the weekend together.

events.title: Dad's Highline Slackshop
events.description:
As a beacon of 9:00 plaza, two pyramids pierce the Tokyo sector skyline… and strung between them is a 30’ tall highline slackline that we’ve built along the avenue! Pros will be there to instruct & assist for at least a few hours each of the weekdays. Let yer Dad show ya the ropes! Bring a harness if you’ve got one, otherwise we’ll have a spare for you to borrow. 

Silks and Lyra shall be a danglin’ for those to move, stretch and play. Beneath the highline participants find a playful shaded net to hang and watch the highliners from below. Small ground level slacklines are also connect to excite your balance.  Come play and learn something new, or show us your skills and have some fun!

The highline will only be available for people to try when we have some of our pro-slacker Dads around to ensure safety, so if you wanna get WAY up high and wiggle on a nylon string, we can’t wait to hear you scream :]

Join us for the tournament of dusty Dad-ly extravagance. Extra points if you bring your playa Dad. Gold stars if you bring your real one ;)

events.title: Contact Improv Curiosity Jam
events.description: My Dad’s house is holding a safe space for curious bodies. We’ll start with a grounding meditation to find centered stillness, transition into solo movement, and then curiously play with finding synchronicity with another person. Push and pull and lean and fall your way into presence and aliveness. The jam will be lightly guided, beginners and experts are welcome. There will be close physical contact with others, but it is NOT a sexual space.

events.title: Healing Your Father-Wounds
events.description: Hurt by your dad? Who wasn’t? Everyone is welcome at ‘My Dad’s House’ as we do some reframing about our past, our wounds, our history with the role of “father” in our lives. Be ready to dive deep, be vulnerable, and shift your perspective so you can see just how whole, loved and healed you are! We will use storytelling, writing and small groups to help facilitate a powerful shift in how we see ourselves and our dads.

events.title: Live Jam Band in Dad’s Garage
events.description: My Dad’s House has a full garage-band set up to bring resonant live music energy to our broader playa family. We’re excited to share our musical talents with you and rock down the house. There will be a crew of musical devotees comprised of touring musicians and friends playing into the wee hours of the morn. Come hear their gospel. We promise live rock and warm smiles (plus a contentious game on our pool table and a cozy lounge on the couch). We’re hanging. We can’t wait to meet ya!

events.title: Kickball Bonanza in 9:00 Plaza!
events.description: Two teams, one ball, lots of encouragement, team spirit and community. Join us in a radically inclusive game of Kickball with your fellow Daddies. Each player is required to take a moment to travel back to being a kid on the playground. Everyone was a big shot... maybe some were on the sidelines! All that matters here is that we're having fun! All players must cheer each other on, give each other pats on the back, and kick that ball with all they got!! You'll be surrounded by the best, most excited, proud dads of all with big ol' open daddy hearts ready to give you a pat on the back when you hit home plate or even get tagged out.

history.description:
My Dad's House is actually your dad's house. He's out back talking about how interstellar plasma opened the door to new dimensions while leading a pu'er tea ceremony. Some Malort shots may have been involved as well. It was his idea, really, but we're running with it.

We're an antiquated reprieve from the dusty digitization, complete with some cozy lounge spaces, a cheeky bar, and a stage full of stooges. If you're in the neighborhood, swing by for some live tunes, uncouth art, cheap booze, or to just take a nap in the shade. 

Looking for a place to perform some radical self-expression? Drop us a line. We're stoked to facilitate individual offerings to the playa with our infrastructure.

events.title: Mindful Movement - Meditation & Contact Improv
events.description:
Join us in the shade for a mellow morning of intention & play! We'll start with meditation, and then gently begin moving our bodies and exploring consensual touch. If you've never done contact improvisational dance - no worries - we'll provide plenty of guidance (while also making sure you're living up to the first rule of contact improv dance, which is...there is no rules...let your curiousity guide you, and listen through your body for what movement wants to be expressed!)  If you are a lover of contact dance - this will be a great space for you to re-connect with the ethos of non-attachment, exploration, and just letting the dance be what it is. Overall - join some fellow embodied mindful creatures for play and platonic intimacy :)

Hosted by: Lucia Pohlman

Want to participate at Tomorrow Today driving to the Playa in an old VW Bus or other unique camper? Well, Welcome Home to VW Bus Camp, a wonderful Burning Man theme camp which has been placed and participated on the Playa every Burn since 1998. So first, make sure to change out your leaky fuel lines, check your tires, carry a fire extinguisher and pack lots and lots of spare parts and then join us and participate in Camp's many interactive projects. Yep, we still have a tie dye party amongst other cool stuff. This is a wonderful opportunity for you to bring out your own projects to share and teach us all something new. Welcome Home and see you in the dust!

history.description: "Come to kindly terms with your ass, for it bears you" opens John Muir's How to Keep Your VW Alive DIY repair guide, for the Compleat Idiot. For Animalia we invite all Playa Idiots and would be idiots to visit Bus Camp for our Leopard Lounge and Day Spa where we offer tequila shots, foot massage and clean white cotton socks, Grateful Dyed tie dye party, crafts, camp tours of our asses, I mean buses, and how we feed and take care of these old beasts. We've been doing this on Playa since 1998. To quote John Muir again "The type of life your bus contains differs from yours by time scale, logic level and conceptual anomalies but is "Life" nonetheless. It's Karma depends on your desire to make and keep it Alive!" Camp's "Life" is Equality and Community, come visit and see for yourselves.

Enter camp, tour and experience 1990's style Burning Man. Expect so many surprises and so much fun that you will never want to leave. Also, bring a white cotton T shirt for Wednesday's Grateful Dyed party!

Bring something made of natural fibre: cotton, linen, rayon, you get the hint and while you wait for your art to soak you can slide over to the Leopard Lounge and Spa for a cold beer or a shot of tequila (providing ID please) then come back over and finish your art. You will take it home and wash it there.  See you in the Dust.

history.description: For Metamorphoses VW Bus Camp is bringing back our fabulous Leopard Lounge and Day Spa, Grateful Dyed tie dye party, Mothers' High Tea, Hooping, Games and Brain Freeze. Now celebrating our 22'd Burn on the Playa, for the first time we will play the role of a "Living History of Burning Man" camp. Think of us as interpreters of an event we all think we already really know? Wander through camp and experience the closest most of you will ever get to a circa 1990's Burning Man theme camp, check out the cool old buses and hang with us. For the 1% of Burners out there with more Playa experience, please visit us and let us hear how full of it we are.

history.description: VW Bus Camp and Leopard Lounge is happy and thankful to be able to share our dusty collection of iconic old VW campers and our inviting and playful Leopard Lounge and Day Spa with citizens of BRC for our 21st Burn. Returning are favorite projects like the Grateful Dyed tie dye party, Hoop Jam and the new acts that you'll need to visit to see!

events.title: Grateful Dyed
events.description: Come make tie-dye art with us. Bring something of natural fiber. Cotton, linen, silk, hemp. You will make art at burning man  Drink tequila at the Leopard Lounge and listen to your favorite Grateful Dead.

events.title: Sunset Spin to Stardust
events.description:
Watch the sunset at the art installation Stardust!
Join us for a trip into a special galaxy not so far, far away. 

We leave on bike from VW Bus Camp’s Leopard Lounge at 6pm.

history.description: Come visit and celebrate with us our 20th Burn on the Playa for Radical Ritual and experience a taste of Burning Man from the1990's, a happy continuum, one which still feels fresh and fun. The Leopard Lounge and Day Spa is returning better than ever, along with our Grateful Dye and Hoop Jam parties, Mothers' High Tea, many games, Sparkles, lectures, live music, and lots of beautiful VW Buses!

events.title: Blondie Parallel Lines Singalong
events.description: Don't leave me hanging on the telephone - costumes & props are apropos, bring yours, and/or maybe the desert will provide. One way or another, we will sing the whole album. Picture this: We all sing along with the album from the bottom of our hearts, perhaps on top of a big bus? Fade away and radiate...your flashy blinkies. Pretty baby, please stop by & join us for one or all twelve songs. I know, but I don't know where we'll be placed, just look up VW Bus Camp. It's 11:59, and I want to stay alive. Will anything happen? Yes, Sunday girl, Y comprise un verse en Francais. Once I had a love, and it was a gas, please don't be, a pain in the ass - everyone deserves to sing! I'm gonna love you too - strangers are friends you haven't met yet. When it's over, don't go away sad, don't go pre-fab, don't go away mad, just...you know.

events.title: Grateful Dyed
events.description: Bring your natural fibre to VW Bus Camp and enjoy a moop free tie dye workshop.  Do art, and take a fun memory home.  We have all the supplies including washing soap and baggie with instructions to keep your project clean and damp until you get home to wash it out.  The Grateful Dead music will keep us rocking and you can enjoy libations at the Leopard Lounge before during and after.  This is the 10th Grateful Dyed.

events.title: Mothers’ High Tea

Music provided, some hoops available to share.

events.description: Can you read another players mind?  or wrist?  Or maybe roll the RockPaperScissors dice.  Come have some fun with us.

history.description: Our 19th Burn on the Playa, VW Bus Camp will share the Vitruvian Van, your opportunity to learn about the proportions and function of the VW Bus, this light and once inexpensive, ubiquitous utility van, one of the world's only vehicles that can carry its own weight and travel over any road, repurposed here for magic. VW Bus Camp is returning with our greatest ever Leopard Lounge and Day Spa, Grateful Dyed tie dye Party, Hoop Jam, games, lectures, vehicle repair and much, much, more!

events.title: Beer: Ice cold keg
events.description: For the 7th year in a row, TImekeeper & Big Mike will be at VW Bus Camp's Leopard Lounge pouring ice cold trucked down from Seattle's Pike Brewery.  Wednesday and Friday afternoon.  Starts shortly after lunch and ends when the kegs are empty.  Bring your thirst, you cup, and your ID.

events.title: Grateful Dyed Tie Dye workshop
events.description: Come to Buscamp and enjoy Moop free tie dye.  Bring something natural fibre to tie dye.  We have all the supplies you need.  We have helpers to assist you with your designing.  We send you off with your creation in a zip lock bag to rinse out at home along with the soap you need.  Enjoy the work shop, some grateful dead music and spend some time in the Leopard Lounge while your creation soaks in the soda ash bath... Peace

history.description: Experience VW Bus Camp's twisted take on Carnival of Mirrors by participating in the distorted 1960's spectacle that our VW Buses now represent. Take in our Leopard Lounge and Day Spa, carnival booths and games, Grateful Dyed tie dye party, lectures on trippy subjects including VW repair and maintenance, thoughts on the dead french philosophers and take part in our silly effort to reimagine the '60s and contemplation of the safety of Lawn Jarts!

events.title: Almost Sunset Hoop Jam
events.description:
That orb in the sky is powering up your super spinning powers. 
Use them before the sun goes down at our annual hoop jam! Music courtesy of Sparkles the Bus. We’ll have some hoops on hand. Bring more if you can. Then afterward, join us for a gorgeous view of the sunset on top of Sparkles.

events.title: Sunset Whisky Tasting
events.description: Sunset Whisky Tasting.  Bring your best Scottish accent, and your worst Scottish Whisky to our sunset deck.  Bottles will be placed on a giant map of Scotland according to where they were distilled.    Much conjecture and beard stroking anticipated. Other stroking optional.

events.title: The Grateful Dyed
events.description: Bring something clean and 100% cotton. Moop free tie dye. Jam to some grateful dead music & make art.  Dye at Buscamp and rinse @ home.  We have all the supplies and you just come.

events.title: VW BUS OR BUST!?!
events.description: Step right up step right up !! Come one come all and take your chances with a spin of the wheel, for the placement of a very unique Volkswagen Bus Camp Stamp !! If you love your custom rubber playa stamps , and we know you do, please come through.

history.description: VW Bus Caravaners, stop and camp with the VW Bus Caravansary at Black Rock City. Stay and participate with us at the great Burning Man Caravansary, before continuing on your paths across the wilderness of Nevada and places beyond, VW Bus Camp, where camaraderie and the spirit of Burning Man has lived on now for 17 Burns.

All VW Bus pilots landing on the Playa are invited to join us for our 16th Burn as we return, not expectantly waiting for cargo from John Frum, or even Larry Harvey, but to deliver and share fun with citizens of BRC. Camp’s Newbielandia newbie acculturation project, tie dye party, hooping extravaganzas, yoga, Leopard Lounge day spa and tiki bar, Playa famous vehicle repair, Burners Without Matches, live music, lectures on olive oil and original Buddhism will return!

Survivors of an ill conceived ticket lottery, VW Bus Camp invites Black Rock City’s great new cohort of Playa virgins arriving in a VW bus to join us on our fertile camp ground, ready to be re-sown with love and with play. This, our 15th year on the Playa.

VW Bus Camp welcomes all Transitional Beings and new camp mates to join us for our 14th year on the Playa.  Relax in our Urban Jungle Day Spa, party in the Leopard Lounge Tiki bar and the Rasta bar, ride BusZilla 2 the VW Bus based articulated art car, grab one of our many hula hoops and hoop away while enjoying a brew, learn tie dying, all in a camp of dusty Burners and their fabulous VW Buses!

Enter VW Bustropolis and experience unique ways of metro living. Relax in our Urban Jungle Day Spa, get a new/old look at Bus Camp’s Grateful Dyed tie dye party, hitch a ride on BusZilla 2 our  gas/electric articulating VW Bus people mover, Hula Hoop while enjoying fine brews at camp’s Hoopa Dome!

Camp with us in your VW bus and evolve, devolve, this our 12th year on the Playa. Visit and ride BusZilla 2, our articulating VW bus based, Mothra fighting, electric/gas late Pleistocene people mover. Return for great hula hooping and beer. We are evolutionary proof that the slowest survive on love!

VW Bus Camp welcomes all arriving in a VW Bus or other unique camping         vehicle to join our camp. Visit us and experience the unique American         Dream that comes from experienced Burners still driving these archaic         and slow vehicles, hula hooping to a non-stop 4th of July, dreaming of         strong tail winds!

Come celebrate VW Bus Camp’s 10th year on the Playa by joining camp in your VW or other unique camping vehicle. You will be welcomed by our giant Bus Camp Man while enjoying the Leopard Lounge, snuggling in the Hubble Cuddle Dome, playing Hoops and Beer, listening to Radio Dionysus, utilizing the Bus Camp Free Store, riding in our helicopter, and participating in our Sawmi’s Lunar Eclipse celebration The Marrige of the Sun and the Moon!

VW Bus Camp welcomes all arriving on the Playa in a VW Bus or other strange and unique camping vehicle to join us, now in our 9th year at Burning Man.  In 2006 we shall conspire in The Bat Cave and play Hoops and Beer in our most beautiful VW Bus village!

VW Bus Camp welcomes all Burning Man participants arriving in a VW Bus or other amazing and personal camping vehicle to join us, now in our 8th year. Visit us and experience a unique Burning Man community, one that can only be delivered to you from experienced burners in a VW Bus!

VW bus owners and worshipers unite for the 7th incarnation of VW Bus Camp. Be ye air or water cooled or just enjoy the smell of a toasty engine, all are equally welcome. Renowned for a relaxed atmosphere of sharing and creating, join us as we shed the dogmatic shackles of our so-called normal lives in the true spirit of burning man.

VW Bus Camp is maturing like a fine wine. Join us for our 6th consecutive year. Eclectic bus owners unite, share the nomadic spirit in the Bus Camp Lounge with good food, good drink, and of course our world famous great vibes. (And yes, our water-cooled friends are welcome also).

VW Bus Camp is back for our 5th consecutive year. Eclectic bus owners unite, share the nomadic spirit in the Bus Camp Lounge with good food, good drink, and of course great vibes. (And yes, our water-cooled friends are welcome also)
Good vibes, good times, nomadic spirits unite at the 4th annual VW Bus Camp. Owner or worshiper, air or water cooled, all are welcome.

VW Bus Camp is back for our 3rd consecutive year. Celebrate your nomadic spirit, bring your bus and good vibes. Create, share, emulate, and “Burn” with us. Enjoy the all new Bus Camp lounge and Massage tent.
Welcome all air and water-cooled nomadic bus gypsys’ to our concentric crop circle of fun. Join our Phamily in the all new Bus Camp Lounge as we Burn together with peace, love and buses.
The Bus spiral will become a growing mechanical crop circle, alive with its inhabitants and aircooled engines.

Atlantis returns from the dust with mezcal, myth, and music. Our lounge is open 24/7. Two DJ parties to incite dance rituals. By day: tea, meditation, and rest. By night: light, rhythm, and strange delights. Come curious. Stay so long that you forget why you came.

The demigods of Atlantis invite dusty desert travelers to relax at our mystical shaded and fanned oasis. Our mischievous hosts will offer up savory treats to our guests in hopes they might become enchanted by the oasis and never leave. We invite our new friends to join us each afternoon in bacchanalian festivals and indulge in rituals of song and dance. Once the sun sets, mysterious lights illuminate the caves of Atlantis which reward nocturnal travelers with sweet treats and interactive surprises.

history.description: Imagine a future a thousand years from now.  We have lost all history and technology, but discovered strange artifacts and the sun gods.  Let's worship deep house with them…

events.title: Sunset DJ Parties w/ Atlantis
events.description:
Dance to deep house, enjoy tasty drinks, experience art / panoramic views from our towers, and celebrate the setting of the sun god over the playa.

------

The legendary city of Atlantis has fallen and many millennia have passed.  All that remains are ancient artifacts used by the inhabitants in radical rituals.  

We don’t understand where or when these sacred artifacts came from or what they mean.  But they have been recovered from the sands of time… and we are inexplicably drawn to these objects… we worship them. 
 
As a rite of passage, pilgrims from all over the playa flock to the Towers of Atlantis for a week once a year to worship the sun god.  The unbearable intensity of his sight will be shaded by a pleasing geometric covering that will be a gathering spot for deep house music dance rituals and the imbibing of tasty spirits.

Join us in our radical ritual!

history.description:
We seek out the weary, the overheated and the disconnected to offer our signature Icy Hands experience.  The instantaneous sense of relief, joy and connection turns recipients into PARTICIPANTS and makes them part of a larger whole.  Icy Hands epitomizes "the gift that keeps on giving"  by coaching recipients through providing the experience to others.  Hands are cooled to near freezing temperatures by means of a simple block of ice, then with full positive consent of the recipient, those hands are placed upon the neck and jaw, providing an immediate sense of cool, calm and connection. 

Block of Ice: $5.  Memories, endorphins, friendship and dopamine rush: PRICELESS.

history.description: The pinhole project provides daily art making workshops and hosts a gallery of the pinhole photography art we create throughout the week. We maintain a large fleet of cameras which we use to document the art and community of Burning Man. We believe this traditional analog form of photography provides a nice contrast for folks to slow down and become more present with art making. Our offering is art making, communal effort, inclusion and gifting. Ideally, we like to take pinhole photographs of playa artists in front of their installations. We believe documenting creators with their work is a delicious form of acknowledgement and provides a wonderful gift.

events.title: Pinhole Project \<>/ come create ART!
events.description:
Come and join us to experience the creative process of making fine art photography, in its purest form, through the eye of a pinhole. No lenses, no mechanics, no digital sensors.  100% Pure Vintage Photographic Alchemy.  We bring the gear, darkroom, chemistry, and knowledge – you come and co-create with us.

Explore the Playa making images, and then come back to our darkroom to see the magic of an image appearing on the paper; or enjoy browsing through our camp’s Pinhole Gallery.  Every image we make is scanned for archive and digital display - and most original photographs are gifted.

We honor and acknowledge all the artists and creators of Burning Man installations with our equally monumental photographic equipment.

https://pinholeproject.org/

We have 8+ boards ready to come play. The boards are setup & always here for you :) but the dice will only listen to our commands ;-)

events.title: Come Make Art, Pinhole Style!!!
events.description:
The pinhole project has been doing the pinhole thing on playa since 1999. We need to break down the darkroom on Saturday but we can't do that until we blow our wad... of photo paper.

Our cameras shoot 40" x 30" and 20" x 16" paper negatives. We brought 120 sheets of photo paper, today we need to use it all up. We have the cameras, darkroom, chemistry, but we don't have YOU! Come now!!!

We have a weekly class / workshop that starts every morning around 10 or so.

history.description:
Black Rock Disc Golf Club has a mushroom-themed disc golf course which embraces fun, games, friendly competition, collaboration, and creativity. We provide a place where folks can join together and throw one of the custom stamped discs loaned out at the camp. You can win one at one of our tournaments or events! The course is accessible 24/7, and discs glow in the dark so don't hesitate to swing by late night/early morning for a round. 


We also have some mushroom hazards on the course! We have tall ones, small ones, ones that glow, and ones that show you what disc golf is all about. It's definitely a psychedelic experience to walk through, even if you aren't in the mood to play a round. Just make sure to listen for the call of, "FORE!"

history.description:
Black Rock Disc Golf Club has a mushroom-themed disc golf course which embraces fun, games, friendly competition, collaboration, and creativity. We provide a place where folks can join together and throw one of the custom stamped discs loaned out at the camp. You can win one at one of our tournaments or events! The course is accessible 24/7, and discs glow in the dark so don't hesitate to swing by late night/early morning for a round. 

We also have some mushroom hazards on the course! We have tall ones, small ones, ones that glow, and ones that show you what disc golf is all about. It's definitely a psychedelic experience to walk through, even if you aren't in the mood to play a round. Just make sure to listen for the call of, "FORE!"
24/7 LED disc golf! We have discs, and multiple tournaments!  Newbies welcome!

history.description:
This year we're bringing the disc golf course to a whole new level and will be building out the psychedelic forest to incorporate some trippy art and oomfy shade structures for the community to enjoy. As burners begin or end their adventure into open playa, they can stop by the disc golf course 24/7 to throw some discs through our glowing nine-hole disc golf, trip out under our 10' tall mushrooms, or grab a drink and relax in the Gopher's Hole during happy hour.

We'll be constructing a trippy forest to act as obstacles for the 9-hole disc golf course. The disc course will be open for play all of the burn, with LED discs for night play. The forest will be made different fun obstacles and will include 15' tall tye-dye trees to 10' tall mushrooms to dozens of 3' mushrooms, all of which will  light up bright for the fairies to prance through deep into the night.

Come by and get your skate groove on at the Black Rock Roller Disco.  Don’t miss the Black Rock Rollergirls roller derby game Thursday evening and Soul Train night on Friday night.

There’s a place on the playa where the funk and disco beat will have you rollin’ nonstop!!!  Make tracks to the Black Rock Roller Disco where you can roller skate on the playa all day and all night.  The Black Rock Rollergirls will be slamin’ the competition with all girl roller derby Thursday, Sept 1 and the bar ia always open.  You can even show ohh your foosball skills!!!

No visit to the playa will be complete until you shake your booty and get your skate groove on at the Black Rock Roller Disco. We’ll be pumping the old school funk and roller disco beat ’til your wheels fall off.  The Black Rock Rollergirls will kick ass with roller derby action. Stop by and say hi

Come get your skate groove on at the Black Rock Roller Disco. We’re open 24/7 and will be pumpin’ up the jams with the old school funk and roller disco beat. This year DJ/s are linging up and the band, Soul Glow will be in the house.  Take a ride on the Soul Train or stop at the Soul Man Bar.

The Black Rock City’s roller rink will be in the house!!!  We have Black Rock Rollergirls are doing roller derby games and the band “Soul Glow” will be playing on Friday night. We’ll have a bigger rink, more skates and the old school funk and roller disco music will make you dance all night long.

The Black Rock Roller Disco comes to the desert each year as an extention of the fantastic skating scene you will find in San Francisco’s Golden Gate Park, New York’s Central Park and and the skate spot in Venice Beach. Ca. We love to skate and we want to share the joy of skating with everyone at Burning Man. We will be rollin’ 24/7 to the old school funk and roller disco beat. We’ll have over 100 pairs of skates, skate instructors, performances AND all girl roller derby. Bring your skates and plan to boogie with the Black Rock Rollers.
The Black Rock Roller Disco is back on the Playa in 2006.  Come and get your skate groove on with us as we continue to build on the ultimate interactive Burning Man exoerience ON WHEELS!!!!!

This year we will have a wedding on the rink as two of our burner skaters will do the permanant hook up thang. We’ll have skates, but if you have some, BRING THEM!!!!!!!

events.title: Eye Gazing
events.description: We may often avoid eye contact with “strangers” in society. However, sharing unbroken eye contact may increase your mindfulness and deepen your connections with people. Like meditation, eye gazing may leave you feeling more spiritually open, connected and relaxed. The difference with eye gazing is that you share these experiences with another person. People who have eye gazed have made long life connections, and even found love! Will you find love looking into the eyes of a stranger? Although we cannot guarantee this, but we can however facilitate a place for those willing to share an unbroken gaze into the eyes of a stranger. The space will be available for 30 minutes. Gazing partners will be limited to the number of consenting gazers in the space. Importantly there is not a time limit you can gaze for as long as or a little as you feel comfortable. We will not force gazing time and if any gazer decides to end a gaze we respect their decision. To get started we suggest you try eye gazing with someone you know for a minute. If you are not immediately ready to dive into a gaze feel free to watch other eye gazers. You may find mediating a few minutes before a gaze may ease you into it.

We utilize music, intention, ritual, energy work and guidance to help you access Source, your inner Divinity, your true essence of being.  This transcendental breathwork guides you to awaken, to remember, to transform.  

By breathing in a conscious, connected, circular manner, you are actively breathing  life force energy into your Being; and, in doing so, you are inviting the intelligence that lives within the breath to dissolve, melt, release any blockages,  suppressed and/ or repressed emotions and experiences from our past.  In releasing the old, the stagnant, the unconscious patterning using your breath as your healing modality, you also then are open to receiving the “new” — new information, clarity, confirmation, creative expansion, and a whole host of possibilities based on your soul’s desires.

While some people use plant medicines to access these non-ordinary states of consciousness, we will only be using our breath in our session — nothing will be ingested other than deeply connecting with our breath. Please bring an eye mask or bandana, yoga mat (or something to lie on), blanket(s) and a pillow.  Please arrive on time as we will journey as a group.

Get creative, get inspirational, wear a costume or just belt out a classic ballad. If this sound like something you will enjoy (or would be a great opportunity to step outside your comfort zone) sign up to the Lip-sync Battle 2016.
Space is limited, so register early at Camp Anita! Bring your song on an USB or MP3 player. Ask for Tim or Verity!
For some inspiration watch the teaser video from PapaZahns (Camp Anita’s Sister Camp) at this years Blazing Swan (Western Australian Regional Burn) in the URL link provided.

history.description:
Camp Exclamation Mark! at Burning Man welcomes high-energy, exciting participants and visitors from the "Immediate Here" to everywhere. We strongly value self-expression, are open (in mind and connection), and infectious (in vibe and fun). Our events are about genuine connections, thought-provoking and self-help thoughts, and we love hosting unique themed parties!

Join Our Camp – One of our strengths is our diversity in camp-mates
Expecting 100 members for 2023
Global – mostly USA (California, Las Vegas, Arizona, Colorado, New England, Texas, Atlanta), Canada, Europe, Australia
Age Inclusive: 21 – 60 welcome (we are mostly in 30's)

If you're looking for a 3rd year camp that you can grow with from the beginning, message us!

Learn how to become aware of and heal your inner child wounds, your walls/defenses and your societal conditioning to understand who you truly are. Learn tools to see the truth of the situation: that we are all souls in human bodies projecting our wounds onto each other, while providing each other with opportunities for growth. Our responsibility is to heal those wounds and realign with our soul.
Madison Creel is a certified mystical therapist whose goal is to empower others to facilitate their own self realization and expansion.

Then once you learn your new moves, as a group, we will surprise-pop up to a neighboring camp or art piece and we will flash mob them with our robot skills!
