events.description: The Burn can be overstimulating, right?  Need a reset?  Time Walk (playa name) invites you to join a positive group in a positive space where he will first show you breathing exercises, then guide you through the meditation for 20 minutes.  Mindful breathing will help enable you to consciously influence your breathing in daily life.  Please be on time or plan to arrive early!

events.title: Make Your Mark at Camp Exclamation Mark!
events.description: Get marked with our free Henna Tattoos plus Free Hats and Hat Decorating Art Workshop. How will you make your mark? Add some flava to yourself for the week, and a hat you own or just use a new one (limited supply only so remember to arrive early)

events.title: “Sun Cheese” Free Grilled Cheese Before Sun Down
events.description: We love Moon Cheese, but figured you would be hungry during the day too.  Delicious, toasty, and cheesy.  Come early and hang out!  We love cheesy conversations.

events.title: Nothin better Than The 90’s DJ Set! + Open Bar
events.description: Spinnin your favorite throwback tunes from the 90’s! TLC / Spice Girls / Smash Mouth / Nirvana / Snoop Dogg / Backstreet Boys / Blink 182 / Fresh Prince (do the Carlton dance with us)

events.title: Lessons Learned before The Burn + Walk to Man Burn
events.description: Before the week is over, come enjoy free drinks and talk about how the principles have influenced/impacted your burn, any stories you care to share, and what you hope to bring back with you to the default world. All are invited, especially those who may want new friends to watch the burn with. Walk to and watch the Man Burn with our camp!

history.description: Shwashbucklers, Pirate Loners, and Social Captains, we RADICALLY salute and invite you all to visit our friendly camp! Whether you came to Burning Man alone, or want to meet new people outside of your camp, our space is one that is open, comfortable, and encouraging of new interactions and connections.  Set sail with Friend SHIP on a journey of new friendships, Pirate Slur (ARRRRRR!), live DJs (not just house music), a bar, and interactive events.

events.title: Camp Friend SHIP Pirate Happy Hour!
events.description: Bring your own friends or make some new friend! Live DJ + Open bar.

events.title: Friend SHIP Party with Friendship Bracelets!
events.description: Workshop. Live DJs.

events.title: Friend SHIP Pirate Treasure Scavenger Hunt
events.description: BRC Land-Lovers, ARRRREEE you ready for riches beyond your wildest dreams? Come grab a tankard full of the plightiest rum and join our pirate themed scavenger hunt. Pirate themed prizes & booty for all pirate participants! Sometimes, the real treasure isn't what's found at where X marks the spot, it's the new friends made along the way.

events.title: Friend SHIP Welcome party!
events.description: Friend SHIP Welcome party + "Make your own bike name tag" workshop where you can make a name tag (luggage tag) for your beloved bike with playa name, and playa address. (We provide the tags, Music, and Open bar!

events.title: Friend Speed Dating!
events.description: Open invite to everyone, but extra special invite to those who came to Burning Man by yourself. We wanna meet you! If one of your intentions for the burn is to open up and meet new people, this event is for you! No romantic expectations, just a way to connect with rad people and maybe make some new, lifelong friends!

events.title: Guided Sunset Meditation
events.description: In spirit of the Friend SHIP camp theme, a portion of the meditation will have a dyad portion for a Listening and talking exercise.

events.title: Playa Pirate Party
events.description: If you're on the playa, you're a pirate by default, no matter how you're dressed! Come shake that treasure booty! Event with live DJs, open Bar with Pirate themed drinks, we will be handing out pirate eye patches and other accessories to everyone attending.

events.title: Music Meditation
events.description: Join us for a trip to outer space through music and guided meditation led by star-crossed lovers Simon and Tonya.

events.title: Transcendental Yoga
events.description: Join us for a transcendental, expansive, and just the right amount of silly yoga flow by Sierra Madre.

events.title: Kundalini Yoga
events.description: Let's set the perfect tone for the week together with a grounding and elevating Kundalini practice by Tonya Papanikolov.

history.description: La Ville Bohème is a haven for the artistically inclined, seeker of depth, eccentric soul. Calling all musicians and lovers of music to come play, dance in the Bohemian living room.
La Ville Bohème is a haven for the artistically inclined, seeker of depth, eccentric soul. Calling all musicians and lovers of music to come play, dance, and bask in the medicine of sound.

Cirque Du Sol Riser is a fire, flow, and movement arts camp bringing high-energy performances, absurd competitions, and interactive workshops to Black Rock City. From the sultry "Sex on a Slackline" showdown to the "Butt Cheek Olympics," we invite you to play, perform, and push your limits. Our fire jams and "Heckle & Flow Show" nights challenge performers to spin their props while enduring comedic roasts from the crowd. Whether you're here to dance, heckle, or simply bask in the spectacle, we welcome all playful souls to join the fun!

events.title: Heckle & Flow Fire Show
events.description: Got flame game? Prove it. Where brutal, loving & utterly unnecessary commentary is not just allowed—it’s encouraged.

events.title: Sol Risers Fire Show
events.description: Hearts On Fire: a full-throttle fire show fanning the flames of radical love, in all it's forms!

history.description: GOOD JOB! You made it to Burning Man. Now come playfully question existence with us at STEEP?. Explore you inner child with games, heckling, random acts of wonder, authenticity, connection, and... DRINKS. We love them. With alcohol, without alcohol, and often featuring plant extracts and ALWAYS made with love. Come Drink in the Love at camp STEEP? ya weirdos.

events.title: Nickelback Pickleback
events.description: The return of the game no one asked for! Come by and earn your stamp. Scream "Are we having fun yet?"

history.description: GOOD JOB! You made it to Burning Man. Now come on down and get STOOPid with us. Explore you inner child with games, heckling, random acts of wonder and befuddling art, clowning, gooning, and general mayhem. We also have refreshing tea, a lounge, hammocks, and shade if you don't like having fun.

events.title: Mischief and Mayhem!
events.description: Stop by for games, self serve tea, competitive heckling, clowning and what other madness we make!

events.title: Clowning Around!
events.description: Come find your inner clown! Through movement, silly games & exercises we’ll unleash your inner child!

events.title: Stoop  id Fortuneteller
events.description: The most profound and sometimes stupid very old fortune telling that burning man can provide

events.title: Negroni Happy Hour
events.description: Start off your evening with the greatest cocktail ever invented while listening to jazz, funk, soul and Digby Jones.

events.title: Nickelback or Pickleback
events.description: It’s the game no one asked for and we don’t even want to host…

events.title: Silly Self Soothing
events.description: Get ready to laugh, play, and regulate your nervous system.

events.title: Hamm-Lee Foam Evening (Family Home Evening)
events.description: An ex-mormon meet and greet at Burning Man. If you know, you know. Bring refreshments. (Rice Crispy Treats?)

events.title: Play STOOPid Games, Win STOOPid Prizes
events.description: Come play incredibly silly party games and win equally silly prizes!

events.title: Corporate Takeover
events.description: Wear your power suits and power ties (NO BIZ CAS, IT AIN'T FRIDAY) and join us as we extract value from the desert.

history.description: Camp STEEP! is a chill space where you can come and enjoy a custom made cup of tea from our massive apothecary of over 50 different teas and herbs. Come have a seat and let some of the stimulation of the playa roll away as you Drink in the Love!

events.title: Herbal Tea with Camp STEEP!
events.description:
STEEP! is home to a large apothecary of herbs and chill space. Come sit with us while we prepare you a hot, cold, creamy, and/or sweet cup of tea while enjoying the opportunity to calm your nerves and recharge your batteries so you're ready to rock the playa again!
Special Chinese Tea Ceremony on Friday from 12-2 and then regular herbal tea service resumes until 5pm.

events.title: Nervous System Regulation for Sexuality
events.description:
Ever find yourself feeling a little overwhelmed or reserved when you know that at your core there is a divine, sexual being just waiting to be unleashed? Come join an ORGASM coach as she shares some of her best tricks to biohacking your neurobiology so that you can regulate your nervous system quickly and easily. During the workshop you will learn simple embodiment practices for your default stress response (super useful while you're spending time on the playa). Then you'll learn a quick and easy way to harness quantum energy to create safety for yourself or a partner so you can experience heightened conscious, consensual sexual experiences. 
This is a judgment free zone!

history.description: STEEP! Is a place of refuge and home within home. We offer herbal tea and chinese tea ceremonies. Our space is generally quiet and peaceful with space for doing art, receiving a healing or intuitive reading or listening to live music. Come rest and recharge with a delicious cup of tea brewed just for you from over 50 different herbs. Drink in the love!

events.title: Tea Ceremony
events.description:
It's been a wild week and it's not over yet. Recharge your chi with this sacred & meditative tea ceremony. Chinese tea is an experience of the Tao in action. 
Starts on time, limited space. Be there or square.

events.title: Tea for Transformation
events.description: An alchemical cup of tea awaits you! Hot, cold, sweet or straight we have a bar of over 50 herbs to bring you home to your heart! Drink in the Love!

history.description: On the surface we are a gloriously over the top tea and herbal apothecary camp. We have over 50 herbs and teas. On a deeper level we create a conscious space for expansion, connection and love to renew all burners who join us for tea and transformation.

events.title: Past Life Regression Workshop
events.description:
Have you ever considered that some of the issues or emotions you are experiencing may not be from this life?

Past life regression is a workshop for exploring past lifetimes in order to release the influence they have over you now. You will have the opportunity to free yourself of emotion, karma and reconnect with lifetimes in which you had positive experiences.

Come and join at Camp Steep and add to your burning man experiences with a fun, dynamic journey of energy healing!

events.title: Sacred Tea Ceremony
events.description: In a roughly traditional Chinese tea ceremony style, we invite you to join us for a profound journey through tea. Beginning with silence we will connect with the tea and ourselves. This ceremony will have a sense of the sacred to it. Come prepared to enter a meditative space. Space is limited, please arrive on time. The ceremony will start at 12 and end around 2 with our regular herbal tea bar service resuming 2-5pm.

events.title: Tea and Transformation
events.description: Slow down with us for a magical cup of tea brewed just for you. Over 50 different herbs and teas, our apothecary is ready to support you mind, body and spirit. Chill in our space while you wait for your tea to brew. Connect, create and participate! Come Drink in the Love!

history.description: Transformational Tea and Conversation. We are a space for rejuvenation, replenishment and self discovery. Join Camp STEEP! for a delicious cup of herbal tea. With more than 50 herbs at our tea bar, we have a custom tea blend to sort you out, lift you up and leave you ready for more dusty adventures. Drink in the Love!

events.title: Teas, Tisanes and Timelessness
events.description: Camp STEEP invites you for a nourishing and refreshing cup of herbal tea. Hot, iced, sweet or creamed we have got over 40 different herbs and teas that we custom blend just for you! Witness the magical alchemy yourself, your senses will be glad you did! Hang out in our lounge while you enjoy your tea, converse, draw, or discover the deep inner connection we all share while rejuvenating your mind, body and spirit! Come Drink in the Love with Camp STEEP!

history.description: Stop by Camp STEEP for a fresh cup of hot, iced, creamed or straight herbal and traditional loose leaf teas. Over 40 herbs and teas mixed by hand in front of your eyes! Dreams interpreted, conversations to be had, pillows to be lounged upon - come Drink in the Love!

events.title: Teas, Tisanes and Timelessness
events.description:
Join Camp STEEP for a nourishing and refreshing cup of herbal tea. Hot, iced, sweet or creamed we have got over 40 different herbs and teas that we custom blend just for you! Witness the magical alchemy yourself, your senses will be glad you did!
Hang out in our lounge while you enjoy your tea, converse, draw, or get a dream interpreted!
Come Drink in the Love with Camp STEEP!

history.description: At STEEP we value immersion into love, laughter, and the sacredness of living life to its fullest. Join us for a cup, a workshop, conversation, and creating something beautiful to remember your burn or gift to a loved one.

events.title: Transformational TEA TIME!
events.description: Join Camp STEEP for afternoon tea! Hot, Iced, Creamed, Straight, for your heart, hangover and hydration! We've got all your tea and apothecary needs covered! Come by for a totally customized cup of tea or pick from one of our signature blends. Along with a great cup of tea we are a space for transformational conversation; we might also have some other fun things going on to keep you entertained while you steep and sip. Art projects, card readings, body painting... you never know what might be happening around STEEP! We look forward to seeing you! Open Daily M-Sa 12-4pm and whenever the heck else we want. Drink in the Love!

history.description: Attention all personnel! Come visit the MASH 4207th - best care anywhere! Relax during the day for ice cold PBRs and the best martinis on the Playa. Enjoy the shade of our vintage tents and the company. Return at night for a break from the chaos of the burn with nightly showings of MASH TV episodes.

events.title: MASH Episode Viewing Parties
events.description: All night, every night! Stop by the 4207th for a relaxing visit to your friends from the MASH television program.

“Best Care Anywhere” The least disciplined but the most hospitable military unit in Black Rock City, M*A*S*H 4207th is the bastion of democracy in the sea of communist infiltrators known as Terminal City. Support your military troops by keeping the commies at bay!

The least disciplined but most hospitable military unit in Black Rock City, M*A*S*H 4207th has been on the playa since 1999, and a registered theme camp since 2000. Feeling unwell? The doctors & nurses of our unit will prescribe inebriation therapy till you can’t walk, then throw you on the stretcher & haul you from post-op to your home camp or where we decide to dump you. Our well-trained alchoholics will gladly eliminate any surplus liquor you may have. Who else on the playa will hand out military spec toilet paper rations at 3 AM when the JoTS have run out? If we like you, you may get invited to the 38th Parallel Medical Society poker game. If we don’t like you, that won’t stop us from giving you shelter from the heat & dust. While the USO seems to be avoiding us, that has never stopped music & comedy from occuring at random in the mess hall. Travel with caution near our camp at night; The CO & others are avid playa fishermen. From draglines to driftnets to simple fishing in front of camp, no tripper wanting that free glow stick is safe from our master anglers. Carry your BRC issued ID near this camp: random security checkpoints at all hours. Raids & blockades of other camps will occur when least expected.

Ocean Beach is a sun-soaked fever dream of surf shacks, sea creatures, and boardwalk absurdity. Join our salty circus for lobster pizza rituals, smoothie shamans, sunset cocktail ceremonies, and the infamous ode to JB's cheeseburger in paradise. Stretch your soul with yoga, tantra, and sound healing. Play boardwalk games, ride silly rides, and lounge like a sea god. We're a 100% green camp and compost collection site riding the tide toward a stranger, better world. New beach bums always welcome — come get weird by the waves.

1001 Nights is a desert sanctuary where anyone who enters our dome is immediately welcomed, acknowledge and heard. We offer Makateeb where you can enjoy an Arabic coffee/tea while writing out your story for our treasure chest.  Once done, you can reach in and read a story left behind. In our main dome we will have DJs, musical acts, spoken word nights, movies under the stars, etc. The dome is decked out with foam flooring, mattresses, cushions, pillows, blankets and low top tables.  So one minute it can be our dancefloor and the next minute our lounge. Whatever the offering, we want people to feel like 1001 nights gives rest to weary souls desperate to recharge.  It should feel like you would want to stay with us for at least 1001 actual nights.

history.description:
At 1001 Nights, we believe in togetherness and generosity, and our core values revolve around sociability and creating strong connections with each others.

Our purpose is to create a haven for nomadic burners under our Dome who reprensents our Sanctuary. Such in a tales, each year our camp comes alive by magic. During one week, the time of a story we invite everyone to be a part of this enchanting experience by joining us and partaking in the traditional offerings we provide under our Dome, creating a space where all come together to celebrate life and create unforgettable memories.

Our stories represent the memories of our Community and are written each year by all the Nighters at our camp, reflecting the constant evolution of our Community.

history.description:
1001 nights is a haven to nomadic folk who journey from all lengths of the world.

Togetherness is our purpose. Our intentions are to bring part of middle eastern heritage and culture to the playa. Generosity and sociability  are the beauty of this culture and we invite whoever to be part of it, indulge as royalty and enjoy traditional offerings to share lovely connections under our dome. We welcome all as if inviting visitors into our homes and our hearts.

Our stories represent us and our project, Makateeb, is our flagship. Makateeb stems from the Arabic word "Makatoob" which means "written". Through it, we provide an immersive and warm environment capturing some middle eastern hospitality of communing and sharing experiences with each other through hand-written letters.

events.title: Makateeb

history.description: 1001 Nights is a desert sanctuary where anyone who enters our dome is immediately welcomed, acknowledge and heard.  We offer Makateeb where you can enjoy an Arabic coffee/tea while writing out your story for our treasure chest.  Once done, you can reach in and read a story left behind. In our main dome we will have DJs, musical acts, spoken word nights, movies under the stars, etc.  The dome is decked out with foam flooring, mattresses, cushions, pillows, blankets and low top tables.  So one minute it can be our dancefloor and the next minute our lounge. Whatever the offering, we want people to feel like 1001 nights gives rest to weary souls desperate to recharge.  It should feel like you would want to stay with us for at least 1001 actual nights.

1001 Nights is a warmly inviting, casually laid-back, heavily oriental-influenced lounge space. Our variety of community Dome offerings are here to please the masses from starting the day with yoga, sharing love through our unique Makateeb experience, releasing into a delicate cranial sacral massages, transforming your look with a personalized braiding session, withdrawing from the playa commotion for an afternoon Tea laying in comfortable Majlis seating, to dancing the night away under the stars.  We are confident you will enjoy paying us a visit. Artists from all horizons are welcome to flow into the Dome and jam their tunes and share their talents.

Drop by our camp to see the daily schedule for morning yoga classes, coffee and tea Makateeb servings, hair braiding & cranial massages and chill afternoon music vibes... we are confident you will enjoy your trip through 1001 Nights!

history.description: 1001 Nights is a warmly inviting, casually laid-back, heavily oriental-influenced lounge space. Our variety of community Dome offerings are here to please the masses: from nurturing and sharing love through our unique Makateeb experience while having delicate cranial massages, to withdrawing from the playa commotion for an afternoon Tea laying in comfortable Majlis seating, we are confident you will enjoy paying us a visit. Artists from all horizons are welcome to flow into the Dome and jam their tunes along our now world renowned hoopers.

1001 Nights is a camp that offers a day oriental lounge to collect love and support MaKaTeeB (Arabic for letters) from burners reaching 1001 MakToob (singular for MaKaTeeB) in the 7 nights of the burning man experience. Spreading the MaKaTeeB nurturing the energy that connects us and spreading love and support: important pillars to the survival of our community. 

The camp also offers a "Majlis" experience with Arabic coffee and sweets served during the day. The lounge will have suspended fabric for shade, floor carpet and seating, playa furniture, in addition to suspended chair hammocks.. The space is open at night for public use with the starry and dreamy lights.

Flow artists are welcome to flow in our space for jams on our flow tunes along with world renowned hoopers.

1001 nights is a camp that offers a social setting every night to collect stories from burners reaching 1001 stories in the 7 nights of the burning man experience. the camp also collects stories every morning offering cheese and zaatar manakeesh (dough based pastries with cheese and Thyme) along with refreshing shots. 

Flow artists are welcome to flow in our space with hoops and pois for workshops or to jam on our flow tunes along with world renowned hoopers.

We are Space Oddity.  We are here to sooth our fellow wearied space travelers with the following:

-To ward off the sickness of having lingered so far from our home star, come bask under our One Square Meter Of Sun lounge, equipped with a fire ceiling built as the ancient Egyptians to fill your pores with flames, who we all know came from space (Hours of operation: 2 hours ending around midnight)

-Fly around in our psychedelic Anti-Gravity Gyroscope, and ready yourself for travel beyond planets (Climb aboard anytime with supervision)

-Rest and relax in the Cosmic Lounge filled with levitating carpets (hammocks), chill Martian beats mixed from our spaceship (always open, music 2 hours daily, dusk)

-Prepare for harsh enviros of new planets with our Steam Chamber and accustom yourself to life without your suit (open 2 hrs in the evening)

-Climb atop our space deck and view the space you have past traveled, peer at the stars and chart your way towards your next frontier (always open)

history.description: Yellow Balloon is a clean and sober camp at Burning Man, offering a space for fun, connection, and wellness without the influence of substances. We host daily recovery meetings, wellness events like yoga and breathwork, and interactive art experiences designed to uplift and engage. Our camp is a vibrant community of burners who love to have a great time while staying sober throughout the burn. We welcome all who are committed to sobriety and those curious to explore a sober experience, providing a supportive, inclusive space to thrive. Join us for a unique blend of fun, recovery, and creativity!

Our Life-Tenders will guide you through a healing ritual based on what you're seeking out of life in the moment. As a bonus, we'll also top off your water bottle before we send you on your way. You'll leave rejuvenated, hydrated, and ready to go explore, connect, and play.

The Yellowstone Burners are excited to invite you onto the upper deck of the old west styled Watering Hole Saloon where we provide shade, cozy seating, beautiful views, and delicious hydration drinks. Don't let the heat of the day get you down! You can even play cards and other games from the interior of our bus and we always have a misting bottle or two on hand. Come on by to enjoy this unique experience of old west hospitality. We're officially open 9ish to noonish, Monday through Friday but we're happy to let you climb on board and have some refreshment any time we're around camp. Please come by and say hello!

Created by the Yellowstone Burners, Saddle Up! is a mutant vehicle based on a school bus, designed to look like a 30 foot tall saddle. The upper deck features The Watering Hole saloon where we will serve electrolyte drinks, teas, and good 'ol plain water. Join us for a unique western experience and get re-hydrated before moving on to your next adventure. We can't wait to Saddle Up! with our fellow Black Rock Citizens.

The Yellowstone Burners come from Northwest Wyoming and specifically Park County which is home to 90% of Yellowstone National Park. Our base is in Cody, Wyoming where we gather to build the Saddle Up! art car. Stop by our camp, when we're not out prowling the playa on our giant saddle, and join us at our campfire for s'mores, drinks, and stories.

events.title: Cacao & Kirtan Ceremony
events.description:
Lift your vibration with a Cosmic Cacao & Kirtan Ceremony! 

For thousands of years, cacao has been celebrated as a food of the gods. Together we will drink ceremonial cacao, giving ourselves the opportunity to enter into the stillness and wisdom of our being. This journey will offer a space to align your actions with your intentions, connect with others and yourself, and engage in mindful movement.  

We will then dive into a kirtan workshop, where we will tap into ancient mantras and awaken our divine voice within. Kirtan is an ancient spiritual practice of Bhakti Yoga designed to collectively raise our vibration through call and response chanting of Sanskrit mantra. Through this repetitive ecstatic chanting we are able to drop in, unify, channel and access the divine within ourselves. This practice of devotional chanting is one of the simplest ways to channel divine energy and experience Bhava, the high or good vibes we feel from kirtan. The mantras invoke certain aspects of the divine and by collectively chanting them we align with that energy and raise our vibration. Our hearts will melt and overflow with divine nectar.

events.title: Opening Up to Intimacy Playshop

Are you curious to discover how to access greater intimacy within yourself and with your partner? Do you want to understand how to honor your desires and set your boundaries?

Through a series of simple and fun somatic games, you will increase your ability to
- FEEL
- KNOW what you want (desires) and what you don’t want (limits)
- ASK for what you want
- NAVIGATE your relationships (in and outside the bedroom) with full consent

You don't need a partner to attend this event. We will pair you up with someone. 

The games will involve sensual touch (not sexual). You will never be asked to do something you don't want to do.

events.title: Into the Deep with Lemurian
events.description:
Born in Peru, Lemurian is a prolific designer of frequencies who punctuates the present moment with the truth of sound. 

He produces vibrations that connect you to your higher self and ancestral knowledge while continually bridging the gap to the conscious mind.
There is something to be found in the soul and his music becomes the tool that creates a connection between all living beings around. He molds the energy of the listener in that moment to become infinite and cultivates the mind to wander in different directions beyond time and space, bringing a simplicity to our reality that incorporates tribal beats, jungle vibes and intergalactic travel. I invite you to close your eyes and let his music guide you, get lost in the space between the worlds, the space where feeling is your only compass.

events.title: Introduction to Ritual Magic
events.description:
Ritual Magic is the embodied practice of using one's will to alter consciousness, through the manipulation of physical reality. It blurs the lines between the experiential, the conceptual, the symbolic, and the phenomenological. 

Come join in a discussion/workshop which explores the foundations and history of ritual magic, a discussion on how to practice it safely/consensually, and (if it calls to you!) perform some rituals with us.

events.description:
Last year on the playa I was helping my friend hydrate his curly hair. The process is a time for us to connect with each other and connect without being physically intimate. It is a service to each other that expresses deep love for one another as our hair is such a point of vulnerability. 

We got so many people approaching us wanting to give a treatment to their hair too and thus was born Crown Connection. Our hair is such a point of vulnerability and such a reflection of our identity. In this experience, we will spend time taking care of each other’s hair as a way to show care, vulnerability and expression with one another. Come to moisturize, detangle, and connect intimately. We would provide the space and guidance, you would bring yourself, hair products and open hearts.

events.title: Shake It Off: Nurturing the Body's Natural Ease
events.description:
Let the soft animal of your body love what it loves... Neurogenic movements are a key way mammals (that's us!) automatically release excess stress and stuck energy to return to their natural baseline, nice and easy. 

In a small, safe community of playanauts, this somatic exploration will remind us how to comfortably access the body's own way of discharging tension through gentle involuntary movements such as tremoring (TRE) and intuitive stretches, concluded with deep integrative rest and group connection.


ABOUT SCOTT:

Scott has been facilitating TRE, Tension/Trauma Releasing Exercises, for many years and is stoked to adapt it to the playasphere via Kamp KISS!


OUTLINE:

10 min - Opening Circle (intro and welcome process)

10 min - Brief Lecture/Questions/Agreements

55 min - Experience (warm-up (with music), orient to environment/community, drop-in, neurogenic movements)

15 min - Integration (shavasana w/brief yoga nidra, orient to environment/community)

15 min - Closing Circle (outro and shares/questions)

10 min - Conscious Dance (2-3 songs)



WHO FOR:

Those seeking relief, restoration, greater connection/healing, and who agree to be respectful to the group and its container.

history.description:
Loveland culture means leading with love in all aspects of life on and off of the playa.
We are in community 365 days a year and pride ourselves on being accepting of new faces while still holding our firm boundaries to ensure that everyone feels seen and heard in a safe container of love. Our ethos celebrates owning our enthusiastic "yes" and our firm "no." We are constantly striving for positive radical self-improvement and use this platform to manage internal community conflicts. This is how we lead with love.  Loveland is a heartfelt container that invites everyone to step up into his or her higher self and shine. We also have a lot of fun doing it!  We  hold community fundraisers and seasonal parties that keep us connected in our culture and promote consent culture. 

https://www.facebook.com/loveland.brc/

events.title: Body Love & Ecstatic Dance Workshop
events.description:
The Workshop Experience: participants will leave their body love/dance workshop feeling empowered and in love with their bodies! We start with Kerry teaching you a practical tool you can use to truly love and appreciate your body in the moment. You'll be supported in implementing this tool in a group setting followed by sharing new insights.
Next is a guided journey where you cultivate and connect with love and appreciation of your body. Then you experience an invigorating dance session. By dancing, shaking, and grooving together you'll integrate into every cell of your body making this process fun and transformational. The workshop will end with a gentle stretching and intention setting including specific action steps you can take away to build your own body love practice. This is a combined work-out where participants connect with their bodies, minds, and souls- as well as with the group, creating a community of support around body love.

She'll be teaching BRC citizens how to body paint each other! The core of the event’s spirit will remain intact– providing a safe space for all genders to feel comfortable and empowered in their body, to explore personal boundaries and celebrate the human form! events.title: Loveland Serendipity Outpost
events.description: Last year, under the moniker of Love-a-Thon, this opportunity for gifting brought smiles to hundreds.  The concept will remain simple and streamlined this year– a small engaging space (connected to but distinct from our larger public facing structure) where 1:1 gift giving interactions from Lovelanders are offered up. Last year we had:  5-min massages, tarot card readings by Siamese twins from Sweden, psychotherapy sessions, guitar lessons, flogging lessons, Grandma’s cookies, manicures, necklace making, live poetry readings, aromatherapy misting, live music, etc. This year we’ll have all of that, plus new additions of silkscreening, costume alteration services, eye gazing, dating advice and more! Each day a different Lovelander will man the outpost, keeping the Serendipity Outpost open daily from 12pm-6pm. The Outpost is outfitted with a standing bar for volunteers to use to store their materials /snacks /use as a prop and 3-4 chairs, the intention here is small and intimate interactions. We have a large chalk-sign that we place in the street to display each unique offering available per shift, to help entice passersby in.

events.title: Play Party Survival Guide with Misha & William
events.description:
Play parties can be fun-- that seems obvious. But they are also incredible laboratories for play, discovery, personal growth, and even social change. Hidden just beneath the surface of everyday life is a world of passion, purpose, exploration, and pleasure. Join us for this unique workshop to learn how you can skillfully, safely, and pleasurably navigate it. The experience probably won't kill you, but it'll definitely make you stronger. Whether you’ve only dreamed of attending a play party or you’re a seasoned participant, the Play Party Survival Guide will help you thrive in sexy spaces, get the most out of your play party experience, and bring your most open and vital self into the rest of your life. In this workshop you'll get:

-Self-Exploration - Learn about your own desires, edges, and boundaries, and how to communicate them to others.

-Consent 101 - You'll get a crash-course in how to respectfully and consensually navigate play spaces.
-Making safer sexy - Understand your tolerance for risk, how to communicate it, and how to protect your and your partners’ sexual health.
-Community - Learn where to look for the sex party spaces and communities that meet your needs. Leave with a new cohort of fellow sexplorers!
-Support - In a community-oriented environment, you'll develop tools to help yourself and others anticipate, engage, and overcome the emotional challenges that can sometimes accompany this exploration.
-Communication Skills - Become so good at sex party communication that you up the game of everyone around you.

Reveal your deepest self in ecstatic dance or by playing one of our many drums or gongs. Catch us at our Wednesday night camp party with DJ sets and live percussionists, or meet us on the playa as we share the same energy serendipitously!

events.title: The Quantic Man. Einstein versus Galileo.
events.description:
Craving for a cup of coffee?
Please come visit us to have a real Italian coffee.
We will thrill you with a pleasant discussions.Is it still possible to have a galileian reproducibility of phoenomena in a quantistic world? How does the human organs  included the brain work? Do we still have 5 senses? How does our perception of the world that surrounds us changes trough these senses? Should we rewrite how the chemical body works? How con we modify the research after discovering that quantum physics can describe up to 95% of the Universe versus the classic physics? If you want to find out please join us in our shaded ElvisEspresso and sipping on a cup of coffee corretto plum grappa we will hopefully find a solution. We invite quantum physicians, biologists, mathematicians, statistical researchers, and whoever is interested in a brain workout to better understand how the human body and our brain work after the revolutionary discovery of modern physics not so advertised trough out the media around the world. How can we rewrite the human biology, biochemistry, physiology etc. now that we know that the human body has been shaken in a Petri Capsule called Hearth? The aim is to discuss it taking down all the defenses that you have in an academic world , you can express your idea that will be eventually contained by the expert in the field giving you the limit and at the same time allowing him or her to be able to see reality trough someone else’s eyes and changing his or her perception. Hopefully this will allow the participants to have new ideas that can eventually become rules in the future. Sharing knowledge and ideas is the aim of this meeting, hopefully that one day we will have a different scenario in this cyclic war ruled world!

events.description:
The world-famous Brothers Crow Artisanal Bloody Mary Makers of Deep Playa Inc are proud to debut their first- ever event in the city proper! After years of honing our craft in the hyper-competitive Trash Fence market, we will share our unique brand of corporate shenanigans and utter chaos with city-farin’ citizens of BRC.

Thirsty participants will offer a performance of any kind in exchange for a refreshing beverage — and most importantly — sincere, specific, positive feedback. Whether it be a story, a dance, a song, a poem, or a daring feat of public exhibitionism… all acts are welcome. (Seriously. We have literally no standards… just a great f*cking attitude.)

Come enjoy “the finest Bloody Mary’s on Playa,” meet some new friends, and most importantly, help us increase market share. We will also check your ID!

PS If you miss us in the city, come check us at the Trash Fence from 130p on. NOTE: We expect things will be getting VERY normal...

events.title: Inner Cosmos
events.description: Camp Cosmica is a group of rational mystics awed by the true wonders of the natural world. For the event INNER COSMOS we are combining our love of the sciences with our desire for deep connection in our expanding community. The corps of this unique event is the dozen Experience Leaders who take participants at random through a series of curated exercises that each offer a new way to commune with the infinity within. Like an immersive theatrical play, we will on-board participants before starting: our invitation is to be still, to intentionally go within, and to commit to exploring a part of themselves that is occasionally hard to find in Black Rock City - inner stillness. They are then taken to a sumptuous middle area where our Hosts will engage participants with their full presence and attention. From there, Experience Leaders whisk participants away for one of several 5-10 minute exercises that each aim to unlock a part of their relationship to their inner world. We are curating these Experiences to offer something for everyone - some are through the mind, the body, the heart, through the stars overhead, and through theatrical interplay. At the beginning and end of INNER COSMOS will be a guided meditation. We will offer our own cacao elixir for burners to share, and the performance will end in a dancing celebration of what we have unlocked together.

events.title: Building a Consent Culture at the Burn and Beyond
events.description:
What is consent culture? What is rape culture? How do we build a community (and a world) that understands these issues? 
Join Mitchell Gomez from DanceSafe, Sol from the Black Rock City Bureau of Erotic Discourse and Presley Peach from ConSensual Circus for an interactive conversation on consent at the burn and beyond. 
Mitchell Gomez is a graduate of New College of Florida (whose Alumni included the founders of Erowid, MAPS and the Zendo Project), and has his Masters from CU Denver. Mitchell joined Dancesafe in 2014, and was promoted to Executive Director in 2017. In addition to his work with DanceSafe, Mitchell also sits on the Advisory Council of Psymposia, a media and events group that shares stories and fresh perspectives about the emerging science and social issues of psychedelics, psychoactive drugs, policy reform, and harm reduction, and is a member of the Denver Drug Strategy Commission Data Subcommittee. He is a passionate advocate for reality-based drug policy and harm reduction. 
Sol is a member of BED's leadership team, who specializes in developing materials and trainings, and co-facilitates specialty workshops. Their free-time in default includes community organizing around sexual assault prevention, intersectionality, development of accountability and restorative justice processes, sex education with an emphasis on queer and trans communities, and sex worker advocacy. 
Presley Peach is a performance artist and sex worker who uses their experience in both fields to create sexual education that is fun, non threatening, and informative. Presley believes that American sex culture is broken and that sex is also a core human need and therefore, a very important aspect that needs healing. Presley has been a performer for over 8 years and a sex worker for 4 years. Most notable is their project ConSensual Circus based out of Denver Colorado. This project combines sexual education with circus and uses that platform to talk about sex in local communities.

events.title: Cory Doctorow : Capitalism
events.description:
The creative industries are more profitable than ever and creators are seeing a smaller share of that wealth than ever. In a market where a small number of Big Tech and Big Content firms control access to audiences, giving creators more copyright is useless - it's like giving your bullied kid more lunch money. Unless you get rid of the bullies, they'll just take that money, too (and if you give your kid enough money, the bullies will have enough left over to bribe the principal to look the other way). Chokepoint Capitalism - where a small number of firms erect tollbooths between creative workers and their fans - can be defeated, but not by pursuing the failed strategies of the past three decades.

events.title: 5-MEO-OH MY GOD
events.description:
"5-MeO-DMT (5-methoxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine) is a psychedelic tryptamine found in a wide variety of plant species, and a single psychoactive toad species, the Colorado River toad (Incilius alvarius). First synthesized in 1936, 5-MEO-DMT has been used in ritualistic snuffs in Central and South America for thousands of years, and the use of psychoactive toad venom was almost certainly known to ancient Pre-Columbian cultures. Although outlawed in the United States in January of 2011, the use of 5-MEO-DMT continues to rise throughout the world, in both religious and 'recreational' contexts. Although often described as 'literally indescribable', we have gathered a panel of experts to try to break down what this experience is, both subjectively and from a neuropharmacological perspective, and what it might mean. We will also discuss the emerging 'best practices' for facilitators and users to be as safe as possible when engaging with this substance. 

Moderated by Mitchell Gomez, Executive Director of DanceSafe"

events.title: Andrés Gómez Emilsson-Consciousness vs Replicators
events.description: Patterns that are good at making copies of themselves are not necessarily good from an ethical point of view. We call Pure Replicators, in the context of brains and minds, those beings that use all of their resources for the purpose of replicating. In other words, beings that replicate without regards for their own psychological wellbeing (if they are conscious) or the wellbeing of others. In as much as we believe that value is presented in the quality of experience, perhaps to be "ethical" is to be stewards and advocates for the wellbeing of as many of the "moments of experience" that exist in reality as one can. We will talk about how an "economy of information about the state-space of consciousness" can be a helpful tool in preventing pure-replicator take-over. Lastly, we will announce the existence of a novel test of consciousness that can be used to identify non-sentient artifacts or robots passing for humans within the crowd.

events.description:
Nikki Sunshine - "An 80-year-long Harvard study concluded that our health over time is greatly determined by the quality of the relationships in our lives. It's no secret that as human beings we not only desire close relationships but we absolutely need them. The problem is that close and intimate relationships over time require personal responsibility, conscious effort, and skills. Most of us didn't learn the complex nature of navigating intimate relationships in school, so we've been left to figure out this tricky-terrain once we find ourselves in a close relationship come adulthood. 
The main issue I see at the root in all the couples I work with is a lack of proper communication between both parties. Sometimes, that means that feelings are 'brushed under the rug' rather than explored together. Sometimes, this comes in the form of simply withholding the truth in fear of the consequences of speaking the truth. Sometimes, this can manifest in passive-aggressive (and often passionless) energy within the relationship. Or this lack of skilled and authentic communication can show up as massive arguments and frequent fighting.
Do any of these scenarios sound familiar to you? First, please know that you are not alone. Also, you were likely never taught how to do this stuff, so release yourself of blame. Instead, choose right now to empower yourself with awareness, knowledge and skills that can set you up for success in your relationships going forward. 
In my experience, fear and expectation are the biggest blocks to open and authentic communication in relationship. Fear could look like ""I'm scared to cause tension in the relationship"" or ""I'm scared they will think I'm too much if I reveal myself"" or ""I'm scared they will judge me."" Expectaton maylook like ""I'm not going to give them what they need because they have not given me what I need"" or ""I'll change once the other changes first."" events.title: Psychedelic Clinics on the Horizon
events.description:
Psychedelic Clinics on the Horizon: Visions from Two Early Career Psychiatrists

We have not been this close to legal psychedelic medicines since the start of the War on Drugs. It is exciting to witness the culmination of decades of drug policy advocacy and clinical research, and there remains much uncharted territory to be explored as legal psychedelic clinics become a reality in less than 2 years. Psychedelic clinics, for the foreseeable future, will require affiliation/liability of a licensed psychiatrist. This will require partnerships between psychiatrists and psychologists, who traditionally have not worked together and who at times, and have had significant challenges in doing so. Young psychedelic practitioners are grateful for past work done by practitioners, many who have continued this work illegally ("underground"). What lessons have we learned and how can we continue to learn from the knowledge of these practitioners while the field is introduced to a health care community that is at best weary, and more realistically scared of psychedelic medicines. Lastly, current models of legal psychedelic therapy appear to be out of reach financially, even to the middle class, and there are no indications that insurance companies will cover treatment. How might we insure that safe and legal psychedelic healing is available to all? These and other issues will be discussed during this lecture/Q&A.

events.title: Social Impact and Ethics of Robotics
events.description:
AI is reshaping our entire world and this change is coming fast. Voice enabled assistants, home robots, flying cars, personalized medicine … are all just around the corner. With AI we have made significant advances in computer vision, speech recognition, natural language understanding and motor skills. Emulating human cognitive intelligence is the next big step.


In the first part of the talk we will explore the future of work. The real power of AI is to assist, augment and automate decision making. We are beginning to see software robots augmenting humans to realize an autonomous enterprise. What is the impact going to be? In some jobs AI will help humans have super powers. However, there are many routine jobs that machines will end up doing. What are going to be the new jobs of the future? Being freed from being robotic will allow us to be more human, but what will we actually do? How will we make a living? What about income disparity between the owners of robots and the rest of us?

Will machines feel and love? Will they develop a heart, consciousness, and soul? 

What are the other social and ethical challenges of AI – the opaqueness, bias & errors of AI, weaponization of robots, loss of privacy and surveillance, and the dehumanization of the world. And finally, as machines improve themselves continuously to build super intelligence, will humans stay in control? Must we?


T. M. Ravi is the founder of The Hive, a studio for co-creating and funding AI based startups in Silicon Valley. He is co-chair of the Lucas Arts Program at the Montalvo Art Center.

events.title: Getting Unstuck: Immediacy and Emotional Flow
events.description:
Emotional (or motivational) flow is what happens when you're present in your immediate circumstances and connected to what you really want in this moment. It is a foundation for fulfilling, connected, and self-expressed action.  

In this experiential workshop we explore how we can use immediacy and to guide us back into a state of emotional and motivational flow. The goal here is to unhitch ourselves from three patterns that block us from flow: rehearsing thoughts, reacting from emotions, and re-referencing emotions. We'll use interactive physical exercises to explore the felt sense "stuck" that these three patterns of being create. Then we'll expand that felt understanding through a guided emotional flow meditation.

The goal of this workshop is not to offer a tool to practice emotional flow in the future, but to create an experiential understanding of how we can meet emotions to return to emotional and motivational flow.

events.title: The Struggle for the Sacred
events.description:
Cultural appropriation is a topic that brings heated debate nearly every time it’s mentioned. Quite often, ignorant westerners who were raised to purchase meaning on a shelf or through a TV set can trigger sensitivities within traditional or sacred cultures, while at the same time individuals that seek in earnest to experience authentic meaning by transcending that very same commercial culture are easily stereotyped as insensitive or as frauds. The word “shamanism,” for example, is taken for granted and thrown around casually in festival culture, and yet who can agree on what it truly means in our context or who it legitimately offends?

We’ll uncover the complex history of this term while exploring a vision for planetary culture that integrates the profane and materialistic west with the sacred magic of the indigenous and the archaic. The story of the west is surprisingly rich with culture heroes (including the Cacophony Society and Suicide Club groups that Burning Man emerged from) that point the way towards a rich and meaningful cultural future, despite the overwhelming totality of capitalism. In fact, in the development of a global psychedelic culture, the world market has actually paved the way for a diverse confluence of neo-tribal adaptation and integration much the same way as the Romans built the roads that ultimately spread Christianity. Authentic cultural appropriation is the way forward and superficial cultural appropriation is a natural evolutionary byproduct.

events.title: Professor Dr. Lumington’s Traveling Medicine Show!
events.description:
Professor Dr. Lumington’s Traveling Medicine Show
Do you have a desire for transformation? Perhaps a tad disheartened? Disorientated? Disconnected? Need to be disinfected? Suffering minor aliments caused by a world turned upside down?
Or are you a devoted seeker on a quest for inspiration, community, creativity, and outrageous health, wealth and happiness?
In either case friend, you need not go further.

The world-renowned and highly certified Professor Dr. Lumington wants to ease your indispositions and bring that salubrious vigor back into your step.  Their extraordinary traveling medicine show, the Espiratorium, will not only delight your senses and renew your faith in humanity. 

The Prof. Dr. has the great honor to present to you her rare and exotic crew of misfit mistrals: Accaplaya! Their heavenly sounds will cure even the dustiest among you. You can expect an appearance also by the Grand Reverend Snakeoil and our trusted Pharmacist. Truly folks, a show not to be missed!
**We of course are not responsible for any of the direct and wonderous effects our talents, special elixirs, potions, talisman, and therapies may have. If a miracle does occur however, we claim all of the credit. The show must go on after all!!!

events.title: Prof. Dr. Lumington's Espiratorium
events.description:
Enjoy our 4-part interactive playground designed to lift your spirits, soothe your soul and (re)connect you to the best of humanity. 
   Under one tent you'll begin your exploration with Common Ground and see how our diverse universe unifies! (R.I.D.E.) Then on to Higher Ground, our confessional where you can interact with the perfect. compassionate stranger. Our Playground stage hosts performances (check our daily schedule) and is open for ping pong when there are no performances. And finally Prof. Dr. Lumington's Pharmacy, where all sorts of potions, lotions, swag and remedies await you.

events.title: Violin/viola/cello duet drop in
events.description:
PARTICIPATORY EVENT.  Longstanding violinist of Deep Playa String Quartet was unable to form a quartet this year.  So, she is bringing music for string singletons who seek chamber music fun on playa!  Music for two violins, violin and viola, three violins, two violins and viola, violin and cello, violin viola cello, and, if we can get a string quartet plus, we can play Haydn's Seven Last Words!  Bring a stand:).  Cellos, if you show, I think we can drum up a semblance of a decent chair for you.

If you are not available on Tuesday but want to come play duets some time, stop by Beats n' Deets and ask for Phoenix.

events.description:
Drink the goon and suck the Sao in a Vegemite Communion with Reverend Redback™ from the Church of the Thieving Charlatan ™ in the Hills District of Sydney.
Called the Croc Dundee of the Cloth, he was recently inducted into the Australian Cultural Universe of National Treasures. ACUNT.
He’ll spread the word faster than chlamydia in a Koala colony.
So purge the darkness from your soul by inhaling the black gold and receiving the Sacrimite.
Then head to the ‘Strayla Day party at Tribal Spirit.
Or Rampart if the vegemite doesn’t agree with you.
(This event is recommended for devotees of Vegemite and the Vegemite curious. It is not recommended for the religious)
The power of Larry compels you.

history.description: Robot Art at the Oasis offers robots and humans an oasis from a weary, mechanized world with jewelry making and a bar available, as well as a plush, welcoming space at all times.

events.title: Humorous Presentation: “Robots: Friends or Foes?”
events.description: Stop by the Robot Art at the Oasis camp for a fun and fascinating look at how humans have both worshiped and reviled robots. Do you think Rosie the Robot or Commander Data from Star Trek were the robots you should be worried about? Think again my friend – Artificial Intelligence is already managing your life. Stop by to find out more – and stay for a cocktail as we open the bar! Our presenter is an accomplished speaker that presents on many topics during Modernism Week in Palm Springs and at his monthly Salon for the Parched.

events.title: Jewelry Making/Branding
events.description: Join Robot Art at the Oasis as we provide guidance and a variety of materials to make wearable art, including leather, metal and metal discs, beads, charms, gears, circuit boards, and cords. Bring your own leather objects (or use the leather we supply) on which to brand the Burning Man emblem. Use an engraver for metal or pound/emboss it with letters and numbers. Make your own jewelry using our robot parts, so these dissembled robots can live on as a part of your Burner life. Our KnowBot Bar will also be open and serving our signature cocktails: The Bender and the Gender Bender.

events.title: Open Party at the KnowBot Bar
events.description: In a world where robots are enslaved by humans, one oasis still exists: Robot Art at the Oasis. We are an Oasis in which the sentient beings that robots have become are respected and treated as equals. Stop by our fun chill lounge for an open party for all Black Rock City residents. Visit the KnowBot Bar with your own cup and sample our signature drinks: The Bender (vodka and lemonade) and the Gender Bender (a fun twist on the Bender). With fun music and a welcoming crew, we’ll make sure you’re set to explore the Playa!

events.title: Dying with time to spare: A nomad's journey home
events.description:
A deep dive into death, suffering and challenging fate through simple physical practices - opening the heart and accepting what life has to give.
In many cultures death is seen as the unknown, the point at which it is difficult to determine what happens next. Will death be the end of life? The pain experienced in the lead-up to death or the manner death is portrayed may have lasting impressions on how we determine our own death. If death is a passage and a natural step, like a leaf that falls and disintegrates into the earth, how do we best prepare to be ready, at a moments notice to fall onto earth, without a shred of remorse, guilt or unpacked potential? This workshop is about giving yourself a chance to look deeper into death with a clean slate. Determine your own method to prepare for death and live life with an openness to dying. The heart-opening exercises are done alone, and with the group using resonance tuning, energy-centering and creative visualisation. Raise your consciousness!  with Tia Kansara

events.description:
Psycho-physical awakening exercises from different traditions to feel out her vibratory field.

Open yourself to the possibility of living the paradox of being joyfully alive in this tangible realm we live in while at the same time being liberated and awakened in this body.  We as humans are microcosms of this universe, whatever exists in the outer universe also exists within. Feel the vibrations of this tangible Earth we live in knowing that everything is in motion and nothing rests. Tantra is a system so intuitive and natural to human kind that its essence can be seen within all spiritual paths from the Celtic, African, Native American, Sufi, esoteric Christian, Hindu, Sound Healing, Kabbalah, Buddhist, and Taoist wisdom traditions. It is a set of spiritual practices and ritualistic actions that through personal effort and experimentation are designed to direct universal energies of the macrocosm into the practitioner to achieve total liberation from ignorance and suffering. In this workshop we will use a myriad of psycho-physical exercises learned from different traditions for modifying and exploring consciousness. We will feel the energy of the Earth and learn to appreciate this vibratory field we exist in. with Ashleigh Rojas

Camp Nose Fish hosts and operates the Desert Nose, a gesodesic replica of Buckminster Fuller’s nose that contains the Great Un-Hot: a wind/spray cooler capable of inducing a coolgasm in some people and levitating others. We also operate the Fishmobile which contains an interactive experience in personal transformation guided by many blacklight-lit sea creatures.

events.title: Attachment:Unlock connection to ourselves & others
events.description:
This workshop will be put on by therapists and cousins: Eleanor Hooper and Garrett Hooper. We believe that once you learn Attachment Theory, you can never "unlearn" Attachment Theory. In our workshop, we will first thing, have you take an attachment quiz so you can get to know your own tendencies in relationship. The different attachment styles we will be addressing are: anxious, avoidant and secure. Then, we will go over what attachment theory is, where is comes from, and why it matters. We will offer techniques so you can move more towards a secure attachment.  We will go over different real life scenarios so the material can be practiced on the Playa, right then and there!
Guides:  
Eleanor Hooper is a nature based, relationship therapist out of Denver, CO. Her private practice is called The Makaranda Method where she sees clients outside for walk and talk sessions. This is a holistic practice where Eleanor works with the whole person addressing their mindset, movement, nutrition & nature. With a Masters in Marriage and Family Therapy, Eleanor works with adult individuals and couples seeking to transform their relationships and tap into the boundless flow of love and ease that is inherent within us all.  
Garrett Hooper is an experiential and relational focused therapist out of Denver as well. As a therapist, Garrett encourages clients to discover their own relational superpowers. Garrett earned his Masters in Marriage and Family therapy and is passionate about experiencing contact and more fulfilling connection. Garrett works from an attachment and developmental lens to guide children, adolescents, young adults, and couples towards achieving their fullest potential in their relationships to themselves,  others, food, movement, and the natural world.

events.title: Collaborative Community Cacao Ceremony
events.description:
Join us at our organic fruit and veggie camp on Thursday morning as we gather in community to drink the sacred ancient heart-opening Mayan medicine and superfood known as cacao. We will begin with a ritual component guided by the influences of European Shamanism, connecting mindfully to the earth elements and our human senses. Then, with the theme of metamorphosis and the energy of the August 30th new moon in mind, you will be guided through exercises that will help you tap into your deep instinctual self as well as facilitate connection with all the other souls in attendance. Together we will co-create a unique and delightfully dusty desert ceremony.
Ceremony prep advice 👇 

A few recommendations to maximize your experience (these are not rules just guidelines to optimize the effects of cacao): 
• refrain from consumption of alcohol and caffeine 24 hours prior to ceremony
• opt for easily digestible vegetarian fare 24 hours before and after ceremony 
• consider fasting (skipping breakfast) prior to drinking cacao
• drink plenty of water 24 hours before and after drinking cacao
• dress in comfortable white or light colored garments (try to avoid black)
• bring any sacred items you would like to share, place on the altar, or connect with and musical instruments are more than welcome

events.title: Fear Talks, Change Walks! An interactive workshop
events.description:
Can we think of metamorphosis and transformation without first addressing what is oft pulling-our-strings? Come join us, let us talk about fear.

While statements like “you do you” and “nothing to fear but fear itself” are thrown around almost daily, we rarely hear how to approach the influences that constrain us. Drawing from each of our own personal experiences, this interactive workshop will explore why we all struggle with fear and what we can do about it.

This will be a safe space for everyone who attends. You will find authentic, like-minded people open to sharing their experiences and stories. You will not find judgement, gurus or bullshit.

About the Facilitator
Rohit is a behavioural trainer and self-relationship coach who understands first-hand the challenges of living under fear and the expectations of others. His goal is to equip you with tools that will help you connect with your authentic-self.

An experiential afternoon of finding a deeper connection through highly curated mind-body practices to expand our ability to be present and curious in our connection with each other. After a guided sequence, we will participate in various exercises that are designed to add immense value and insight into the magical world of being human.  

Come as you are.  Be with what is.  Discover something new in every interaction.

events.title: Relationship Check-In: enhance your connection
events.description:
Relationships include : romantic, platonic, intimate, familial, business professional, and especially with oneself. 

This workshop will be given by Relationship Therapist, Eleanor Hooper (MFT).  The Relationship Check-in is a list of 20-questions that Eleanor and her partner created at the start of their relationship. When building the check-in they considered: What worked well in their last relationships and what didn’t work well? What were the things they wished they had discussed that could have made them better?
Since employing this monthly check-in, they have found that it offers a structure to allow for them to say what needs to be said, in a container that works. Eleanor often does these workshops for couples in her private practice.  Defenses tend to be lower than usual during the check-in and openness is often increased because people know that charged topics are bound to come up.  There will be a demonstration that offers healthy communication techniques for when the hard material arises, so the conversations can be constructive and intentional. You can even do the check-in with yourself to see how your relationship is with you!

history.description: EZ Tiger's Time Drop is an immersive art experience that uses water, audio, lighting, sculpture and mirrors to create an expansive environment that will bend your perception of time and space. Raindrops and eagle tears pour from the ceiling into a vast garden. With a turn of the control knob, the music slows and stretches, and the water begins to fall in slow motion. Real water drops, sparkling as they fall, slow and then hover in mid-air, each drop contorting before your eyes. If you find yourself stunned by the experience and would like to see it again, no worries -- you can reverse time by turning the knob the other direction, lift the water back into the sky, watch as it absorbs back into the eagles eyes, and then see the same drops fall again.

EZ Tiger is a watering hole with music. Yes, there are libations - please wrangle one from the bartender and nurse it slow. There's sound art here, too. It's loud enough to feel. But we're NOT set up for a sea of zombie ravers throbbing in front of a DJ pulpit and an endless row of speakers. This is a place to explore sound and space on your own terms. There's plenty of shade and comfortable seating - you can find a place to relax or conversate. And of course there's room to dance, if you please.

In the year 1050 BCE, an idea began to grow. An idea so revolutionary that it would need to ruminate, morph, and gestate to perfection. For thousands of years, it floated in space. In 2007 CE, a group of non-talented, uneducated, uninspired individuals merely sat in a room unable to speak. This group was actually unimportant. Yet, beside them in the room, a motivated, frolicking, bubbling team found themselves smacked in the face with an idea. Bumblepuss was born.

events.title: DickChicken: the only death is that of a coward.
events.description:
Hello fellow Olympianese. I am aware of the constant rumblings that taint our strange wayStation. The questions posed all too commonly to Old Scratch at the crossroads. The ponderings which confound the Jungians as much as they validate the Freudians... 

 What in the good name of St Anthony, patron Saint of all heavenly miracles, is a DickChicken?

 The only surviving prehistoric sport, a ProtoDickChicken is believed to have been enjoyed during the ice age. A mix of fencing, old west pistol dueling, bull fighting and capoeira, DickChicken was proliferated amongst all the known ancient civilizations.  The Nordic called it dïkkChükken and translations from Olmec hieroglyphs tell of a DuxmalChixenitza game enjoyed throughout the americas. The Greek played a dramatized version called deuxus ex maChichina.  

In order to reach the highest heights, we must mash pelvises with giants. To soar with the eagles we must first dick the chickens.

events.title: 2016 Black Rock City Air Guitar Championship
events.description:
2016 Black Rock City Air Guitar Championship - Esplanade & 6:45

OFFICIAL RULES OF COMPETITION:  
 	Each performance is played to 1 minute (60 sec.) of a song
 	The 60 second song will be provided to you from a list of 100+ tracks to choose from
 	The instrument must be invisible & be a guitar, i.e. air drums not allowed
 	Air roadies are allowed, but must leave the stage before the performance
 	Back-up bands (air or real) are not allowed

Black Rock City Air Guitar contests each consist of two rounds:

 	Round 1 (freestyle): each competitor performs to a song of their choice from the list
 	Round 2 (compulsory): top competitors from round 1 perform surprise song

JUDGING CRITERIA:  
The jury is a panel of independent judges. The results of the jury cannot be protested. All performances are scored on a scale from 4.0 to 6.0 – 6.0 being the highest possible. Scores are given to one decimal point (e.g. 5.4, not 5.48). A single score is given to each air guitarist based on their overall performance in that round.

The score reflects the quality of the performance based on three key criteria:

1.	Technical merit - You don’t have to know what notes you’re playing, but the more your invisible fretwork corresponds to the music that’s playing, the better the performance.
2.	Stage presence - Anyone can do it in the privacy of their bedroom. Few have what it takes to rock a crowd of hundreds or even thousands – all without an instrument.
3.	“Airness” - The last criteria is the most difficult to define yet often the most decisive of all. Airness is defined as the extent to which a performance transcends the imitation of a real guitar and becomes an art form in and of itself.

Please note: the scores from BOTH ROUNDS are added to determine the contestants’ final scores. This combined score determines the winner.  Earn the title of Black Rock City Air Guitar Champion!

events.title: Send mail home (or to your mom)
events.description:
BRING USPS STAMPS.  Must meet postal regulations, our pros will help you make it work.  Come as you are.  Your fridge will thank you all year long. 

You can send mail to the default world (and receive it).  Terms and conditions apply.  Form a line.  Please fill out this detailed form in triplicate, in crayon.  You have 2 minutes.  Non-compliance will be punished.  Please procure one (1) joke from a passerby.  Stand on your head, or dance like a teapot.

We want your stamps.  So does every other un-prepared burner.  It shall be a quest, huzzah!

If you're an international burner, please stop by a post-office on your way to the playa and get an international stamp (or three, for your friends).

Out-going mail:
First-class postcards and letters ONLY.
No large letters or parcels.
Please read the USPS dmm100 for further restrictions.

Incoming mail:
If you absolutely MUST have valuable, time sensitive or indispensable mail during the week of the Event, it would be most reliable to have it sent to YOURSELF C/O General Delivery, Gerlach, NV 89412 and must pick it up there yourself (with appropriate ID).

We attempt deliveries: 
- Build-week deliveries must be properly marked.
- Camp addresses: use man/mountain-side, and better addressing 5:01/4:59 (vs 5:00); to specify block (vs. a less-helpful intersection).
- Your name & playa-name (there are quite a few people named Chris)
- Return addresses are required (delivery is not assured)
- No large/heavy packages (bicycle delivery)
- DO NOT MAIL DRUGS, even if they are legal in your state. USPS / Feds screen packages, and run sting operations.  Being responsible here keeps many people in replacement driver's licenses, spare car-keys, phone batteries, prescription glasses, and spark-plugs for broken vehicles.

yourname (& playaname)
your playa address and campname + details
[optional: buildweek: day]
C/O PO9
PO BOX 149
Gerlach NV 89412-0149

Updates during event on twitter.

events.title: Games and Playground
events.description:
We have a lot of games to play with you. The following is a list of games we planned for this year.
(a). Plank Challenge: A one-sided, curved plank 8 feet long by 1 foot wide will be placed on rubber tires at both ends. We will stack 3 to 5 bricks on one end, and visitors will be challenged to cross the plank from one end to the other without tipping the bricks from the pile. The loser will need to drink a shot of alcohol, tell a joke, sing a song, or engage in an activity suggested by other participants and spectators.
(b). Giant Jenga: It's the classic block-stacking, stack-crashing game of JENGA! How will you stack up against the law of gravity? Stack the wooden blocks in a sturdy tower, then take turns pulling out blocks one by one until the whole stack crashes down. Is your hand steady enough to pull out the last block before the tower collapses? This giant set will stand from 4 to 6 feet tall. We will have special rules instead of the standard Jenga rules.
In addition,  you are invite to bring your own Cyr Wheel or use one of ours to spin/ride and dance on our wood platform area with us. We will also have basic workshops on spin/ride Cyr Wheel.
If you want to try out as an aerialist, we have aerial hoop and rope to satisfy you.

We are a small Burning Man camp focused on creating community and connection both on and off Playa. We maintain a camp size of around 25 members, mostly based in the San Francisco/Bay Area.

This year, we are bringing a two-part gift: Veg Out and The Brothel. Veg Out is our daytime gift, where we will be serving cool, fresh vegetables to overheated Burners. And at night, our Brothel will serve hot, steamy broth to people who want a cozy place to hang out and warm up.

We believe in creating systems that empower radical self-reliance while taking advantage of the utility of communal effort. We are a mix of veteran and new Burners, all of whom share an excitement to build an amazing experience for ourselves, each other, and other Burners.

events.description: Have you ever had three things to hold on to but only two dusty little hands to grasp them with? Well come on down to the Hippodrome and learn how to juggle! We will start you off easy with just one lemon, learning to REALLY hang on to that bugga. Then working our way up to two, passing back and forth like acquiring some hot potatoes you really want to eat but just cant yet. Then get you going on all three at once like a pro. Why stop there? Lets get going with four, or five. Heck lets juggle bikes, or your friends or wild bear cubs! Once you get the hang of it you can juggle anything that's not locked down to the playa!

It is our pleasure to host you at Slippery Vulvas! Today we'll be carving beautiful and varied vulvas out of pink soap in this live workshop space open to all genders. Promoting eye-opening (and leg-opening) dialogue on the many different forms of this tucked away treasure. We're talking innies, outties, bald vulvas, hairy vulvas, groomed vulvas, asymmetrical vulvas, layered vulvas, big vulvas, small vulvas . . . just like a fingerprint no two can ever be the same! The assortment really is amazing.

Inspired by Australian artist Greg Taylor's exhibition entitled The Great Wall Of Gina displaying 151 life size porcelain sculptures along a 130ft wall at the MONA in Hobart, Australia. In the gift shop of the museum they sell soaps that are a replica of these moulds, but on Playa we will be the artists!

events.title: What do you believe? Why?: Street Epistemology
events.description:
Our beliefs not only form our behaviors and actions, they define our identities and how we form relationships.  During this workshop, you will be interviewed using a socratic dialectic called Street Epistemology.  You will benefit from this workshop by gaining deeper insight to how you think about the way you reason and form beliefs.  We may also (optionally) record and platform your views (more on that below).

Street Epistemology is a civil, sincere, and collaborative way of applying a set of philosophy and psychology-based conversational tools to primarily reflect on the quality of the reasons someone has to support their level of confidence that a claim is true.

You don’t need to come prepared with anything to attend this workshop, however, it may be helpful to think of:
 -Something you believe is true that influences how you live your life.
 -Something you believe others should also believe.
 -A story about how a belief interfered with a relationship.
-A goal that you have in life.
-An important decision you need to make.

Recordings are available which serves two purposes:
 -Audio will be sent to your email address after we return to default world for your further enjoyment and reflection.  
-If you consent, the best conversations will be posted to a YouTube channel, consent can be withdrawn at any time before publication.
