events.title: What do you believe? Why? : Street Epistemology
events.description:
5-20 minute long, one on one deep discussions about what you believe and why.  Together we will examine the reasons why you hold the belief.  

How much do we care if our beliefs are true?  If it turned out that one of our comforting beliefs were false, would we want to find out?  What is Truth anyway?  Are some pathways to truth more reliable than others?  Some would argue that truth is subjective, while others claim truth can never be possessed.  Is there a difference between truth and Knowledge?  How is perception different than reality, or are they the same thing?  Are you and I equally experiencing a separate vantage point from within the same universe, or am I a part of your simulated dream?  How would we know?  Does it matter?  How do we justify what we think, or is this even possible? 

Once we get passed these important abstract questions, we can begin discussing what it is that you believe.  (God, Karma, astrology, tarot, politics, philosophy, Earth is a sphere, climate change, big bang, souls, spirts, bigfoot, vegetarianism, Polyamory, love, war, American dream, Science, perception; literally whatever you believe). The goal is to gently and respectfully challenge your belief with questions in order to better understand you.  ‘Epistemology’ is the philosophy of knowledge and this workshop will use Epistemological interviewing as an exorcise in critically reflecting our own understanding.  All you need is the courage to vulnerability express your idea with an open mind.

At the end of your interview, you may turn the questions onto me.
Let us seek truth together!

events.title: Kids Only Sk8 Lessons
events.description: Our Sk8 lesson will shre-ucate your aspirating young skater. All skill levels welcome (Boys and Girls) (age 3-7 year old) for the little shredder program for first time skaters. Instructors will teach proper standing, pushing, stopping, turning, and in some cases going down small ramps holding hands. We will have a blue wave runner sk8 tunnel for practicing your skating and surfing. Sk8 Director James Pike has been teaching surfing and skating for 20 years in California, Oregon, Hawaii and Mexico. He’s has run and created little shredder programs (3-7 years old) for skate camps in Santa Barbara, California with parks and recreation and Scotts Valley, California with parks and recreation. Pike’s attention to detail combined with his love for sharing knowledge about skating making this the very best place to learn how to skate on the Playa. All instructors are trained and certified by Pike to teach up to his standards and most importantly safety, saftey, safety. Skateboarding is also very emotionally therapeutic and a great way to work out things with yourself. Pike’s sk8 philosophy plays a huge role in learning to trust yourself and looking at the bigger picture. Sk8 yoga is also a huge part of lessons and we will do some stretching in the beginning and afterwords to keep ourselves properly skateboarding to the best of our abilities. When showing up to skate camp please sign in at the Sk8 kiosk with the surfboard that says “Sk8Watch” to check in. Look for skaters with t-shirts that say “Sk8Watch”.

Our camp is dedicated to creating the ultimate playa living shelter based off the rarely used rhombicuboctahedron dome geometry. Our dones are constructed of reusable and sustainable panels held together only with zip ties. They can be built nearly as fast as a tent yet these domes have the strength and feel of a cabin. Stop by to see and learn about our latest iterations, share some ideas and learn how to live in the dust in comfort

We create dwellings that are artistic, comfortable and able to survive the most extreme weather effortlessly. We achieve this by using a rare but incredibly versatile dome geometry that is based off an Archimedian solid. With this geometry we can build metal, cloth or foam panel domes that are infinitely reusable. Some of our domes have had 9 years of playa use and are as solid as the day we made them. Stop by and see our latest iterations

We are a full-service repair shop with the tools and talent to help Burning Man's most abused participants: bicycles. We teach too!

Every year we all but close our Minneapolis bike shop in order to run Hammer And Cyclery at Burning Man. At our core, we are a bike repair camp. But stop by for workshops, free bike locks, and plenty of propaganda (or just to say hi).

We believe access to transportation is fundamental to determining one's own destiny. At Burning Man Hammer And Cyclery delivers this mission to nearly ten thousand people each.

Join us!

events.title: Open Heart Communication through Body Awareness
events.description:
So many of our daily challenges break down to difficulties in understanding each other, whether it is communicating with friends, family, people in your place of work or in romantic partnerships.  This interactive workshop will explore what it truly means to communicate receptively while staying in our bodies.  We will explore what it feels like to be fully heard and how to actively listen.  Our bodies know so much more than we are often willing or able to hear, but with practice and some helpful techniques we can deepen in our abilities to remain open during challenging conversations and to notice the shifts inside that are giving us clues as to how we truly feel and help us be able to express it in a way that we can be understood.  As a participant you will be guiding through a series of exercises and discussions that will open your heart and bring new awareness in your communication.  

Your guides for this workshop are Annie and Snowflake, partners of 8 years, burners for longer, and lovers of direct clear and open conversation.  We have independently and together explored many avenues of body awareness and what it means to feel understood and we are so looking forward to sharing our discoveries in this workshop, especially during this time of existence when open communication could not be more necessary and helpful in our lives! We strive to provide valuable skills that will help you well beyond your burn as you venture back out into the wilderness of life!

We’ll have an opening circle to support each other with intention for the burn, then take a journey of interaction with ourselves alone, with another person, and with the whole group. After this holistic experience for mind, body, and spirit we’ll come back together for integration.

This activates and cleanses the whole mind/body system and can be quite healing when done with determination. Nick Meador customizes the meditation a bit, bringing in tips and wisdom from study in a variety of awareness and healing modalities.

events.title: Dynamic Meditation
events.description: Self-development guru OSHO designed active meditations to amplify, release, and and re-activate. The Dynamic Meditation is his most intense experience, involving a breath of fire, intentional madness, hopping, chanting, and total stillness. Face your demons head-on and you will reap the rewards. What better place to go a little crazy than Black Rock City? Nick Meador is fully trained to hold the container for you to go deep and have a transformational experience.

history.description:
"Awake" emerges from the collective imagination of a group of inspired individuals, bound by creativity and a shared vision. 
Our mission? To awaken hearts to the power of love and elevate consciousness. It represents the bridge between our human existence and our transcendent realm, showing that love is the ultimate answer and urging a collective transcendence beyond ego. In a world craving for healing, "Awake" stands as a symbol of hope, offering a pathway towards enlightenment and unity.
This Theme Camp is more than art; it's a catalyst for change.
We invite everyone to let down the ego, open your heart and join this journey. Stand with us in spreading love and light. Together, we can forge a new path for our world, one filled with love, peace and collective well-being. We are AWAKE!

history.description: Daily Daytime non medical Clinic helping you clean those holes in your head in a fun way. Serving Playa since 1792

Come to see Dr. Playa to have your ears, nose, and throat refreshed by our complete package of spa-like treatments- no appointment necessary! We offer cotton swabs to clean dusty ears, essential oils for for your mask, and an 'injection' of infused vodka (or plain juice) to soothe your throat. 'Cat' scans are included! Yes, we will use our handy, silly stuffed cat to scan your body from head to toe. All ages welcome and encouraged to visit!

Dr Playa's ENT Clinic. Come get your head holes cleaned out!

Pesky Playa dust packed in those head holes? We can help with that! Our decidedly *non-medical* staff can fix you up with the tools you need to clean your nose and ears. Your throat? Well, that requires an exam, possibly a CAT scan, and perhaps a shot. Most people need a shot.

events.title: Dr Playa's Ear Nose and Throat Clinic
events.description: Pesky Playa dust packed in those head holes? We can help with that! Our decidedly non-medical staff can fix you up with the tools you need to clean your nose and ears. Your throat? Well, that requires an exam, possibly a CAT scan, and perhaps a shot. Most people need a shot. In a classic 3rd world clinic setting, our decidedly non-medical staff treats Burner's dust-filled head openings. And inevitably winds up transporting or showing people the way to Rampart. We dispense ear swabs, essential oils, and tissues for those crusty playa boogers, and our N.D.'s (not doctors) give shots if necessary (and they're almost always necessary). These are administered via well-aimed oral irrigation syringe and a foot or so (but sometimes so much more) of empty space. These can be alcoholic or not, depending on participant age and desire. We do our best to make waiting for our services an interesting experience via our excessively low tech waiting room, and snarky or helpful nurses and staff, depending on their mood, and the heat index at the time. And new for this year, we have a CAT scanner, which is a plastic cat skeleton, liberally applied, and a bunch of old x rays we can put up.

history.description: We are a bunch of people that speak openly about our relationship with God. Some of whom simply have found Christianity as well as other faiths to be helpful in our own spiritual journeys. When we interact with people at Religious AF, we are there to welcome them, serve them and answer their questions.  We aren't recruiting them, or asking them to join anything. We practice Radical Inclusion, conversation, prayer, and ritual to all who seek it: gay, trans, straight, high, sober, clothed, naked, polyamorous, monogamous, celibate, gracious, and grumpy alike. We have welcomed people in all of those categories and more because we also identify as those folks. We want to participate and co-create experiences that open hearts and connect us with the Divine.

Share your complaints & questions about God or faith communities & we'll listen as fellow faith seekers. Disco blessings, prayer strip offerings, divine cursing, laughter, & quiet contemplation may occur.

events.title: Glacial Facial Massage
events.description:
Treat yourself to the most chilled-out facial massage on the Playa.

We use towels that have been soaked in a mix of essential oils (lavender, eucalyptus and peppermint) and then deep-frozen till they’re icy and crisp.

We then gently massage your face until you swear you’ve ascended to a plane of olfactory and chilly bliss.

You’ll walk away refreshed, invigorated and tingling—ready to face the phantasmagorically epic delights of the Playa!

history.description: A Boeing 747 transformed into the largest moving art car. Step into an alternative reality, where dreams come alive in an interactive art experience.

events.title: Storm the 747, They Can't Stop All of Us
events.description:
We will all meet up at the 747 tourist attraction (2 & K) and coordinate our entry. If we run, we can move faster than their TSA agents. Let's show them the true meaning of "Radical Inclusion" and hold the biggest playa party on Friday night.

Everyone's invited!

history.description:
The sky's the limit, and welcome about the "747 Experience". entering the 747 aircraft, the largest moving art car ever to grace Burning Man, each visitor will be checked onto the plane, and through the Insecurity Checkpoint where they can receive hugs and praise from our crew members and volunteers. Proceeding further into the 747 fuselage, they will be asked to fill out an Emotional Baggage Tag, to let go of anything holding them back.  Once completed, they hang the tag on the wall of baggage handles. Next, a flight attendant asks them for their destination (where they are going on their journey through life), which will be shared on a Boarding Pass.  This pass is hung onto the Destination wall. Once completed, the traveler is given a pair of airplane wings. 
Come and be inspired, and dream of what is possible, while letting go of the things that hold you back in life.

history.description:
New York Dangerous (www.NYD.nyc) is a merry band of adventurers from New York City and around the world. We see ourselves as an extended family that loves to have fun together.

On playa, we gift whimsical "what your mom warned you about" daytime events including: Strangers with Candy, Running with Scissors Relay Race, Put-Your-Eye-Out Shooting Gallery, Playing with Fire, and more.

Off-playa and year-round in NYC, we host and participate in shenanigans involving adventure, art, music, exploration, Altruism, and Radical Self-Expression. We love to have fun and strive to recreate the wide-eyed wonder and whimsy of the playa in everything we do - plus we founded the House of Good Deeds, one of the largest Burners Without Borders and fully volunteer-run organizations in all of New York City!

events.title: DJ Miloš Balkan Dance Party
events.description:
DJ Miloš and the BPE creates an immersive experience for concert goers dancing to a barrage of Balkan folk-inspired contemporary dance, EDM, and trap music mixes accompanied by club lighting, and Balkan Kafana-style food and drinks to immerse them in an altered state of consciousness in which their worries are left at the door as they are engulfed with a communal feeling of Kef or Kefi.

DJ Miloš and the Balkan Party Experience (BPE) is the creation of musician, composer, and immersive environment artist Ted Monnich. Influenced by his Slavic heritage and 30 years of involvement in America’s Balkan music and dance scene, Monnich unleashed his Serbian alter ego Miloš at the Burning Man festival in the Nevada desert in 2017, performing the first DJ Miloš and the BPE concert to ecstatic party goers, many incidentally from the Balkans. Subsequent concerts were performed at several DID Festivals and the Virginia Fairy Festival at Spirithaven Farm in Stuart, VA.

events.title: Solar Solutions for the Beginner
events.description: Discussion of the basics for adding solar to your BurningMan camp and/or RV.  Will cover: assessing your needs, sizing your system, panel selection, wiring, battery options and limitations, charge controllers (the good and the junk), the magic of a proper battery monitor, why you want a shunt, why are batteries not created equal, inverters to get 110 AC, and simplified installations.  RV plans will include battery storage, panel placement, and wiring access into the RV.  Camp installations will include simple portable panels, connecting multiple panels for more capacity, battery storage, connections for recharging simple USB devices and small inverters for AC only devices like a CPAP (or DC adaptor source).  Bring pen and note pad if desired but check lists and links to information providers and advisors will be provided and also available via our website.

The Wheel of Life is a nice entry point for personal introspection, growth, and alignment.

events.description:
Fill your emptiness by formulating a new creation story that tells you why you are here, or pick from one of the many existing creation myths that best fit you. 
 
Mankind has always had the inherent desire to explain where it all came from. An origin story to find a purpose, grounding, control, or just be entertained. We’ll examine many of the ancient to more modern myths, and the serious to the absurd. A short tour of the majestic Creation Museum. We’ll dig out the patterns of what makes a great creation story, and apply modern day methods and knowledge to build new ones. At the end, we’ll preach our own personal word of…

This is an open forum for culinary enthusiasts. Let us create a burning man gift together: a playa recipe cookbook! Join a relative newbie on a quest for radical self-reliance at her second burn; the quest for good-as-homemade food with no RV, a very long drive, and a small budget.
 
Let’s talk about food! Share in my journey from one week of nothing but military rations to setting up my first playa kitchen. Learn with me about frozen pre-made meals, dehydrated pre-planned meals, coolers, and home-made solar ovens. Teach me what you have learned about cooking on the playa, swap recipes and techniques. If I have had any success, we can also share something tasty from the solar oven!

events.title: Improv Workshop with Andy and Kat
events.description:
For Virgin Burners and those to want to recommit to authentic participation. 
Improvisation and BRC aren't so different. Both run on the engines of spontaneity, discovery, and participation. Whether it's the improv stage or the playa, you only need one magic word, and that word is YES!!!
In this workshop, we'll play low-pressure collaborative games that connect us as a group. We'll hush up your thinky-thinky mind (you know, the one that comes up with all the reasons for why you can't do something new) and awaken your gut (where courage and inspiration and wildness dwell) And we'll experiment with the practice of "
Yes! And..." to push our own boundaries.
Open to all. Yes...even you.

The Lost Penguins have proudly been a theme camp since 2001.  Our founders dream was to establish a hospitality camp where all burners are welcome and made to feel at home.  We have expanded on that dream and are proud to welcome Burners into our Cafe in 2018. 

Our cafe as a place for burners to chill on our couches and seating and listen to music.  We emphasis hospitality and greeting burners into our cafe and serving wine and chocolate and snow cones and penguin pee (vodka and lemonade drink).   To go with this year's theme, we have our space ship and the Penguin oracle to answer all of burner questions.  We are a camp that provides space for musicians, poets and others at Open Mic times, and welcome burners who want to participate in an informal open mic and music experience.   We have music equipment set up or bring your own.  Burners who are musicians can check in with our Entertainment lead and schedule time to perform.    And music is scheduled throughout the day and night.

We'll lead a guided compassionate meditation using the heart-opening qualities of cacao to tap deeper into your sacred heart and expand your feeling of connection to others, yourself and the world. Cacao drink provided - bring a cup and a willingness to open your heart.

events.description: We all have experienced different types of psychological trauma in our lives, and often continue to live with it in some way, shape or form. The focus of the workshop will be the use of bilateral stimulation used in EMDR (Eye Movement Dissociation and Reprocessing) to install resources that can help build resilience and tools to process trauma, where the healing truly begins.

history.description:
Our name and our ethos are one in the same: Joie de Vivre!
 
An international group of Joiers (as we affectionately like to call ourselves), we join you from all over the world: France, Sweden, Belgium, Germany, Ukraine, Canada, Norway, Korea, the United Kingdom, Australia and the good ole' USA.

Our interactivity focus this year will be two Joie Pétanque pitches for fellow burners to join us in this fun French 'lawn' game with two tournaments during the week in addition to everyday play. Come enjoy a cup of rosé while learning something new and meeting like minded interesting people!

The Swedish lawn game of Kubb will also be on offer for anyone to play and we will have a midweek tournament including a midsummer themed sunset happy hour!

events.title: Joie de Vivre Midsummer Party and Kubb Tournament
events.description: For the very first time, Joie de Vivre is throwing a Swedish themed afternoon celebration honouring the ancient and traditional "Midsummer" celebration. On Wednesday, we all gather to sing traditional snaps-visor, dance “little frogs” around our bespoke Maypole and drink snaps! We will also be having our inaugural tournament of the Viking game Kubb for all to join in! White costume (or attire) and flower crowns are encouraged!

Come and find the brightly colored neon sign and flags atop our Joie de Vivre Arch, step inside and fuel up on a Cup of Joie coffee or relax with a chilled Rose-ayyy! We will also be offering yoga and beauty sessions throughout the burn in addition to our good old fashioned Joieful tunes and vibes!

In addition to our stationary coffee bar, we will continue with our mobile tricycle coffee cart "Joie a la Kart" that will give a boost to the burners in the depths of the Playa as well.

history.description:
Welcome to The G Spot; you've finally found it! At The Gong Spot, we believe sound, movement, and play have a profound ability to ground and connect individuals. TGS's mission is to contrast the Burn's high-intensity energy. We offer chill spaces (3 individual lounges) for weary travelers to rest, get out of the sun, or even take a smoke break. Our scheduled sound baths (we like Gongs) and vibey spaces offer respite, grounding, or a quick nap for many weary travelers.

Our air-conditioned sound bath tent doubles as an (almost) 24/7 cuddle puddle lounge and hosts a variety of movement-based interactivity (both whimsical and sensual) and talks throughout the week. Join us, and then tell your friends you've finally found The G-Spot!

history.description:
Welcome to The Gong Spot; you've finally found it! 

At night, you'll be greeted by synchronized, multi-colored lights and be lured in by the gravity of the gongs. That'll be the first sign you're close to hitting the right spot.

The belle-mahal (our centerpiece) will be receptive and pulsing, inviting the curious to come inside for giggles, conversation, and cuddles every evening. You'll find no pretense and no expectation in our space. We find the gong to be grounding and connective, sometimes playful and sometimes serious, and we want to share that with you.

If sound baths and cuddles aren't your thing, stop by during the day to visit Smoke Break, where our apothecary-style lounge will open up your lungs and heart to new possibilities.

events.title: Burlesque Show
events.description: Our Burlesque Show is our longest running tradition, but far from conventional. We celebrate body and sex positivity through playful tease and theatrics; a reclaiming of sensuality. Our 8 to 10 performers creatively (and irreverently) poke fun at societal norms in a wide range of shticks and stylizations; from modern dance to comedy to drag to acrobatics. Our talented MCs encourage lots of audience participation between acts, and the show always ends with a celebratory dance party (that lasts into the night)! While we showcase some of the best performers on the playa, we also work to introduce new performers every year. We push the boundaries of traditional sexuality; resulting in a show that is whimsical, thought provoking, and sexy as fuck.

We provide all the materials, sparkly accouterments, equipment, guidance, and earnest encouragement!

events.title: The Wiggle Room
events.description: Now a Dark Sparkle institution, The Wiggle Room is where anything goes as long as it is non-verbal, sober, barefoot, mutual, and consensual. We provide hours of safe space to dance to awesome music together. The narrative of our Wiggle Rooms are hosted by one of our extremely creative and experienced DJs, each set a customized work of art made specially for that moment. It is a family-friendly event that happens during the daytime so we can enjoy the sunshine. Our large flat top provides shade, however, for those in need. We find joy in bringing in people off the streets and into the fold–inclusive and joy-filled. We are really excited to share in this special time with our larger Burning Man family.

history.description: Dark Sparkle is the potent mix of the mysterious and the dangerous that makes something irresistibly attractive.  It's what causes people to push their limits to the point of insanity, what spurs exploration of territories both physical and metaphysical,, that unexplainable quality which arouses curiosity in the dark side. Some days, Dark Sparkle is your alter-ego; other days it is your most natural feeling form. Dark Sparkle is Mona Lisa's smile, tarot cards at prom, mother's milk, the apocalypse. Dark Sparkle is an adventurous way of life--audacious and bold as BRC itself.

The Love Apothecary: A Place of Healing & Connection
Our camp's public offering will be a mystical, whimsical apothecary—a sanctuary nestled on the Playa that combines elements of a healing space with the warmth and intimacy of a home. The ambiance will invite people to slow down, connect, and be present.

Please enjoy our apothecary counter where members of our camp will prepare and serve the Love Potion. The Love Potion is an herbal aphrodisiac, and stress reliever, paired with a ritual focused on connection, love, and open hearts.

Our camp will feature an interactive wall where people can write anonymous love notes or positive messages to strangers on the Playa.

history.description:
Dreamery is a camp to discover, share and experience dreams. It is an interactive space to read and write dreams and fantasies, happy or scary, random and crazy, sensual or sad.

What dream would you ask for if you could?
If you could go anywhere in a dream, where would it be?

At Dreamery, you might also meet someone special. You can see if you want to hang out for just a bit or maybe become lifelong soulmates.

Got any bad dreams you want to get rid of? Drop them to the Dreamery Alter to be ceremonially burned at The Temple Burn.

Have any happy dreams or exciting tales to tell? Jot them down in The Book of Dreams. Flip through the pages to discover stories and dreams from people from around the world, and you might even find new dreams to call your own.

We're the "La Escuelita" ("Small Classroom") team, a friendly and helpful group of burners from different backgrounds that strives to teach newcomers and old comers alike about how to implement the ten principles during your burn and beyond! 

In 2017, we brought MÚCARO, our wise, woody owl dedicated to teachers everywhere. Inspired by the incidents we witnessed at our installation and the vandalism we heard about from other artists, we realized we needed to be teachers ourselves.

Most of our programming will take place on buses or art cars. With a "learning is fun" mindset, we'll use quizzes, reenactments and songs to impart tips and tricks designed to embed the principles into your very soul.

events.description:
Condensed beginner-introduction into the Mother Palms of Cheng Style Baguazhang. The Mother Palms are considered core and foundational practices for dynamically conditioning the body and mind for not only for martial development, but as importantly, wellness and awareness. Our session together will include bagua basics (specific to the Cheng style) to get us walking the circle and techniques that go into the practice of the Mother Palms. Any levels of martial arts experience, including none at all, are welcome and encouraged!
Hibernaculum Camp on 6:30@E.

events.title: Cheng Style Baguazhang: Intro to Turning Palms

Condensed beginner-introduction into fundamental palm changes for Cheng Style Baguazhang. Baguazhang serves as one of the primary traditional internal martial arts, sharing with Tai Chi and Xing Yi. Alongside some bagua basics and distinctions of Cheng style over other styles of bagua, this session will focus on the Old 8 Turning Palms, based on the core Mother Palms in the Cheng style. Any levels of experience and skill in the martial arts are welcome, including those who haven’t had any!
Hibernaculum Camp on 6:30@E.

events.title: 1st Inaugural Hobby Horse Championship!
events.description:
Come one, come all-neigh! Welcome to the FIRST inaugural Hobby Horse Championship! 

Have you ever participated in such an event?! Make your childhood dream a waking dream with a first of its kind event. Save a horse, ride a hobby horse! Saddle up your very own sparkle pony and join us. Have no idea what a hobby horse championship is? That’s ok! The Hobby Horse championship is a stable competition, and we hope you hoof it to the winner’s circle! If this is your first rodeo - do not fret, just frolic your way to the top, stirrup some good old fun, and get off your high horse and join us for the ride! 

Each rider will compete for "Best in Show" in 3 hobby horse events - barrel racing, jump course, and dressage. We will be handing out prizes for 1st-3rd rankings based on poise/performance, speed/agility and radical interpretation! 

We will have hobby horses for use, but we encourage participants to bring their own and dazzle them up. Since it's Tuesdays, tutu's may garner our judges’ favor. So come on by and show us the stallion that lives in you!

Illumination Village is an eclectic gathering of camps, held together by history and shared resources. You will find within the village, much like the microcosm of Burning Man, art and interactivity everywhere. 
Showcasing our fire artists in the front, and then placing our interactivity within the village in our Town Square and internal roads. 

Each year it's a new experiment in radical collaboration to create a cohesive feel for the village, across our many diverse camps. We love the multifaceted variety of environments and believe that it makes Illumination Village a unique and delightful place to visit. 

Come take a steam during the day and make sure to visit our Fire Art Carnival in the evening. Our Fire pit will be lit up late into the night.

events.title: Pinhole Project
events.description:
Are you a social snapper, professional photog, or just a lover of all things photo?
Join Pinhole Project and create pinhole art with a playa twist.

We have adapted a centuries-old technique to capture the incredible scale and
diversity of art and culture at Black Rock City — and, more importantly, to
capture the immediacy of moments, photons and people.

Each day, we head out to the playa with twelve 50-gallon cardboard-drum
cameras and use the unique combination of light, location and collective
imagination to document our city. We then return to our desert darkroom where
we develop 30 x 40 inch photographs that exhibit in Illumination Village, Center
Camp and off playa.

Join us as we create one-of-kind artistic records of the radical self-expression,
innovation and art that make our ephemeral city so special.

events.title: Come Make Pinhole Photographs with Pinhole Project
events.description: Remember that lesson in art class where you made a camera out of an oatmeal box? Pinhole Project invites you to check out our cameras, do an art tour, and make art on the playa!  Each year, we shoot, develop and fix about one hundred photographs on the playa each Burning Man. he Pinhole Project exposes 30 x 40 inch sheets of light sensitive gelatin silver paper. We work with 12 pinhole cameras, created out of 50-gallon cardboard barrels. This size is uniquely suited for capturing the incredible scale and immense diversity of art and culture at Black Rock City. Under the red safelights of the darkroom, photosensitive paper is inserted into the camera body. Exposures range from 40 to 300 seconds, where concentrated beams of sunlight are funnelled through the pinhole and into the camera, creating a negative image of the recorded subject. We maintain a desert darkroom in a shipping container, where we gather to processes, develop and fix about one hundred photographs each Burning Man. These unique images are then exhibited in Illumination Village, Center Camp Cafe, and off-playa. The pinhole camp has been creating large-scale portraits with festival participants since 1999.

Here at Suburbia, we are putting our efforts into bringing that same tacky suburban culture to Black Rock City. New and old burners will be able to see one of the most disgusting/ugly parts of society in the urban sprawl of the 'default world' displayed in a beautiful and enjoyable way. From the moment someone spots Suburbia, they will see a typical suburban neighborhood, but the with Burning Man principles close to heart. We hope that through this subverted lens, participants will appreciate Black Rock City for more than an escapism from their daily lives, but also an opportunity to encompass the Burning Man principles into their everyday lives when they return to the 'default world'

events.title: Crack is Whack!

CRACK IS WHACK is back, Bitches! The infamous Whitney Houston extravaganza party.
I wanna dance with somebody, don't you?
Come join us sing along with the Queen of the Night in this epic afternoon dance party because there is no better way to count down to the burning of the man than dressing up in your fiercest dress, walking our red carpet, taking photos at Black Rock City's one and only step-and-repeat, and then singing "I Will Always Love You" at the top of your lungs arm-in-arm with all your new friends and family on the playa.

Our contingent of Israeli Mudskippers are bringing this party back to the playa this year and just like in the past, it is sure to bring out all the Israeli Burners out from all across the playa and introduce a lot of non-Israelis to some really amazing new beats!

events.title: Smoothie Cafe Party & Glamour Salon
events.description: One of the playa's only and largest full-service dining experiences. Our barkers invite passers-by to come into our shaded and decorated cafe where our cafe host will guide them to a cafe table and chairs. Menus featuring our *family-friendly non-alcoholic fruit smoothies* are handed out and our waiters take the table's order and brings them their smoothies. Meanwhile, our DJs play delicious jungle beats while they relax, refresh, and rehydrate.  Every year we are jam-packed with 100s of participants even though we keep adding tables. To create magical Burning Man moments, our hosts encourage solo guests and smaller groups to sit together and get to know each other!

events.title: BlackSKYwhite Show
events.description:
BlackSKYwhite's performances are magical sights - incorporating organic actor's bodily movements, music reaching from electronics to cabaret and ethnic style as well as stunning lighting effects which create a surreal world of great illusion, yet at the same time, a world that is very close and true.
blackSKYwhite have created, and continue to create a special technique of placing actors on the edge between reality and illusion - where performances are more of a dream than anything resembling real life. It is difficult to identify the genre of this theatre's stagings (as the word "genre" in itself implies some kind of traditionalism) and perhaps the company's style is closest to modern choreography in its most nonconformist form. The shows tell no story, reveal no plot, have no dimensions, or narrative. Rather, they mirror reality through dreams, bordering on that thin line between the outer and the inner worlds that interacts with the spectator through their own intuition or unconsciousness. As in the 'absolute mirror', every single person should see in each their work, an inner world and their own particular destiny. 
blackSKYwhite has received important awards for innovation in theater at FringeFirst - the international performing arts festival in Edinburgh, Scotland and have headlined performances at Glastronbury Festival. They have performed at Burning Man 2010 also.

What Is The Burning Man Videogasm Photo Walk?
It’s a social photography event where photographers get together (usually in art work on the playa) to walk around, shoot photos, and have fun with other photographers. After the walk, participants have the opportunity to come back to Videograsm, chill and pass their cameras around and see what how people saw the same subject, but from their point of view. Marys Little Lambs (MLL) is a Burning Man theme camp that embodies a vibrant, queer, and international community. The camp thrives on its welcoming atmosphere, where wit, fun, care, community, and duty intertwine seamlessly to elevate our collective experience before, during, and after the Burn. With an inclusive ethos, it embraces individuals from various backgrounds, making everyone feel like part of the flock. The camp exudes a sense of warmth akin to a lamb's gentle nature, fostering an environment where diversity and community flourish under the Black Rock sun and amidst the fiery essence of Burning Man.

history.description: Deoxidized is a global oasis on playa that hosts intentional gathering space, a soul series, and endless opportunities for diverse connections with people from around the world.

Our camp was founded by a passionate member of the Entrepreneurs Organization (EO), whose faith in humanity was changed after being exposed to the Burning Man culture. Inspired to share this transformative view of community and participation, the camp grew through an initial network of global entrepreneurs, and has evolved into a heartfelt family of change markers, leaders, and creators focused on personal development, innovative business, social impact & community engagement.

Deoxidized is a global oasis on playa that hosts happy hours, a soul series, and endless opportunities for diverse connections with people from around the world.

Together, we will co-create an unforgettable experience with our community of friends old and new. Come join us every day in the Deoxidized Oasis, our lounge-type chill space featuring a 60′ parachute shade structure, an open bar, live DJs, informative and vulnerable talks, breath work, yoga, and much more. We'll be hosting talks and classes in the mornings and daily happy hours from 4PM to sunset. Come meet our international crew from across the U.S. and more than a half dozen other countries. We are a diverse group of Burners with much to share and look forward to meeting you! "

history.description: dEOxidized Camp is dedicated to recharging the batteries of all hard-working Burners. Our camp is comprised of members of an Entrepreneurs Organization along with guests from around the world. Together, we will co-create an unforgettable experience with our community of friends old and new. Come join us every day in the dEOxidized Oasis, our lounge-type chill space featuring a 50' parachute shade structure, an open bar, live DJs and music, and daily happy hours from 3pm to sunset. Come meet our international crew from across the U.S. and more than a half dozen other countries, including Australia, England, Holland, Germany, Mexico, New Zealand, United Arab Emirates, and more. We are a diverse group of Burners with much to share and look forward to meeting you!

history.description: Inflatable Wildlife Disco is the premiere discotheque destination for all indigenous inflatables of the playa. With a menagerie of inflatable wildlife, helping to magnify their natural syncopated basslines which undulate through us all. At its heart, disco is not simply a musical style or an aesthetic: it was and is a cultural movement for outsiders, misfits, and lateral-thinkers, both inflatable and un-. We will be serving signature cocktails during an array of events throughout the week, including our renowned UnBirthday Party, a chance to meet your mate at Not Awkward Speed Dating, Inflatable Wildlife Whisky Safari where guests will get to try their hand guessing from many varied whiskies from around the world, All-Day Bocce and and Sunrise of the Machines Pre-Game Party.

Our mighty USS Nevada will be doing 2+ tours around playa daily from our home port so come visit us, enjoy our signature grogs concocted with our homemade distilled rum in an awesome full-fledged pirate bar, The ArrghBar. pARTicipate in our 2+ daily theme parties 10am and 2pm, come get your drink on, play games, and then relax in our Pirates Den – an amazing chill space with couches. Visit our Wayward Wenches Bazaar, because we got what you forgot. Come party with us....It's sure to be an adventure.

events.title: Blackbeard's Blackberry Bash
events.description: Party with the Pirates of the Playa at Gallavant, home of our Mighty Ship, the “USS Nevada”, and our infamous ARRGH Bar, open daily from 10:00am to 10:00pm…ish, where we’ll be serving up our special “Se(a)men” and other delicious grogs.  Come join us for our 2019 “Theme Parties”.  The start of our Party season officially begins on Monday with our “NAKED PIRATE SHOTS” party from Noon to 2pm. Tuesday from 10am to Noon we head down the rabbit hole for our “MAD PIRATE TEA PARTY”, and from 2pm to 4pm, “BLACKBEARD’S BLACKBERRY BASH” serves up our own Blackberry grog. Wednesday from Noon to 2pm, join us for our “MAI TAI PARTY”, and from 2pm to 4pm we get to wear white with our “WHITE LINEN PARTY”.  Thursday from 7am to 9am, stretch out with “MORNING NINYASA YOGA AND MIMOSA”, then from Noon to 2pm our bartender’s “booty” will be on display at our “BOOTY SHORTS PARTY”, and from 2pm to 4pm our lovely lasses will dazzle you at the “WICKED WENCHES PARTY”, and 4pm to 6pm, our “PIRATES AND MERMAIDS PARTY”.  Friday from Noon to 2pm, join us for some “SUNKEN TREASURE TASTY TREATS, and from 2pm to 4pm, our “PIRATE COWBOY PARTY” shows that Pirates are just Cowboys with a different hat.  Saturday from 7am to 9am start the day with “MORNING VINYASA YOGA AND SUNRISE SIPPERS”, and then from Noon to 2pm, embrace your inner Basque with our “PICON PUNCH PARTY”, and from 2pm to 4pm, our “DRAG BALL FASHION SHOW” will surely inspire ALL Kings and Queens. Finally, on Sunday from 10am to Noon, we bring an end to the party with our amazing “BLOODY MARY PARTY”! Daily, we will have morning coffee, and throughout the week we will be hosting Burlesque lessons, Pole Dancing demonstrations, Flogging demonstrations, body painting and more!  We also have an awesome “Chill space” with lots of couches and shade, a Wayward Wenches Bazaar, where you can pick up that much needed item, great music, and a rowdy crew of Wenches and Pirates that are always up for the best time possible as we “Belly up to the bar

Naked Heart is devoted to the full embodiment of the divine feminine. We offer amazing experiential and experimental workshops that allow you to feel your feminine heart, your radiance, your inner goddess. This work requires the masculine as well; Everyone is welcome. 

At Naked Heart we recognize the need to embrace both the light and the dark in our journeys. When we pursue the light we use movement, the senses, sensuality, sexuality and connection. This beckons us in and brings the light of awareness back into the bodies we have vacated. To go there fully requires confronting our shadows. We embrace those as well as we dive into shame, fear, anger, unsavory memories from this life and past lives, and disempowering images of our bodies. Welcome home.

Human beings need touch, comfort, safety, love, and intimacy in their lives to feel whole, welcome, complete, and content. Attaining the combination of this cocktail of bliss often is only experienced through a sexual relationship of some kind, and rarely are all of these needs met simultaneously, or by the same person. 

Often, along the path to deepening a relationship or flirtatious connection, one partner or the other begins to dabble with sexual energy through flirting, playful touch, sexy talk, innuendo, or other strategies in an effort to shift the situation into an opening for sexual connection and orgasmic release. 

Sexual energy is incredibly powerful, playful, blissful, and transformative, yet it can also be overwhelmingly tricky and even deceitful to one's self and others if not stewarded with care. 

This workshop explores the fine lines between sexuality and intimacy, between loving touch and sexual touch, and between desire to be with someone intimately and the desire to fuck. 

Through practicing clear and open communication, bringing awareness to the energy in our bodies and intention in our hearts, and by relaxing into the openness of the moment and surrendering any agenda for where it may be leading, the relational space can be transformed into a mysteriously infinite void of possibilities where literally anything can happen. 

Countless women have confided in me that they are frustrated beyond measure by their partner's (or men in general's) inability to be with them in a way that makes them feel safe, free to express their fullness, and feel loved, cherished, and comfortable in their bodies.

events.title: Contraexpression
events.description:
Do you want to experience poetry of the body while hardly moving at all? 
 Contraexpression is not passivity or the anti-expression; it’s 'contrary-expression' of any expressive stimulus, and it’s irresistible. There is no wrong way to do this.
 
 Open the door to your body to express the unimaginable. 
 
 In the experience, you will be guided through a passage in which you find your own way of moving the body. I don’t ask anyone to move their body in a rhythm, nor engage bodies, nor expect that all the people do the same action. People don’t need to follow a pattern or imitate; it’s experiential, there is no wrong way to do this. I give directions based on trust in the body, and what it can manifest. The person will discover how to adapt these directions to their understanding and needs. Maybe someone can move rapidly, maybe another can move slowly, or hardly at all — each one with their own development and course of action.
 
 This workshop focuses on the method of “The Unknown Theater” (El Teatro Desconocido) directed by Juan Carlos De Petre and developed over forty years by a group of people concentrated on exploration of subtle expression. The practice reveals knowledge; we start from the consciousness of not-knowing — ignorance is the beginning. This knowledge is experimental and creative; not intellectual, preconceived, acquired through repetition, or memory. Participants will work as a unique being, independent, and according to their own development. You can overcome intimidation and shame; discover empowerment, physical malleability, and grace.

Here we will be given the opportunity to accept our injustices, reclaim our disowned aspects, and renew our awareness and devotion to wholeness and love.  As the Light of Truth and Divine Love radiates from our hearts we will share in group and anchor in our bodies with physical relating exercises and dance.

events.description: This workshop guides women through a series of movements and offerings to reclaim sensuality and sexuality for themselves in a safe space, while rediscovering their personal experience of pleasure. Women's psyches are bombarded with notions of what sexy is, disconnecting us from the experience of what it feels like in our own bodies. No more shall we allow for our bodies to be used as marketing schemes to fulfill viewer‚Äôs fantasies. Now is the time to reclaim the power of our sexuality, to reconnect with our feminine sensuality and to offer ourselves the gift of deep pleasure and embodiment.

events.title: Root the Body, Release Ego, Ignite Power

By tapping into the vulnerabilities experienced within our bodies, we can discover where pain and triggers are stored by the ego, allowing for us the ability to see them for what they are, liberate ourselves from them, and fully fill them with the light and power already existing within us. Release your greatest self out onto the playa through guided touch, divine creation and ecstatic movement.

events.title: Sensual Butterfly Transformation Yoga
events.description: The Butterfly is a high-vibrant, spiritual creation. It is sensitive to its surrounding and is vibrating in the same wavelength as the particles of niverse, as well as the life on earth. It lives in symbiosis with nature, mostly in flowers, becoming one with the Beauty All Around. The Butterfly symbolizes the Universal Spiritual knowledge and deep Wisdom, and creates its life in the perfect alignment of non-attachment, in a dance of flow and Ease. It has a life filled of transformation, from the day of birth until re-birth, between stages, outer and inner form, with ease and grace moving further, without attaching to its old shape, heart wide open for the life in front of Her. This Yogic Journey is dedicated for you to connect with YOUR inner Butterfly, through a travel of transformation, through your body and senses. Bring a Mat (if you have), soft clothing, yourself, as the beautiful and whole being you are.

events.title: “Soil and Water” Yoga
events.description: The focus of this class is in the First and the Second Chakra. Digging the feet into the ground, dipping the toes deep into the soil, feeling the earth. By Rooting down and stabilizing our ground we will slowly get ready for the rising up to our second chakra, following the watery juiciness of sexual energy in our hips. Stepping into our sensual Animal  with softness and care. Bring a Mat (if you have), soft clothing, yourself, as the beautiful and whole being you are

events.title: Tantric AUM
events.description: The AUM (Awareness Understanding Meditation) Workshop is based on the understanding that in order to find its silence, the western mind first needs to express its tension and stress.The aim of the AUM Meditation is to consciously transform stress and negative emotions into positive creative energy, and to create personal well being and peace through a social process of Awareness, Understanding and Meditation.It is divided in twelve stages that allows you to experience all shades of your emotional life ‚Äì anger, love, sadness, laughter ‚Äì and to express these emotions in a protected and safe environment.Once emotional awareness and intelligence are mastered, it becomes easier to express emotions in a healthy way, resulting in more effective communication skills and a greater sense of personal empowerment. The fear of expressing all our feelings diminishes, freeing us to make a genuine choices about how we act. Unspoken positive and negative feelings can create blocks in our relationships with friends, colleagues and loved ones.Through experiencing the AUM, relating becomes clearer, more honest and more fun. the AUM also allows you to reclaim to joy of simply being alive.Bring a pillow or cushion

events.title: Tantric Puja
events.description: This is a space to see, feel, smell, touch the divine in ourselves and others. Choose to embody the masculine or feminine for this play and bring a partner of the opposite polarity just to balance the numbers - you have the choice to "see the one in the many" if you decided to move around partners to experience "seeing the One in the Many" or to stay with the same partner and go deeper into "seeing the Many in the One" - this will be a puja style ceremony unfolding deeper layers of intimacy.

events.description: Begins with a discussion on striptease, its history, purpose and method. Activated shakti energy in a group dance setting. Here we will "strip" the taboos around stripclubs and nudity to reclaim our sexual, seductive power. Ecstatic, exotic striptease to celebrate the divine feminine form at its best. With intention and groundedness, a lovingly performed striptease is the ultimate celebration of love... and of self-love.

Land of Monkey is a multicultural, international LGBTQ+ camp that welcomes diversity and that promotes human evolution through body (Aguas Frescas, coffee), mind (deep talks on important subjects) and soul (yoga, breath work & meditation). We also have a chill space, our Jungle with pillows and hammocks where citizens of Black Rock City can escape from the sun and relax, listening to uplifting tunes by our resident DJs
At Land of Monkey we believe that we are not yet fully human and must evolve. Learning to listen, to be patient, to understand, to forgive and to be more merciful: these are among the skills we practice in becoming more human.
We evolve by being the best version of ourselves.

history.description:
We call ourselves monkeys not only to identify members of the camp, but to highlight that we are not yet fully human. Humanity is a process of becoming, one that we all practice throughout our lives. Learning to listen, to be patient, to understand, to forgive and to be more merciful: these are among the skills we practice in becoming more human. 

In 2022, we will be inviting others to join us in this practice through a series of interactive experiences that explore ourselves, our connection to each other, and how the 10 Principles help guide that discovery. By sharing these experiences with the Black Rock Community, we hope it will help all of the monkeys of this city to fulfill their ontological vocation of becoming more fully human.

events.title: LED / Blinky Lights Workshop
events.description: At night, Black Rock City becomes surreal and wondrous, due in part to the thousands of LEDs lighting the city. Ever wonder how those LEDs work and how to get them to blink in coordination? Land of Monkey’s own LED guru, Matt, will run through the basics in this interactive learning experience where participants explore how to make their own blinky lights. All required hardware is included - LEDs, controllers, and batteries - and you can take home your LED masterpiece to show off on the playa at night! This workshop has limited capacity so be sure to come early!

events.title: Totem Necklace Crafting Workshop
events.description: Close your eyes, reach into the pouch. What's in the bag? Touch and find the crystal that resonates with you. In this artisanal wire-wrapping workshop with Land of Monkey, you'll learn to wire-wrap a rough crystal into your very own totem necklace. This workshop has limited capacity so be sure to come early!

events.title: Artisanal Lemonade & Tea
events.description:
At each interactive event in 2022 and spontaneously throughout the week, we will be offering the citizens of Black Rock City artisanal lemonade and iced tea served in our sheltered temple, which includes lounge areas for napping, chatting or engaging in solo activities, like adult coloring books. Gentle, uplifting music will play throughout.

Land of Monkey will be serving dairy-free iced matcha lattes and highlighting new and exciting flavors of fresh squeezed lemonade each day, such as Ginger, Old Fashioned Lemonade, and limeade. Come find out which new concoctions we’ve prepared for you!

events.title: Libertarian Principles of Burning Man
events.description: This interactive dialogue explores Libertarian perspectives on the 10 Principles and how they can be applied to foster political freedom, autonomy and personal responsibility in the default world. It will be led by 3 titans of libertarian principles: social media star and Guatemalan presidential hopeful Gloria Alvarez, Fernando Amerlinck, a Mexican author, radio personality and libertarian for over 50 years and Fernando Maskobi, a Brazilian economist, author and media personality, These 3 monkeys will lead participants in group discussion and activities so that burners of all political stripes may expand their understanding of liberty and civic responsibility beyond Black Rock City.

events.title: Intention Setting: Why You Are Here
events.description: Intention setting is the first step in the manifesting process. It kick-starts our creative power by pushing our desire to be heard out into the Universe. And the Universe will answer. This interactivity is led each year by one of our most seasoned monkeys and signals the beginning of our spiritual, sensual and intellectual journey. Citizens of Black Rock City are invited to join us to set our intentions and herald the week ahead.

events.title: Baptism by Dust: Reveal Your True Playa Name
events.description: Still don’t have a playa name? At Land of Monkey, we have learned that playa names are not chosen, they are conferred. For Burners who lack a playa identity, or for those who just want to learn a little more about themselves, our very own Yago the Baptist and a team of monkeys will interview you, gather requisite information, and ask the God of the Playa (Dust) to reveal their true identity. Return later to be baptized by our guru and learn what the Dust revealed.

events.title: Slow Yin Stretch Yoga
events.description: Join us at Land of Monkey for a session of Yin Yoga. A gentle and relaxing experience all levels that is suitable to all students. Enjoy a period of stillness during this busy week, surrender yourself to a sensory awakening and release of repressed emotions. Leave the session feeling lighter, clearer, and relaxed.

events.title: Apéritif Musical: Classical, Rap, and Electro
events.description: Big feelings and 45 minutes of classical music (XVII to XX century), European rap (XX) and Nordic noir électro (XXI). Come celebrate an apéritif of sounds we guarantee will vibe your ears and eyes. Come explore the old World in a burning set! Not another Daft Punk meets Wagner behind the trash fence romance. Bring out the spleen!

events.title: Breather Meditation before the Man Burn
events.description: Breathwork connects you with your True Self — perfect, whole, expansive, and eternally connected to Source. See what happens when you stop managing the mystery of Life and trust the wisdom and Light within. Let the breath be the bridge from your head into your body!

events.title: Listening to our body: a holistic medical approach
events.description: How much of the food we eat is processed, canned, contaminated with pesticides, xenoestrogens and antibiotics? You’d be surprised! How does that affect our hormone system and neurotransmitter regulation? How to make smart decisions when we choose our food and which is the best way to supplement it in a natural way? Join us for a deep discussion about health, our bodies and what we put in them!

events.title: Applying the 10 Principals to HIV & COVID-19
events.description:
Coronavirus is the new HIV: Applying the 10 Principles to Living with HIV and Living Through COVID-19

This interactive workshop, hosted by a Burner who has been HIV positive for almost 20 years, explores how principles like radical self-reliance and decommodification could have sped HIV’s evolution from death sentence to treatable disease, and how we can avoid repeating those mistakes by applying these principles to the current Covid-19 crisis. Burners will discover how principles like immediacy and civic responsibility apply to contemporary issues like disclosure, social distancing and ‘pozzing’ to rethink public health systems and save millions of lives.

For those citizens of Black Rock City who crave the standard and familiar, Land of Monkey will offer yoga with meditation led by one of our own flexible monkeys. This guided practice will follow basic yoga poses like those found in the standard Sun Salutation and is appropriate for everyone—from those just beginning their practice, to seasoned yogis.

events.description:

events.title: Naked Oil Wrestling: Hosted for Gymnasium Camp
events.description:
Join the Land of Monkey and Gymnasium Camp to get oiled up, naked, and wrestle to honor the monkey god, Hanuman!

Hanuman symbolizes immense strength and fearlessness and it is to him that India’s wrestlers pray for victory.  The monkey god of the Ramayana, is revered in Kolhapur. It was Hanuman who helped rescue Sita, Rama’s wife, from the demon Ravana. And it was Hanuman who flew to the Himalayas and carried back a mountain with medicinal herbs to save Rama’s brother, Laksmana. 

Our playful event should not be taken too seriously nor do we want anyone to get hurt. Listen to referees and have fun with it... slicked up in oil and releasing those aggressions. Need to settle something with someone? Join us!

events.title: Osho Kundalini Meditation
events.description:
Anna (Ma Anand Magdalena) will lead one of the famous Osho meditations to feel whole and complete.

The Kundalini meditation is best done at sunset or in the late afternoon. Being fully immersed  in the shaking and dancing of the first two stages helps to “melt” the rock-like being, wherever the energy flow has been repressed and blocked. Then that energy can flow, dance and be transformed into bliss and joy. The last two stages enable all this energy to flow into silence and peace. It is a highly effective way of unwinding and letting go.

events.title: Hindu Ritual of Fire Sacrifice vedic ritual
events.description: Havans or Homas- The foremost among our ancient vedic rituals, the ‘RITUAL OF FIRE SACRIFICE’ was revealed to our ancient sages after several years of penance and austerities. A Homa or Havan is a sacred fire ceremony in which various forms of the Divine gods and Demi-gods are invoked in a sacred fire that has been kindled according to the guidelines in the Vedic scriptures. Certain special offerings are made into the fire while Sanskrit Mantras are chanted. The combination of the powerful energy of the fire and the Sanskrit mantras create extremely auspicious and purifying vibrations that are beneficial to all who attend the Homa. The smoke that rises from a Homa contains a powerful healing energy, and as it rises to the heavens it purifies the atmosphere, both physically and subtly, encouraging a peaceful environment and gentle weather. Every kind of negative karma can be purified by the sacred Homa fire, due to divine grace.

events.title: Rootist Yoga Practice
events.description:
"What is Rootism?" My response to this in short: Rootism is a belief that the truth of our learned existence lies in the Roots of all teachings/truths and beliefs. These truths are different for everyone based on how they we raised and what we resonate with at the time of our learning. As a Rootist, we take the roots of various truths and incorporate them into our own mantra, our own way of living, to become the well rounded person that we wish to be. When you resonate with more than one truth, you are a Rootist. There are many different types of Rootist's. You could be a Christian Rootist, a Buddhist Rootist, or any type of Rootist. The moment you resonate with more than one truth & take the roots of those teachings as your truths, you become a Rootist.

Rootism is a lesson that I have learned and come to resonate with over the last few years. I am grateful to share this information with each of you. Please feel free to share this with anyone with whom you feel might be interested.

As an offset of Rootism, we have The Rootist's Way. A style of yoga that is in-tentful in it's design and sequences to help to facilitate a certain type of energy clearing and calling in of new energies.

Thank you for reading this and for wanting to know more about Rootism.

The 8 Principles of Rootism:

∞Principles of Rootism™

1. Release what no longer serves - nurture yourself & ground yourself
2. Embrace a Creative Vision
3. Move forward on your journey -Take Steps Fearlessly
4. Empathize and Feel what is going on within you & others
5. Motivate yourself & others by Truth – Check the Ecology of the Whole
6. Bridge the Mind & the Heart
7. Evolve a Pro-Sociality Lifestyle & Manifest a Greater Humanity - help others and give back
8. Revolutionize - Reveal Yourself! Open UP! Inner Knowing is Outer Showing

The acronym is "Remember"

events.title: Vinyasa Flow
events.description: Take a deep breath in. Fill the space between the earth and the sky with the light of your energy. Let the rising and falling of the breath move you in and out of postures both high and low, fast and slow, light and dark. Come find your voice, your rhythm and your dance through vigorous movements, grounding stillness and heart opening chanting. Guided meditation and breath work weaved in and out of this movement we call vinyasa yoga will open doors to parts of your body and mind unknown and will create a little more space both physically and subtly. Come take the leap, the ever graceful rise and fall and ascension into the sky. Come sweat it out and get ready for all the night has to offer.

events.title: Love Immersive
events.description:
WHAT TO EXPECT:

TALK: We'll kick off with a talk about how you can DJ your consciousness through love, with a mash up of insights ranging from the Tantrics and Yogis to Western psychology and neuroscience.

TOOLS: You'll walk away with some simple ways of applying these concepts in everyday life. Think of it as subtle ways to internally DJ.

EXPERIENCE: Together, we’ll move from ideas to experience. Expect a multi-sensory adventure that is intensely intimate and heart-opening.

IMPORTANT NOTES

PRESENCE & INEBRIATION: The playa is a playground full of mind-altering substances. Do your thang! However, presence is key to the experiential portion of this workshop, so if you aren’t feeling in the mental space to be present, we ask that you sit that portion out.

TIMING: Time can morph and twist in wonderful ways on the playa. However, to keep the integrity of the experience, once we start going into the set up, late-comers will not be able to join.

SPACE: It's limited. We may need to cap it depending on the number of people that show up. Also, this event is listed as Consciousness Discussions in the Playa Guide – we'll be doing that with a bit less thinking, more feeling.

Feel free to share, see you in the dust xx

events.title: Feed Your Head Talks. MOOP and Danger
events.description: MOOP and Danger.  So, you've heard of MOOP, matter out of place, but where does this concept come from? It's a whole lot more than mere litter. From dietary customs to architectural vocabularies, this important concept has had a major impact on our understanding of human social organization for the last 50 years. Come learn about the origins of MOOP, and get introduced to the work of Mary Douglas, one of the most bad-ass theorists of the 20th Century!

events.title: Feed Your Head: Which Riesling For Your Problem
events.description: Interactive drinking workshop: "What's the Riesling For Your Problem?"  Got a hang nail? Lost a shoe? Wanted for not paying camp dues? Let a Sommelier pair the right Riesling for your problem. 21 and over only.  Elise's desire to do this comes from her love for the grape. Remarkably expressive, it can range from "so tart you think you're drinking lemon juice" to "nectarine honeysuckle heaven"!  Something bubbly from Germany, something serious from France, some approachable Austrian delight, something mineral forward from Canada or NY, and some rubber hose super crisp dry example from Australia.

events.title: Stoicism: Ancient Necessary Philosophy
events.description: Stoicism: How an Ancient Philosophy Can Turn Us All into Laughing Vulcans.  Philosophy is often thought of as the exclusive playground of philosophy students and their professors, but what about the rest of us nincompoops? Stoicism is a philosophical school that is highly misunderstood today, and the model it offers promises us a way of living that is still applicable.  It offers different perspectives, teaches acceptance of imperfections, and demonstrate an updated Vulcan model for living: to live well and prosper.

history.description: We plan on bringing out our best "Mom-itudes" to be some of the most delightful caretakers around. We know how non-stop the party can be in the staff camps, and how much a little time away can make a big difference. We strive to offer a relaxing retreat for staff, volunteers, theme camp and art project leads and workers to get a little time away to clear their heads and center themselves. Haven't had a decent meal or are sick of commissary? We just might happen to have a pot of soup going for our upcoming meal which we're more than happy to share, or one of our Moms might be in the mood to whip up a grilled cheese just for you! events.title: 🔴 RED CIRCLE - "RECLAIM the SACRED MASCULINE"
events.description:
MEN are NOT toxic - men are Necessary. This WORKSHOP for MEN is a celebration of all that we are - shadow and light. For many of us, there is something blocking our power, our purpose, our passion ... How do we claim our power without doing harm? How can modern men acknowledge the infractions of SOME men while claiming our (Re)Masculation with integrity? How do we stand up as men in 2022 and heal from both the unintended consequences of Feminism and the same elements of Shadow Masculinity that has harmed our women and world? How do we become "two-handed" men? Men that can wield BOTH Strength & Sensitivity; Power & Presence; Humor & Depth; Kindness & Killer Instinct … men who can hold space, hold their partner(s), hold his business(es), hold himself? 

Together, we will engage time-tested practices that connect us both to our hearts, and to the sword. The Sacred Masculine can wield aggression as an act of love. The Sacred Masculine can choose peace with a warrior's regard. Join us as we unwind the tales that have been told about us as men - both true and untrue - and let's write a new story, together. Come open your voice, your heart, and your sex for the sake of all humanity. Every man has within himself the capacity to be the King in every room. It's time. We need you. Join us.

events.title: Archetypal Agility through dance for Women
events.description:
Women are being asked by society to act a lot like Men, and it’s not always sustainable for us. As we hold more "masculine" energy in our day to day lives, we can get stuck there. We can forget that we have many energies to choose from in every moment. 

This workshop, which is part discussion, part dance exploration, offers a reminder that we are agile, archetypally. We can shift our energy to meet the moment at hand. 

We will hear each other's voices and then take a guided dance journey through the archetypes to feel how the different energies move in the body.

Come gather with us, share, and try on a new energy!

Taught by Miss Touch Copple!

events.title: Joining the Circles: Men + Women Group Healing
events.description:
Open to all genders, this workshop brings the powerful tools of Men's & Women's Work together into one ritualized experience. We all begin together in group conversation and embodied practices around what it means to Men, Women (and Other) in the World today. Then, we gather into two separate circles - one Men, one Women, and do our own Work. Finally, we come together again for conversation,  space holding, connection rituals, and deep healing.  

Your hosts: Spotlight + Touch fell in love on playa in 2019 and have been together ever since. Join us!

Facilitators from around the world offer multiple daily sessions of Conscious Dance, movement, and meditation on our fully shaded and easily-accessible 2,500 sq.ft. bamboo dance floor. With no experience necessary and no "steps" to learn, Conscious Dance offers a pathl the destination is the discovery of ourselves and a return to our center.

history.description:
Tremendously gratefull to return to Black Rock City in 2018, for our 12th consecutive year at Burning Man!

RhythmWave is dedicated to the practice of Conscious Dance as a moving meditation. With no experience necessary and no "steps" to learn, Conscious Dance offers a path, different for each person, and the destination is the discovery of ourselves and a return to our center.

Facilitators from around the globe offer multiple daily sessions of Conscious Dance and movement on our 2,500 sq.ft., fully shaded and easily-accessible bamboo dance floor. RW also hosts morning yoga and meditation, as well as workshops and intention circles throughout the week.

All citizens of Black Rock City are always invited to bless the bamboo at RhythmWave. Please join us!
