history.description:
Proud and thankful to return to Black Rock City in 2017, and begin our second decade at Burning Man!

RhythmWave is dedicated to the practice of Conscious Dance as a moving meditation. With no experience necessary and no "steps" to learn, Conscious Dance offers a path, different for each person, and the destination is the discovery of ourselves and a return to our center.

Facilitators from around the globe offer multiple daily sessions of Conscious Dance and movement on our 2,000 sq.ft., fully shaded and easily-accessible bamboo dance floor. RW also hosts morning yoga and meditation, as well as workshops and intention circles throughout the week.

All citizens of Black Rock City are once again invited to bless the bamboo at RhythmWave in 2017. Please join us!

events.title: Closing Blessing, on the bamboo @ RhythmWave
events.description: Please join RhythmWave as we cleanse the bamboo and ourselves, and say farewell to Black Rock City for 2017.

events.title: Radical Breathwork @ RhythmWave
events.description: Radical breathwork, a journey with Jimmy, Stephane and Karen: Guided breathwork, evocative music, bodywork, and toning in a safe and supportive container. A powerful way to release and integrate emotions and traumas, access transformative, non-ordinary states of consciousness, and to rejuvenate and relax.

events.title: 5Rhythms Dance w/Andreas Tröndle @ RhythmWave
events.description: The 5R practice reveals it's true power when we simply show up and allow the container of these 5 shamanic rhythms to hold clear and present space in which we may for once surrender such notions of planning and presentation and instead discover the pure and exquisite artistry of our true self as it comes forth in a timeless expression of movement, never to be repeated, but always to be remembered.

events.title: 5Rhythms Dance w/Charlie Korda @ RhythmWave
events.description: Lets add movement to our bodies and retrieve the animating force dancing through us. Supported by music, environment, intention and the other moving bodies, we play. Using the 5Rhythms map, we follow our feet, awaken the senses, find our creativity and dance. Whether you have danced forever and know it like an old friend or have never thought yourself a dancer, this is the place.

events.title: 5Rhythms Dance w/Chloe Goodwin @ RhythmWave
events.description: The 5Rhythms is a body based awareness practice rooted in the notion that if you put the psyche in motion, it will heal itself. The 5Rhythms are: Flowing, Staccato, Chaos, Lyrical, and Stillness. Together these rhythms form a cycle of energy, patterned after the way all things move and change. When we sync up with this cycle, we integrate the wild, wide-ranging scope of who we are and how life moves through us. Movement is the medicine, the metaphor, and the meditation. Our dance becomes the ritual that calls all the pieces of us back into one unified being loving knowing seeing healing whole. All are invited to join Chloe Goodwin for this 5Rhythms dance medicine movement ritual at RhythmWave!

events.title: 5Rhythms Dance w/Huggy Bear @ RhythmWave
events.description: It’s Saturday Morning. You need a well held dance space to ground, get energized and launch yourself into The Burn. The Wave awaits you!

events.title: 5Rhythms Dance w/Mackenzie Amara @ RhythmWave
events.description: In this Sweat Your Prayers style dance we will greet each other as if for the first time while we say our first goodbyes of the season. We will dance, pray, cry, and laugh with each other in celebration of our beautiful existence together and apart. There will be love.

events.title: 5Rhythms Dance w/Marcia Dancingheart @ RhythmWave
events.description: The body is our living, breathing temple. We can seek refuge in our body parts, inviting them to move, dance, and reconnect our whole being. We dive deep into embodied listening, co-creating our tribal heart-beat. The 5Rhythms with Marcia Dancingheart will open your body temple, shake out your soul, and call in Spirit to nourish your Being. It’s a simple yet powerful moving meditation that anyone – of any age, size, or physical ability – can practice. There are no steps to follow, no choreography to learn, no way to do it wrong. The only requirements are a body that is still breathing, a mind that is still curious, and a heart that is still beating. Feet. Breath. Beat. Dance. All are invited to join Marcia on the bamboo at RhythmWave!

events.title: 5Rhythms Dance w/Neil Pinnock @ RhythmWave
events.description: 5Rhythms reaches the parts that other dances miss. So bring the whole of yourself, no matter the size, shape or experience your body has, you are most welcome on the bamboo floor @ RhythmWave for this morning Sweat. Hailing from the forest & fields of the UK, Neil brings his funk and fervor for your Dancing Soul. A fully fledged, Raven born, 5Rhythms teacher who will delight.

events.title: 5Rhythms Dance w/Rosebud @ RhythmWave
events.description: Chaos Flame Dance is a 5Rhythms dance meditation to bring in Burn Night. We will shake the unneeded old from our body and prepare to send up in flames along with the man any inner shackles, shadows or memories that we wish to leave behind.  We will dance into embodied steadiness amidst the chaos, and seek the freedom to stand tall, footsure, and to walk through any darkness and confusion that may twirl about this night.  Anyone is welcome to participate in this dance.

events.title: 5Rhythms Dance w/Tess Howell @ RhythmWave
events.description: 5Rhythms is a moving mindfulness practice, a powerful dancing pathway to greater presence. There are no steps to learn, nothing to get right. All that's needed is the willingness to follow your own feet. As we dance we learn to stay grounded, rooted, real; present in our own potency; as the world swirls and shifts around us… An in-bodied, out of your mind dance experience not to be missed!

events.title: B.E.D. "Clarity & Consent Playshop" @ RhythmWave
events.description:
The mission of the Bureau of Erotic Discourse (B.E.D.) is to help people safely and happily navigate the sexual shoals of Black Rock City, to get what they want and avoid what they don’t want. This workshop is called “Clarity and Consent” because it is about clearly communicating desires and boundaries for consensual sexual activity.

The subtitle of this playshop is “Negotiating Sex on the Playa,” so some of the material is about how to get to a positive, consensual agreement. But a negotiation is also successful if it helps to avoid an unwanted outcome, so we also discuss how to convince someone to go away. B.E.D. values the right of individual choice, which includes the right to choose NOT to have sex.

We don’t care what gender you appear to be, or what gender you claim to be, or what kinds of partners you prefer. What matters is communication and consent. All are welcome to attend this "Clarity and Consent Playshop" presented by the Bureau of Erotic Discourse - at RhythmWave!

events.title: Black Lights~White Dance @ RhythmWave
events.description: Dance your way to a bearable lightness of mid-week being w/Skye and Huggy Bear, at RhythmWave's annual under-the-blacklights White Dance. Our 11th consecutive year, the RW Black Lights~White Dance has become a BRC tradition. Wear your whites and show your glow!

events.title: Contact Jam @ RhythmWave
events.description: Contact Improvisation is an open-ended exploration of the possibilities of bodies moving in and out of contact. Wild and athletic, or quiet and meditative, it is a dance form open to all bodies and inquisitive minds. At the jam we practice, research and play with other dancers, following our own dance as it flows through the movement constellations we find ourselves in. Facilitated warm up and mixer with Stormbird and LoveGrenade.

events.title: Doc Film Screening "Leave Your Shoes at the Door"
events.description:
A documentary on conscious/ecstatic dance. Follow individual dancers as their lives are transformed by the experience of free-form dance. Heartfelt events unfold as dancers find a place where they can freely express feelings and emotions including illness and death. There is a brief  history of dance and some of its modalities such as 5Rhtyms, Contact Improvisation, Soul Motion, and Biodanza. 
4 years in the making.

events.title: Earth Honoring Ritual w/Glide @ RhythmWave
events.description: Please join RhythmWave to connect with, honor, and care for Mother Earth on our beautiful bamboo dance floor. Ground, connect, and open to the world around you and these troubled times we are in.

events.title: Elemental Wave w/Mackenzie Amara @ RhythmWave
events.description: The 5Rhythms®--Flowing, Staccato, Chaos, Lyrical, & Stillness--correlate to the five elements that make up our natural world: earth, fire, water, air, & ether. Through the dance we will learn, discover, and enjoy our own elemental nature by connected to the big-picture and the defining elements of our world.

events.title: Feldenkrais Workshop w/Shara Ogin @ RhythmWave
events.description: At the seat of our souls, core to all of our ambition and desire lies our heart. Though gentle, relaxing movement sequences along with inspirational meditation, you will leave the class standing straighter and taller and with your shoulders falling back behind your chest. If you are experiencing any pain, you might find it improve or resolve throughout the class.  Feldenkrais helps with the realignment of our bones, muscles and joints and with the coordination of our overall movement patterns. This will help you with your late nights dancing to the beats, or with walking long distances through the desert. As we radiate more love out into the world, the world can’t help but smile back.  And with that, only magical shifts can follow.

events.title: Ho‘oponopono Forgiveness Meditation @ RhythmWave
events.description: Let Shannon guide you through an ancient Hawaiian forgiveness process. Together we will be clearing out preconceptions of how we view others to create new connections and rejuvenated relationships. This is a guided, easygoing embodied and joyful meditation. In true RhythmWave spirit we will use a little rhythm to align our bodies in our seats. The Hawaiian word ho‘oponopono comes from ho‘o ("to make") and pono ("right").

events.title: Intro. to Contact Improv. w/Si @ RhythmWave
events.description: Explore movement and relationship through Radical Contact improv dance, with Si at RhythmWave. Bring your body, vulnerability, and curiosity. No experience required.

events.title: Move with the Mystery w/Tess Howell @ RhythmWave
events.description: 5Rhythms is a moving mindfulness practice, a powerful dancing pathway to greater presence.There are no steps to learn, nothing to get right. We can learn to avoid the places where our mind messes things up and surrender in to the sweetness of our own body-based intuition. What opens up when we let the mystery move within us? We will use the dance to get out of our own way and to let life flow through us- so that we can learn to flow with it all...lightening up, letting go.... surrendering our sense of separateness as we drop into beat, bassline, breath, bones.

events.title: Open Floor Dance w/Charlemagne @ RhythmWave
events.description: A somatic dance exploration with full range of e/motion. Good for the dancer who seeks more than just an ecstatic release. It's sexy, sweaty, deep, and playful.

events.title: Open Floor Dance w/Wisch @ RhythmWave
events.description: Have you ever wanted to say something, but not had words? Have you ever felt more alone in a crowd than you do by yourself? Have you ever wanted to be closer but not known how? This movement session is an invitation into closer contact with ourselves and with others.

events.title: Opening Blessing, on the bamboo @ RhythmWave

events.title: Re-Weaving the Human Dream w/LeeAnn @ RhythmWave
events.description: Dancing Freedom is an ecstatic, shamanic, somatic and expressive movement practice – a radical and grounded movement ritual. Our prayer for tonight’s ceremony: please help us truly walk on this earth in a good way. The invitation: start with yourself and your own sacred body. We will engage the energies of earth, water, fire, air, and ether to open new possibilities for ourselves and for the world. All are welcome to join LeeAnn Mallorie at RhythmWave for body activation, personal awakening and transpersonal healing from this 5-element dance wave. The only rule in Dancing Freedom? There’s no way to do it wrong.

events.title: Singing Bowl Meditation w/Breeze-la @ RhythmWave
events.description: Fall into the music of the Alchemy Crystal Singing Bowls; a sound healing meditation on the RhythmWave bamboo. Grounding, clearing, and deepening into the presence of awareness.

events.title: Tribal Tantra Medicine Dance w/Eugene Hedlund
events.description: Come experience a taste of your innate capacity to heal and be healed through this Intuitive Medicine Dance, with Eugene Hedlund at RhythmWave. Discover the magic of allowing versus doing. By embodying this ritual, we attune our body to tend toward our highest good while making space to step with clarity into what is next. The healing practice of Medicine Dance to melt some of the walls to giving and receiving that love within. Medicine Dance is a space where we tap into our own intuitive power to heal and be healed. There is nothing to do. The ritual will work it's magic by inviting you to tap into your own without even trying!

events.title: Warrior Wave w/Andreas Tröndle @ RhythmWave
events.description: Turn your wounds into the powerful qualities of a healer-warrior. Dance wildly, rest in the beat, and deep medicine of your own wild tribe.

events.description: Come experience the original conscious dance practice created by Gabrielle Roth. The dance can help to soothe those rough spots, release unsettled emotions, connect lost body parts and ignite your heart. Side effects of the 5Rhythms practice may include: feelings of well-being, love, bliss and transformation. Marcia will be your guide for this dance journey on our beloved dusty bamboo floor.

events.description: 5Rhythms with Tess Howell is an in-bodied, out of your mind dance experience not to be missed! It’s a simple yet powerful moving meditation that anyone – of any age, size, or physical ability – can practice. There are no steps to follow, no choreography to learn, no way to do it wrong. Using the dance, we drop into breath, the beat, and the bones. Please join us for this 5Rhythms feast on the bamboo with Tess @ RhythmWave. Open to all!

events.title: 5Rhythms Dance w/Visudha de los Santos
events.description: 5Rhythms is a dynamic and exhilarating movement meditation that, over time and with regular practice, frees your spirit and catalyzes growth of unimaginable heights. Each rhythm – a beat of its own, a body dialogue with different drums, moods, and motion – leads you into the sweetest and most wild territories of who you really are. VisudhaBuddha from Taos, NM, will lead you through a spirited wave embodying each rhythm: body, heart, mind, soul, and spirit. Move your Body, move your Life. It's that simple.

events.title: 5Rhythms Dance w/Visudha @ RhythmWave
events.description: Make it Good. VisudhaBuddha believes that endings can be bittersweet, and the way HOME, is to make it Good. Your week on the playa has been full & rich, possibly even messy & beautiful, crazy in good or not so good ways. In the 5Rhythms we will find the pulse of the Mother, the beat of your own heart, and the music of your soul meeting in the unity of one Tribe: we remember and breath the rhythm of Life together. Joining in patterns and repetitions—one dance, one motion, one wave of energy—we come home to ourselves, each other, our home on the playa, and the essence of pure love. Leave Black Rock City with love and your family firmly embodied in your heart. Make an ending you will always remember. Please join RhythmWave and Visudha de los Santos as we close the week and our 10 years at Burning Man with a 5Rhythms celebration of movement, reflection, and spirit.

events.title: Black Lights~White Party w/Skye & Huggy Bear
events.description: Dance your way to a bearable lightness of mid-week being at RhythmWave's annual under-the-blacklights White Party. Our 10th consecutive year, the RW White Party has become a BRC tradition. Wear your whites and show your glow!

events.title: Bless the Bamboo w/Skye & Breeze-la @ RhythmWave
events.description: Please join Skye, Breeze-la, and RhythmWave as we bless the bamboo and our Burning Man family for 2016, our 10th consecutive year in Black Rock City!

events.title: Booty Shakin’ African Dance w/Fanny Parkin-Diallo
events.description: Need a little more spice in your dusty playa day? A fabulous crew of live drummers will get you moving and your booty shakin' in this ecstatic, African-rhythmic dance experience. Traditional celebration dance sequences from West Africa for any and all levels of experience. Everyone is welcome, come dust or shine, for what has become a playa tradition at RhythmWave!

events.title: Closing Blessing w/Visudha & Feather
events.description: Please join RhythmWave as we cleanse the bamboo and ourselves, and say farewell to Black Rock City.

events.title: Dancing Freedom w/Hakari-jin @ RhythmWave
events.description: Come join us as we consciously enter into the moment to moment dance of life. In this Dancing Freedom journey YOU will be invited to explore the unique, dynamic, and interdependent qualities of each of the 5 elements. As we invoke these primordial forces, they awaken the dreamer within who can assist us to create a deeper relationship to our Selves, others, and our environment. Expect deep soul-filled bass, tribal beats, and a range of intuitively chosen music to guide you on our dance journey. Inspired by her experiences on dance floors around the globe, Hikari-jin has devoted her life to exploring what it means to use movement and ceremony for healing and transformation. In facilitating her own evolution and that of others she is assisting the global shift that is upon us.

events.title: Feldenkrais Workshop w/Shara Ogin @ RhythmWave
events.description: Free yourself from all the aches and pains of the week, restore your body's inner symmetry and alignment, and restore yourself for the weekend! The Feldenkrais Method emphasizes the connection between the mind, body, and spirit. It helps with blood flow, the realignment of our bones, muscles and joints, and with the coordination of our overall movement patterns. Be prepared to lay down, relax and attune to yourself as Shara guide’s you through gentle, simple movement sequences guaranteed to shift your nervous system to a place of greater serenity, comfort, and joy. Please bring a mat or blanket if you have one.

events.title: GGG: Dominatrix for Dummies w/Eleanor O’Brien
events.description: By turns raunchy, hilarious and heartwarming, “GGG: Dominatrix for Dummies” is Eleanor O’Brien’s (Dance Naked Productions) solo show about training to be a dominatrix in New York City.  Deliciously funny and unabashedly graphic, O’Brien portrays an unforgettable cast of sex workers and clients.  Far from a simple guide to whips and chains, there is a love story woven into the fabric of the S&M adventure.   From the agony of junior high dances to the inner sanctum of a professional dungeon, enemas to ecstatic dance (including a cameo from Gabrielle Roth), GGG: D4D explores what it means to fall in lust with yourself!

events.title: Ho‘oponopono Forgiveness Meditation w/Shannon
events.description: All are welcome to join Shannon Tamsin on the bamboo at RhythmWave and be guided through an ancient Hawaiian forgiveness process. Together, we will clear out preconceptions of how we view others to create new connections and rejuvenated relationships. This is a guided, easygoing and joyful meditation. The Hawaiian word ho‘oponopono comes from ho‘o ("to make") and pono ("right").

events.title: Morning Renewal Yoga w/Amy Vito @ RhythmWave
events.description:
Come all you wanderers, take retreat. Make a conscious choice to distance yourself from the forces that rob you of your peace. Retreat is an advance toward your own center. You move toward balance, and thus a much stronger position. Cut yourself free, and answer the call of the open vistas before you.

Please join Amy Vito for this yoga class inspired by the 33rd (Tun/Retreat) & 56th (Lu/Wanderer) hexagrams of the I Ching. Come and be renewed, at RhythmWave.

events.title: New Moon Ceremony: Sound for Healing & Alignment

The tones and overtones will lift your spirit and move the energy within you. Bring your intentions and please wear white. Meet at the Temple East Gate at sunrise.

events.title: NO Dimension Sufi Whirling Meditation
events.description: The SUFI whirling started in the heart of the desert, looking towards the infinity of the horizon. Standing still, connecting to the earth, and expanding our hands toward the universe, the SUFi begins to swirl joining the infinite movement of the planets. The participants will synchronize our movements, breath and heart beat to become conduits of this infinite energy that derives from the cosmos. In doing so, we become grounded amounts the chaos all around and reunite with the infinite energy within as we spread i it in all directions. WELCOME! Come stand still in time and watch the expansive SUFi whirling come from within!

Add fire. Push the limit. Embrace paradox. Please join Wisch for this Open Floor Exploration on the bamboo at RhythmWave. All are welcome!

events.description: Kick off your Burn on the right foot (even if it’s your left)! “Sweat Your Prayers” with Huggy Bear at RhythmWave, as we bring this beautiful and dynamic dance/meditation back to Black Rock City. There are no steps to follow, no choreography to learn, and no way to do it wrong. The only requirements are a body that is still breathing, a mind that is still curious, and a heart that is still beating. Please join RhythmWave as we return to BRC for our 10th consecutive year!

events.title: Tribal Tantra w/Eugene Hedlund @ RhythmWave
events.description: We will warm up with Movement Meditation to arrive in our bodies and listen to the wisdom within. As we dance, we will awaken the elemental spirits within our physical bodies as we invite that sacred tremor which frees our hearts to love to move us so that we may release that which has held us back and shed any limiting beliefs so that we may invite new gifts and possibilities into the empty space within. By embodying this ritual, we attune our body to tend toward our highest good while making space to step with clarity into what is next. Then we will offer the healing practice of Medicine Dance to melt some of the walls to giving and receiving that love within. From that place, we will dance in the cultivated energy of the tribe - a full wave to ground all the gifts, shake loose any layers ready to release and make even more space to be empowered to our birth right to love and be loved, starting with the Self.

events.title: What are those 5Rhythms anyway? w/Aaron Lifshin
events.description: Just like light, sound, or ocean waves, a dancing body moving freely passes through five distinct rhythmic patterns. These patterns continuously repeat themselves in a wave of motion. Gabrielle Roth's 5Rhythms® are: FLOWING – the fluid, continuous, grounded glide of our own movements; STACCATO – the percussive, pulsing beat that shapes us a thousand different ways; CHAOS – the rhythm of letting go, releasing into the catalytic wildness of our dance that can never be planned or repeated; LYRICAL – the rhythm of trance, where the weight of self-consciousness dissolves, where we lighten up and disappear into our own uniqueness; and STILLNESS – the quiet emptiness, where gentle movements rise and fall, start and end, in a field of silence. Please join Aaron Lifshin for an introduction to the 5Rhythms movement practice, at RhythmWave.

All are welcome to join Kambiz Fahim at RhythmWave for Yoga Dance Emergence® - designed to guide you to revelation of your innermost truth, through a joyous act of full expression.

Art Car Camp is a celebration of Art Cars founded in 1994 by Harrod Blank.  In addition to art cars parked in front, there is a  photo exhibit of the history and with the DMV located nearby it helps to demonstrate the difference between art cars and mutant vehicles.  Come see for yourself.

Art Car Camp at Burning Man was started in 1994 by art car creator, documentarian and promoter, Harrod Blank. As the Burning Man Festival has grown, art vehicles have become more elaborate and fantastical (now known as "Mutant Vehicles"). Many of the original "art cars" that once roamed the playa freely can no longer get licensed by the Black Rock DMV. Art Car Camp celebrates these street legal, permanently altered "daily drivers".  Come and see the origin point of Art Cars at Black Rock City!

history.description:
Maxa Village 

Where the Wixárika Legend of the Blue Deer---he who leads the chosen on visionary pathways to tuning their gifts & gaining unique knowledge-- comes to life in the dust of the Black Rock desert. A space where burners are welcomed to come immerse themselves in the camps that bring our village to life dedicated to Sustainability, Tech & Art, Gastronomy, Healing & Transformation and of course Music!

Maxa Camp is centered on the promotion of unity and recognition of past cultures and ancestral heritage. Our camp will be a representation of the deeply rooted, ancient beliefs of the Mexican and Huichol communities combined with the contemporary views of a community of our own.

Maxa Camp is centered on the promotion of unity and recognition of past cultures and ancestral heritage. Our camp will be a representation of the deeply rooted, ancient beliefs of the Mexican and Huichol communities combined with the contemporary views of a community of our own.

Maxa Camp was formed by using elements and beliefs of the Huichol Culture and complementing them with contemporary views and grooves (& Mezcal). We promote spreading good vibes and the main objective of our mystical mutant vehicle, the Blue Deer, will be to guide you to fun and new experiences, as the Huichol Maxa guides it’s followers to new and higher perspectives.

history.description:
Equilibrium has been established as a destination to represent the pinnacle for the collective first world culture in which we live: vacation. Adhering to a strict belief that our shared time together should be one of joy and relaxation, we seek to strike the all too difficult balance of hard work and play.
It is here that we have constructed a series of spaces and activities to ensure that all who step through our threshold experience the relaxation, camaraderie, and playfulness that we all deserve outside the hectic worlds of which we live the other 51 weeks of the year. "Because it's vacation for fucks sake."

history.description: The Center for Corn Bong Equilibrium, a Wuice Co-Op...Yeah Baby (EQ for short), represents the pinnacle in Radical Ritual for the collective first world culture in which we live: vacation. Adhering to a strict belief that our shared time together should be one of joy and relaxation, we seek to strike the all too difficult balance of hard work and play. We are an established camp designed around the confluence of radical inactivity and community support, of which we've coined as "the camp that does nothing, but has everything." It is in this space of in-between action and inaction we are expressing our confidence in the rituals we have set up to ensure that our camp and the community at large experiences the place of relaxation that we all deserve in this place outside the hectic worlds of which we live the other 51 weeks of the year.

Apply electrical theory to amp up your energy response. Electricity is Energy. Get grounded with Star Captain as we demystify all the woo-woo jargon in energy work to help you amp up your life. (This is a relaxing and informative talk).

Feeling confused or frustrated by all the terms being thrown around in energy work? Have you ever found yourself resisting change? Do you feel the need to disconnect from certain places, people and things? Do you wonder why bonding feels so good? Does your capacity to receive increase as you tap into different frequencies? Can you step-up to transform your life?

Energy work doesn’t have to be confusing, and you don’t have to take it personally. In fact, once you understand that most of the terms used to describe your energy are borrowed from electrical engineering textbooks, you can increase your own potential and generate real results in your own life experience. Get grounded with Star Captain as we demystify all the woo-woo jargon in energy work to help you amp up your life.

events.title: Feel The Feline: Unleash Your Inner Cat
events.description:
The non-verbal language of cats is renowned for its nuance and diversity, so much so that it can take years for humans to master this beautiful art. And indeed, it is a language familiar to humans, often much more than actual humans non-verbal language. But this cat language is similar enough to human’s that it is easy to learn for those who are still in the dark. In fact, many people interact non-verbally more often and in more complex ways with pets than they do with other human beings, so it is a good starting point for a common language of touch between lovers. 

In this playful romp of a class, you will learn…

★ Mastery of the mysterious feline gaze
★ The elaborate dance of the their walk
★ The beautiful and nuanced language of their touch
★ The intricacy of their meows and purrs (and one special trick to turn you into a cat magnet)
★ Their top-secret missions to take over the human world (and how you can join their ranks)
★ A beginner’s vocabulary and codes to instantly become a cat’s best friend (even if you’re really a dog person)
★ How kittens are much more dangerous than adult cats (even as they are cuter!)
★ And much, much more…

Don’t wait to become friends with the greatest slyest animals on the planet, join us and become their ally!

history.description: Who says trainwrecks are inherently bad? Come to Union Giraffic 2: Train Wreck and experience the finest waterholes a crash site can offer. Take in panoramic views of the playa from our climbable gym, sue a friend (on an enemy) at our in our Westward courtrooms and enjoy a dusty dance party at our favorite watering hole the Long Neck Saloon. Anyone with boots and a thick layer of dust welcome. Union Giraffic Railways keeps 'em rolling!

Venture into the wild unknown with Union Giraffic Railways, the finest in the stationary dust to dust transportation. Open a can of beans over our cozy fire, get your daily dose of TENSION in our high noon standoffs, or squint into the sunset + plan your next move across the playa from our Sky High Lookout. Anyone with boots and a thick layer of dust welcome. Union Giraffic Railways keeps 'em rolling!

Come by Aer Jiraffa and play on our 20' climbing gym day and night, with tree house suspended 15' in the air, some swings on the bottom--an amazing place to catch the sunrise or sunset. Come by and grab a drink at our craft beer bar or sit by the fire at night, or just come hang out; we're pretty nice.

events.description:
Join us for your morning caffenation ritual. Offerings change daily, but over the course of the Burn we will be serving freshly ground coffees prepared in various ways, a multitude of teas from around the world, and a host of other morning time beverages guaranteed to put a spring in your step.

Some of our rotating beverages include: Turkish coffee, Vietnamese coffee, espresso, pour-over coffee, French press coffee, cold brewed coffee, yerba mate, matcha, chai, and many more.

events.title: Beyond Prepping, burningman as a guide
events.description: Are you concerned about debt levels, wealth imbalance, and the environment, but don't like the negativity surrounding prepping. Learn how to be resilient in a time of great change without falling into negative thinking.  I will talk about all the things I have learned in the last year, and the approach to resiliency that I like the most and then we will open the class to interactive discussion.

events.title: Coffee. An Appreciation & Understanding
events.description: Have you thought about the process of how that warm cup of liquid heaven got into your hand? Let’s discuss the journey from plant to cup; including harvesting, processing, globalization, and cafe culture. Q & A about brew methods with complimentary cold brew, of course.

events.title: Find Joy by Shifting your Thinking
events.description: I used to have a negative voice in my head criticizing my every choice. Learn how I changed my thinking by focusing on the positive in my life and taking new actions. Find joy and happiness by changing your thinking.  The class will include concrete examples from my life with group interaction so everyone gets a chance to share their story and get help.

events.title: Mate: A Way Of Life
events.description: Join us on a journey as we travel through time from the inception of Mate into the Latin American culture to the present moment. We will teach you the ritual of how to prepare and consume mate with an active demo. Come buzz with us!

events.title: Your Passion is your Purpose
events.description: Having trouble deciding what to do with your life? Follow your Passion and watch everything fall into place. Find out how to unlock your Passions.  This class will include concrete example from the instructors life, and there will be group sharing so everyone will be able to share and get guidance.

In the daytime, come wiggle your limbs on our shady dance floor, fuel up with a refreshing cocktail, or enjoy galactic-sized Consensual Abduction (aren't you curious what that is?). events.title: SORNE at Burning Man 2015
events.description:
Morgan Sorne, known in his solo music project as SORNE, is an American singer-songwriter, composer, multi-media artist, music producer, and actor. He is known for his supernatural vocal range and utilization of homemade instruments and found sounds to create sonic tapestries of layered vocal samples and unconventional instrumentation. His performances often feature an construct of self-made visual art pieces inspired by personal and cultural archetypes, a continual thread woven throughout his performance aesthetic.
SORNE performs and tours with a revolving cast of dancers, musicians and artists while working with local communities of peoples around the world to create unique participatory live experiences of his work, thus blurring the line between performer and audience member.  His musical style has been described as a combination of tribal, electronica, avant-garde, avant pop, alternative rock, and opera.

A cascade of images, music and performance awaits as we gaze outward from the Esplanade and inward to our soul. Join members of the Vau de Vire Society, Bad Unkl Sista and Dustfish for a performance fusion evening like no other: ritual, fire, physical theater, circus all woven together. You don’t want to miss this show. Starts promptly at 8pm! Bring a small mirror.

Doll up and dance to the haunting hoopla of the West Coast’s premier electroswing pioneers: DELACHAUX, THE KLOWN and The GENTLEMEN CALLERS of LOS ANGELES. And indulge in hypnotic undulations with international burlesque sensations TOSCA RIVOLA, IDA FOCHT, KITTY OAKS, VIOLET D’VINE, IVIZIA DAKINI, TANA THE TATTOOED LADY, BRITTANY WALSH, and those fabled fiends and floozies FOU FOU HA! Plus ferocious Femcee MISS EMMMA! This joint WILL jump. Equal parts Weimar cabaret and wild speakeasy rave, Trapeze lures a bevy of underworld flappers, vipers, vamps and villains to a bass-fueled night of jazz age abandon. history.description:
We're a community of creatives and applied technologists who are harnessing the power of renewable energy to fuel our festivities. SOLARPUNKS is an exploration into what society will look like when humanity learns to wield technology to create in harmony with nature—rather than destroy it. 

We're constructing a decentralized grid of batteries and inverters to be supplied by solar PV arrays to power our camp functions. With renewable energy surpassing the cost efficiencies of fossil fuel, we're excited to energize systems-level solutions to and for fellow burners.

Inspired by our many years of participation in Burning Man, we're here to prototype and prove the viability of renewable-energy based solutions that can be expediently deployed at scale, to contribute to 2030 Sustainability Goals.

events.title: Ariadne's Labyrinth
events.description: Ariadne was the immortal wife of the wine-god Dionysos.  Her labyrinth, which we set up on the playa, is for you to enjoy.  Labyrinth walking in an ancient practice used by many different faiths for spiritual centering and contemplation. Entering the serpentine path of a labyrinth, the walker walks slowly while quieting their mind and focusing on a spiritual question or prayer.  Lose yourself to find yourself.  Look for the colorful fabric and multicolored LED rope lights at night.

We'll share "cool hugs", do a little speed dating and just mingle with other singles. Meet the person of your dreams or just meet a new friend. events.title: Create a Cult! (in Silicon Village)
events.description:
Do you lack direction? Do you need a crazy purpose in life and want to share it with other? Then join us and create a cult!

You and many other followers craving direction in life will work together to create a cult of metamorphosis and transform the dull and dreary citizens of BRC into mindless cultists like you. One of us.. ONE OF US! That’s right, we will help lead the discussion and figure out the aspects of our cult. What is our core belief? What is the symbol that binds us together, what inane phrase will we say on greeting each other? Also what is a cult without a symbol, that’s right, using art supplies we can make a symbol that represents our cult, make some extras so you can spread the word of whatever amongst the population. All must join, all that do not are obviously too sane!

events.description: We will explore the delights & receptivity of being in your divine feminine essence. This includes a discussion of what is the Yin in Yin/Yang. It can possibly include using belly dance as a way to access the divine feminine. Please join us if you are curious or have questions. We have answers!

events.title: How to be more flexible at Yoga
events.description: Want to know the secrets to becoming more flexible at yoga without hurting yourself? It’s all in the posture you begin with. Come join us for an alignment based Mindful practice! You will discover ways to gain more flexibility and mobility without creating pain, tension or injury. This method is based on a 30-year longitudinal research studying the spines of people in disparate developing countries where they coincidentally have the same spine shape  and no incidence of back pain. You can find this shape too! All levels welcome.

events.title: How to Roast Coffee Beans (in Silicon Village)
events.description:
Anyone can drink coffee, but how to Roast Coffee Beans for that Ultimate Satisfying cup of Joe is this class.

The green coffee bean is actually the seed from a flower and tree which is processed and dried. Roasting coffee beans is simple, yet it takes a little practice…just like everything else…in order to perfect it. There are programmable roasters which make the whole process as simple as turning a dial and pressing a couple of buttons. These start at a little more than a hundred dollars and go up from there. The “Whirley Pop” which I will demonstrate here costs around $40. This air roasting method works like popping popcorn. There is a hand crank which turns a small metal paddle and keeps the beans moving so that they do not overheat and burn. You’ll also need a measuring cup to measure ½ cup of the beans and a large metal bowl to allow the beans to cool off and degas. Taught by the bean master himself, Pacer.

If you've ever done Pecha Kucha you will be familiar with the idea... but this is a different format where we provide the slides for you and it's only two minutes.  Fun, funny, or serious is all fair game.  You will learn to think on your feet better.

Based on the time slot, limited to 20 participants.

We are also hosting a series of events to tantalize your senses and stimulate your soul, in honor of Dionysos; the god of wine, ecstasy, theater, dance, fertility and revelry! Text your mom for your birth time BEFORE you get here.  Tell her you need to find out where and when your personal "metamorphosis" is going to take place.

events.title: Traditional Thai massage, a beginners class

Loving touch is a meditative dance with your partner. Join us to learn how to give a traditional Thai massage! Clothed, no oil.

In Silicon Village

Such an important life skill. But, bizarrely, high schools don’t yet include massage in the curriculum. Learn what you’ve missed all these years! Come as a couple or we’ll pair you up, and experience an introduction to giving a traditional Thai massage. Thai massage is done clothed, with no oil. This traditional healing system combines acupressure, Indian Ayurvedic principles, and assisted yoga
postures. After a night of dance, you owe it to yourself…

events.title: Mindfulness & Meditation-nothing more nothing Less
events.description:
There is a reason you are here, right now. Maybe you want to live the mission of Burning Man? Did you know the mission of Burning Man is to guide, nurture and create a society that connects each individual to his or her creative powers?

Burning Man also offers each of us an opportunity to strengthen our ability to participate within a community and help in the creation of a society that connects to an even greater world of nature that exists beyond society. This is a special mission. And this is why you are here. 

If you would like to learn HOW to do this, this session is for you.

This session is designed to:
A. increase our understanding the mission of Burning Man.
B. strengthen our own self awareness and the possibilities that lie on the other side of fear.

These sessions explore the fundamentals of mindfulness meditation and how it cultivates mindfulness –the ability to tune into your senses and be present to what’s happening moment–by-moment instead of getting lost in the storyline of your thoughts.
Through mindfulness exercises, meditation instruction, discussion and exposure to the scientific benefits and history of meditation, you will gain a clearer awareness of your thoughts, your emotions and how the power of mindfulness will propel you to connect with your super powers.
You will learn how to begin a simple meditation practice that you can do anywhere along with suggestions on how to make it a habit. (If you’re a regular meditator, you’ll learn how to deepen your existing practice.)
And lastly, you’ll learn easy ways to bring mindfulness, along with gratitude, appreciation and joy into your time here in the desert and into your everyday life.

The Black Rock Travel Agency is a gang of pilots, aviation enthusiasts, and adventurers who come together every year to serve the airport village and its visitors located at the end of Point5. Yes, there is an airport! BRTA makes it just like you imagine a Burning Man Airport would be. A massive Starport pyramid structure with entertainment and bar underneath with 30 foot viewing platform above? Yes! A super yummy galley serving pancake breakfast and bbq? Yes! Facilitating scenic airplane flights for Burners? Of course! The Agents at the Black Rock Travel Agency are committed to burners having an experience only to be found at the best airport in the world. Start, continue or end your journey with us.

Serving the Airport Community Since 1998

BRTA is a theme camp located at the Black Rock City Municipal Airport (located near point 5) since 1998. It provides a home for wayward pilot, airport volunteers, and those seeking a place to escape from the craziness and crowds of Black Rock City. 

For others, it's a stopping point on a journey that may not take them where they want to go... but hopefully where they need to go.

BRTA's physical presence includes the Starport shade structure and observation deck, the Galley,  We host new and returning art installations.

BRTA also hosts events throughout the week.

history.description: We have Occupied the BRC Municipal Airport since 1999. We believe in government-funded contraception. There is a rumor that Newt Gingrich and Calista will be flying to Burning Man this year after losing the nomination. You get to first dibs on giving Newt a TSA-style full body search while Calista and I trade shots of Southern Comfort and Watermelon Pucker.

Instead of a pithy comment this year, let’s have H.L. Mencken say a few words:“For it is mutual trust even more than mutual interest that hold human associations together-our friends seldom profit us but they make us feel safe.”“Every normal man must be tempted at times to spit on his hands, hoist the black flag, and begin to slit throats.”
We are a full-service hospitality agency, an FBO, and a legend in our own minds. Come fly with us.

The Black Rock Travel Agency has been serving and supporting The Airport at Port of Entry Village since 1999. BRTA is one of the oldest theme camps that are still talking to one another. Est. in 1996 with 3 members, it has grown to over 50 travel agents. We’ll help you get where you need to go!

Once again, hospitality. All love, all groin. This year, in line with the new “American” theme, we will be lovin’ babies pretty much 24/7. Oh, and mothers too. All love, all the time. Mothers and babies. BRTA, since ’37.

It was 1996. The Black Rock Travel Agency (BRTA)-sensing the birth of a radical city of artists, born in the backseat of a Chevy Monte Carlo-pitched a golden spike along the outskirts of that city, on the troubled road to Rave Camp. A Travel Agency Was Born. BRTA and Hospitality-no two words could have closer meaning.

The Black Rock Travel Agency (BRTA) has been serving its playa customers in the most untoward ways since 1937. BRTA is one of the oldest institutions at BRC (since 1991) and was instrumental in keeping Helco at bay in 1996 (though some of the details of these black ops have never been–and will never be–revealed). We will tell you about the old days, if you have the time. Otherwise, we will just take you on an airplane trip and try not to give you too much of a thrill. If you catch our drift.

Allah Akbar!After wresting control of the disputed “Airport Gate” region from the dread Banned Rogue Terrorist Association last year, the hyperpatriots of the Black Rock Travel Agency continue their mission in 2005:

The Black Rock Travel Agency has been making love to the world for so long it no longer knows what love is, or what is is; and we find ourselves in a quandry, wondering how love will flourish in a post-Bushian world. But this much is true: if you are good and true, if your vision creates love and beauty, it has the automatic Black Rock Travel Agency seal of approval, so come show us what you have that is truthful, beautiful, and full of love.

events.title: Gender Fuckery Revue
events.description: This is an opportunity for you to perform! You can be a rockstar, a novice, an expert at your craft, or just beginning to explore - this stage is for all of you - from advanced to beginners we want to see you shine. Together we will create a safer space for you to perform. We will cheer for you, love you, & accept you. This is especially a place for queer, trans, gender nonconforming, and enby artists to thrive! That said we welcome everyone to shine of all sexualities, genders, and backgrounds. We want to see your gender fuckery in action! We want to see your drag, your make-up, your performance art, your political theater, your most wild and beautiful vision in action. Come be on our stage - show us burlesque, drag, poetry, circus arts, strip tease, comedy, spoken word, you name it - we want it! Some weird talent you have never shown anyone else. Bring it! We also need an audience so if you don't want to perform but want to witness this is also your time to shine! We want you to sit, relax, sip on a beverage, and enjoy the show! If you want to perform, help DJ, or be part of the magic and you know in advance then FB message Trixie Lamonte. If you want to just show up the day of  - you can. Come to Gender Blender half an hour early to sign up for the show and you are in! Let's make this stage magical! We want you all to participate either by watching or performing. Let's gender fuck together!

events.title: Sexploration! A Gender Blender Play Party
events.description: Welcome to the hottest play party on playa! We welcome your sexiness, kinkiness, hotness, & creativity! We are so excited to connect, play, & explore in a safer consent focused environment. We offer safer sex supplies, toys, harnesses, & an environment that is focused on mutual respect and consent. We center trans, enby, nonconforming, blending, bending, cross-dressing, gender exploring, gender questioning, & all queer people. We welcome you if you are straight or cis too - just know this event centers trans people and queers of all genders. You can be lesbian, bi, queer, gay, pan, straight, literally all that you are - we welcome! We want you in your beautiful, hot, sexy body! You can come with a partner, many partners, or solo. Voyeurism with consent is allowed. If you are creeping on someone or making people, especially those this party centers, feel uncomfortable you will be escorted out. We have vibe checkers making sure everyone at the party is consenting and respecting. Do not come here to goggle at trans & enby bodies - come here because you are trans or enby or questioning your gender or because you are nonconforming or because you feel connected to this community or because you in your own way are part of this community. Do not attend if you are homophobic or transphobic. This space does not apply to you. If you are open minded &  of any background you are welcome. ALL genders are welcome ALLways. Are you a gay boy - you are welcome. Are you a lesbian woman - you are welcome. Are you pan boi-girl-they/them fairie - you are welcome. Are you straight but not narrow - you are welcome. Hopefully you are catching on that as long as you are not creeptastic/transqueerphobic you are welcome. We want to celebrate! This probably will be the only play party on playa to center trans & enby people - that is MAGICAL. Show up for that & if you are used to being the center explore being the margin. AND if you are on the margin WELCOME to the center! This party is for you!

history.description:
Are you tired of gender labels? Are you over being told you need to look, be, or behave a certain way? Are you ready to smash the bonds of gender oppression and metamorphosize into gender liberation?! Do you believe in creating safe spaces for trans, non-binary, genderqueer, non-conforming, bending, and blending folks than Gender Blender the place for you!

Gender Blender is fun, interactive, educational, and a space to explore your gender identity. We are a safe space community of trans, non-binary, genderqueer, and gender out-laws and radicals. We support each other, heal the wounds of gender oppression, run workshops, play parties, and create magic. We welcome all genders all-ways.
Check us out at www.genderblenders.org

Catch someone’s eye during this super flirtatious blender bar event. Both alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks will be served. All genders welcome all ways. We mean this - you can be trans, cis, boy, girl, gay, bi, dyke, king, queen, loving these words, hating these words, our neighbors, or from far-away lands across the playa: this night is for you. So let’s enjoy ...each other! Consent, respect, and safety are mandatory in our camp.

events.title: Bridging the Gap: Allyship w/The Trans Community
events.description:
An open-format conversation hosted by representatives from the GQ and Ally communities in an effort to foster communication and kinship. Hosts will facilitate respectful communication on topics ranging from vocabulary and privilege to visibility and intersectionality. Lots of Q & A and opportunities to be heard and to listen!

Ever wanted to know why people do what they do? Or feel how they feel? This is your chance to ask!

The workshop will be held at the Gender Blender, a safe space for trans and non-binary burners where the motto is "All Genders Welcome, Always". We will strive to spread that sentiment around the playa and beyond with meaningful communication and expression.

Please join us Wednesday from 2:00-4:00pm to help us to build a better community. The more attendees the better - we need your questions and your input!

events.title: Gender Blender 10 year Retrospective & Future!

From that small rag-tag camp, a great and powerful community was born. Now we are a community of hundreds with about forty people per year making it home to playa. We create anti-oppression/liberation trainings, hold safe space for trans and gender non-binary people, educate the larger public, make smoothies, create theater, throw safer sex hot play parties, and build lasting beautiful chosen family connections. Its been 10 years of blood, sweat, tears, hot sex, awesomeness, building, and growing. So now what? What is our next level vision? Where are we going from here? What do we want to build next. Come and dream with us and grow this vision. This is going to be a facilitated and engaging brainstorm and action workshop. Let's make magic!

So let's be real and talk about how these isms affect our time on playa and off and what we want to do to create the world we want to live in. This workshop will be interactive, engaging, fun, and educational. Let's define what we want the word freakshow to me and let's reclaim ourselves and whole people who all deserve respect.

The journey to Burning Man involves leaving behind the familiar and embarking on a journey towards the unknown. This shared experience resonates deeply with the journey of immigrants, refugees, and boat people, who leave behind everything they know to navigate unfamiliar territory in search of a sense of home in an unlikely place. Black Rock City Refugee Camp celebrates the strength, resilience, ingenuity, and compassion of these remarkable communities.

With open hearts, we welcome all who seek solace, camaraderie, and belonging. Join our journey of resilience and celebration, as we create a space where the enduring spirit of immigrants, refugees, and boat people shines brightly in the heart of Black Rock City.

Members of the Entheos Community organize one of the larger and most diverse theme camps placed at the annual Burning Man event in the Black Rock Desert of Nevada. Friends and members of the Entheos Community come from over 43 countries to contribute their effort, skills, and resources to the creation of Entheos @ Burning Man. The camp creates extensive 24/7 interactivity for all ages as a gift to the citizens of Black Rock City, functions as a pilgrimage home for its members, and serves as a nexus to meaningfully connect people from around the world across national, religious, and ideological lines. As part of Entheos' commitment to radical inclusion, diversity, and equity, we hold a significant portion of our camp capacity open each year to welcome people who are new to Entheos.

history.description: Entheos is an active, global community of makers, healers, artists, thinkers, organizers and leaders from all walks of life.  We have gathered around our common interest in the exploration of healing trauma, raising consciousness and manifesting creativity to sculpt a new way of living in the world. Many of us actively participate in shamanic healing communities, work in medical and psychological research, facilitate intimate experience with sacred medicine and are active leaders in exploring the evolution of consciousness.

events.title: A Model for Community Led Peer Integration Circles
events.description: I'll describe the protocol we've been using in our community in Sonoma County, CA and discuss why community led circles are better than ones mediated by professionals or organizations.  Workshop will touch on the theory of peer integration, power dynamics in the integration setting, the format and principles of the circle.  My ulterior motive is to enroll you to participate in a circle later in the week.

events.title: Entheos Bazaar
events.description:
The Entheos "Bazaar" is an interactive space for the Entheos community and Burners alike, synonymous to a warm, vibrant and slightly chaotic place where a curious soul would find one thousand and one treasures, and will embark on a journey of self expression, sensorial discovery and fun encounters. This welcoming space will cover a variety of gifts from Entheos, enticing visitors to explore the depth of the tent, to take a break and let the care of their souls and beauty in the hand of others. 
The central area will be covered with carpets, cushions, drapes and will host various activities. A samovar will keep hot tea for the parched visitor, whilst they watch a show, relax or get a Tarot reading. The space will be open daily 10am-10pm, with ad-hoc activities only be happening few hours everyday.
The Bazaar offers 6 gifts: 
1) The Boutique, a fun space where anyone can pick from a wide selection of clothing, accessories and jewelry to enhance their outfit or even to do something new and different for a complete personal metamorphoses.
2)The Makeup Station,  a wide range of make up with body paint and markers and temporary tattoos. Burners will be able to paint on themselves and on others freely. This would be a playful station for everyone to get into the art and joy of interaction and embellishment.
3)The (Real) Tattoo Parlour, with professional tattoo artists on site!
4)The Olfactive Journey, where you will discover the world of essences and their power to connect us to emotions and memories. Everyone can come by and experiment with perfumes and aromas and can even create their own.
5)The Desertic Sounds, to really transport you into a world of senses and allow for a short pause from the rest of the playa. Background music and DJ sets will be re-creating the atmosphere of an ancient Bazaar, both uplifting and introspective, mystical and exciting with tribal beats and soulful melodies
6)The Guest Activities, with tarot readings, tea & live performances!

events.title: Psychedelic Peer Integration Circle
events.description: This is a community led peer integration circle for folks looking for an opportunity to share and receive reflection about psychedelic experiences.  The protocol used will be based on the model describe in our workshop on Tuesday August 27.  This is a council style event with each participant having a set and equal amount of time for their sharing. Given the limited time available the size of the group will be restricted to 9 participants and 1 facilitator.  This event is intended to give participants an opportunity to process and integrate past or anticipated experiences with psychoactive material.  All discussion within the circle will be confidential and all participants must agree to confidentiality to be in the circle.

Entheos points to the creative, collaborative spark within each of us, and the divine fire we can ignite when we gather to play and learn together.

We bring together practitioners from  the rich shamanic tradition of entheogenic spirit journey work and create a dialog with the scientific/medical community that is presently conducting FDA-approved research studies for the treatment of such conditions as depression and PTSD. Each workshop and speaker presentation, although on a common theme, is unique. Three different sessions will be presented each day of Burn, Monday through Friday, for a total of 15 distinct offerings.

His talks precede the live filming of Burners perform a page of Finnegans Wake on film to their chosen piece of music.  For further information, and if you would like to radically participate by performing a page of Wake, you can sign up on Finnegan Wakes @ Burning Man Facebook page:  https://www.facebook.com/groups/140895106475855/

This will be the third year Finnegan Wakes @ Burning Man.  This year, we will film chapter 5 of Joyce's masterpiece.  So come along and let loose.  And play a starring role if the first ever film edition of FW!

events.title: Trampoline Dodge Ball Field
events.description: This year, Entheos will bring together a field of commercial trampolines to create a play park surrounded by netting and approximately 90 repurposed 275 gallon IBC water cubes filled with computer-controlled lighting. During the day, Entheos will coordinate a BRC-wide trampoline dodge ball tournament where Burning Man camps and groups of friends can compete for the title of 2018 Burning Man Dodge Ball Champions. At night, the trampoline field becomes a play and dance space for the party. Fog rolls out from underneath, lit by RGB LEDs tied to the sound/lighting controllers, projectors light up the trampolines with a constant swirl of visually engaging graphics, and the trampolines become reactive to the people playing on them. Sensors mounted on each of the trampolines can detect jumping. As people playing begin to explore and work together, new effects are unlocked by jumping in sync in particular patterns.

history.description:
SERENDIPITEA, meanwhile let's have a sip of Tea. 

SERENDIPITEA focuses on the communal aspects of tea rituals around the globe. Tea is something close to our hearts in the UK, but is also a significant to many different cultures; whether it is a tall iced glass of sweet tea in the southern US, or a steaming cup of mint tea served from a silvery teapot in Morocco- all are symbols of hospitality and friendship bringing us closer as a whole. We took a lot of inspiration from the Book of Tea written in 1906 by Okakura Kakuzō of Japan in English, he addressed the growing concern of clash between the east and west cultures. The struggle he speaks of resonates with the modern cultural issues facing society, the very issues that Burning Man explores.
SERENDIPITEA, meanwhile let’s have a sip of Tea.

events.title: Late Night Food Court hosted by FtA

Last year we experimented with bringing together many of BRC’s mobile food providers (many of whom, we’re proud to say, were born out of FtA’s 10 years of work on the playa) for a surprise deep playa food court.  This year, in consultation (and collaboration) with many of our large sound camp neighbors, we intend to create a Temporary Autonomous Food Zone across 10:00 from the FtA camp EVERY NIGHT during burn week from midnight to roughly 3am.  All mobile food providers will be invited to congregate and help us create the world’s first CAFEPLAYATORIUM!  The 10th Street cafaplayatorium will be perched on the edge of 10th street looking outward towards the vast vistas available of the deep playa.  

We’ve all become familiar with the multi-sound car dance parties that form every night around BRC.  We’re bringing this concept to food and inviting all mobile food providers to help us create a place where people can come to relax, receive some nourishment, recover, engage in conversation, meet new friends, and continue on their way. Yes, there will also be music, but it will not be so loud that people can’t have conversations.

Citizens of Black Rock City will be welcomed with open arms, warm snacks and an invitation to experience the interactive cafaplayatorium. Only FtA and Burning Man can combine the cafeteria, playa and auditorium creating the experience that is The 10th Street Cafeplayatorium.

events.title: Solventless Cannabis Extractions using Hop flower
events.description:
Hops and cannabis both express the same glands to produce resins (trichomes). In fact, they are chemically capable of making many of the same aromatic molecules (we call them alpha-acids in beer - the bittering agent in IPA style beers, and terpenes in cannabis, (but they’re the same molecules)

These molecules have their own physiological effects - they are essential oils, after all, and when smoked, along with the cannabinoids present in the flower, the terpenes help to create what we call the entourage effect. Have you ever wondered why two cannabis strains may test for exactly the same amount of THC, but provide completely opposite effects, some making you relaxed and some making you energized? It all has to do with what terpenes you consume along with the specific blend of cannabinoids present that make a finger print of each strain of cannabis.

We will be using a technique called “Ice hash” or “Bubble Hash” to extract these glands.
We use ice to make the glands (made of hollow plant wax) brittle, then we use increasingly fine silk screens to break them off the leaf surface and sieve them away from the plant material, leaving behind a purified collection of plant glands/resins.

Come for fun - come to learn about healthy hash making! Come to make friends and expand your mind.

Whether we go with psycho analysis, aversion therapy or a colonoscopy, we have  everything it takes to dissect your inner most being and discover the person you really are. 
In addition to discovering your unknown, you get to make your own Rorschach Test, try on a straight jacket and take home some awesome tips on how to be a super successful Sociopath.

It's just you, alone, sitting normally in the chair, holding the frying pan, and a background we select.  Don't get clever. Then we send it to you later. events.title: The Beauty of Math for Artists
events.description:
Math - as taught in school - is tedious and boring. But mathematicians who study math create sound and impenetrable structures of logic from concepts they invented out of the blue. Like an artist creating something never seen before - it is often spectacular and beautiful.  

In this workshop I'll tell some stories about mathematical concepts directed to artists with no knowledge and try the present some of the beauty you can stumble upon when studying math. 

NO MATH SKILLS REQUIRED.

Time to shimmy and undulate! Learn beginner belly dance moves that you can make your own!

Since ancient times dance has been a form of physical, emotional and spiritual healing. It can be used to ease tension and emotional blockages!

We will dance to move stale energy in our body. We will do hip movements that stimulate our sacral power center for confidence and and chest movements that stimulate our heart power center for love and compassion. We will learn to dance using muscles that we rarely access and unlock the creativity and sensuality of the Divine Feminine for personal and societal healing. All genders welcome!

Hopefully, you will walk away with a more open/ liberated/ fearless, and emotive flow; channel inward to manifest outwardly. Will leave more confident with ability to flow in third-person while simultaneously rooting yourself to the earth, opening to heaven and being a conduit of the energy through, within, and around you.

history.description: The Avant Yard Village is a motley collection of passionate burners from across the globe. We made our first trek to Black Rock City in 2008, and have acted as ambassadors for the culture of Burning Man to thousands of people, both on the playa and off!

The Avant Yard has been a theme camp since 2008 but our founders first tasted dust in 2006. We are affiliated with the Arts Diaspora, an international network of artists, healers and do-gooders who meet once a year at Burning Man to produce art, connect with new Gnomies (members of our community) and find new ways to empower each other to do wonderful things.

Come and visit the Lost Art of Conversation Cafe! We at Lost Art celebrate opportunities to create deep connections with friends old and new. At our Conversation Cafe you will be welcomed and supported in exploring avenues of conversation that encourage depth with the goal of learning something new about others and maybe even yourself. We want you to come and settle for a while and get lost in conversation. To keep you nourished we have tea in the mornings and street foods from around the world in the evenings.

The Disco Space Shuttle (DSS) LaunchPad will assist camps and art projects that need extra hands/support to realize their vision.

The LaunchPad space will be a place for our camp to play matchmaker; matching people who need build support with people who can volunteer to help them realize their dreams. It will also act as the home base and meeting point for our DSS team of volunteers, a minimum of 10 daily, that are dedicating service hours to help other camps and art projects to launch! The LaunchPad will include a LaunchPad Book to write help requests or sign up as a volunteer with availability to help support others.

events.title: Melt Playa Dust in to Black Glass with the Sun
events.description:
With our welding goggles and fresnel lenses you can turn playa dust into midnight beads of glass with the midday sun. Mount your glass on a pendant at our jewelry making station, and learn about the chemical composition of playa dust, and the glassmaking process. ***Not a rain or shine event! You can melt dust only when the skies are not cloudy. ***

While you wait: take a self-guided tour of our sciencey-art posters. Magical metamorphoses transform water in to electricity, rainforests in to tasty burgers, and cats in to quantum superpositions.

New for 2022: Visit our latest experiment: Lucid Booth.  The Playa Glass engineers have cooked up a way to induce you into a fully self-controlled lucid dreaming state--in just 30 seconds!  This nighttime experiential art piece can be found on the deep playa: Sunday, Monday & Tuesday nights.

More about Playa Glass:
https://www.capeandislands.org/post/breaking-down-dust

Grab a pair of our welding goggles, and we'll set you up at a Fresnel lens station where you'll raise the temperature of the dust to over 1000F and melt it in to black glass.  Turn it in to a wearable pendant at the craft table, and you'll have an easier-than-a-bag-of-dust way to take the playa back to the default world.

After 22 years of welcoming friends and sheltering strangers, 7 Sins Lounge will take its final bow!
So if you've loved one of BurningMan's oldest theme camps and the "friendliest slice of Hell on the Playa", come visit us "for the first time" one last time! 

Come share a memory, sign the book, have a final Flaming Blue Phuck and share some 7 Sins swag!
Because we're not fading quietly into the night- we're going to "party like it's 1999!" (Our 1st year!!)

Come Embrace the Heat as the Playa's "Friendliest Little Slice of Hell" returns for the 20th straight year! 

Daytime brings what Sinners need - shade, chill music, friendly conversation and slushy drinks. 

But NIGHT brings what Sinners WANT - Flaming Libations and the ever popular WHEEL of SINS! Spin this brightly painted carnival wheel to expose your Sins again and again! (will it be Greed? or LUST?) 

Our highly skilled and dedicated staff will happily deliver absolution & encouragement with a FIRM hand, sending you dancing forth to SIN ANEW! 

So come earn your "Get Out of HELL Free" card and remember: 
Start your SINS at 7!

Word Play Cafe is the space at Burning Man dedicated entirely to word games for people to gather, play and learn together. Visitors to Word Play Cafe can play favorite daily games, classic word games, and custom games like our Burning Man themed crossword, and other new word games we created just for Burning Man in our 30 ft dome. We also serve cold brew coffee daily from a cute vintage trailer just beside the dome. Additionally, we have daily events such as panel discussions featuring game developers, facilitated group games and friendly competitions.

Snacklandia is a whimsical camp serving up surprise snack and drink pairings through our interactive Spinning Wheel.
Each spin brings a random delight—salty, sweet, spicy, or maybe a group hug. New this year is our Nail Art Station, where Burners can express their favorite Burning Man principles through creative, glitter-filled nail art. With daily tastings, playful workshops, and spontaneous fun, Snacklandia invites you to come curious and leave deliciously surprised.

A Butt Bounce? Or a bag of Zapp's New Orleans Kettle Style Voodoo Chips? Step into Snacklandia, where every spin yields a surprise and every bite sparks an adventure. Embark on a journey through wild flavors, engaging workshops, and a vibrant community that revels in the extraordinary. Here, taste knows no boundaries, and Burning Man transforms into a playground for the curious and the epicurean. We're crafting two giant spinning wheels brimming with wild and unexpected flavors, elevating the Snacklandia experience to new heights of surprise and delight. Our menu, ever-evolving, draws inspiration from the diverse cultural backgrounds of our campmates each year. Get ready for a taste adventure that changes daily and annually, reflecting the rich tapestry of our community's culinary heritage!

history.description:
Do-More-Now is a setting in which art can flourish. We assist the camps that make up our village to bring various artworks each year: static, interactive, performance. We also create studio & maker spaces in which art can be created: glass-blowing, painting, crafting. Our iconic Firehouse incorporates 250 ft of wall space on which we encourage people to paint using the many pots of paint and brushes we provide. We view art as intrinsically collaborative – the playa allows us to collaborate directly with residents of BRC.
The 5 story Firehouse bar is the most recognizable symbol of Do-More-Now. Visible from the Man it is a perpetual draw for the curious, and for old friends and sector mates. Our intention is to create a space where folks gather before adventures, and decompress afterwards.

history.description: We're the GDI's (Gawd Damn Independents), and we're working for the Man - We are Gerlach-ians, Reno-ites, plus one gawd damn Canuck -  all with "Playa MacGyver" skill sets. Drop in late afternoon or late at night as you might catch us enjoying a hot coffee or cold one...after work. Pull up; dust off a chair and share your best "There was this one time at Burning Man" story around our fire-pit. We might trade a trinket, a laugh, or one of our stories for your effort. We have Burned forever, and we long the days of Cacophonic attitudes; however - if speed past our camp on a 'lectric bike - that'll be us - yelling at you -  "SLOW the F*** down...". Dusty hugs and squinty eyed smiles back at yah; "In Dust - We can Trust".  Peace, Love & Hugs - the GDI's. (insert smiley emoji "here").

history.description: We're the Gawd Damn Independents - and we're workin' for the Man - perhaps you are too. Stop by and say hello after your long dusty day; if your bike needs a bit of TLC - we'll try to MacGyver something for you. If it's hot - we'll crack a cold drink and you can tell us a story about your work under our shade - while you share your best -  "there was this one time at Burning Man..." story.

We're BM Workers - and you might be too. Maybe you just need to take time to watch the street activity roll by, with a cold beer in your hand and a snacks on a dusty table after a busy time at work. This little camp is a Sit+Chill - where we'll talk about our past BM stories; like there was this one time at Burning Man... and complain about the latest crop of Birgins and the sound camp two doors down. We'll be up early for sunrise - so don't bother dropping in until I get back at 9am or we are off shift at 4pm.

An amulet goes with you, and draws you back toward a radical ritual; reminding you of your own participation, your impact, and your amazing decisions- bridging intention and manifestation.  Welcome to Amulet;  let our counselors guide you to craft a record of your rite of passage in brass.

Amulet- An ornament or small piece of jewelry thought to give protection against evil, anger or disease, power for stirring creative juices for new ideas, and bringing love and hope to a dreary life.  It is said that Da Vinci possessed an unusual amulet that he always kept close to him.  We wish to empower participants with similar protection and positive energy.  

Entering our dome, our guests are invited to emboss letters, numbers, and symbols onto a brass plate (aka dog tag) or a brass disc; creating an Amulet to carry with them around their neck, or perhaps to gift to another.

Become naked and shiny as nature intended.

Daily Glittering 2-5pm, Monday through Saturday... Glittering in the Glitterbox.

events.title: Tazii Chill Space and Bar

Day sleepers can literally chill in our swamp cooler-controlled environment!

The space is open 24 hours per day for your convenience and use.

history.description: Providing that Ali Baba chill vibe since 2001.

Tazii is a chill space that welcomes folks to wander into an authentic Moroccan tent filled with flowers, candles, tapestries and ambient music each night into dawn. The tent rises from the playa floor to soar over 40’ in the air; the inside of the tent beckons with hand-sewn silk inlaid gold-colored panels that provide an ambience of romance and respite…Tazii provides a refuge for the body as well as the spirit.

As part of Sanctuary Village, Tazii is a chill space that welcomes folks to wander into our authentic Moroccan tent filled with flowers, candles, tapestries and ambient music each night. During the day Tazii hosts yoga and reiki and impromptu music jam sessions.

Tazii is a camp within the Village Sanctuary. Tazii theme campe is a Moroccan tent structure that provides a stunning background for impromptu musical jam sessions during the day. At night, the tent is transformed into a romantic, candle-lit luxurious space with a “chill” atmosphere with music mixed by playa DJs.
Come relax in luxurious Moroccan splendor at Tazii! Yoga, music jams, general chill… in our beautiful festival tents, di-rect from Marrakesh…

Refresh with a cold water, a chance to cool off in the mist and check email with loved ones who could not make the Playa.  You can also meet Burning Man artists that camp with us and you can volunteer to help with their art.  We have an art garden in camp as well as art support vehicles to support our Playa art.

history.description: Over Exposed - a place for models (or "want-to-be" models) photographers and videographers to gather learn and collaborate.  We offer dust proofing supplies for cameras, formal photography and video classes, photography field trips, rides on our art car, and so much more.  Drop by in the evening for our photo happy hour or stay later as we hold classes on how to photograph fire performers.  We are a camp within a village full of performers, musicians and artists.  If you are looking for someone to shoot, or if you want creative images of yourself or your fiends, please come by!

events.title: Bodypainted Models Photography Workshop
