events.description: Are you an animal lover? Do you like wildlife? Do you like photography? Come learn with a veteran burner photographer how to catch, shoot and release a wild animal on the playa. For adventure and SeaWorld lovers, we will also perform underwater photography. Have a camera with you that has the letter “M” somewhere, so we can all play with your camera. Post-burn, we will have the trophy parade, so stay tuned.

events.title: Portraits and Drama
events.description: Learn how to use wide lenses to make photos dramatic yet eye-catching. Bring your camera gear!

history.description:
Are you a photographer/videographer... or want to be?  We have 15 professional or semi-photographers/videographers, two or three professional models, a bus driver (for photography field trips in his DMV approved vehicle) and others who will/have serve(d) black rock city that want to teach you or talk with you about photographing Burning Man.  We teach "how to" photography classes, we lead photography/videography tours, we embrace the ethics of shooting media at Burning Man, etc.    From the very basics of how to take a "camera off auto" and "how to shoot great photos on your smart phone" to advanced stuff like shooting fire breathers and fire dancers at night, you can catch one of several classes each day. Or, You can drop by and ask what is wrong with this piece of shit camera.

Come by and see our schedule of events!

Also, we will have a solar charging station for camera batteries, camera protection and cleaning supplies and a place (out of the dust) where people can change lenses.

events.title: Basic Camera Settings - Take better pics OFF auto
events.description:
Basic Camera Settings - F stop does not mean F__k stop.   This class will teach you how to take your camera off of “Auto” and use the full range of settings on today’s digital cameras.

Instructor: Chris Oggerino – Chris is a semi-pro (working on being pro) sports photographer and videographer in Reno, NV.  He has been a documentarian at Burning Man and has created images for magazines, a museum, and web sites over the last 10 years.

events.title: Field Trip - Natural and Ambient Light Photography
events.description:
Field Trip!! Get your ass out of bed and shoot the playa! we will be focusing on the use of natural and ambient light to shoot pics of people while using shadows and other inanimate objects to add to the scene. 
Instructor: Siddharth Srinivasan Iyengar  - Sid is a wedding and portrait photographer originally from ___, India and now living in New York. (www.sidsyart.com)

events.title: Photographing Fire Breathers
Photographing Fire Dancers
events.description:
A hands on participatory workshop that will focus on capturing fire trails and the fire artist using a strobe.

Instructor: Kevin LeVezu – Kevin is a professional photographer from Denver, CO.  He specializes in portrait, product and event photography.  He has been a documentarian for burning man for 4 years and has been a displaying artist as well.  (www.kevinsphoto.com)

events.title: Photographing Fire Performers, flame as light
events.description:
“Photographing Fire Performers using the flame as your light” –  Most performers are one with the flame that they dance with.  Come learn how to capture that in a hands-on workshop by one of the best fire photogs out there!

Instructor:  Espresso Buzz I've been photographing events and playing with cameras since I "borrowed" my first camera from my parents when I went to college. My photos have been featured in national & international publications and have been in a few galleries.  I've been photographing the art, people and performances of burning man since the year 2000.   You can find me on Instagram as Espressobuzz, and also at http://www.espressobuzz.net/browse.
I hope to see you on playa!

events.title: Protect your Photography Equipment from the dust

Protect your equipment from the dust.  Come learn how to correctly create a camera condom or come learn what magical solution cleans this dust off of anything,  -  we have the supplies and expertise.  Come ask questions, clean and tape up your camera, or just share your knowledge with others.

Instructor: Grant Wigmore - burner since the early 1990’s – fix it guy extraordinaire

events.title: Sacred Form Photography
events.description:
Sacred Form Photography - creating artistic nude images on the playa, In this workshop we will give participants the opportunity to create artistic nude photography.  Through out history artists have created art around the shape of the human body.  This workshop will teach you how to do that with photography.

Instructor: Kyer Wiltshire – Kyer is a professional photographer from Santa Cruz, CA.  Kyer  is a destination photographer traveling the world to shoot weddings and events.  Kyer has published two books on Burning Man. (http://kyerwiltshire.com/)

Burning Man: Set The World On Fire (www.youtube.com/watch?v=k4uxzj48zCw)
Jeremy Dunn also makes home brew so he is going to share it while he teaches the class for a second time.

Burning Man: Set The World On Fire (www.youtube.com/watch?v=k4uxzj48zCw)

The Sweet Spot is an enchanting, safe, and sacred space to explore our vulnerability and humanity through movement practices, spirituality, explorations of human relationships, and play. 

We aim to nurture the body, mind, and spirit of all beings by offering spaces, events, and offerings to meet everybody exactly where they are. 

Enjoy our Self-Care Tent, Come drink some herbal delights at our Elixir Bar, Melt into the Honey Pot Tea House, Play, Be Entertained, and Groove on Our Boogie Floor & Carefully Crafted Food Party Events, OH MY! 

Oh and the fire pit, every night come by and warm your face and heart. 

See you here.

history.description:
Welcome to The Sweet Spot

We aim to nurture the body, mind, and spirit of all beings by offering spaces, events, and offerings to meet everybody exactly where they are.

We deeply value the nourishment of genuine connection, rest, ritual, good ass food, and play.

We cater to all human beings,
 both shadow and light,
 both high highs and low lows, 
with needs for rest and introversion and needs for being seen and extroversion, and so many shades in between. 
That is the sweet spot.
 Being right where we are in any given moment, and having the space, tools, community, and nourishment to hold us along the way!
We offer a variety of Workshops like:
-Daily Practices
-Dance & Community Circles

history.description: Welcome to Camp Endstation, your intimate oasis at Burning Man. Dive into deep human connections in our cozy space adorned with cushions and rugs, all set to the backdrop of soothing lounge music. Receive a crafted ticket to explore scheduled and spontaneous activities, and engage in meaningful conversations sparked by our unique 'Who Cards'. Each morning, our pavilion transforms into a coffee bar with massages, promoting reflection and connection. Embrace the tranquility of our communal area, designed with an enchanting oriental atmosphere for relaxation and nightly festivities. Our camp is a sanctuary for shared stories and experiences, inviting you to rediscover yourself and connect deeply with fellow burners.

A Burning man camp that has been operating for the past 6 years - "Flying Falafels".This year we have joined forces with Fruthas’ Weirdos to provide an even more extravaganzas experience.

history.description: Did you know that in another dimension, right now, a group of cats on a feline-dominated planet are ALSO going to Burning Man...er Burning Cat?  Thanks to these felines' superior interstellar technology they have constructed a wormhole that - for one week in August only- will end directly at SECRET PASSAGE CAMP.  Don't worry, they come in peace(ish).  They just want to convert you into one of them! They'll do this by inviting you through their wormhole and into their space shuttle to undergo a metamorphic HUMAN TO SPACE CAT SOUND BATH. After your conversion to space cat, delicious Thai Iced Tea and treats will be served at the SPACE CAT CAFE. Although I suspect that once you finish your tea they will knock your glass off the table with their paw while looking you directly in the eye.

events.title: Space Cat Cafe
events.description:
You know what the playa doesn't have? A cat cafe.  You know, those cafes where adoptable cats charm, delight, and annoy you while you are sipping a cold beverage?  Well, earth cats may find the playa inhospitable, but SPACEcats are very well adapted to its harsh terrain.  
After the metamorphosis from Human to  Space Cat in our SPACE CAT SOUNDBATH (11:30am), our new feline friends are invited to take part in our Space Cat Cafe with us.  You know, flick their tails around and arch their backs, get used to their new physical forms.  Thai iced tea and treats will be served to humans and spacecats alike. Cat toys will be available to distract us. 
Speaking of which, are you not into interstellar felines? Scared of Aliens? Allergic to cats (or humans who wear cat costumes?) No problem!  Skip the Human to Space Cat conversion process and join us for Thai Iced Tea and treats in the space ship and in our public shaded cafe.  Maybe you'll come for a drink and end up adopting a spacecat.  It's the playa, who knows?!?!?!?! 
If you're lucky, you'll be at our cafe when Mac and Joon are on-site with their INFORMATION/INTUITION BOOTH.  Have a question? Participants who approach the booth will be given the choice between Information from Mac who will be present with books and a myriad of facts OR they can select  Joon to intuit an answer. She will meditate  and offer them a response. Answers may not be available at this time, answers may be too personal to get a clear read, or answers may come spontaneously. Participants will be advised well and approached with both humor and depth. Mac and Joon intend to bring a balance between Science and the Mystical.

events.title: Sake Bomb Sunday
events.description: Saki Bomb Sunday is a celebration. Our tradition began over 15 years ago when the question was asked "What do we do with all this leftover beer and saki?" while camp was breaking down on Sunday after the Burn. Come gather around our tables where each cup of beer has a shot glass of saki balancing on a set of chopsticks, chant "Saki Bomb Saki Bomb Saki Bomb Sunday,” and let that saki bomb drop into your beer like an Olympian diver and then gulp it down with gusto to make it part of your tradition too!  Come join us on Sunday after the Burn and make your own camp breakdown much more delightful as well.

You Look Amazing is not just a camp name, but a state of mind. We LOVE each and everyone of you and want to get to know you better. 

Our camp is an oasis of wellness at Burning Man. Where mind, body, and spirit converge in a harmonious dance of rejuvenation and exploration. Nestled amidst the pulsating energy of the playa, our camp offers a sanctuary unlike any other—a haven where participants can immerse themselves in a holistic journey of self-discovery and transformation.

events.title: Longevity Stick
events.description: The sun’s just up, but not too hot; clothing is optional here, so adults only, please. Come for a not too early hour of low-impact exercise in the Longevity Stick Art (LSA) discipline of 12 lo-impact exercises to build balance, ﬂexibility, strength, mental focus, breathing capacity, vitality, & open your points & channels. Bring water or hydration liquid. We have sticks for U. Master Mai Bac Dao developed Longevity Stick Art discipline while he was a prisoner of the North Vietnamese Army. He helped his fellow prisoners restore and maintain health thru LSA, and vowed if he was ever freed, he’d dedicate his life to spread its beneﬁts, with this proviso: No trainer may ever charge for it. (Like "gifting," eh?) He was freed, moved to Southern California, and taught classes of students and future teachers. Today, weekly classes abound in So Cal, around the US, & the world. Leader: Gerflash.

events.title: Massage Deli Services Appointment only!
events.description: Adult oriented: By appointment only! Check into our nook to sign up for your massage deli session on, where we will aim to please your every need with gentleness, dexterity, and aplomb; or just catch some stimulating chill shade time between hours. Couples are always welcome.

events.title: Non-Selfie Kaleidoscope Photoshoot
events.description: The Non-Selfie Kaleidoscope is a human-sized kaleidoscope. When you and a friend look at each other through the viewing ports, your faces will be replicated in different fun patterns. Bring a camera to take pics and videos, make silly faces, get creative, have fun, see if you can turn your eyeball into a mandala! Don’t forget to bring a friend – it’s called “Non-Selfie” because you can’t do it all by yourself. The kaleidoscope will be available throughout the day, but if you come during the marked times, artist and Liz Avalon will be present to talk about the inspiration behind the project, give pointers as how to get the best effects, and to do personalized kaleidoscope portrait sessions.

events.title: Pepperland Pancakes!
events.description: Food Stop by in the morning for these hot off the grill tasty cakes. Syrup? Sure. Nutella? While it lasts. They only last so long, but they’re oh so good on the way down!

events.title: Pepperland Sing-A-Long!
events.description: Party Been working hard to get your camp built? Okay. So, do you like to sing? Do you like The Beatles? Classics? Standards? Step right this way! One night only! Wear your groovy (and warm!) duds that show off your spirit of the 60’s and beyond while you take a trip through Pepperland and memory land! Enjoy popcorn and refreshments while you sing along with fellow fans! It’s a grand vocal jam. - Some years ago, on the Playa, we had a total blast when a spontaneous chorus broke out in our camp, covering classic songs, and an annual tradition was born. We’re updating that tradition as we gather this year to sing timeless Beatles and classical standards tunes with/without accompaniment. Everyone’s invited and welcomed! It ain’t over ’til it’s over!

events.title: Pepperland’s Robotic Rock ’N’ Roll Danse Kraze
events.description: The robots roll in!  Are you the latest in Rossums Universal Robots (RURs), modern arduinos, or even primitive cardboard or steampunk types? You are all welcome as you merge with each other to enjoy some oldies but goodies, tunes from the 60’s +/-10 years, along with some refreshments for refueling any automaton. Robots always bring their own cups to keep it green, while enjoying their pleasures. Plenty of fun in a classic evening of rock and roll razz-ma-tazz and good conversation as you blend with strange robocircuitry and maybe some human types, too. A few surprises will add plenty smiles

events.title: See Art in Three Dimensions
events.description: Kid Friendly Don our red/cyan 3-D glasses and view the world in a new light! Our resident anaglyph photographer invites you see depth and realism in what appear to be ﬂat photographic prints. Our proliﬁc and fecund photog invites you to gaze beyond the ﬂat of the land to more pregnant sights. It’s so real! He has images on 2-D paper that will protrude into your mind and fertilize your imagination. Cited techniques will be available so that you can do it yourself at home, using a digital camera and photo software, and don't forget to take a free pair of viewers with you (while supplies last!).

events.title: Seed Bead Jewelry of the Playa
events.description: Class/workshop: Make the perfect shwag for your own sweet neck, or for that of one you love, or like! We’ll start you out with natural shells, some glassy bling, plus some color and a closure clip, and you’ll create a lasting, artistic memento to show off, gift, or take home.

events.title: Sit & Spin
events.description: Round and round you’ll go as you sit and spin - and just hold on tight - but to what?  Perhaps in the maelstrom you’ll even be able to channel a new & radical ritual during one of your many revolutions! Let us know what you have discovered when U debark - but try not to barf en route!

events.title: The R-Rated Reading Room
events.description: Adult oriented: In our library on the Playa, we have collected several notable volumes for aloud recitations, including classical and modern, in the soft porn genre.  These include Victorian era, Anais Nin, Letters to Penthouse, modern erotica, and more. Are you a reader or a listener or both? You get your choice. Or might you bring your own offerings?  Adults only, please.

events.title: Vinyasa Yoga
events.description: Your back is probably sore after all the buildings, the preps, the parties, the biking around. Let’s flow together to reset your body and be ready for a brand-new day.

events.title: Wide Open Mic
events.description: Performance You’ve got an act? Great! We’ve got a stage! Our Wide Open Mic is ready for any entertainments you wish to provide – singing, poetry, instrumental, stand-up comedy, storytelling, or something else! It’s Wide Open! Here’s your chance to shine! Sign up early! (or show up at the last minute, like you always do.) Or just come and watch an unpredictable variety or acts!

history.description: If you're an accomplished or aspiring artist, cartoonist, singer, comic, improv maven, writer, or game enthusiast, on-stage model, dancer, or dramatic reader, Pepperland has much for you plus some radical rituals on-Playa. Want a massage or a snack?Our campers can serve you, plus with Laughter Yoga and Longevity Stick exercises to get your Xi flowing like the Playa wind blows. It's our 10th year at BRC, the spirit of the Fab Four still inspires us. 3-D art is yours; we've got the glasses for it, and the views to go with 'em. Our week includes 200-plus hours of interactive, inventive entertainment.  Need a home at home?  We are it.

events.title: Artists Draw Models
events.description: Feeling artistic? Prolific? Choose your favorite position/pose in our art studio: Stand, sit, or recline on either side of the “canvas” as the workshop artist or the on-stage model, and dwell in our Artists and Models moment. BYO drawing materials or any mediums you work in, or use the pencils and pads we will have ready for you. All gender models are welcome to participate. Sessions will range from 5 to 20 minutes. Our stage will not be easily visible from the street, just to our participating artists. Adults only, please.

events.title: Back To The ’60s Party!
events.description: Our camp’s 9th Anniversary year rolls on as you join each other to enjoy those oldies but goodies, tunes from the 60’s, along with light refreshments and beyond. Bring your own cup to keep it so green, and enjoy your pleasure. Mix plenty of fun with a classic Cartoon Commune soiree of rock and roll dancing and good conversation as you meet new friends and old. A wide open dance contest just for the fun of it. We’ll have the music you like, light refreshments, and beyond. Guess what else? A few surprises to add plenty smiles.

events.title: Burner Toastmasters Speak-A-Thon
events.description: Want some “stage time?” Like to speechify? Pontificate? Step up to ye olde soap box? We’ve got you covered. While there's some jargon in the notes below that our wannabe’s might not understand, we assume the Toastmasters folks will get it. And you will soon! Note:    Bring your TI Magazine and we’ll take pics over at the Man! If you’re a Toastmaster and couldn’t be in Washington, DC, for their August International Convention, then bring your CC/CL/other manuals you’d like to advance in, and join us (with friends) for a real Toastmasters meeting - and some photos! We plan to cram in speeches, evaluations, and table topics into a one hour session, or more if demand exists for it, so on time is a good thing. Prompt arrivals will have the best chances for the most fun and credit.    Looking to join in? Pepperland theme camp, Tuesday, 1-2PM.  Email: Gerflash (at) socal (dot) rr (dot) com. so we can plan ahead and count you in.    Just maybe - the pix we take might make it into the TI Magazine! You’ll actually be Toastmastering on-Playa!

events.title: Calling All Virgins
events.description: If you are a newbie/virgin on the playa, this is the class for you! It's Monday at 1 PM and all information regarding the playa will be at your fingertips. Have all your pressing survival issues answered while being refreshed by our hospitality.

All skill levels welcome; you do not need to have any prior training or experience.  Learn all the basic skills like character creation, layout, composition, perspective, and comedy writing.  Brush up on advanced techniques like human and animal figure drawing, proportion, and color.  Supplies provided, or bring your own.

events.description: Come all you writers, all levels, to explore and enjoy your innate creative talent. Whether you're a rank amateur or a literary master, you've got talent. We know, because everybody does. We'll help prime your pump with warm-up prompts, free writing, poetry forms, Dadaist scores, surrealist techniques, and much more. Express yourself, memorialize your experiences on the playa, and share with others if you wish. Writing essentials will be provided, or bring your own.

events.title: Improv Comedy Jam!
events.description: Are you an Improv Comedy fan - or better yet, a practitioner? Radically participate for fun, applause, and the admiration of all! Or sit in the audience and enjoy the spectacle - and give your suggestions! Best of all - do both! All those endorphins are so good for you! Sign up early to ensure your stardom! If you already know your improv stuff, come early to make your preferences known!

Cited techniques will be available so that you can do it yourself at home, using a digital camera and photo software, and don't forget to take a free pair of viewers with you (while supplies last!)

events.title: Sit & Spin is Back!
events.description: Round and round you’ll go as you sit and spin - and just hold on tight - but to what?  Perhaps in the maelstrom you’ll even be able to channel DaVinci’s robust imagination during one of your revolutions! Let us know what you discovered when U debark - but try not to barf en route!

events.title: The R-Rated Reading Room
events.description: In our library on the Playa, we have collected several notable volumes for aloud recitations, including classical and modern, in the soft porn genre.  These include Victorian era, Anais Nin, Letters to Penthouse, modern erotica, and more. Are you a reader or a listener or both? You get your choice. Or might you bring your own offerings?  Adults only, please.

events.title: “Who What Where” Game
events.description: Ready? Draw! Who is that? What are they doing? Where are they doing it? Come for a totally fun, fast-paced party game, led by our expert gamer, Nostrildamus. It has yet to be determined whether artistic talent is a help or a hindrance. We have pencils and paper for you. Fun – definitely!

events.title: Wide Open Mic
events.description: You’ve got an act? We’ve got a stage! Our Wide Open Mic is ready for any entertainments you wish to provide – singing, poetry, instrumental, stand-up comedy, storytelling, or something else! It’s Wide Open! Here’s your chance to shine! Sign up early! (or show up at the last minute, like you always do.) Or just come and watch an unpredictable variety or acts!

events.title: Yellow Submarine Viewing Party and Sing-A-Long!
events.description: Do you like to sing? Do you like The Beatles? Step right this way! Roll up for our Mystery Tour! One night only! Wear your grooviest duds that show off your spirit of the 60’s and take a trip in our Yellow Submarine as we gaze upon The Beatles 1968 voyage through Pepperland! Enjoy refreshments while you watch the movie with fellow fans! Harmonize with The Beatles during the movie and attend our after party in our Karaoke sing-a-long!   Come for the movie; stay for the vocal jam. - Some years ago on the Playa, we had a total blast when a spontaneous chorus broke out in our camp, covering classic songs, and an annual tradition was born. We’re updating that tradition as we gather this year to sing timeless Beatles tunes with/without accompaniment. Everyone’s invited and welcomed! It ain’t over ’til it’s over!

history.description: If you're an aspiring cartoonist, artist, singer, comic, or game enthusiast, on-stage model, dancer, reader, or goth rocker, there is much for you at Cartoon Commune in the Carnival of Mirrors. If you need a massage or something to drink, we're here to serve your preference, and with Laughter Yoga as of yore, plus revered Longevity Stick exercises to get your Xi flowing like the Playa wind blows — and so much more, in our 9th year on Playa.

events.title: A Capella Chorus Jam
events.description: Like to sing? Come to our vocal jam. A few years ago, we had a blast when a spontaneous chorus broke out in our camp, covering classic harmony-rich songs like Billy Joel's "For the Longest Time," and a tradition was born. We will gather and sing popular, well-known, or timeless songs in harmony (e.g., folk, pop, rock, opera, blues, barbershop, and on and on), without accompaniment (a capella). Song title lists provided to spark your vocal chords. All are welcome - no training needed.

events.title: Artists and Models Drawing Session
events.description: Feeling artistic? Prolific? Choose your favorite position/pose in our art studio: Stand, sit, or recline on either side of the “canvas” as the workshop artist or the on-stage model, and dwell in our Artists and Models moment. BYO drawing materials or any mediums you work  in, or use the pencils and pads we will have ready for you. All male and female models are welcome to participate. Sessions will range from 5 to 20 minutes. Our stage will not be easily visible from the street, just to our participating artists.

events.title: "Blue Room" Comfort Concierge, by Cartoon Commune
events.description:
When on duty, our polite and handsomely-dressed concierges are your humble servants to enhance your johnny-on-the-spot experience.  Line up behind the velvet rope.  Enter the orange-mint scented stall.  Rest easy, knowing your port-o-john will not be disturbed in any way.  When finished, help yourself to an array of convenience items: hand sanitizer, lotion, breath mints, and what-have-you.  Continue on your journey, refreshed and invigorated.  

All thanks and love may be directed to hosts Cartoon Commune.

events.title: Burner Toastmasters Get Together and Speak-A-Thon
events.description: Like to speechify? Pontificate? Step up to ye olde soap box? We have you covered. While there's some jargon in here we admittedly don't understand, we assume Toastmasters folks will get it. Note:"If you’re a Toastmaster and couldn’t be in Vegas for their August International Convention, then bring your CC/CL/other manuals you’d like to advance in, and join us (with friends) for a real Toastmasters meeting - and photos! We plan to cram in speeches, evaluations, and table topics into a one hour session, or more if demand exists for it, so on time is a good thing. Prompt arrivals will have the best chances for the most fun and credit.Looking to join in? Cartoon Commune camp, Tuesday, 1-2PM.  Email: Gerflash (at) socal (dot) rr (dot) com. so we can plan ahead and count you in.Just maybe - the pix we take might make it into the TI Magazine! You’ll actually be Toastmastering on-Playa!

events.title: Button Down Da Hatch!
events.description: Kick off your week with a DIY button to commemorate the Carnival of Mirrors, or whatever you want. Create a unique button for yourself and a friend. We've got a prolific Badge-making machine for the magic to accommodate our materials, and you can add a photo or trinket for an extra special souvenir! Our able machinist will convert your creativity into a lasting memento for only you. Then pin your own, unique shwag on whomever. Light refreshments and other stuff are on us. Bring a cup!

events.title: Cartoon Commune Green Reflections’ Eco Camp Tour
events.description:
Build up your eco-consciousness for Playa life. We’ll show you how we reuse, recycle, repurpose, and redesign. See our solar cooker, rocket stove cooker, solar power, evapotron, and much more. Consider the Playa’s ecosystem, and the gear and food that are right for a trip into this world.Be ready for your next vacation with Mother Nature.	Nothing seems more natural than spending time in nature, but it’s easy to forget eco-attitudes when away from concrete cities.
     We’ll discuss prepping for a trip, being alert to pack only what we need: e.g., first aid kit, weather-appropriate clothing/gear, water & food. We leave packaging at home to minimize trash on-Playa. If we can, we pre-buy local fruit, veggies, and nuts; pre-make dishes and seal them in lightweight reusable containers. Reuse these to avoid disposables. We seal our food well, store trash, compost and recycle our waste.
We’ll be happy to hear your own ideas and consider them for additions to our Playa eco-practices.

events.title: Cartoon Commune’s Ninth Anniversary ’60s Dance
events.description: Our camp’s 9th Anniversary year rolls on as you join each other to enjoy those oldies but goodies, tunes from the 60’s, along with light refreshments and beyond. Bring your own cup to keep it so green, and enjoy your pleasure. Mix plenty of fun with a classic Cartoon Commune soiree of rock and roll dancing and good conversation as you meet new friends and old. A wide open dance contest just for the fun of it. We’ll have the music you like, light refreshments, and beyond. Guess what else? A few surprises to add plenty smiles.

events.title: Cartoon Workshop
events.description: Cartooning is a powerful art-form that can entertain and influence, but is simple to learn and accessible to all.  Come learn from a professional cartoonist to practice this expressive and enjoyable skill.  All skill levels welcome; you do not need to have any prior training or experience.  Learn all the basic skills like character creation, layout, composition, perspective, and comedy writing.  Brush up on advanced techniques like human and animal figure drawing, proportion, and color.  We end with an improvisational art game using the cartooning skills we've learned.  Supplies provided, or bring your own.

events.title: Improv Comedy
events.description: Are you an Improv Comedy fan - or better yet, a practitioner? Radically participate for fun, applause, and the admiration of all! Or sit in the audience and enjoy the spectacle - and give your suggestions! Best of all - do both! All those endorphins are so good for you! Sign up early to ensure your stardom! If you already know your improv stuff, come early to make your preferences known!

events.title: Laughter Yoga
events.description: Start your evenings with the most intense laughter you can experience. We laugh for no reason, other than for exercise, and health. Relieve stress and pain, promote natural healing, and create spontaneous bonds of friendship through group laughter. It’s fun! The brainchild of Dr. Madan Kataria in India and practiced by millions worldwide, Laughter Yoga combines Unconditional Laughter with Yogic Breathing (Pranayama). Anyone can Laugh for No Reason, without relying on humor, jokes or comedy. Laughter is simulated as a body exercise in a group; with eye contact and childlike playfulness, it soon turns into real and contagious laughter. The concept of Laughter Yoga is based on a scientific fact that the body cannot differentiate between fake and real laughter. One gets the same physiological and psychological benefits. Find much more info online by searching on Laughter Yoga, but come! Enjoy!

events.title: Longevity Stick
events.description: The sun’s just up, but not too hot; clothing is optional here, so adults only, please. Come for an early hour of low impact exercise in the Longevity Stick Art (LSA) discipline of 12 low-impact exercises to build balance, flexibility, strength, mental focus, breathing capacity, and vitality, and open your points and channels. Bring your water or hydration liquid. We’ll provide sticks for you. Master Mai Bac Dao developed Longevity Stick Art discipline while he was a prisoner of war of the North Vietnamese. He helped his fellow prisoners restore and maintain health through LSA, and vowed if he was ever freed, he’d dedicate his life to spread its benefits, with the proviso that no trainer could ever charge for it. (Like "gifting," eh?) He was freed, moved to Southern California, and taught classes of students and future teachers. Today, weekly classes abound in So Cal, around the US, and the world.  See: www.longevitystick.org/Longevitystick.org/Home.html and www.filmbaby.com/films/2341 .

Roll on by our camp for friendly bike repairs! Whether it's a flat, a squeaky chain, or some Playa mystery, we've got your bike covered so you can keep cruising without a hitch. We're here to get your ride back in action so you can keep the fun going.

But it's not just about repairs—we've created a super chill space to relax, swap stories, and soak up the good vibes. Whether you need a quick fix, a break from the dust, or just want to hang out with fellow Burners, we've got great company and a laid-back atmosphere waiting for you.

And if you can't make it to us, don't worry! We actively cruise around the Playa looking for bikes in need of some TLC. Flag us down, and we'll get you back on track! Plus, if you're extra comfy, we can even make house calls!

Ever get a flat tire in Deep Playa and feel like you'll never get back to camp? We're here to help! Our camp "Chain Reaction" has daily mobile bicycle repair teams with our logo and motte: "Break 'N Fix!" With some serendipity your Playa miracle awaits you!

If you would like to get involved, no experience is necessary as we go by the DIY model of "see one, do one, teach one." Come by our camp to meet us. 

Happy (dusty) trails!

Bubblegasm is a mutant vehicle built to spread the joy of bubbles and lights with all those who ride on her or dance and play around her. Bubbles are a metaphor for life, fleeting and fragile and are a reminder about how precious our time is while we are here, and to make the most of each moment. And like each bubble, each person and their life is beautiful and unique. Bubbles are also temporary and once they pop they become part of the universe, just as we do when we die. When people encounter bubbles it is a like a rare moment of magic. They symbolize our childhood innocence, reminding us of a time when life was simple and carefree. When we see these glass-like orbs dancing in the air they remind us to live in the moment, let go, dance with a stranger, be silly - have a bubblegasm!

Harmonizing the heart and mind~ Bold fusion of Vedic sound healing and drumming practice, paired with contemporary evidence based healing.

It’s easier than we think to let our heart break wide open in preparation for our metempsychosis. I’m looking forward to sharing EMDR resourcing for stress reduction, grief work and chakra balancing for our growth and development. Improve our sleep and help regulate our moods using this creative brew of healing techniques. We will let stress melt away and learn to tap into our deepest creativity through sound meditation.

As the bass fades and the creaking of your bike becomes audible once again, you turn onto tan unfamiliar street.  Appearing as the breeze sweeps the dust from the ground is a warmly lit wooden cottage, beckoning with firelight and the soft sound of mandolin and laughter.

Catawampus is ramshackle and sincere, just like our group of members, relationships and structures built with love and found materials. We spread the mantra of "magically imperfect", both in our on playa offerings and in our compassion for all people. We tap into the old wisdom, of the land and ancestors, worn but still worthy, to bring comfort and connection to all who venture to our porch. We are askew, perfect in our irregularity, having found a place that only we fit. You will fit too.

A synesthetic dreamworld where movement, light, and sound unite, empowering groups to create multisensory, collaborative performances. Pulling on levers, traversing a slackline, jumping on buttons, strumming a guitar, beating a drum will cause corresponding light and sound patterns to ripple through the area. The DECO FISH ART CARS ARE exotic creatures of the deep. Bright rainbows of glorious PSYCHEDELIC illumination, with powerful FIRE effects and rockin' sound systems laced up with intricate ART DECO styling throughout.  Come and say HI! And we'll give you a ride you won't forget.

The Deco Fish Twins Art Cars were built in 2016 in West Oakland, California. These nautical wonders were designed and fabricated by a dedicated team of artists and craftsfolk that continue to maintain and improve upon them each year.  Owners Andy Tannehill & Kimberly Medici worked with the founder of their former collaborative Burning Man Camp, Star Star Roadhouse, to creatively direct how the Deco Fish would best allow groups of people with bikes to enjoying amazing sound you can feel in your heart while still being able to chat and dance freely on a gorgeous platform with bright psychedelic kaleidoscopic lighting.

Imagine you and your friends comming back home from a long day of school on the playa to find no one is home.  You think, this is great We've got the place to ourselves we can sit back and fire up a little WWIT.  When you hear the car pull up "Oh shit mom's home! Hide the WWIT!"

Welcome to black rock citys favorite after school special.  
Featuring:
-Help with your homework
-Fresh baked cookies
-DJ mom
-Full bar, but if you break into mom's liquor cabinet you'll get a spanking!

events.title: Wait, What's In It For Me?
events.description: What is the best gift you have ever received (other than that Nintendo 64 Christmas of 1996)? Gifts don’t have to be a sweet ass electronic box capable of letting you pretend to be James Bond, gifts come in many forms, some more obvious than others. And gifting is one of the most commonly misunderstood of the 10 principles. How many of your friends have asked you what you’re bringing to the Playa to barter? Join us for DRINKS! …and an interactive discussion on gifting! Learn why gifting is so crucial to the Burning Man community and how your experience in this place is a gift to you and others. Share you experiences on and off the Playa in our group discussion, and foster new ideas on how you can be the best damn Santa you can be.

events.title: Wait, What's In That Breath?
events.description:
What a better way to start your day at Burning Man than a Mini Wheats meditation session? 
Take a moment to breath in, breath out, feel the power of Now and carry on this mindfulness with you threw your day in the playa. 
Take a moment to learn more about mindfulness, the effect of meditation on the brain and happiness. 
Neuroscience will help us understand more what happens in the brain when we meditate and are in the present moment. 
We will finish the session by burning one resin or plant to clean the spirit.

history.description:
Broken Compass is a collection of travelers from a far away world, and we have built this forum to share with you all that we have seen, heard, and learned during our travels. Our world is comprised of 5 continents, each with its own unique story, culture, climate, and aesthetic. Over the next 5 years, we will be investigating each of these strange lands, then reconvening back here to tell of our adventures.

While our travels instilled in us a breadth of knowledge, the catharsis of adventure has left us with a desire to share our experiences with the world. Through workshops, lectures, performances, and merry making, our mission is to educate you in the ways of these 5 mysterious and foreign lands.  In addition to daily and nightly events, we will also be serving food and drink which we have discovered along the way.  And what of your travels?  Do you have stories to share with us?  Read through our story books, then add your own tales to be incorporated into our ever growing lore.

events.title: BRC's Queen Of Coffee Competition Crawl
events.description:
Did you know that coffee is most enjoyable when there are clear winners and losers? Countless camps serve coffee but who is judging them, giving them useless unsolicited opinions?!? Cruise the playa and taste all the coffee!! We'll fill out scoresheets, give awards, and be silly. Bring bikes, mugs & hipster mustaches (paste-on hipster mustaches provided for those in need). Guided by an IRL actual coffee judge who will also give an "intro to coffee judging" class at the start of the crawl. Part shtick, part competition, 100% fun.

We are meeting between 10-11am at Soon To Be Infamous to gather and do our "Intro To Coffee Judging" class, then heading out on bikes at 11am for judging.

Are you serving coffee and you want the chance to be crowned BRC's Queen Of Coffee? To enter the competition, please email jeremy@kuempel.co with your camp name, address, and type of coffee you will be serving.

events.title: LED Bicycle Flag Creation Station
events.description:
Worried about losing your bike in the sea of identical cycles? Concerned some spaced out burner will accidentally ride off into the sunset with your cruiser? Or possibly you're the spaced out burner who just forgets where they left their bike.... 
Come to Soon To Be Infamous and radically express yourself by decorating a bike flag with your playa name and address. For four years, we've been gifting customizable bike flags to cut down on the number of bikes lost or mistakenly taken on playa. Choose a light string and grab some batteries and we'll install it for you. A previous participant had this to say about his/her flag "My flag from y'all has been my most trustworthy companion and also almost literally took my eye out. So... amazing, but never let your guard all the way down around it. Sustain wariness." No better recommendation can exist. See you in the dust.

At Burning Man 2015 Kostume Kult's ongoing FreaKKshow is emerging from the sub-urban depths… Strutting down our runway onto Esplanade Frontage!

events.description:
Let Kostume Kult transform you with a new costume or accessory! Costume experts dress you & send you dancing down the runway. Silliness guaranteed!

Tuesday through Saturday from Noon until 5:00pm Black Rock City citizens can jump on the "K" (subway) Train with its outrageous ads and colorful graffiti to arrive at the platform of Koney Island’s best kostumery – the closed down mysterious K Station.  Kamp Karneys assist folks as they morph themselves with over TWO TONS of costumes. Exit through the gift shop onto the runway where burners strut their newfound finery rebirthed onto the playa - ready to participate with extra attitude. From the raised dance platform watch the daily fashion shows and ongoing esplanade carnival. Loved by the paparazzi and Cheered on by subway straphangers, live DJ music, and the infamous ring master MCs, citizens can show their freaky side on the runway under the watchful eye of the 25' tall King Kong. Hanging from the Empire State Building, even Kong gets his freakshow on with his Guinness World Record 45' pink tutu (Tutu Tuesday) and BRC Animal Control bling.

history.description: Kostume Kult recreates the glory days of NYC in the 70’s and 80’s by transporting you to the seedy throwback replica of “Times Square BRC”, the crossroads of the world! The Empire State Building and King Kong loom above the NYC skyline while a runway show that blows fashion week out of the dust goes on. The playa provides the grit, we supply the glamour so hop the K Train to costume transformations and a non stop runway show.

Kostume Kult is back with the “Kult of Kong”, featuring a large, multi-story cityscape playspace with music, interactive art, and of course, the costume giveaway experience that we all look forward to year after year. Come by to dance in the shadow of Kong, walk the runway in your transformed and costumed state, and spend a pleasant afternoon in the crafting dome making booty shorts, tutus and other spectacular projects.

Kostume Kult is back presenting “The Island of Dr. More-Oh!”, with a twisted take on fertility, cross-breeding and animal experimentation. In Nyrvana Village, KK offers free costumery, personal transformations & runway shows every afternoon Tues-Fri along with day & evening dancing at the Garden of Heathen’s Rainbow Lounge. Come by to channel your inner beast or to recycle your old costumery in our Kostume Dome.

Kostume Kult offers daytime costuming makeovers and a celebration of YOU – emerging from the Kostume Dome, through the Nyrvana Arch and down the runway where MCs/DJs propel you onto the playa and into your new life.  For 2011, we present “Rites of Kultage” celebrating all cults and their unique rituals. Featuring Witchdokktor Magamboo O’Boogie, a Mayan Dance Temple, the Church of Coulrophilia hookah bar, the Passage of Enlightenment video tunnel and a Horned Voodoo Ball on Wednesday Night.

In NYrvana Village, visit our Mutation Station kostume dome.  Transformations by day, absurdity around the clock. Video, performances & evolutionary art. Costume recycling with your help (on playa or email us.).  Costuming the naked since 2001…

In NYrvana Village, we present “KKoney Island” in a fantastical reimagining of this legendary Brooklyn neighborhood. Come by for transformations in our daytime costume dome & round-the-clock absurdity.  To recycle costume supplies please contact us. *Costuming the Naked -with your help- Since 2000*

As part of Konsortium Village, this year Kostume Kult returns to present the “Dark Side of Oz”. In our Emerald City, we twist inspiration from Oz with other fantastical films, Pink Floyd psychedelia and a dark aesthetic. Flirt with the munchkins, dance down the green astroturf road or nap amongst the glowing poppies. As always, Kostume Kult offers transformations through costuming, body paints and makeup (wednesday through saturday afternoons) but, in this green year, we encourage theatrical participation over consumption and recycling whenever possible. Consult the crystal balls, visit the Witchdoctor of Oz, cuddle in the Munchkinland Lounge, partake in a farcical fashion show or shadow dance at The Flying Monkey pub… As darkness falls, the camp glows green peaking at our annual Thursday Midnight party where we fuse the Wizard of Oz with Dark Side of the Moon and the random insanity that is Burning Man. There’s no place like home, indeed.To recycle/donate costume supplies, please stop by on-playa or contact us online…

Bubbling up from the NYC underground, Kostume Kult is an artistic party crew like none other.  Inside the costume dome we offer up costuming and body art while sweet DJ’s massage the vibe in our chill lounge/performance area.  Early in the week we seek to trade but, by the burn, everything must go! During the days, our dome is open to all and, by night, the Kostume Kultists parade the playa in style! Themed “Carousel”, this year we embrace hope, ascension and a sci-future aesthetic.  Our Thursday/midnight costume party is always insane and there will be fashion shows, hooping lessons and random theatrics going on all week.  Please stop by if you love costuming and comfortable vibes.  You are one of us 🙂

Bubbling up from the NYC underground, Kostume Kult is an artistic party crew like none other. Inside the Kostume dome, an unruly gang of faeries, gnomes and artists offer up costumes, accessories and body painting to all who participate. Please stop by or email us if you are an enthusiastic costumer-participant. You are one of us 🙂

Inside the Kostume Dome, haberdashery, fabric, paints and accessories will be offered to all, by the benevolent Goddess. An unruly gang of artists, gnomes, fairies and elves are on hand to inspire your costume transformation.
Bow to the Goddess of Kostuming and prepare for your elevation. Creative assistance and costume supplies may be offered to those who show the proper deference.

You might know us as the 40-foot long rolling disco whose entrance, naturally, is through the pulsing pink sphincter in the rear. Day and night, we graze on the playa — laser eyeballs shining, beloved DJs spinning, dancy people flocking.
BAAAHS Station is our central depot where everyone is welcome to kick up your hooves. Come for our daily dance parties, get a view from our four-story watchtower, enjoy a lovely beverage from our friendly bartenders, and meet a homo or two.

history.description: Camp Not a Cult provides an alcohol-free, sobriety-supportive space for new and experienced burners which is light-hearted, sarcastically and not culty. We believe that by removing alcohol from our lives we have unlocked a way to live more authentically, feel better, and have more FUN every single day. And that doesn't make us boring. You still find us howling at the moon, wild-eyed and sometimes naked, dancing around the fire. Rather than daily recovery meetings, we offer a variety of yoga and meditation classes and workshops, a cacao ceremony & ecstatic dance, a fire-spinning workshop for beginners, Ayurvedic wisdom, 1-2 sober/sober-curious meetups, and other events. All these events will be open to the community.

events.title: Circles of Forgiveness
events.description:
Circles of Forgiveness, is a ritual, an unique spiritual tool which
can bring much relief, forgiveness and love into your life.  Olivier
Clerc is the founder of this experience after he received his teaching
from Don Miguel Ruiz,   the author of The Four  Agreement, which are
based on ancient Toltec wisdom and basic spiritual values such as
Love, Forgiveness and Truth.

Circles of Forgiveness is a workshop of 2 hours that allows you to
express and receive forgiveness even from people who are not
physically present. Forgiveness is, healing the heart’s wounds. Asking
for forgiveness and forgiving is freeing yourself from all the
negative feelings such as anger, resentment, and other toxic emotions
that can fill up your heart. Forgiving does not mean accepting what
the other person did wrong to you, neither to be reconciled with the
other person. It allows you to let love flow freely through your whole
being.

came across a tent in the desert. Intrigued by its glimmering
exterior and needing to escape the brutal sun,
you entered. You, weary traveler, were served chai and
while you drank you were captivated by the stories that
were told by fellow travelers. The myth and misadventures
they had seen. You, moved by their stories, told a
tale that left the whole tent in awe. You were glad that
you had wandered into Spice and Vice for this story slam.

events.title: Hechi-Ken Hamazaki / Red Tea Ceremony -YOU ARE GOD
events.description: Art performance by Japanese contemporary artist, Ken Hamazaki. This performance was inspired by and arranged from traditional Japanese tea ceremony. The original ceremony consists of a variety of manners to drink, but to experience this fully, please simply drink with a style you favor most. The most interesting practice would be turning your thoughts inward for a few minutes without speaking and enjoy drinking in this small silent space. I always serve this tea for whoever sits down in front of me. Red Tea Ceremony -YOU ARE GOD- is always a great tool to communicate universally without any thought of hierarchy. I'll be happy if we could find any great idea to make a brighter, better, and more enjoyable future through this tea ceremony.

events.title: Connect 4 Love: A Twist on Speed Dating
events.description:
"It' Connect 4 Love!  Don't let the name fool you.  This event is for everyone!  This is Burning Man after all.  So if you're single, married, straight, gay, figuring it out, you'll fit right it.  You can connect 4 wherever you are in the moment.

Connect 4 Love is a welcoming environment that inspires your authentic self. This is the place you create attraction and chemistry. This is how humans create trust. 

Connect 4 Love offers an organic, social setting mixed with a curated mingle. This flow is designed to provide an opportunity to meet as many or as few people as you like before requesting time in our Connection Lounge. The Lounge is for folks who have created a connection and would like to spend more time getting to know one another, but there’s a twist. You don’t just get to ask mundane questions, and you don’t have to feel nervous. We are here to help. We have a curated list of questions that are scientifically designed to get right to the truth and see if you have a connection.

Join us for our camp BBQ immediately following Connect 4 Love!  Oh yeah, you got that right we're gonna feed you too!  It like an actual date on the Playa!!!!!"

You will be guided to set an intention for yourself for your burning man experience and beyond.

events.title: Guided Burning Man Intention Setting Meditation
events.description:
Join Conscious Leader and High Vibes Yoga Instructor, Carly Benson as she leads you in a 75 minute Silent Savasana Yoga flow. This experience will take place near the Temple where your intentions will be felt and put into Vibrational alignment with your path. Silent Savasana is a powerful yoga movement offering a memorable, playful and inspiring version of yoga that infuses the practice, community and music into each event.
Created by renowned instructor Dray Gardner, each practice is grounded in the principles of balance, discipline, self-acceptance and strength of mind.
When you walk into a Silent Savasana event you are immediately transported into an urban oasis in which the settings are handpicked to deliver a unique and transformative experience for yoga practitioners of all levels.

Our vision is to create the most innovative yoga movement of the 21st century and change as many lives as possible through transformative experiences that cultivate self-exploration and discovery with self-love, authenticity and forgiveness as guiding principles.

Facilitated by Nexus (JR Russ) and Pretzel (Michael Donofrio)
Join Nexus and Pretzel for a conversation about consent. Just say yes, so we can talk about how to say “yes” enthusiastically. We'll start with a discussion and practice saying and hearing “no," interactive role playing, some sensual ice breakers, and have candid discussion about what you want to do, how you want to do it, and who you want to do it with. And are you into groups? We'll also learn about consent in groups and how to step up and stand up for your friends. These skills build confidence and connection because nothing is sexier than hearing yes or respecting a no.

events.description:
Love Thyself as thy Neighbor: Cultivating Self-compassion
Facilitated by Ning Zhou
It might be easy to be kind to your friends, but when it comes time to be kind to yourself, many people struggle. Do you have a harsh inner critic that preys on your sense of self worth? When you look at all you've accomplished, do you only see what's missing, or do you see everything you've done? Are you looking for ways to improve your resilience and emotional well-being? Come join for a workshop that will cover the basic components of self-compassion, review some of the research findings supporting its effectiveness, and provide several engaging exercises to practice self-compassion.

events.description:

We conclude our series with a one-person play, which takes place in the living room of Ken Martinez, an elderly Gay San Franciscan, and follows him as he tells stories from his youth about his first love, his youthful experimentation, his life as a nurse during the AIDS Epidemic, and the loss of his loved ones. Join Ken as he remembers key moments of his life, that helped to shape him into the man he is today. This piece was created using actual interviews that Albert took of Ken Martinez, Albert then distilled those stories through his own artistic lens. After the show we will head to Celestial Bodies for a tribute to all long-term survivors and from 3:00 - 4:00 pm Celestial Bodies will host a workshop Current Safer Sex- Life in the World of PrEP and U=U. Located in GlamCocks' Morecockin Tent (7:30 & Bender); Reception and Workshop at Celestial Bodies to Follow

events.title: GLAMCOCKS: QueerTalks & Workshops
events.description:
Are you ready to challenge your worldview, step outside your comfort zone, and provide a little TLC for your body and brain at Burning Man? Join the GlamCocks and friends for QueerTalks and Workshops: a series of moderated audience discussions and wellness activities on topics important to our queer communities. Join in on a real-talk discussion or push your body and mind with yoga, meditation, and vulnerability. Our thought provoking discussions may not always be comfortable, but are intended to be a safe space where we can learn and grow together.

QueerTalks and Workshops schedule:

events.title: Sacramento Region Meet-Up
events.description:
Come meet your fellow Burners from the the Greater Northern California area before you head back to default. Group photo takes place at 1700 (5:00PDT).

Our region encompasses a large geographic area in Northern California including areas to the south/west of Sacramento such as Davis, Woodland and Stockton and to the north/east including the Sierra Foothill communities, Marysville, Chico and beyond. 

We’ll meet up at Comfy Cozy Voodoo Lounge & Community College at 8:00 & Esplanade.

After this class you’ll be tested to prove that you can pass on the moves as well as the date, time, and location. Once you pass you’ll be certified to certify as many burners as possible. Pass it on to anyone you feel a connection with so that we can all meet up later to perform it together and see how our connections branched. 

The time, day and location will be announced at the class.

This work is trauma-informed and takes place in a safe, and sacred setting (this is ceremony.) with time for intention setting, grounding, opening, and group sharing.

events.title: Anthropology 232: Make Your Own Magic Mala
events.description:
Make your own Magic Mala

Give yourself the gift of taking time to make your own magical Mala. 
Remind yourself that even in the excitement and chaos of the playa, it is important to find your way back to yourself and inner peace.
Malas have been used for thousands of years for meditation and prayer and consist of 108 beads, with one “guru” bead.

You can choose between 86 black lava beads from Indonesia, or 86 Rudraksha seeds, the tears of Shiva, from where the Rudraksha tree grew. Plus 23 gemstone beads to complete the holy number 108, (and one “guru” bead).

I will bring a whole range of healing stones from Malachite, Agate, Amazonite, Quartz, Turquoise, just to name a few, and also teach you how to charge them.

Come early to choose your favorite stones, maximum 15 places to keep the class intimate.

Why 108?

A full cycle of 108 repetitions is counted on the Mala so the practitioner can focus on the sounds, vibration, and meaning of what is being said.

The chakras are the intersections of energy lines, and there are said to be a total of 108 energy lines converging to form the heart chakra.

Sun and Earth: The diameter of the sun is 108 times the diameter of the Earth. The distance from the sun to the Earth is 108 times the diameter of the sun.

Moon and Earth: The average distance of the moon from the Earth is 108 times the diameter of the moon.

Planets and houses: In astrology, there are 12 houses and nine planets. Twelve multiplied by nine equals 108.
1, 0, and 8: Some say that one stands for God or higher Truth, zero stands for emptiness or completeness in spiritual practice, and eight stands for infinity or eternity.

Pranayama: If one is able to be so calm in meditation as to have only 108 breaths in a day, enlightenment will come.

There is a 109th bead that hangs at the bottom of a Mala, called either the sumeru, bindu, stupa, or guru bead. 

It is never counted among the repetitions but used as a marker.

history.description:
Sit and stay at the I Miss My Dog Café! If you have a furry friend at home, you understand how much we miss them while we're out on playa – their unconditional love, the warm greeting when you walk through the door, the cuddle sessions on the couch. Get the therapeutic comforts of having your pup around even when you're on playa. 

Our on-duty DOG-tor (human therapy dog) will be available sunrise to sunset to listen to your stories intently, comfort you when you're down, and dexterously serve you coffee, tea, and food that the house is cooking up that day. As a food & flow camp, you'll also find yoga, meditations, flow jams, and workshops. Plus, we have playa-dog-ified twists on the cafe events you love (trivia night, open mics, etc.)! Lunch served daily from 11–1pm.

Mystopia is the playa’s most refreshing oasis complete with two giant misting tents, refreshing snacks, chill house music, comfortable seating, and more Persian rugs than a camel can sneeze at. This year we’re not only bringing back our massively popular French Toast Brunch and Friday/Saturday night parties, but also new events like Deflower A Virgin (what?!), Feed the Virgin Camp, and Calcutta Bitch’s Barber Shop and Beauty Salon — and that’s just the beginning, so come play with us!

Mystopia is the playa’s most refreshing oasis. Our multi-generational camp has everything you could need: cool misters, frozen otter pops, chill house music, comfortable seating, and more Persian rugs than a camel can sneeze at.

Camp Mystopia offers many mysts: the Magical Mystery Vans and Mobile Mystery Science Theater will rove the playa sharing gifts, popcorn and film, while our camp itself will host a Mystery Fruit Stand, a Cooling Myst Tent, and of course the 2010 Mystery Masqued Ball.  Come visit our MYSTerious utOPIA!

Following the principle of Immediacy, the prize will be awarded right then and there to the winner of the competition.  Everything one or two people need for their impromptu overnight stay is provided: luxury 100% cotton sheets, comfy and cozy leopard PJ's, a travel amenities kit, souvenir vintage jewelry, relaxing ambient music, candle light, and various bibelots. Note that The Dream Spa is staffed by professional therapists.

Ebb & Glow village is a play space all day and all night.  

We host camps that serve refreshments, repair bicycles, serve cupcakes, and take portraits.  Enter Magic Lantern Society to relax, interact, have some tea, hookah, & maybe watch belly dancers.  Climb our play structures any time for views of BRC.   Afternoons and evenings: our stage hosts lectures, dance lessons, neighborhood band jams, improvisation groups, performers, and occasional DJ's. events.title: ManifestiV at EBB & Glow after Man Burn
events.description: Hailing from Vallejo California, the Gemini duo sound team leaders of EBB & Glow, Paragraph Taylor in full robotic garb and EvE in indigenous warrior queen wear, test the most hopping live stage outside Center Camp. ManifestiV (their collective Playa name & duo touring the default world for the majority of this decade) perform with the heaviest guitar & only electric vibraphone on Playa over electronic & acoustic laptop instrumentation more akin to Nine Inch Nails & The Grateful Dead than Noisia & Skrillex, due respect to all. More than just an hour of songs played live, they live-scan souls of attendees with concepts of transcendentalism, introspection & unity to each their own interpretation. Last year's post-Temple-Burn performance touched so many Burners, EBB & Glow Village insisted the two return this year one night earlier to send the intensity of Saturday night's end flaming into Sunday's stratosphere like a satellite reentering the Earth's atmosphere. Perfect for a dust cleansing of all chakras before the spiritual conclusion to the I, Robot themed Burn, their performance ends with a celebration of life for all present & not, commingling with participants abound.

history.description: Milk + Honey is a multicultural camp with Jewish roots that remains guided by the principles of Jewish culture and tradition. Our guiding principles include: community building and support, the belief that food and the table are a place to nourish and gather, expression through dance and movement, intellectual introspection, loving our neighbors as ourselves, and more. We are a welcoming and inclusive tight-knit community of all types of people. Our camp is meant to be a home, not just a place to live, for our campers. We are stewards of the Burning Man principles and culture that provide engaging interactivity and a gathering place for citizens of Black Rock City at large. Our campers span a wide array of creative pursuits, skills, and passions.

events.title: Shabbat Celebration
events.description:
Join us to welcome Shabbat with ecstatic singing, creative ritual, and a hot veggie meal.  All denominations are welcome to join hands and hearts. BYO plate!

Come to our large dome as the sun sets; you welcome the sabbath while a sea of twinkling stars envelopes you, our public shade structures transforming from daytime misting cloudscapes to light installations. We fire up our sound responsive LED beacon to help guide anybody who hasn’t found their way, and our singing voices set it to a communal pulse of light.

After the service we guide you to our dining area and seat you at a communal bedouin-style table. We fill your cup, nourish you with a multi-course meal, and ease you into the embrace of a subtle sound environment. Later, once our souls and stomachs have been nourished, we transition into celebratory dance.

This is Dharma's famous hands-on, clothes-off erotic massage workshop in its 11th year on the playa, now at Milk+Honey.  Over the course of 75 minutes, you'll experience how to give or receive a full-body orgasm using breathwork, music, and non-ejaculatory erotic massage, screaming along with 40 or so other burners.  This is the form of massage taught by the Body Electric School, though in a very condensed format.

Bring a towel/sheet, and water.  Best to come with a partner; we're in a group, but this is a 1-on-1 practice.  Come early: we will fill up.  ALL gender & sex combos are welcome.  The massage practice focuses on the penis, so it is helpful (but not essential) if the receiver has one; the giver's junk doesn't matter at all.  More info here: http://playajoy.org/?p=2758

history.description: Welcome to the Kinsey Walhberg Field Lab. This groundbreaking camp, developed by the esteemed Lindsey Kinsey and Remy Walhberg, stands at the vanguard of art analysis, offering training for those interested in their unique and comprehensive framework that transcends conventional critique methodologies. Enter KWASI-3. KWASI-3 is not just an assessment tool; it is a revolution in understanding art. Our instrument delves deep into the realms of artistic creation, exploring various dimensions such as Dimensional Topology, Activation Shape, and Materiality. This multidisciplinary approach allows for a holistic understanding of art, enabling critics, artists, and enthusiasts to engage with artworks on a deeper, more meaningful level.

history.description:
Honoring divine femininity with a cosmic connection attenuated to the migration of atoms, transformation occurs with presence and through participation. We are the playa portal of the universe to your inner self. Our display art is mesmerizing, opening pathways to deeper mysteries. Our activities expand and challenge your mind.
Honor your form through body adornment and care, yoga, mediation. Celebrate this existence through food events, dance parties, and a number of craft activities.
You, the cosmos and the world sacrificed much to bring you to this moment in time. Make it matter!

events.title: Blockchain Bingo
events.description: Blockchain provides opportunities in this emerging world economy to rethink how parts of our society work. Innovation here might reduce friction in the economy, or create new kinds of services and ways of doing business with each other. It could even help us to manage our energy consumption more sustainably to help deal with climate issues. Join us at Karma Love Camp for a chat and some fun and games as we examine, using laughter and a ton of salt, what the Blockchain can really do. Plus, there WILL be gifting.

events.title: Celestial Yoga Classes
events.description: Join Karma Love Camp as we enjoy the physical, mental and spiritual practice of yoga. We always remember that yoga is for spiritual and physical development; to cultivate discernment, awareness, self-regulate, and to achieve higher consciousness. Yoga encourages you to relax, slow your breath, and focus on the present by moving into your body. We provide a shaded space and ground covering. We welcome Burners to participate with our talented instructors from around the world.

events.title: Chant and Meditate Infinite Love
events.description: Forget walls & (Br)exits. Join us to send out loving-kindness to the playa and perhaps even to the world. This simple meditation is based on the pure practice of directing well-wishes towards other people, even those we may struggle with..... especially those we may struggle with. It will consist of chanting and engaging with positivity as we send out beautiful support to those beyond our camp.

events.title: Cosmic Partnership Workshop
events.description: Relationships don't have to be difficult. Being with the one you love shouldn't be a chore. Seek a deeper connection with your intimate partner(s) by agreeing to enhance each other’s life experience. Cosmic Partnership teaches the perspective of mutually enabling your relationship to be the best it can be. Find the core of partnership & bring it into your open space. This workshop is intended to heighten well-established relationships of every variety. 2 hours of idea/principle discussion & intimacy & connection techniques. Limited to 15 couples. Arrive Early!

events.title: Ecstatic Dance
events.description: Ecstatic dance is not your typical ‘dance’. You are not being led by an instructor, partnering up or under the influence of anything other than the music. Instead, your ego is left at the door as you enter the dance space. An ecstatic dance host facilitates the floor, sets intentions and perhaps a theme and then the music begins, and you enter into a meditative, free movement vortex, spiraling into full expression and liberation.

events.title: Egyptian Salt Dough Pendants
events.description: Using salt dough to form jewelry is an ancient process that dates back to the Egyptians. Though the use of salt and flour we are following this tradition by crafting handmade, oven harden pendants for participants to decorate with paint and brushes. These are gifts for them to take.

events.title: Empyrean Tresses Hair Braiding
events.description: Skilled camp members will braid participants hair in a unique playa inspired style under a shaded structure.

events.title: Enchanting-Body Painting
events.description: Body painting origins stretch back to the beginning of time with a human need to adorn the flesh with exotic and alluring designs. Our master body painter will carefully and lovingly use all their skills to create a fleeting, washable masterpiece. Wear it with pride and share with your friends.

events.title: Funky Grooves Dance Party
events.description: We’re offering a beginning level Hip hop dance class for the enjoyment of public participants and encourage experienced dancers to join.  This is a non-traditional dance style that combines breaking, crip-walking, locking, popping, electric boogaloo, floating, turfing, and roboting. Our talented teacher, Lisa, will break down the basic steps and provide a full hour of sweat generating, heart thumping exercise.

events.title: Higher Dimensional Meditation
events.description:
Meditation allows us to increase awareness and develop more ownership of our minds. However, taking charge of the mind is not about controlling it. It’s about giving ourselves the means to connect with mind’s innate qualities – spaciousness, goodness, creativity – so that mind’s natural light can outshine the, shadows of confusion and disturbing emotions. A free mind finds its own peace.
We welcome all types of practitioners to join Karma Love Camp's daily meditation sessions.

events.title: Heavenly Body Flag Making
events.description: Everyone has a story to tell in the dust of the playa. We want to document your story and participation in the 2019 event. We imprint your body part on one of our camp flags. Then we provide a vibrant jeweled colored cloth flag and washable body paint to imprint and decorate for your take away flag. This event is a repeat of last year where we had over 100 people leave a body print on our camp flags. We are displaying those flags, along with our individual camp prayer flags, to recognize those who attended last year.

events.title: Karma Love Rage Yoga
events.description: We are all angry, stressed, and tired about something and have been holding onto an ‘F’-bomb or two for a little bit too long. Rage Yoga allows you, no encourages you, to have a safe space to let go of your frustration and rage in a healthy way…and wash it all away with some ice cold beer. Think: war cries, occasional dirty jokes, f-bombs, and yes, beer. Karma Love Camp offers you a safe place to park your anger on the playa and we even throw in beer :-) More than just a practice, Rage Yoga is an attitude.

events.title: KarmaTea Inner Reflection
events.description: This event offers Burners a chance to engage in deep, personal talks that matter. Working not as an opportunity for one person to talk to many, but rather as a participatory event where discussion and reflective engagement are welcomed. Burners will leave feeling they have listened but have also been heard. This event also offers freshly made Chai tea, Gatorade, or iced tea in a relaxed environment with soothing sounds.

events.title: Krishna’s Dance of Divine Love
events.description: In Hindu Myth, Rasa-Lilla symbolizes the exchanges of pure spiritual love. Before the performance Rukmee, our instructor will conduct a workshop on Indian classical gestures and expressions. She will explain & demonstrate jewelry, facial expressions, movements & their deeper meaning. The audience is invited to join in & learn. Rukmee will perform Lord Krishna’s Rasa-Lilla in full Indian costume with audience participation.

events.description: Burning Man cries out for the perfect accessory of a magic cape to celebrate your playa adventure. We are hosting a unique workshop for you to select your fabric and design a unique and stunning cape that reflects your playa being. A special cape that reflects your playa personality to wear for that exclusive event that calls to you from deep in the playa.

events.title: March of the Naked Parasols to The Man
events.description:
Join us as at Karma Love Camp as we fully embrace the principle of Radical Self-
Expression as we march naked to The Man. Arrive at our camp early enough and

you could get gifted a parasol. All participants will receive, if they wish, a water-
soluble butt stamp. March on Burners. Show yourself to the world. Be proud. Be

naked. Revel in the playa dust.

events.title: Metamorphosis Dance
events.description: Metamorphosis: " a profound change in form from one stage to the next in the life history of an organism, as transformation by magic" Change is inevitable, and life is in constant change. However, some moments are more profound than others. The earth is going through a big change as a result of human impact. Consequentially, we all need to change our patterns & behaviors; in how we meet our own needs and how we connect with others and co-create resilient communities. Gaia Tribe facilitators will guide you meditatively into dance designed to shed your skin and leave behind the old and dance into the new. Accompanied by experienced ecstatic dance DJs playing ethnic downtempo, tribal and world beats.

events.description: You will smell our delicious pancakes before you step anywhere near Karma Love Camp. Come grab your prize of mouthwateringly fluffy pieces of goodness. Cover them with syrup, honey, nutella or leave them naked, just as you wish. We will offer an assortment of pancakes, syrups, coatings, and sprinkles. We will also offer coffee with milk and sugar.

Perhaps you have a piece you would like to leave with us in return or maybe even write us a little love note? Our members who hail from all over the world have been asked to bring 6 -10 pieces of playa appropriate jewelry that they are willing to gift to random members of the public. Each piece of jewelry will be fitted with a tiny Karma Love charm. The jewelry will be mounted on a specially designed Bling board at the front of our camp and will be hosted by one of our members. We will also have a mailbox, paper, and pencils for those who wish to gift us a love note.

Rukmee will perform an adaptation of this healing fire ceremony which is said to tap into universal energy and to propagate life and fulfill desires. A beautiful meaningful ritual, it reduces stress, leads to greater clarity of thought and improves overall health & energy. Most importantly this ceremony facilitates the heart & mind to become embrace love. Sweet food items will be gifted afterwards

history.description:
Let Gravity do the work. Like love, gravity is one of the many unseen forces of the universe. It binds together our solar systems, keeps us firmly grounded, and rolls off the tongue like an avalanche.

With this in mind, Gravity Camp is the force that attracts and propels participants forward on the playa. 

Our camp's primary activities take place during the setting of the sun, when its gravity propels the earth through orbit and dazzles us with its majestic colorscapes. It is during this time, that we celebrate the success of a sun-filled day, and boldly continue our trajectory into the darkness of the night.

On the outskirts of the city, with no obstruction in sight, Gravity is the ideal location to celebrate the sun and wind-down before an evening of exploration.
