A morning-ritual cafe that offers interactive experiences with mindfulness practices focusing on fun daily topics. While serving coffee to our Burning Man citizens, we'll be raffling off an experience only a handful will get to participate in: A restful night or day at our camp in a custom-built solar reflective A-frame structure.

Our menu will include organic ethically sourced single-origin coffee, organic herbal tea, quantum-infused biolumina spirulina shots, and organic vegan power balls to get your mornings started.

What to bring for our daily Series:
1) Journal / Paper 
2) Pen 
3) Your Magical Coffee Mug

Monday's Experience is the DREAM series. 
A session that includes dreaming, journaling, and envisioning with others in the community.

Tuesday's Experience is the EXPAND series. 
A session that includes the expansion of the mind with breathwork, meditation, and guided visualization.

Wednesday's Experience is the EMBODY series. 
A session that includes participants to be partnered up with a fellow citizen for a partnered workshop + a 'Mirror' workshop.

Thursday's Experience is the AWAKEN series and we plan to end our morning series with a bang. This is our Series finale. 
The session includes a guided journey to awaken our citizens to their dream. This is our final event of the week and will include breathwork, yoga, and dance with optional mimosas served along with to-go burritos. This session is about activating and moving the energy from dreams to Waking Dreams. We will also announce the winners for the Dreamtopia Stays.

history.description: Greetings and salutations! We are are phasmantis, a group hailing from Los Angeles and Seattle. We come bearing gifts of snow cones, poptarts, and shenanigans at all times. Come stop by for some heavy bass music, drinks, or a high five
Phasmantis,

Phantasmatis is a camp celebrating the uncanny in technology, the fascinating autonomy that mechanisms seem to take on,and their habit of playfully subverting  users' intentions.  Our camp features DIY, hacked devices that come alive in the hands of participants, and a interactive themed environment that gives Burners a glimpse of the fun machines would create if left to their own devices. Night time Rainbow "Laser" Tag engages humans and machines in a game of light. Players pursue each other with laser guns in a maze hung with prisms that cast rainbows on the fabric walls. Burners will emerge exhilarated from this excursion into the colorful dream world of machines while in the midst of amazing music!
Phasmantis is an eccentric combination of music, drinks, food, and fun. Boisterous yet reserved, Phasmantis may or may not be what you expected.

Hypothesis: Scientifically rigorous yet playful participation enhances your burn.

Intro: LOBE invites you to experiment with our placebo bar, sci-art and brain-inspired activities. 

Specific Aims:

Aim 1) Are you drunk!? Our speakeasy The Double-Blind Pig serves placebo-controlled refreshments. While you sip, ask the local (inebriated?) scientists all your burning questions (results may vary)
Aim 2) Can we tickle your brain!? Play with our interactive neurotech, mind-stretching games, and discover the neuroscience of your favorite drugs!
Aim 3) Ready to blow your mind!? We're not just nerds, we're artists too! Study our scientifically inspired pieces co-created by neuroscientists and friends. 

In summary, WE WANT YOUR BRAINS to test our innovative approach to nerdy fun on the playa!

events.title: We, Human
events.description:
A live ballet and orchestra performance depicting a migration from a place of oppression, violence, and shame to a world where everyone is celebrated for who they are. The performance focuses on the intersection of individuality and radical self-expression with our shared humanity and capacity for interconnectedness, and will occur along the trash fence at sunset on Wednesday evening. We, Human celebrates the intrinsic value and magic of every person, imagining an inclusive, interdependent world free from nationalism and fabricated barriers of entry. 
Location: The Trash Fence

Our camp provides art, music, culture and social events in an interactive space designed for spiritual refueling. events.title: Gamelatron Programming
events.description:
Come experience the world’s first fully robotic gamelan orchestra. A Gamelatron is a sound producing kinetic sculpture presented as site-specific installations, and stand alone art works by Aaron taylor Kuffner. Gamelatrons are made from traditional bronze, brass and iron instruments from Indonesia’s gamelan tradition, retrofitted with mechanical mallets on sculptural mounting systems. The pieces are connected to a network that transcribes digital compositions into an array of electrical pulsations that results in a ghostly musical automaton. 

Located in the smaller, private, peaceful tent outside of the main event tent in front yard.

history.description: Welcome, Traveler, to Devachan Lounge: Sanctuary of the Divine. Behind our gates lies a homeland where we love you fiercely, with open arms, unapologetically, through happiness and through hardship. Whether camp elder or neophyte, we couple Radical Self-Expression with a commitment to being a Generous Family. We embody our Best Selves through giving and receiving Love and Acceptance, and other Gifts like Play, Performance, Healing, and Art. Our conscious practice of the Ten Principles allows us to set ambitious intentions, pioneer new ways of being human on Playa, and transfer what we learn to our off-playa communities and cities.

Devachan Lounge is a sanctuary for authenticity. We live the 10 principles both on and off the playa and support an environment where everyone can bring their best selves to the community. We have gathered a revolving crew of passionate Burners, always at the ready to help new people acclimate to the Burning Man culture and the challenges of thriving in the Black Rock Desert. This is the true magic of Devachan Lounge. For anyone who finds themselves in our space, the Lounge is a peaceful, revitalizing, and reaffirming oasis. All are welcome.

history.description: Hey there, fellow BRC citizens! Are you ready to be dazzled and transformed by the queer dayglo wonderland? events.description:
Have you got any pressing questions about your life? What future brings? Any hard decisions to make? Come and ask Ruby for a Rune casting, or I Ching reading from the Book of Changes.

Runes are the secret letters of the Norse, Vikings, Old Germans and Celts - a potent and living system of magic. They revealed their magic to this World through the self-sacrifice of the mighty Odin (https://norse-mythology.org/tales/odins-discovery-of-the-runes/) while hanging on the tree of life - a large ash tree named Yggdrasil, which connects the Nine Worlds and is the center of the cosmos.

I Ching  is an ancient cleromancy divination method based on the Book of Changes that was composed more than 3000 years ago. Using yarrow stalks we generate random numbers and create hexagrams that are interpreted using Book of Changes. A great tool for Times of Changes we live in!

events.description: Fear often gets in our way in realizing our life goals and achieving our highest potential. Fear sometimes get embedded deep in our psyche and will remain there until and unless we choose to address them. Granted it is easy to ignore our fears and stay in the comfort zone, yet imagine life's possibilities if we confront our fears. In this workshop, we will breakthrough our fears by breaking an arrow with our throat as a metaphorical exercise. events.description: The Joint Study is a crowd-sourced, community-based research project that allows cannabis users, former users, and caregivers to create their own patient-driven research by contributing data about their use of cannabis, submitting potential queries, and analyzing their results to come up with larger research questions. events.title: Countless Carrot March
events.description: Each year, as the Billion Bunnies hop across the playa, we prepare to meet them with our small but powerful Countless Carrots March! It's time to claim our rights and the rights of all veggie-kind to be treated as the sentient beings we are. All Carrots and Allies assemble in your finest green and orange attire for a pre-party from 4pm-5.30pm at Orange Root Theory Camp before the Bunny March. In true Carrot fashion, we'll provide drinks and a party before we head out to intercept and defeat the bunnies at 5.45pm sharp! Bring along your best vegetable themed cocktails and costumes. Help us as our wave of orange and green goodness spreads across the playa!

history.description: More Carrot: Sure, you could live off protein bars and MREs all week if you really want to, but how about giving your dusty soul a treat? Come by the More Carrot Camp and get yourself something crunchy, cold and crisp; we gift fresh vegetables and fruit at the More Carrot Camp. Tues. - Fri., 9 - 11 am. We also open The Carrot Club and gift vegetable and fruit based cocktails and make your own alcohol infused smoothies from 10 am to 1 pm Tuesday through Friday. Most importantly, join us Thursday afternoon for the Countless Carrot March, where we march with the Div. of Animal Control to save The Man from the ravenous Bunny hordes!

events.description:
INTRODUCTION
With lots of people at Burning Man comes lots of waste. Large amounts of compostable matter such as food scraps and soiled paper are wasted to landfill, creating massive amounts of unnecessary CO2 - the stuff that's harming our atmosphere. The Compost Project was created in 2016 to educate and support the BM community in properly disposing of food scraps during the BM Main Event in August. The project is a comprehensive program including compost awareness, hands-on education, and the facilities to collect pure compostable matter, placed directly into the funnel of regenerative farming. 

HOW IT WORKS
Bring us your compost! We will be dumping the compost directly into the Compostainer, so no need to use compost bags. In fact, save the earth from 1-use plastic and bring us your compost in buckets. Or even better, dry out your compost and bring it to us that way! 

Together, you and the Compost volunteers will sort through the compost to make sure there are no unwanted materials. Don't worry, it's actually not that smelly and we provide gloves. If we find anything that we can't take, we'll send it back home with you. 

GOT QUESTIONS?
Make sure to visit our website to read the FAQ page.
Or join our facebook page and pose your questions to the community
Or send us an email

events.title: Bucky Ball Pit with VR: Fuller's Workbench
events.description: The Bucky Ball pit is inspired by the life and work of Buckminster Fuller, a Da Vince of the 20th century. Come have a ball and gain a deeper understanding of the fundamentals behind creating a future that “works for 100% of humanity, in the shortest possible time through spontaneous cooperation, without ecological offense or the disadvantage of anyone”. Immersive yourself in virtual reality and connect the dots/balls between your intuitive ideas around ecological/conscious design and the core principles of nature’s coordinate system. Play with and create your own models of synergetic structures. Learn how geodesic domes are made.

events.title: "Now we dance! Now we fight" Dance/Fight! Party!
events.description:
Come dance, (pillow) fight, and dance again on rapid rotation to high-energy flamenco according to the whims of our Dancefightmeister B Riles! Also, drinks during intermissions. 

It started with a vision. A vision of Germans in a slightly alternate dimension. A dimension where the only way to dance to German techno was under the strict supervision of a leader. The leader would announce "And now we dance!" and they dance dance dance, only to be followed by "And now we fight!" whereupon a raging fist fight would break out. Soon enough, the leader barks "And now we dance!", fists are dropped, and they stomp dance once more. 

It was a very silly vision. And now we bring this vision to you. Join us and alternate between internal states of joy and (joyful) rage as rapidly as we alternate between dancing and (pillow) fighting. Pillows provided.

history.description:
Forged from scavenged tech, glowing mesh, and post-industrial grit. This camp pulses with the creative chaos of a world on the edge. 
By day we're a collective of rogue artists, experience engineers, and anarcho-hackers. 
By night we anchor the Fire Zone, maintaining our iconic flame stage and collaborating with conclaves and performers that set the horizon alight. Inside our cyberpunk themed bar, the Tech Noir, dust weary wanderers trade stories and camaraderie over chilled concoctions in a haze of neon and nostalgia. Makers, fire spinners, and resilient nomads converge here to prove that even in collapse, creativity survives.

history.description:
Feel the warmth of our fires, see our lights when the sky is dark or filled with dust, and share our vintage spirits. But be warned, some things that can outlast an apocalypse, have mighty sharp teeth!  
We are an oasis of fire and rust, surrounded by a sea of neon, thumping tones and desert chaos. Learn not to fear the end of civilization, step into our world and learn alittle about yourself. 
All those that enter our lounge are welcome to become completely immersed in our world. Full attention to detail is everywhere, from the rusted fire sculptures to the burning bar. The stage is lit with fire and torches, while dancers spin hoops and metal.  Performers share the stage with our unusual blend of house music ranging from death metal to the 40s jazz of the Atomic Age.

When the world as we know it is gone, and survivors of the apocalypse wander the wastes, we are the last refuge of humanity in a chaotic world. Seek out the warm glow in the night, soak in the heat of our fires, take refuge from the sun and dust in our sheltered cove of rust and metal. Join our story tellers and share your tales, where wanderers are welcome.

events.description:
It is told that anyone who can apply themselves to create 1000 origami cranes is bestowed with fortune and a *wish* – this is certainly true at the Paper Cranes Lottery! We use the power of community to create thousands of cranes together, ensuring that our wishes can come true collectively!

Feeling lucky? Make a wish, fold a paper crane, then place it in the mystery box to see if it is a winner! Winners spin the rainbow wheel to see who will bestow their special gift upon them. Gifts range from handmade jewelry boxes, to *consensual* spanks, to a happy birthday serenade. All the while we'll be groovin to the DJ, taking ice cold pickle backs, and enjoying the shaded refuge in our sprawling lounge space. Don't forget to look for strings of these paper cranes at The Temple where the wishes of burners far and wide will get released into the ether.

events.title: Diversion Traffic School, Lounge & Bar
events.description:
Traffic school interactive fun & games for unlawful bikers receiving citations. Includes MoreMose mornings @ 10am right before traffic schooll begins at noon.

Negligent bikers receiving traffic and parking citations on site or photo radar notices received via the BRC Postal Service for breaking traffic, speed or parking laws MUST report and complete the traffic diversion course (obstacle courses, bike karaoke, traffic bingo, biker bar and more) to avoid your violations landing on your PERMANANT Burner Profile record. 

We will be inconspicuously placing photo radar cameras at high traffic and the research-cited "most dangerous intersections" and sending our snarky shark bike brigade patrol out to parking congestion gathering spaces in and around Black Rock City. So slow down! And park properly! 

Diversion traffic school covers how to avoid unlit darkwads, proper ways to hitch a ride for you and your bike on an art car, responsible parking and traffic safety and what to do as a citizen to keep you and others safe. Includes a stop at our diversion bar offering up surly bartenders to hydrate and treat you to libations with proper snark. 

Early birds, start your day with us at 10am for delicious MoreMosas and loungey, chill music to wake up to right before traffic school begins at noon. If you are lucky, you might have a few “celebrity” sightings!

events.title: Bay Area Buzz Kill presents An Apology Workshop
events.description:
Ever wonder why your well-intended message is not getting through? 
Dazed and confused about someone getting MORE upset when you’re trying to make it better? Ever feel like you are on the right side of their/her/history but can’t find your way through? OR Did you receive a BABK Citation at some point in the burn? 
Then this is the workshop for you!
In this workshop, we will consider how to clue into when we have harmed another, how to gather important information, connect with feelings, and finally use all of this to apologize with better results. We will also identify how interpersonal harms often connect to dominant narratives. Better relationships, quicker resolution, stronger connections, and healthier communities! More thoughtful and heartfelt apologies make a more thoughtful and heartfelt world.  

Systemic/Structural Keywords: consent, microaggressions, cultural appropriation, rape culture, misogyny, heteronormativity, homonormativity, racism, racial insensitivity, the patriarchy, general insensitivity, ableism, and more…

Our deepest fear is not that we are inadequate. Our deepest fear is that we are powerful beyond measure. It is our light, not our darkness, that most frightens us. We ask ourselves, who am I to be brilliant, gorgeous, talented and fabulous? Actually, who are you not to be? You are a child of burritos. Your playing small doesn't serve the world. We were born to make manifest the glory of spaghetti that is within us. It's not just in some of us; it's in everyone. And as we let our own light shine, we unconsciously give other people permission to do the same. As we are liberated from our own fear, our presence automatically liberates others.
"I've learned that people will forget what you said, people will forget what you did, but people will never forget that you made them a spaghetti burrito." -Maya Angelou

Our enchantment with, and disenchantment from, the modern world are not so easy to distinguish from each other - They exist in a reciprocal relationship. Rosa Parks sued Outkast. The key to happiness isn't the search for meaning, it's to just keep yourself busy with random nonsense till you die. A time period called, they want their object back. Nilbog! It's goblin spelled backwards! 7 Minutes!

If only there could be another way to do this 'cause it feels like murder to put your heart through this. I know I always said that I could never hurt you, well this is the very, very last time I'm ever going to eat a Spaghetti Burrito

events.title: Evening Fishing
events.description: How can you give out fishing licenses and NOT let people start fishing right away.  We had an amazing time last year sitting on the porch of our camp and casting blinky fish out into the center of the portal.  Some unsuspecting burner would be drawn to the pulsating lights and start to apply the brakes to their bike.  As the fish slowly was reeled in, the burner would be confused… Then curious and would begin to move towards the fish faster and faster until they were standing on our porch realizing what has happened.  At this time, when they were caught, we would smile, laugh, exchange hugs, and even offer the fishing rod to them to allow them to try their luck.

history.description: The qt pies are an eclectic collective of souls inviting you to explore non-normative interpretations of time. We're on a mission to deconstruct our understanding of time - our most ubiquitous, yet most precious, finite resource. Traverse the 4th dimension with us. Embrace pie-in-the-sky ideas. Our doors are open to all who dare to question, who might be questioning, or who simply have questions. This year, we plan to bring back our most popular events from 2022 and innovate new offerings engaging with this year's Animalia theme. We believe that the soul, or anima, is eternal. Our interactivity takes participants on thrilling journeys of soul and body exploration.

history.description: The qt pies are an adorable, eclectic collective of souls inviting you to explore non-normative interpretations of time. We are on a mission to queerify the cosmos by deconstructing our shared understanding of time - our most ubiquitous, yet most precious, finite resource. Traverse the 4th dimension with us. Embrace pie-in-the-sky ideas. Our doors are open to all who dare to question, who might be questioning, or who simply have questions. Come fetch that QT with us: Queer Time, Question Time, Quality Time through multi-level participatory activities that engage the six senses, and the seventh - our sense of time.

events.title: Pleasure Your Mud Pie Hole
events.description: Come open your mud pie hole in our open circle discussion and workshop. We'll be teaching butt-shy humans across the entire gender and sexuality spectrum how to unleash the potential of pleasure in their most uncharted territories. Expect live conversation and demonstration utilizing anal props. You'll take away some techniques you can use to practice at home and you might even make a friend in the process who might want to practice with you ;)

events.title: The Big Wig Party
events.description: Shed your sense of self or adopt a new persona by dawning one of our fabulous wigs and booty shake yourself across space and time. Will you choose the edgy bob you've been too nervous to try? The neon pink that will get you noticed? Find your real self with our fake hair and never party the same way again

events.title: Have a Good Time Cocktail Lounge
events.description: Spin our Wheels of Temporal Fortune and experience the playful interplay of language, time, and delicious cocktails. After a few sips, you might even feel so inclined to share a secret with us on our Confession Tree in the grammatical tense the wheel lands on. But, don't worry, no one will ever know if it happened in the past, is happening right now, or is something you are fantasizing about for the future!

Come submit your ideas for the poses you wished existed and watch your fellow practitioners bring them to life. Together we will create a flow that the world has never seen before, and will likely never see again.

Nothing serves as a reminder that you are but a speck of dust in a vast infinite universe than taking a cream pie to the face. Let us fling cream together to celebrate how none of us really know what the hell is going on.

We'll come together as a rag tag group of singers who might just make something beautiful. We'll also eat Whoopie Pies. Religion and singing experience is NOT required

events.title: Momentum (Movement over Time)
events.description: You're invited to experience a group movement game! See how you as an individual contribute to the creation of a group narrative, sometimes known as history, through weaving our individual narratives with those of others. The goal is to move our group from one place and time to another through a series of unique interpretive movements

events.title: qt pies’ 11th Principle: Radical Self-Inclusion
events.description: How do we make our voices heard in a world that can marginalize entire groups of people? How do we build the confidence to radically and respectfully include ourselves and other marginalized individuals through radical self-expression and self-reliance? How do we join conversations of others that may not be like us and open ourselves to listening? We are all connected and want to share tools for building communication skills to free ourselves from imposter syndrome.

events.description: The Greatest Mutant Arts Parade will launch its 4th consecutive year of parading an improvised route through Black Rock City and the Playa.  Mutant Art Vehicles will unite to celebrate the unique and diverse spectacle that is Burning Man. The goals of the Greatest Mutant Arts Parade (GMAP) is to create a future planned route event...where Black Rock City can unite together in an uncensored, magnificent Meet and Greet of Mutant Art Vehicles, Theme Camps, BORG Organizers, Art Groups, Marching bands, Bicycle Crews, Stilt Walkers, and much much more. Look for the parade on its rogue route around Noon on the Playa, through the City...where??? We cannot tell you the route. But we will start and stop the parade at Reverbia Camp (3:45 and Esplanade)  ****All interested participant vehicles and people who would like to assist...then ride in the parade...contact us via email.

events.description: Enter a journey of sacred yoga dance, where body, mind, and spirit harmonize into the movement of our self awareness and being. Prepare for elevation!

events.title: Samba Reggae Dancing
events.description: Reggae and Samba Music Lovers unite! As Reverbia presents Reggae Samba Dance Before Noon, instructed by the dynamic, effervescent Andrea Monteiro of Samba Fusion and accompanied by All Star Reverbia Musicians. Come learn how to get your Samba Reggae dance grooves on!!!

events.description: Come join the premier open mic, singer/songwriting showcase at Burning Man.  Featuring amazing guest musicians from around Black Rock City, no covers, originals only...fresh off the Playa.

events.description: Backstreet Reverbia features The 9th Node...an Interactive Soundscape Experience, where movement,  breathing, heartbeat, chanting voice, acapella song... will redefine your concepts of sound.

events.title: Tribute to Lost Musicians (2016-17)
events.description: A concert in tribute to all the Lost Musicians who passed away from our last Burning Man to this Burning Man.  All Star Reverbia musicians will be performing songs from: George Michael, Leonard Cohen, Chuck Berry, Greg Allman, Chris Cornell... and more.

history.description: Reverbia- Known as the "Portal of Live Music" or "Oasis of Live Music at Burning Man", offers Live Music programming 18 hours a day/night including: Live Music Yoga in the Morning, Live Dance Workshops, David Bowie Tribute, Sing Alongs, Song, Dust, Sing (Black Rock City's popular singer/songwriter showcase and open mic), our Concert in the Shade Series, Sunset Classical Concerts (BYO Wine, Food Baskets, and Blanket), Reverbia Live Nights (featuring International, national, and regional festival bands), and After hours Jam and Chai in our new Teahouse.

events.title: Afro Brazilian Dancing Before Noon
events.description: Afro Brazilian Dance Workshop with Live Music…what more could your offer your rhythmic, sexy body, who gives you so much energy!  Dynamic Afro-Brazilian Dance instructor, Andrea Monteiro of Samba Fusion and Festival: Carnival del Sol in Vancouver, BC, will ensure you complete body movement satisfaction, while educating you in the art of this very popular music.  QViolin aka Quetzal Guerrero and Robin Layne…along with special guest Vir McCoy bring the Live Music.

events.title: Belly Dancing Before Noon
events.description: Unleash the power of your sexy hips with our lively instructor, Ishani Ishaya, for a fun belly dancing class! Accompanied by the live music of Tarun (of Delhi to Dublin) & Robin Layne.

events.title: Blues and Partnered Dance Before Noon
events.description:
Have you seen how partnered dancers seem to have amazing connection and almost psychic communication with one another? How they move together with the music so perfectly? Want to learn how to speak that language? Join us for a beautiful encounter with partnered dance at Reverbia and dance under our Radience Dome. .

We'll be showing you how to listen to the music and find the rhythm that unites you and the dust with the world. Then we'll be giving you some simple tips to express it in your own movement so you can connect with any partner. Stick around for live music and dancing afterward with the California Honey Drops!

events.title: Calm Inside
events.description: Wake up with a blissful dose of Live Music...yawn and stretch, breathe, meditate, set the course for your wonderfully, adventurous day. Calm Inside is designed to let you center your day, before all the hub bub and commotion...thumps thumps and sirens...the inescapable thrills of mayhem and delight. The Live Music will be of a more ambient, soul-filling, relaxation...happiness genre....so come and be at peace!!! After Calm Inside, enjoy our very popular Live Music Yoga in the Morning…where music meets the pose! On Wednesday and Friday, a portion of Calm Inside will include guided meditation.

events.title: Chill Dome Till Dawn
events.description: When Reverbia Live Nights ends…The Chill Dome Till Dawn begins.  Come warm up your body, while your mind and soul journey into the depths of Cosmic Universe.  The Chill Dome Till Dawn is our featured interactive LED and Soundscape Experience, where lights move to sound and sound moves within your mind.  After Hours at Reverbia, The Chill Dome Till Dawn will present live instrumental deep chill ambient music layered upon multi track recordings of cosmic soundscapes.  Detach, Explore, Connect, Envision!!!  Artists are TBA for The Chill Dome Till Dawn.

events.title: Classical Concert at Sunset
events.description: Sunset, Wine, a blanket on the soft dust…and Live Classical music…what better way to start your evening!  BYO Blanket, BYO Wine, BYO Cheese, BYO Dessert, BYO date or friend…we provide the music and stage.  Reverbia's location on the Esplanade affords beautiful views of art and desert mountains…in a neighborhood where live music is respected by all thumping DJs…a place where you can actually hear the delicate of string and woodwind. This could be your chance to rekindle relationships, court a Burner for a first date, or just connect with good friends and family…perhaps even a sunset of self appreciation and silence...except for the music of Mozart and Debussy.  Enjoy your best wine…and maybe some light dinner along with that nice slice of Cheesecake you have been saving in the RV.  Manet's "Dejeuner sur l'Herbe"...BRC Sunset style!  Chamber music by Playa Pops members or TBA.

events.title: Concerts in the Shade
events.description: Reverbia once again offers quality Live Music at our Concert in the Shade Series. Come enjoy 4-5 different groups daily, as they bring you music for your soul and sole (dancing feet). Acoustic Artists start the set…Conscious booty shaking dance bands finish the series. Featured acts will be listed on our schedule in front of our camp. Artists during the week will include: California Honeydrops, Delhi to Dublin, Buckman Coe Band, Quetzal Guerrero, Yogoman, Crow and the Canyon, the return of The Funk Ups, Radio Skies, Sirens of Soul, Loving You, Intrepid Travelers, Alexa Melo, Gabriel Wolfchild (from the Voice), Kelsey Sprague, John Craigie, Haley Johnson (from American Idol), Brett Hinders, Olivia De La Cruz, Marina Lagace, Whiskerman…with more TBA.

events.title: Crow and the Canyon @ Reverbia Live Nights
events.description: Portland indie-folk band with a beloved reputation that keeps music lovers returning time and time again to partake in their charismatic, heartfelt, and engaging performances. Weaving back and forth between precise bluegrass, heartland acoustic folk-rock, and bluesy country.

events.title: Dancing Before Noon
events.description: Each day Reverbia will once again bring Live Music Dancing before Noon workshops to indulge your thirst for knowledge and Dance! Our qualified teachers enjoy their work and love to get the best out of your rhythm and movement. Reverbia National and International touring musicians will be performing the Live Music for each workshop.  This years workshops will feature...Tuesday:  Samba Reggae w/ Andrea Montiero from BC. Music by Quetzal Guerrero Band.  Wednesday: Couples Blues Dancing  w/Bryna  Dunnells and Rosebud Acton...Music by Reverbia All Star Blues Band. Thursday: Belly Dancing w/Ishani Ishaya…Music by Delhi 2 Dublin/Robyn Layne.  Friday:  Samba Carnival w/Athena Rosette…Music by Quetzal Guerrero Band.  Saturday:  Afro-Brazilian w/Andrea Montiero…Music by Quetzal Guerrero/Vir McCoy/Robyn Layne.

events.title: Dark Side of the Moon Live Concert
events.description: Reverbia is proud to bring you a very special presentation of Pink Floyd's Dark Side of the Moon (full album) Live Music Concert!!  Under the Desert Night Stars, amidst the cosmic clouds of psychedelic humanity…the perfect blissful and vibrational setting for Floyd.  21 year old Rock/Indie Virtuoso Alexa Melo, honors this timeless legendary piece with her lead vocals and lead guitar…backed by a star studded cast of exceptional musical talent, including Michael Mowgli from The Mowglis on Rhythm Guitar, Christian Hand on drums...Tempe, AZ music icon Brett Hinders on keyboards, and Vir McCoy of Dogon Lights on Bass…along with other very special guests.  With the Interactive giant art globe The ORB (featured at the World's Fair in Paris) above the stage…in full light improvisational movement…this is a must see show…all cosmic Black Rock City Citizens will want to experience.

events.title: Delhi 2 Dublin @ Reverbia Live Nights
events.description: This spectacular mash-up band from Canada performs live electronic and acoustic instrumental music, with multiple world and groove-based influences.

events.title: Instinctive Song Vocal Improvisation
events.description:
Come try some basic structures to vocal improvisation, explore your creativity through music, build confidence with your voice, and co-create original songs. Using movement and the body as our starting point, we will jam, make sounds, and create music as a group. This work has been incredibly fun, healing, and musically enriching for me and I'm thrilled to be sharing it.

About Natasha:

I'm a musician, facilitator and social artist who works within the Creative Communities Model. I've studied with vocal improvisors Rhiannon (Hilo, Hawaii) and Bisia Belina (Victoria, BC) and give workshops in my home community of Yellowknife, NT, Canada.

events.title: Live Music Yoga in the Morning
events.description: Yoga with Live Music...what a beautiful combination to start your day. Join us in our Embassy Shade structure for a journey of body, mind, and soul. Reverbia is proud to return with our expert yoga teachers who will guide you through your daily poses...suitable for all levels. Come early to secure your space in the shade.

events.title: Lost Musicians of 2016 Tribute Concert
events.description: Reverbia Artists pay their honor to some of our greatest artistically musical talents who passed away in 2016.  The Concert will feature music and some sing alongs from: Bowie, Prince, Glenn Frey, and more.  This is an inaugural event for Reverbia as we hope to continue this Lost Artists Tribute Concert for years to come.  Artists performing will be: Michael Mowgli, Alexa Melo, Brett Hinders, Haley Johnson, Olivia de la Cruz, Kelsey Sprague, BRad Tidwell, Loving You, Quetzal Guerrero, Papa Bear, Leigh Jones, Gabriel Wolfchild, and more TBA.

events.title: Radio Skies @ Reverbia Live Nights
events.description: Reverbia Welcomes Radio Skies for their first year in Black Rock City.  Rapidly growing through to the Sky…this band will take you on a Psychedelic Musical Experience…where without worries you will eventually return to the ground!  From the mountains of Ojai, this collaboration of former label band artists, disregards time and space ala a more melodic Dead Phishy style of modernized transcendental folk.

events.title: Return of the Funk Ups
events.description: An All Star Cast of musician friends who tour internationally in various major groups…collaborate for a 2nd year of Reverbia pleasure in what may become one of 2016's musical concert highlights at Burning man.  With Bushwalla (Jason Mraz tours) fronting this crew verbally and vocally…and Andre de Santana (Sergio Mendes) locking in the Bass Rhythms…anything can happen…and any secret major music industry name could show up on stage (who could this rumor be)…or NOT.    Do not miss this opportunity to dance your feet to gratitude…while getting crazy funky!!

events.title: Reverbia Interactive Live Music Art Wall Mural
events.description: Reverbia presents for the first time our Reverbia Interactive Live Music Art Wall Mural!  As our Live Music resonates through your ears, share your depths of perspective and emotion through the iterative expression of Art Wall Painting. Noted Canadian artist Danielle Caners, leads an expedition into the realms of unknown, improvised art, where only through the collective creative mind, can a masterpiece be discovered.  Daily and nightly, when the live music is playing, come share your artistic expression by painting upon our mural canvas wall.  Portions of Reverbia's Art Wall Mural will be painting between established lines, while other areas of the Art Wall Mural will be free formed expression.  *Note that the Reverbia Art Wall Mural will not be open 24 hours…but will operate throughout the day and night whenever our artist supervision  is available.  During Reverbia's concerts in the Shade Series and Reverbia Live Nights…the Art Wall Mural will be the most consistently available for public painting and expression.

events.description: When the Night starts to chill…the warmth will thrill... at After Hours Jam and Tea. After Reverbia's Live Nights Concert ends…transport a few steps over with us into our cozy, warm Tea House structure..where acoustic artists and jam trios will perform sets in jam session format…as we serve you hot tea. *1 giant pot of tea will be made nightly…bring your own small cup.

Featured Night Acts will include; California Honeydrops, Delhi to Dublin, Quetzal Guerrero, The Funk Ups, Crow and the Canyon, Yogoman, Intrepid Travelers, Brett Hinders Band, Radio Skies, Sirens of Soul, Boom Human, Loving You, and a special presentation of Pink Floyd's Dark Side of the Moon - the full album live concert featuring Alexa Melo and Reverbia All Star Players.

events.title: Quetzal Guerrero @ Reverbia Live Nights
events.description: Quetzal Guerrero is a former child prodigy violinist who now performs American Soul and Rock, fused with Reggae, Hip Hop, and Afro-Brazilian rhythms. Quetzal's music translates his Latin American and Brazilian American heritage into a raw, rhythmic, melodic collaboration of music culture.  Quetzal's band members have also toured and played internationally with Sergio Mendes, Juan Fernando Velasco, and other major artists!  Come prepared to Baila, Baila, Baila!!  Delhi 2 Dublin and Buckman Coe Band will also be performing at Wednesday's Reverbia Live Nights.

events.title: Samba Carnival Dancing Before Noon
events.description: Reverbia presents a special Samba Carnival Dance Workshop…teaching participants this Brazilian cultural tradition of dance, heritage, and celebration.  Costumed in traditional Samba Carnival attire, the wonderful Athena Rosette will guide you in the traditional steps and movement of this very exotic dance style.   Quetzal Guerrero provides the live music with other All Star Reverbia musicians.  So come learn some Samba Carnival Sexy Rhythms…before the big night of Black Rock City celebration!

events.title: Samba Reggae Dancing Before Noon
events.description: Reggae and Samba Music Lovers unite! As Reverbia presents Reggae Samba Dance Before Noon, instructed by the dynamic, effervescent Andrea Monteiro of Samba Fusion and Festival: Carnival del Sol in Vancouver, BC.  QViolin aka Quetzal Guerrero will be joined by fellow All Star Reverbia Musicians.  Come learn how to get your Samba Reggae dance grooves on!!!

events.title: Song Dust Sing
events.description: Song, Dust, Sing is the premier open mic, singer/songwriter showcase at Burning Man...featuring amazing guest artists from Reverbia…as well as other artists from the furthest reaches of Black Rock City. Located on Reverbia's Shade Stage, under the large shaded and sheltered tent called The Embassy structure…performances will be shine, dust, or rain! For artists, the sound system is high quality and for the audience...the chill factor with the carpeted shade space, while listening to music...is the place for a most enjoyable afternoon. Doug Abrahams of Sunrising Artists talent agency hosts. *note to all sign up artists…SDS has a 1-2 song limit pending time and number of participants

events.title: The California Honeydrops @ Reverbia Live Nights
events.description: Fresh off their tour with Bonnie Raitt, The California Honeydrops bring their diverse R&B funk-fectious, Southern Soul, Delta Blues, New Orleans second line booty shaking, foot stomping, gospel dance music to Black Rock City for their second year in a row! Come and see what the Bay Area is raving about!

events.title: Yogoman @ Reverbia Live Nights
events.description: Reverbia is proud to return Yogoman to Reverbia Nights Live Main Stage.  Formally known as Yogoman Burning Band…(perhaps the band will re-add the latter of their former name for this one performance in Black Rock City)…this very popular festival headlining band from the NW can and will get Crazy!!!  Front vocalist and Drummer, Jordan Rain, continues to blend profound, with a wee on the silly side, lyrical content…complimenting their constant wiper blade booty shaking, funky/reggae dub beats style…which the band is now so famous for perfecting.  Bellingham hails this band as one of their favorite sons and Yogoman has toured festivals and show venues all across the West Coast...down, down into the Deep South, including their long stints on Bourbon Street in their favorite hub stop of New Orleans.

events.title: Gabriel Wolfchild
events.description:
Gabriel Wolfchild is a nationally touring singer songwriter with an earnest heart that evokes the last of the Romantic Troubadors.  Sincerity is only a real as the fragile heart exposed…and Gabriel is in tune with this channel…taking us into time and space when we were submerged in love…as the reality of our existence. 
Gabriel will be performing at Reverbia's Concerts in the Shade Series on Wednesday at 2:15 and at Reverbia Jam and Chai on Friday/Saturday morning at 1am.  You can also see Gabriel daily at Song, Dust, Sing…Reverbia's popular singer/songwriter showcase and open mic.

events.description: Having toured in all 50 of the United States, John Craigie, never seems satisfied to sit in one place too long. events.description: Ever get drunk and wondered what Marx would think about Pokemon? Or why Sartre might have turned his nose up at the 10 principles? Or how to tell if Descartes's demon is really hiding behind you? Maybe you just want to weigh in on whether Nietzsche or Kant was a bigger loser? Come have a drink and help drag philosophy out of the ivory tower and into the iron dome, out of the dusty tomes and into the just plain dust. Bring your burning questions and chilled beverages to the lowest brow of lectures.

We are an eclectic group of 30 artists, frisbee players, policy wonks, elder wise men and women, thinkers, doers, and teachers from the Bay Area, SoCal, Northwest and Midwest, excited to provide fun, entertainment and love to all inhabitants of Black Rock City.

Transform shiny foil into mind-shielding masterpieces that (allegedly) block pesky brain vibrations. We have conspiracies galore—grab string and sticky notes to map out your grand design and show how it all connects at the center: Burning Man itself! We'll supply materials (or bring your own) in our shady chill spot, open for hat-crafting adventures. Join us to "save" the world—and look fabulous doing it!

We are bringing our materials of Tin Foil to allow the freedom of expression of making hats of tin foil...WE WILL SAVE THE WORLD! We are ingesting heavy metals , By wearing Tin Foil hats we will be saving ourselves from the radio waves that vibrate those tiny bits of heavy metals within our brains...causing all types of dis ease.  We invite everyone to step right up, into our shady chill space to join our tin foil hat making 24/7....Bring your own aluminum, or some will be provided...Several Professional Tin Foil Hat Makers will be on hand to give lessons and help others shield themselves.

An oasis of luxury in the desert offering an extraordinary measure of hospitality, we set the mood for enchantment through flavored tobacco smoking, sunset ceremonies, and evening fire-dancing rituals. Hookahdome, where hedonism reigns, gentle melodies massage the senses, and respite is found from the lonely desert. In the heat enjoy the mist; in the evening warm mint tea and the hookah offer ceremony, communion, and contentment.

Welcome to The Gutter, your grungy nostalgic neighborhood bowling alley. Land marked by our towering 10-ft bowling pin, The Gutter features a two-lane bowling alley open daily for spontaneous games, wild strikes, and the occasional gutterball. Spin your way into The Spare Room, a shaded lounge and dance space, a bowling-themed bar, and a DJ booth spinning beats to keep the energy rolling. By day, join us for bowling tournaments and themed parties, and by night, get your glow on with your inner child's favorite - Cosmic Bowling. Whether you're here to strike, dance, or just chill, The Gutter is the perfect place to let the good times roll - and don't forget to ask us about our PinPal VIP program!

events.title: Tools of inner peace
events.description:
And if peace was at the heart of the world's cohesion? And if meditation was a beginning of answer to rein in human conflicts? How to contribute to more peace on earth? By embodying it in you! Come to the Inner peace keeping talk, to learn the tools to achieve inner peace in joy.
Inner peace keeping helps you fight against stress and allows you to develop well-being by reconnecting with your soul, body and spirit.
Created by a group of experts in yoga, mindfulness, emotional intelligence, neuroscience, this innovative program was first offered to humanitarian workers and refugees suffering from post-traumatic stress, depression, burnout and anxiety before being offered to everyone.
Amandine Roche became a Hatha Yoga teacher in India and studied meditation with Amma, Goenka, Dalai Lama and Karmapa. In the United States, she studied Vinyasa Yoga with Seane Corn and Mindfulness Meditation with Jon Kabat Zinn. She founded the Amanuddin Foundation in Kabul/Afghanistan to disseminate peace and non-violence education programs and teach yoga and meditation in schools, prisons, the army, women's centers and the Taliban. .She has just found inner peace Corps to heal the invisible wounds of war and restore human dignity with Art in Middle East.

events.title: Authentic Embodyment
events.description: “Authentic Embodiment” is a guided conscious dance practice that brings us to the present moment through a deep connection to one’s body and people around us. When we start listening to our body and allowing ourselves to be curious, we open up to the creative energy that starts flowing through us. We become a life force that is always present, always embodied. This practice is inspired by and includes teachings of myriad conscious movement modalities such as 5Rhythms, Soul Motion, Dancing Freedom, Azul and many others. It is open to everyone, regardless of physical ability, fitness or prior dance experience.

events.title: Breath of One
events.description:
A life-changing transcendental breathing practice that will open our heart, silent our minds and connect us with divinity. Ready to heal..and to fly?


It is a unique combination both ancient and modern techniques from all over the world. There are some aspects of Merkaba Activation, Tantra, Breath of Fire and Holotropic Breathwork. ‘Breath of One’ allows us to experience different dimensions of reality and to feel the vibration of the universe. The technique is as powerful as magical. Almost everybody who has experienced it described it as mind blowing, many as life changing, some others as the most powerful moment of their life.



I have thought the ‘Breath of One’ to nearly 4,000 people all over the world. The 3 times at camp Mystic were always some of the most powerful ones. The intensity of the journey depends on the person and on which moment you are in your life. It will range from a body feeling of ecstasy and peace, until space and time travel. The healing coming from the practice is hard to be described with words. It will allow us to experience breakthroughs, setting ourselves free from blockages and pain, heal deep wounds and traumas, find answers and directions for our life, get connections with other dimensions and (when the channels are deeply open) leave our body for astral journeys! If you follow the breathing it is 100% guarantee that something profound and truly beautiful will happen to you.

THE MORE OPEN TO RECEIVE LOVE AND THE MORE OPEN MINDED WE WILL BE, THE HIGHER LEVEL OF CONSCIOUSNESS WE WILL BE ABLE TO EXPERIENCE.

events.title: From Croesus To Crypto
events.description:
In the early days of humanity, communities were decentralized, but not connected. As civilized humanity evolved, there was an initial need for central authority figures to help guide and shape society. We started with emperors, then kings, then a feudal system. Then came the industrial revolution, the internet age and globalisation. With each step we have seen staged decentralization and greater freedoms as humanity has evolved emotionally and spiritually. 

We are now seeing the exciting development and uptake of distributed ledger technology that is blossoming into a multitude of opportunities to further evolve and empower a more equitable society with broader distribution of freedoms, and material and spiritual wealth and empowerment. We want to take you beyond the hype, scams and greed and chart humanity's epic journey towards a fully decentralized and equitable society and show you how you can participate in what we believe to be the next stage of human evolution that will allow us to reach our full spiritual potential.

events.title: What the Heck is Leadership? A Scientific Approach
events.description:
Jason Gore runs an executive coaching firm for fast-growing startups.  They firm primarily work with highly-innovative companies that will reshape a given industry or domain.  

Many of their clients are young engineers who suddenly found themselves leading large teams.  They needed to learn what “good leadership” was, identify their blind spots, practice new communication skills, and improve their ability to lead.  After conducting 100s of leadership assessments, the firm has been able to scientifically define what good leadership is when it comes to building teams and innovating in the startup environment.

In this interactive presentation, Jason, the firm's cofounder, will share some of their discoveries, how leadership can be defined, and most-importantly, how what we learn by co-creating in community turns out to be the exact same skills that leaders are learning at startups.  

Festivals like Burning Man are more than just a good time—they are a training ground for leaders, community, and innovation. There’s a reason that many startup leaders go to Burning Man and other festivals. 

Together, we’ll look at what we have already learned about leadership though our community experiences and how to apply those skills to leadership in the default world.  Everyone in the audience will also receive a self-assessment (printed or online) to identify areas that they could improve.

events.title: Camp To CampUS
events.description:
There are more than 50 million innocent displaced people that had to flee for war, poverty, injustice or climate change. The average stay of a refugee in a camp is 17 years. Since WWII the hosting and management of a refugee community in such camps has not changed. Till the day of today refugee camps are harsh survival environments where people risk exploitation, are hopeless and rules of the strongest apply. 

After being involved in the epicenter of the refugee crisis on the Greek island of Lesvos I came to the knowledge that there is such a big difference to be made in this global issue if we would stop seeing refugees, victims of injustice. Instead we should approach them as individuals with talents, opportunities equal to our own standards and with the same needs. We should be aware that if we would invest in people that have lost everything this investment will be returned to us in gratefulness and willingness to contribute in their own succes. You get what you give...

In creating communities that thrive you should start with environments that inspire. On Lesbos, the epicenter of the refugee crisis in Europe last year, I witnessed the similarities in dynamics between hosting refugees on a refugee camp and hosting a crowd on a music festival. We believe many insights from the festival industry can be integrated to redefine a refugee camp from a Spartan fashionlike environment to an inspiring festivallike experience.

Adding to the festival game innovative solutions/companies, educational programs and integration of the refugee community in the management and self-sustainability of their camp will create an environment of harmony and dignity that will be an example in how to change a global issue into an opportunity that can serve humanity on a global scale. 

Join me in this quest to redefine the global concept of a refugee camp to a campUS.
