Description: Kizomba Burning Man presents: Meditation Kizomba
Join #DanceNinja ""E"" to learn the connection, intimacy, and meditative aspects of the fast-becoming popular sensual dance from Angola called Kizomba. Understand how to roll your body with the music, be mindful of how your partner feels, surrender...to the dance. Bring a partner or come alone. "

events.title: Merkaba: Tasting The Infinite Through Breath
events.description:
In this dynamic presentation & event participants will literally learn and practice how to 'plug themselves into the Infinite.' Utilizing our physiology and breath we will be co-creating a Merkabah Light Body Activation.
Merkabah activation is a 3000 years old breathing technique that allows to open a portal in our heart chakra. This will bring us to feel the vibrations and the energy of the universe. The intensity of the technique depends on the person, ranging from an incredible feeling of ecstasy, until space and time journeys. Being a technique that connects with the inner and higher self, it will also allows to experience breakthroughs, get answers about our lives, solve problems that we didn't even know to have. The more open to receive love and the more open minded we will be, the more we will get from this practice. The technique is as powerful as magical. Almost everybody that have experienced it, described it as mind blowing, many as life changing, some others as the most powerful moment of their life.
Prepare to experience yourself in Totality!

events.title: Music as Medicine: The Easy Way To Heal
events.description:
Music is one of the easiest and most fun ways to heal our hearts and rewire our negative patterns. Learn how to use this timeless remedy to realize your deepest intentions. 

During this interactive event, you'll get access to several of the most talented medicine musicians around and we'll talk about:

- How to use music as a transformational tool
- How to choose the music that will accelerate your healing
- The catalytic power of singing
- The relationship between feeling your emotions and being a talented singer
- Different approaches to creating healing songs
- Healing our world, one song at a time.
Join us!

events.title: Mystic Presents: An Evening of Troubadours
events.description: Come for a relaxing evening featuring some of the finest acoustic musicians this side of the Man. Come as you are and let the sounds of the Troubadours and the magic of the Mystic Theater drop you in a few layers deeper. Featuring Joe Muscatello, Josh Z., Ariana Hall, and more.

events.title: Phrygianism and the Refoamation
events.description:
Adam Eidinger spills the beans on organizing creative direct action as an art form. A leader in the camp Refoamation, Adam's philosophy of Phrygianism combines citizen action, psychedelics and civil defense.  In 2014 Adam legalized marijuana in Washington, DC and will talk strategy.  He'll also speak about the Liberty Cap and its role for thousands of years connecting liberation struggles since Roman times as well the to cap's connection to psychedelic spirituality in the Mithra tradition

Adam has been arrested 18 times fighting for justice in the Belly of the Beast, Washington, DC.  He is the social action director for Dr. Bronner's Magic Soaps and is the foam OG who first set up the magic foam at Burning Man with Kris Bronner in 2009.  Since then he's helped lead the Dr. Bronner' camp (called Refoamation in 2016) as it has expanded its perfoaming activities.  Adam has been making creative plans for major protests since 2000.  His talk will reveal practical tips and advice for anyone activist or non-activist.  Adams lives by the creed of Ralph Nader who once said, "If you don't turn onto politics, politics will turn on you."

events.title: Pleasurable Movement: Awaken Your Sensual Body
events.description: Your body is a sensual creature designed to be enjoyed. Movement is the quickest, most effective way to tap into your body's wisdom and pleasure

events.title: Reimagining the Village
events.description:
"Intentional living, micro-communities, sustainable developments, matriarchies: What does the next generation of conscious housing arrangements look like?

How can we create happier, healthier, more sustainable human developments, facilitating an evolution of consciousness through innovating and architecting the future through our homes?

Sustainable, tribal micro-communities are the future of this planet: come to hear experts discuss intentional community formation - what works, what doesn't, best practices, and how we can evolve consciousness through innovative tribal architecture."

events.title: Regenetarian Dietary Movement & Choice
events.description: The REGENETARIAN vision is a new dietary movement and identity that chooses only food sourced from regenerative farmers and ranchers.

events.title: Start your own town!
events.description: It sometime seems as if things are grim and change could just never come about in the places where we live. With extreme divide in our government, a broken food system and environmental degradation continuously getting worse, what can we possibly do to change things? I say, start an ecological community with all of your favorite people in the most ideal climate where conscious choice and intentional design are integral to your decision making. I will guide you on my journey in Costa Rica in creating community on a crystal clear river with deep pools where dripping fruit trees line the roads and neighbors care about each other and are dedicated to improving our world.

events.title: The #1 Shortcut to Emotional Intelligence
events.description: If your emotions ever get the best of you, come learn the #1 shortcut to emotional intelligence so you can get the best out of them instead.

events.title: The Anatomy of AHA: The neuroscience of the moment
events.description: The sudden moment of insight is at the heart of creativity, motivation and even sustained human change for people of all ages. It turns out that understanding the science of insight can help us have more of them, or make the ones we have more useful. Join Dr. David Rock as he shares the deeper science of the AHA moment, how to have more of them, how to bring others to insight, and even how to increase insights across large systems.

events.title: The Art of Flow: The Key to Effortless Living
events.description:
"In this deeply transformational, interactive workshop, Jackie and Justin will be sharing the key principles and practices you will need to master to start living fully in the flow and experience how effortless, abundant and free your life can become.  People who master the art of living in flow often feel as if the universe is conspiring in their favor as everything they want and need to be successful, grow and live a truly extraordinary life begins to come to them effortlessly and in perfect synchronicity.  Once you have experienced it, there is no other way to live.

Expect to walk away having integrated a deep understanding of:

+ What the flow is and how to identify the choices and actions which will you bring into alignment with it
+ How to create exponential success and growth in your life and business from a place of effortlessness and flow
+ Techniques for accessing and getting in touch with your intuition and inner wisdom for crystal clear guidance on which path will be the most effortless and fulfilling for you
+ How to let go of struggle, suffering and the fear of surrendering control to the wisdom of life and move into a profound place of trust
+ Simple but powerful practices to be able to call in whatever support and resources you need to further your journey of expansion, personal and spiritual growth and be successful living your passion and giving your gifts to the world"

events.title: The Art of Sensual Rope Bondage
events.description: Bring a partner and learn the intimate erotic art of seduction and sensual rope bondage. The class will be heart-centered, experiential, and hot. Rope provided. Arrive early to secure a spot.

events.title: The Evolutionary Psychology of Polyamory
events.description: Are human naturally monogamous or promiscuous?  Neither view makes sense given what we've learned about human sexual psychology in the last couple of decades. Most of us seem to have evolved over the last million years to be polyamorous by nature. But we are socialized into monogamist mating norms that amplify sexual jealousy, reduce compersion, stifle our sexual sovereignty, and limit the social networks that we instinctively try to build through lovers and metamours. In this talk, a leading evolutionary psychology professor (author of 'The Mating Mind', 'Spent', and 'Mate') will give a quick, fun overview of the new science behind poly. Then we'll have a Q&A.

events.title: The Gift: Culture, Economy, Cosmology
events.description: Gift as a mystery portal, ecological principle, gateway to synchronicity, and bridge between the mundane and the miraculous.

events.title: The Myth of Authenticity (& the Truth of Intimacy)
events.description: Like an electron that can't be directly observed, our "truth" is a vector at best, a nebulous arrow pointing toward an empty center. Good thing that vector is the evolutionary impulse itself. Experience it firsthand in this interactive hour, then spread it around. The more you spread it, the more you get it – that's the magic of love. The playa will never be the same, and neither will your relationships.

events.title: Transforming a City with Art
events.description: The many benefits of public arts in the development of neighborhoods and cities.

events.title: True Love: Beyond Power, Status & Sexuality
events.description:
“Everything in the world is about sex except sex. Sex is about power.”
Oscar Wilde's words have great explanatory and predictive power, but I'm curious about the limits of this model. 
Where & how does Love come in?
Could True Love honor our drives for power and sex by holding them sacred and taking them with us to the next level? Come explore these themes:
    -How does power & sexuality constrain or inspire intimacy?
    -What's the relationship between fear, control & sex
    -Influence & immortality -the ultimate power
    -Can a conscious partnership creatively co-op our need for control?
    -Could True Love offer a map through the power struggle?
    -Why we fuck? Why we fuck off?
Join us for a edgy exploration of how these important ideas intersect. Bring your taboo questions & leave all assumptions at the door.

history.description: Camp Mystic  has a 15 + year history as a theme camp at burning man. We are a group of extraordinary thought leaders, authors, speakers, entrepreneurs, teachers, aritsts, musicians, and healers who provide visionary art installations, live music and performance from some of burning man's best artists, and a series of speakers and workshopw who offer their wisdom  to the playa on topics ranging from emerging civilization, human development, sexuality, relationship, post modern spirituality, the burning man ethos, and more.

events.title: Reclaim Your Erotic Innocence:
events.description: Pleasure has the power to stimulate creativity & replenish energy. But the morality of guilt & shame has prevented us from being comfortable with enjoying these benefits. Until now.

events.title: Activating Your Creative Feminine Magic
events.description:
This workshop is about working with the magical, creative energy of Burning Man to create a plan-of-action to bring your unique offering to the world.  When you are holding onto your creative expression, your gifts, your particular genius, or pretending not to know what it is, it's gets very uncomfortable after a while. It will start itching inside of you to be created in physical form, it's deepest desire is to be born out of the dream space. You came to Planet Earth to share this, now is your time. Calling all healers, conversation-starters, rebels, light-workers, and medicine women. This workshop is broken down into four magical sections. 

1) Connection. How relating to others is the number one function of your business or passion project. We begin the workshop with getting connected on the soul level to your fellow sisters.
2) Reclaiming Your Unique Brilliance. Refining your message and creating something in the world that is unique, contributive, and that people will pay for. 
3) Healing Your Relationship With Money. Girl, if you want to start or expand your business, you've got to look at your drama and trauma with money. What would it be like if money flowed to you with ease? What would it be like if you could actually receive it? We will dive into this exploration together.
4) Closing Ritual. Our closing ritual will include a beautiful ceremony to hold each others intentions and desires as we go create in the world. You will be let into a "light-share" experience.

events.title: Alternatives to Marriage
events.description: Traditionally the way to commit has been Marriage, with over 50% of marriages ending in divorce, many are looking for a different solution.  Many see value in a commitment of some sort but what are the options? What is working for people and what is not.  Come explore alternatives to marriage in a very interactive discussion/workshop.  There are other ways to commit, come explore those with us in a fun way.

events.title: Authentic Communication
events.description:
Learn how to connect more deeply with your partner of five years or someone you met just five minutes ago.

Learn language and communication skills that allow you to express how you are feeling while taking 100 percent responsibility for your experience.

Communicate in a way that shows the other person that you were listening and that you understand them.

events.title: Ayla Nereo sunrise set @ Camp Mystic
events.description:
THURS morning at 6:30 AM ~ Join Ayla at Camp Mystic to sing in the wildness of the heart and greet the dawning sun. With an array of loop-pedals by her side, she builds layer upon layer of vocal melodies into fierce, sweeping harmonies and weaves syncopated threads of guitar, kalimba, piano, and percussion into each live performance. 

Her lucid storytelling and lyrical imagery are water for the thirsty soul; words and sounds that crack open the heart, and embody the many folds of our own selves. Crafting an immersive soundscape we can dive into, Ayla’s performance becomes a journey: an inspired, wondrous experience that holds you by the heart and doesn’t let go.

www.aylanereo.com
Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/ayla.nereo.music
LISTEN: http://soundcloud.com/ayla-nereo

events.title: Becoming the Parent you Always Wanted
events.description: Your childhood was fucked up.  Duh. How not to carry over the patterns, trauma and conditioning to your own children by becoming the secure, self-assured parent you always wanted.

events.title: Change how the World relates to you
events.description: Want more power, passion and purpose?  Synchronicities, synergies and serendipities?  Come to this deep dive into a evolutionary new paradigm of relating to the World as yourself.

events.title: Communication mastery: from bedrooms to boardrooms
events.description: Communication is at the foundation of every interaction we have.  Come learn some of the most valuable tools you'll ever encounter – tools that work in any environment, with people of any age, to generate outstanding connection and rapport.  We'll explore active listening and positive intent, and learn a unique form of mirroring that naturally lifts any conversation – and has a remarkable impact on the voices in your head.

events.title: Dancing Freedom with Samantha Beers
events.description: Join Samantha Sweetwater for her signature ecstatic, somatic & shamanic movement journey.  Unlock your full capacity for embodied awakening, authenticity, creativity, empowerment, intimacy and JOY.  This is the Happy Hummingbird Medicine you've been seeking to balancing your Eagle Visionary Mind and your Condor Heart.

events.title: From Sex to Superconsciousness
events.description:
Totally embrace your wild erotic nature with your partner, letting go of sexual conditioning and repression to experience the free flow of your sexuality. 

Then using a process of chakra toning, breathing and energy activation - feel how you can use the power of your sexuality to launch into deep states of meditation and bliss. 

Finish with profound intimate connection with your partner. 

(Bring a partner!!)

This is perfect for beginners and advanced Tantric practitioners.  ~Layla Martin.

events.title: Imagineering The Future
events.description: The future that's emerging is one that can be described more and more as a "design it and create it" reality, and this will be a conversation about how art and design can be used to develop your creative imagination - in the service of creating the future that we each want to manifest, with Eben Pagan.

events.title: Individual healing sessions in a beautiful oasis
events.description: Individual healing sessions in the beautiful oasis of our healing sanctuary.  Come to experience massage, energetic healing, anointings, body work, and other intuitive healings to get you centered, relaxed, and rejuvenated.

events.title: Life-Force Dynamic: An Exploration of Human Energy
events.description:
" An introduction to human energetic system and how the ancient mystical traditions of India, China, and Europe interweave to create the foundational elements for an integral spiritual practice - the control of the human vessel through postures (asana) + breath control (pranayama)  + mental focus (mantra). Includes 2-hour physical practice of Qigong & Yoga that will prepare you for the burn.

There will be an explanation of Traditional Indian Medicine (Yoga/Ayurveda) and Traditional Chinese Medicine (Qi Gong/Taoism), two ancient healing systems over 2000 years old. There will be an exploration on the difference between the Indian Hinduism (Polytheistic) & Chinese Taoism (Monotheistic) theories and how we can integrate these two philosophies into our daily spiritual practice to empower ourselves.

The discussion will then be followed by a 2 hour Yoga & Qi Gong class which will blend together the elements of ancient India (Yoga) and China (Qi Gong) to provide a dynamic moving meditation focused on providing a balance of both Yang (active) and Yin (passive) elements, that will conclude with a healing Yoga Nidra (conscious deep sleep) meditation - leaving you empowered, focused, and energized - ready for the burn and the new year. "

events.title: Manifesting Magic On The Playa
events.description: This will be a fun and interactive talk on some of the different tools and methods that allow Burning Man to become your personal vortex of manifestation. Attendees will receive stories, examples and new ideas that allow them to use Burning Man as their experimental magic playground. Bring an open mind and any magic you’ve already got.

events.title: Men's Authentic Personal Expression
events.description: I am a  woman who has focused herself over the last year on providing empowerment to already successful male entrepreneurs and thought leaders, supporting the purity of what legacy they leave behind by helping them with everything from how they deliver who they are to the world, to working out their heart and personal logistics, I have developed the "50 Points of Attractiveness" and tested it to success. I have 18 years coaching authentic self-expression, including 4 TEDx talks. 22 years studying people / human interaction via songwriting (and expressing my findings artfully). 28 years as a performer in various capacities, especially singing. In my career I've presented music and talks for over 100,000 people. Also, I've spent the last full year doing a deep dive into femininity/polarity studies. I am an advocate for men being empowered (especially as women claim their power more and more), and attaining the capacity to leave legacies. This includes knowing how to navigate matters of the heart. Overall, I really LOVE showing men how to feel happy and free professionally, publicly, and personally by learning how to express themselves authentically. So much of this revolves around a man's ability to limit drama and distraction in his life.

events.title: Mystic Presents: An Evening of Troubadours & More
events.description: Come for a relaxing evening featuring some of the finest acoustic musicians this side of the Man, plus other short variety offerings.  Show up however you are and let the sounds of the Troubadours and the ambience of the Mystic Theater drop you in a layer deeper.  Featuring Ariana Hall, Joe Muscatello, Josh Z., and more.

events.title: Psychedelic Renaissance
events.description: We will talk about how psychedelics are changing the fields of modern psychiatry, stimulating the rehabilitation revolution and becoming part of the broad based cultural landscape.  We will also share trends in the current research, outline best practices, set up the prescription for psychedelic success and unveil the launch of PRISM - the Psychedelic Research Institute for Science and Medicine in Mexico.

events.title: Rule-Breaking Evolutionary Love Relationships
events.description:
A practical guide to the shortest path to your higher self through the loving (and sometimes critical) eyes of your beloved.

Learn how to use romantic love to unwind and heal your historical pain (and your partners) to reveal your true self - more magnificent than you currently have the capacity to imagine - and dissolve the boundaries between purpose and money, sex and creativity, partnership and self, and unleash the power of dyadic leadership (using duality the way it was designed to be used!)

Taught by Jennifer Russell and Bryan Franklin, teachers and leaders-by-example of radical evolutionary love, as depicted by Android Jones in their now world-famous portrait and upcoming documentary by the same name, "Union."

events.title: Sex Magic + Cosmic Orgasms for Women
events.description:
We'll go through a series of full-bodied orgasmic practices to open your body to maximum possible pleasure, ecstasy and aliveness. 

Then we'll do a sex magic journey so you can harness your sexual energy to manifest whatever you want. 

This is a super safe space to explore and create together as women as well as tap into you deepest erotic potential so you can have epic sex on the Playa.

events.title: Social Artists: How Our Creations Impact The World
events.description: As artists, we remake the world in our image - our imaginings. Given that we have this gift, how do we receive it in a way that allows us to create a more connected, open-hearted, and spiritually authentic world? A full-body/heart/soul experiential workshop through the four realms of human consciousness, where we will unlock our imaginal bodies, meet some of our "inner crew," become our own superheroes, and experience the oneness of our good ol' friend, the Universe.

events.title: Soul Sister Circle
events.description: The soul sisters' path is deep and sweet...and sometimes, it's a little lonely too.  Are you longing to connect with more mystic sisters of our illuminated Black Rock City?  Do you need your deepest heart's desire witnessed, held and cherished by other women?  Come dive into the experience of soul-sisterhood at Camp Mystic and plant your dreams in our fertile loving soul.

events.title: The #1 Shortcut to Emotional Intelligence
events.description: If your emotions ever get the best of you, come learn the #1 shortcut to emotional intelligence so you can get the best out of them.

events.title: The Art of Sensation Play with Philippe Lewis
events.description: In this fun, hot and playful class, you will begin to expand your repertoire of touch skills and role play. First you will learn simple yet powerful embodied ways to interact somatically with others such as caresses, nails, bites/nibbles, light hair pulling, grabbing, kissing, light spanking, pushing/pulling, wrestling/pinning, flirting/teasing, and more. Next, you will learn and practice simple fun roles to use these skills with, such as the inner animal, the god/goddess, the nymph, and the fairy. All skills and roles will be taught in a container of consent to make all engagements pleasurable and powerfully transformative for everyone.Looking forward to playing with you!

events.title: The Canopy Tribe: Sleep in Temple Trees
events.description:
Remember the most majestic tree you have ever experienced?

Did you have enough time to celebrate it? To dream with it?

Majestic trees give living form to the most diverse places on Earth. When they disappear, unseen, the world flattens. These trees are becoming rare. And valuable.

The Canopy Tribe helps others to sleep in majestic trees. To have time to dream – and radically self express.

Three-minute crash courses in tree hunting, tree climbing, tree campouts, tree house building and tree circus.

Acrobats, architects, artists, arborists, tree huggers welcome.

events.title: The Four Faces Of Incorruptible Personal Power
events.description:
"Where are the positive archetypes of feminine power? Kali, who cuts off your head? Hera, who is the god form of holly homemaker: basically “Zeus’ wife” with a goddess-sized jealous streak? Wonder Woman, who battles evil but has no family and no love in her life? It’s time for us to tell a new story of femininity, with our choices, with our self-expression, and with our lives. There are too few positive examples of women who are in full command of their sexuality and its attractive powers. There are too few healthy stories of women who’s full creative expression is unbridled and uncontrolled.

Learn how to harness the dual feminine forms and dual masculine forms of power in each of your interactions and become a true manifestor - brining your highest vision into reality through your being, your words, and your actions.You will learn an unforgettable map of your own sources of power, some of which have been lying dormant for your entire life. Once you can locate and allow all four faces of incorruptible power to move through you, you can lead, inspire, and serve almost anyone.  For Men and Women who want to bring their full spiritual presence into the material world and be the bridge between our present reality and the future vision only you can see."

events.title: The Journey of a Conscious Entrepreneur
events.description: Having been both a blissed out artist and yoga teacher and a stressed-out tech executive, Michel Bayan has seen both sides of the "spiritual spectrum."  He'll share a bit about his journey then we'll open up for a group chat about how we all seek to find balance between going after what we want, without letting it overtake you, and seeking peace without mental apathy.   Come share, ask, or just listen.

events.title: The World Congress for a New Civilization
events.description: The United Nations, for all its good, it not enough.  We need a new, more representative global meeting ground for those seeking to replace our current civilization with something better. In 2016, delegations of current and future leaders from every nation on Earth will gather together for a week to develop a set of common principles for a politically and environmentally sustainable society in the 21st Century. Come learn more from Jim Clark, the founder of the World Congress for a New Civilization. Jim is the founder of the World Technology Network, a former director of a Bill Clinton presidential campaign, a former Harvard faculty member, and TEDx Black Rock City speaker.

events.title: Transcending Shame, Guilt & Envy
events.description:
There are many things you 'could' do, but there's nothing you 'should' do. I suspect there's no such thing as a 'should'. A should is a 'could' with shame smuggled on top of it. Come explore shame and its cousins: guilt, envy, anger and jealousy. All these emotions have one thing in common, they usually hide their tracks and are hard to admit. Learn to transcend your shame with cutting edge subjective tools. We'll investigate the nature of shame & shaming, look at the adaptive advantages of them and how they serve & do not serve our development.

Join love coach Annie Lalla for some powerful exercises that will help you move beyond past shames and show you how desist from laying down new ones. This is a forum to discuss how to experience our emotions, especially the difficult ones, so they stop haunting your psyche.  You will leave shameless or at least shamelessly.

events.title: We Are Evolution with Samantha Beers
events.description: We Are Evolution:  How does evolution function as the sure intelligence of life?  How are you, as a human being, a key part of shaping the future?  Why are people (and our unique, yet not special, souls) particularly important to the patterns of biological and consciousness evolution in our Galaxy at this time?  Join High Priestess and Regenerative Design Expert, Samantha Sweetwater for this interactive playshop where you will learn how to surf the integral & biological mechanisms of evolution.  Find and amplify your unique place and point of leverage in the soul ecology of Life.  Uplevel your present sense of purpose.  And, together with all others present, discover how to co-cause the future we want.

history.description: The Hearth offers a sanctuary of warmth and rejuvenation in the heart of the playa. Step into our cozy squish space filled with cushions and comfort where you can rest your weary body while connecting with fellow burners. Rejuvenate in our steam room, where heat and community combine to cleanse both body and spirit. Stay hydrated with our refreshing spa water station offering cucumber, strawberry, and other infusions throughout the day. As the sun sets, gather around our bubbling cauldron for a nourishing bowl of soup served daily. The Hearth welcomes all who seek restoration, connection, and the simple comfort of being cared for before venturing back into the dust and wonder of Black Rock City.
We are the art support camp building the Moonlight Library. Come visit our camp to meet the artists, and enjoy some hot sake at our sake bar.

We are the art support camp associated with The Prairie of Possibilities, a meditative field of glowing prairie grass in deep playa. This camp provides space for our creators to live, relax, and rejuvenate. Stop by for a preview of our installation, get to know us, and find out more about the inception of our art project and what it took to build it!

Scientists associated with the Moonlight Collective have been studying the phenomena known as the Prairie of Possibilities since the 1960's. It is apparently heading for the Playa; plans are under way to intercept and study this mysterious yet mesmerizing field of glowing, swaying prairie grass. Visit the Moonlight Collective Field Camp for morning tea, review their research, and record your own story to be shared with the Prairie Entity.

history.description:
From Deep within the Valhalla mountains of BC Canada

MythMaker merges the ancient arts of storytelling & theatre with the dramatic skills of the circus arts creating a
multidisciplinary art experience, delving into the mystical, magical and profound. Performances include theatre, music, dance and ceremonies, including the dynamic circus arts of fire spinning, acrobatics, aerials and stilt walking.
Their multi-dimensional performances strive to
integrate a new cultural mythology through ritualistic performance art inspiring a new dream, which empowers the individual and community to co-create a sustainable future for all life.

The Gayatri Shanti is to offer rides to those that wish to join us while having a mobile space for those that will share their dreams, both good and bad, by writing them down on a piece of parchment paper to burn. That paper will be placed in a sealed wooden ballot box. That box will be taken to the temple to be for release and transmutation, once the temple burns. 

This will offer those that have participated to have a chance to release any negative things that they wish to let go of, by writing them down, and then having them burn. This process will also help those who wish to see their dreams manifest, and will then have the chance to have this happen by adding those dreams to the box for transmutation.

We will offer yoga, meditation, pranayama, sounds bowls, shamanic drumming, tarot readings, and dream interpretation along with a few other gifts that are in alignment with the Waking Dreams theme, while we are traveling across the playa. These gifts, for those that wish to participate, will help foster release, connection, growth, sharing, healing, and so much more. It will be magical!

events.title: Vietnamese Iced Coffee Experience (VICE)
events.description:
Vietnamese Iced Coffee Experience (VICE) is eager to return for its 17th year; serving up a delicious hand crafted iced beverage to our dusty fellow participants. 

The VICE process requires a minimum of seven servers to boil water, brew each cup, carefully measure sweetened condensed milk in to reusable cups, supervisor participants thoroughly mixing their beverage before adding the appropriate scoop full of ice.  We then have a health department approved process for cleaning and returning our utensils to service.

As we serve our beverage in reusable cups our patrons tend to take their time consuming their beverage on premises.  We provide and manage bicycle parking to ensure traffic flow and safety. Guests enjoy live entertainment - encouraging the crowd to participate in joke telling, sing alongs, and self-expression etc.

history.description: Vietnamese Iced Coffee Experience is an all inclusive Burning Man Theme Camp. We encourage diversity, participation, and acceptance and welcome new members from all locales and walk of life.  Our camp commitments are minimal, as such we do expect members to be radically self sufficient when it comes to personal needs although we're more than happy to help out with pre-event planning and support in extreme situations.  Participating in our afternoon coffee service is more reward than obligation and we also offer several community directed activities for those that wish to participate.  We have camp events during the week to ensure everyone feels included.  We'd be happy to welcome you to join our group.  Contact us for more information!

The original and still the best steam bath experience.
Step into a world of relaxation and rejuvenation at The Steam Bath Project. Located at the heart of Burning Man, our camp offers a unique and immersive experience inspired by the soothing power of steam. Enter our tranquil oasis and indulge in the therapeutic benefits of steam bathing, surrounded by the sights, sounds, and scents of the desert. Our Lavender Lounge provides a sanctuary for participants to unwind and prepare for their steam bath adventure, while interactive elements engage the senses and foster community connection. Join us for a journey of self-discovery and renewal, where the principles of radical inclusion, communal effort, and radical self-expression come to life.
The first and still the best steam bath on the playa. Since 2001 we have been providing a unique and transformative experince at Burningman.

Using the ages old system of thermal siphoning we use the Japanese Chofu stove to create and circulate the steam in an insulation and wood tongue and groove dome.  In the past we have been interviewed by the Earth Guardians for our economical use of water. We use less than .25 of a gallon of water per steamer and which offer a completely different option to showering on the playa. We have a double sub pump system that drains into our village grey water system which is pumped out. We are part of a Nectar village which is completely solar run. As a camp we participate in a with other camps for kitchen and infrastructure needs.
Steam Bath Project offers a playa twist on the ritual cleansing tradition and embraces the possibility of transformation. Experience the Steam project that started the trend. Daily Noon-6PM.

events.title: Non-violent communication
events.description:
Have you ever found yourself...
- wanting to express dissatisfaction at someone’s behaviour but refrained from doing so in order not to cause an upset?
- Appreciating an action or words of someone yet refrained from expressing gratitude to that person?
- Expressing dissatisfaction at someone’s behaviour only to find that the situation deteriorated instead of improved?
If you can relate to these questions, this workshop may be right for you! It  aims to provide you with an effective model to reformulate your communication and thereby enrich your, and your surroundings’ lives. Meaningful and life-enriching communication is much simpler and more rewarding than you may have previously believed. 
The workshop presents a model called Non-Violent-Communication, which was developed by Marshall Rosenberg.

The People of Color Camp is what happens when The Muppet Show gets put in the same telepod as an episode of The Fresh Prince of Bel Air, MTV's The Real World and a debate at the United Nations.

history.description: For the past several years, we have brought a reimagined Globe Theater to the Playa and  we have filled it with people witnessing one another speak and play with joy, passion, abandon, imagination, irreverence, humor and pathos. events.title: To be or Not to Be Tarot Bar
events.description: You shuffle our specially made Shakespeare tarot deck as you gaze out at the Playa. Maybe you have a question; maybe you just let your mind roam as you gaze out. Then you pick a card which has a major arcana on one side and a fitting piece of Shakespeare text on the back. Perhaps The Lovers. Then you step up onto our stage. One of us stands behind you and feeds you the first line of text, almost at a whisper. “My story being done. She gave me for my pains a world of sighs.” Othello, Act 1, Scene 3. You speak the text at full volume to the Playa. And then we feed you the next line and the next...You get to be a Shakespearean actor speaking a full monologue under the wild desert sky. The card is yours to keep and your assignment is to find another opportunity to speak the text again before you leave. Liquid courage is served to those who may need it before they can speak.

events.title: Every Brilliant Thing
events.description:
When Mum’s in the hospital and Dad says she’s ‘done something stupid’, there’s not much a seven year old can do.

1. Ice cream
2. Water fights
3. Staying up past your bedtime and being allowed to watch TV.

These are the first three items on a list of every brilliant thing in the world worth living for. Duncan MacMillan’s play Every Brilliant Thing pulls back the curtain on what it’s like to be a child of a suicidal mother and the lengths we go for those we love. Based on both true and untrue stories, Every Brilliant Thing is a life-affirming tale of how to achieve hope through focusing on the smallest miracles of life. 

Audience interactivity is KEY to this show so come be a part of bringing this story to life!

events.title: The Decentralized Dance Party - A Battle Plan For
events.description:
"The Decentralized Dance Party (or “DDP”) is an Open-Source Party Movement on a mission to unite the world in Celebration and win the Nobel Peace Prize for Partying. 

The DDP is a giant roaming street Party with no Central audio source and no Central location, created using an FM radio transmitter to broadcast music and voice to hundreds of boomboxes, carried by thousands of participants.

Early on, it was realized that this unique new form of social alchemy had a near-limitless potential to unite humanity and Tom and Gary dedicated their lives to spreading the movement globally.

And it was rapidly ascertained that this mission would require hosting a Simultaneous Global Dance Party to earn the Nobel Peace Prize for Partying.

This was not a joke.

These Parties completely transform public space, creating revolutionary new environments where total strangers can instantly connect on a deep human level.

Within these “temporary autonomous zones”, community spontaneously arises and social healing takes place on an unprecedented scale. It's the opposite of violence. A unique new means of “Waging Peace”.

Join Gary and friends for a rousing talk on the history of this global movement and how to join the Party Revolution!
Hosted by Gary Lachance in Anahasana Village (on F street at ~6:40) in Dome 2"

events.title: Decentralized Science As A Tool For Curing Aging
events.description:
The scientific establishment is failing us. Biopharma is not producing cures, only treating symptoms keeping you sick for longer. 

Enter DeSci, a web3 movement inspired by DeFi, making use of the new cryptoeconomic principles to redesign incentives and disrupt research funding, peer review, scientific publishing, laboratory services, etc

The longevity field is mostly dismissed by the incubments, just like crypto. 

Aging is the root cause of most chronic conditions, like heart disease, alzheimer's, cancer, diabetes, etc. 

Why do we have to cure aging? 

Especially extrapolating the economics, it's unsustainable: we have more people over 65 than under 5. Most of the kids are in developing countries (inverted pyramid). Medicare costs will explode

events.title: Revolutionary Futures Made Possible By The Spatial
events.description:
We'll focus on multiple decentralizing and potentially democratizing technologies including blockchains, the spatial web, the metaverse, artificial intelligence, the internet of things and cryptocurrencies, and how their convergence will impact the future of business, governance and society. For example, permissionless blockchains (also known as trustless or public blockchains) are open networks available to everyone to participate in the consensus process that blockchains use to validate transactions and data. This architecture creates the possibility of global open-source civic networks and generative economic coalitions surpassing the capacities of both state hierarchies and capital market dynamics. Blockchain technologies could enable the construction of a technological commonwealth (CryptoCommons) wherein advanced exchange, communication, and decision‐making technologies are used to aggregate, distribute, and govern capital at multiple levels and on a cooperative basis. My research focuses on the emerging ethical questions related to the impact of technology on humanity and how a commons-based economic model with a new approach to value, ownership, production, equity, work processes, and social dynamics can be built. While still in the minority, there is a diverse and growing global community experimenting with distributed technologies to create alternative forms of production, relationships, and ownership, with radically new and different logics beyond extraction, exploitation, market competition, and private ownership. I will offer the audience several examples of projects of this type across several different industries.

Takeaways:
The shared reality we inhabit ten years from now will look radically different from today. 
We need to think about the ethical implications of these new technologies and the laws that will be required to democratically govern physical/digital spaces.

events.title: Bridging Blockchain & Burning Man AMA
events.description:
"This talk will welcome everyone to DECENTRAL and set the stage for the rest of the Burn on what you can expect in our Dome and our Stage. Well at least the first 5 minutes.
The rest will be about DECENTRAL's Mission! How Burning Man can integrate blockchain technology and why it would be advantageous to do so. Also why the Blockchain space needs to take notice of the revolution happening at burning man.
- What if the Burning Man Foundation could be replaced by a DAO (Decentralized Autonomous Organization)? What is a DAO?
- What are the missing pieces for this to become reality?
- What if each ticket was an NFT (Non Fungible Token) on a side chain? Would the ticket sale be easier to manage?
- What if we could take the culture the burn has evolved and design an incentive model to help it spread even more virally than it already is! 
DECENTRAL has the Tech minds and the Burn has the cultural experience. 
The goal is to inspire now, discuss during the burn, and build it post burn!
Small intro to DECENTRAL
The goal of DECENTRAL is to create a beautiful cross pollination of the Technical side of the decentralization movement (Mostly Crypto Hackers) to the Cultural side of the revolution (Burners). Both are making important experiments that are changing the world and we hope that both can be better informed about their recent advancements and tools. 
Of course cryptocurrencies are a small piece of the puzzle and we will have talks on several other aspects of the decentralizations movement: Health Sovereignty, Seasteading, Decentralizing Psychiatry, Mesh Networks, Flat organizational structures, Open Source Hardware, internet privacy etc, but a majority of our talks will be Blockchain related!"

events.title: Decentralized Governance
events.description: Ethereum and other blockchains present a once-in-humanity opportunity to reimagine, recreate, and rebuild better human governance structures from square one--in a decentralized, grassroots fashion of course. Ethereum, Bitcoin, Tezos, and other platforms have run radically different experiments in governance. This talk will examine what's broken with the existing, "real world" system, how blockchain can help, what various blockchain platforms are attempting, what's working and not working, and most importantly, how we can do better. There will be a focus on big-picture ethical challenges like wealth distribution, poverty eradication, and education.

history.description: The Kazbah is the place to be for the best music and vibes.  Let the lasers guide you to 10:00 and come find our 64 foot tall pyramid DJ Booth midnight to noon.  We've got drinks, shade, and always some surprises.

The Kazbah is a place for all. Located right on the shore of the city, this beacon can be seen from far (and heard) from far across the deep playa, look for our pyramid with lasers pointing towards Sirius and join us for good times, good vibes, good music, proper sound, a bar, and a whole lot of love.
The Kazbah is a 501c3 non profit organization with a focus on electronic music, visual art, architecture, and design.

The Kazbah is back for our 5th year with vibes, music, lasers, libations, and our Pyramid hosting parties from 10pm to 10am every night and morning. Look for the laser pointing up towards the star Sirius, and join us.

Experience the magic of this ancient Mayan medicine as we come together in sacred ceremony to drink an elixir of heart opening cacao, make our intentions and dance wildly into the night. Wild Sirenda will be hosting the ceremony and taking us on a journey with music and live vocals as we go deep into the sunset.

We will entjoy tasting a different kind of food that feeds every chakra and eat them as we learn. 

After the workshop is complete, we invite you to join us for a 45 minute stretching yoga session with music played by U-Mee Dee and yoga insturcted by Sarah Steinback.

We invite all Burners to The Kazbah Pyramid for sunset yoga lead by Sarah Steinback and music DJ'd by Ümee Dee. At the Kazbah, Weds represents the third chakra, the Manipura, also known as the Solar Plexus chakra, and Sarah will be leading us in a restorative-style yin yoga session.

The Kazbah has about 40 mats to offer to attending yogis for use during this class but they will go fast so bring your own yoga mat if you can!

No Bikini Atoll is a group of Burners from the Big Island of Hawai'i. Our camp's coastlines are rooted in the Hawaiian values of aloha ("love; compassion; kindness; acceptance), mālama ("to care for"), pono ("right; righteousness"), and ʻohana ("family"). We engage in "talking story" with neighbors, inviting friends in, and creating our own playa paradise to set a stage of kindness and inclusion so that we may all act upon what is "pono" or right.

'Sundowners' comes from a South African friendship ritual we host Monday to Friday at sunset. A safari-themed art car and joyous South African "shebeen" speakeasy are our experiential tentpoles. Our creative center is Afrofuturism, imagining a positive, inclusive future through speculative art and technology, representing the diverse background and skills of our community. We feel Burning Man, as the planet's largest temporary city, is a fitting ecosystem to explore and express this unique Afrodiasporic ethnographic theme.

events.title: Shebeen Speakeasy & Sunset Soiree
events.description:
From Jamaican shanty town dance halls to favela baile funk parties, speakeasies, at their best, have helped shape and enliven global culture. Sundowners once again honors the vibrant underground female-run shebeens of South Africa through a visual and narrative framework of Afrofuturism.

Our shebeen-styled camp features Afro-digital art and design, a dedicated daring dance floor, and a renegade-style sound system where rotating selectors play everything from African Jazz to Highlife to Nigerian Disco. Experienced instructors will teach the energetic Pantsula dance form, which began as a township expression of resistance to Apartheid before becoming a means of expression for all. Costumed hosts and animal puppets will keep the surprises coming and vibes high.

As the day ends, we cap off each soiree with a heart-melting South African Sundowner tradition of sharing stories, laughter, and drinks with friends old and new at dusk. This special cultural ritual was participated in by many of our founding crew while on life-changing conservation safaris themselves.

Our "Jol", popular SA slang for a party, will ignite the night in our shebeen-styled camp with its Afro-digital art and design, daring dedicated dance floor, and raucous renegade sound system.

Expect body bumping Afro beats from our roster of DJs, live African musical performances, and safari surprises from the Sundowners crew.

We are Camp Tac-O-Cat. We cook tacos for the masses and enjoy serving libations and great conversation. We offer shade, a misty breeze and we have a few gear-heads who like to solve problems. Our camp is made up of Burners with deep roots in playa culture and a few we have newly adopted. People will likely be pulled in by heckling when they pass by, and some of the best connections have come from luring our new friends in from the street. We enjoy cracking people out of their comfort zone and immersing them in dusty happiness.

At sunset Monday, Wednesday and Friday we will be offering tacos. Our tacos are playa-famous and have a special grilled tortilla. We have vegetarian options as well.

events.title: Blinky Things Hospital
events.description:
Bring us your broken gear. We will help you fix it.

Electrical problem? No problem.
Mechanical? On it.
Power-related? Been there, fixed that.
Son or Lumière? Just call us the AV Club.
Need a tool? My friend, we ARE tools.
Need a drink while the repairs are taking place? We'll serve you and join you.

We're confident we can help you fix stuff because we've been repairing our own highly complex gear for years at Black Rock City. We make the Burner Boards -- actual surfboards tricked out with 4000+ LEDs, powerful sound systems and motors, four wheels, big-ass batteries, and lotsa code. They're the Playa's favorite distributed art car / roving disco. 

And they need a lot of ongoing TLC. They’re made solid, but the one-two punch of Playa dust and extreme conditions can make even a block of granite malfunction. It’s a combination that can make any piece of electromechanical gear think that it’s a Nexus-6 replicant at the end of four years, and that it’s time to die.

The one thing we say to the boards, adamantly, over and over, throughout the years, is not today. We’ll help you say the same thing to your gear.

Except bikes. We don't do bikes.

But we'll take a crack at just about anything else. And pour you a yummy cocktail while we're diagnosin' and fixin'.

history.description: LumiNova is a sanctuary of healing, movement, and light. Join us for workshops, sound journeys, ecstatic and regular dance, and our Art from Ashes ritual. At night, catch a deep house or trance as we turn up the womp womp and the untz untz. Our glowing domes offer space to rest, reconnect, and rise. events.title: Working with Challenging Psychedelic Experiences
events.description:
This year, millions of people will use psychedelics outside of supervised medical contexts, many of them for the first time. Difficult psychedelic experiences can be frightening, but also potentially among the most valuable experiences someone can have. What can you do to help someone having a difficult psychedelic experience? What techniques are available for helping transform a potentially traumatic situation into a positive or even therapeutic one? What role has the Zendo Project played at Burning Man, and what take-home messages are available for others interested in psychedelic harm reduction?  

The Zendo Project has been providing compassionate Care Services on playa since 2012. 

Mission
The mission of the Zendo Project is to provide a supportive environment and education to help transform difficult psychedelic and psychological experiences into opportunities for learning and growth.
 
Vision
We envision a world where communities are engaged in providing safety and support for people having psychedelic and psychological challenges; and harm reduction principles are used foremost to reduce the risks associated with substance use.

events.title: Zendo Project
events.description:
The Zendo is a community outreach project at Burning Man that offers education and psychological support, with the goal to help reduce the potential harms involved in drug use. Volunteers provide peer-to-peer harm reduction support for individuals having a difficult drug-related experience and who don't require medical care. Guests are sometimes actively on substance, and other times are seeking integration support, or education about the risks involved in drug use. We staff the space 24/7 with trained mental health and medical professionals who provide oversight, as well as individuals experienced in crisis response.

If you'd like to come to the training to learn more about volunteering, it will take place at Something Freaky This Way Foams, near 2:00&G, on Tuesday September 1 at 11AM. 

The four principles of psychedelic harm reduction include: 

1. Create a safe space - If someone is having a challenging experience try to move them into a comfortable, warm, and calm environment. If possible, try to avoid noisy or crowded spaces. Ask what would make them most comfortable. Offer blankets and water. 

2. Sitting, not guiding - Be a calm presence of acceptance, compassion, and caring. Promote feelings of trust and security. Let the person's unfolding experience be the guide. Don't try to get ahead of their process. Explore distressing issues if they want, but know that simply being with the person is supportive and talking may not be helpful.

3. Talk through, not down - Invite the person to explore what's happening and encourage them to try not to resist it. Remind them that they are safe. 

4. Difficult is not the same as bad - challenging experiences can wind up being our most valuable and lead to learning and growth. Help the person integrate the experience, and remind them the experience will continue to unfold.

events.title: Unlock your Unconscious with EMDR
events.description: Trauma Healing with EMDR Therapy- Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR) is an extensively researched psychotherapy method, proven to help people heal from trauma. When a traumatic event occurs, the memory can become "locked" in the brain with the original images, negative thoughts, feelings, and sensations that were experienced at the time of the event. The eye movements that are used in EMDR, which are similar to the eye movements happening in REM (dream) sleep, can "unlock" the memory and allow the brain to naturally process the traumatic material that has been stored in the unconscious. This workshop will be an introduction to how EMDR Therapy works, including a resourcing visualization that can be used for self-soothing in times of distress.

As each of us expands our erotic energy, we will envelop ourselves in a group erotic vibratory force field, which will grow and expand, raising higher and higher, until it peaks into a group energetic experience.

events.title: The Evolved Masculine
events.description:
We are living in a time in which there is a rebalancing of masculine and feminine energies occurring on this planet. Women are rising up like never before: Claiming their power, owning their sexuality and desires, and taking on leadership positions in all walks of life. Where do men fit into this shift? 

There’s a cultural backlash occurring, with many men responding in one of two directions, either they’re shrinking down, putting women on a pedestal, disempowering themselves in the process, or they are responding with anger and trying to reassert control.

In the midst of this climate emerges a new man. A man who embraces the empowered feminine. A man who meets this powerful woman from his own place of strength, not on his knees before her, nor trying to tower over her, but powerfully at her side, and rising together. 

Join us, as we explore a vision of what this Evolved Masculine is, and leave inspired and empowered to live into your own soul’s deepest potential.

Celebrating what it means to be human, one beat and breath at a time. 
Live DJ (Color- LA) + Somatic Journey

Intimate, edgy and wildly playful, you can expect to feel deeply, move freely and be in the mystery. Think music that can shuttle you to other galaxies and back, movement that will wake you up better than an ice bath and soul to soul connections that simmer with depth and aliveness. Brought to you by a couple of badass sisters with a whole lot of soul and a little sass. 

Come curious.

events.title: Raving Stick Workshop At The Castle
events.description:
Have you ever been at a festival and looked on in awe as some guy raves to his heart’s content while carrying a glittery lampshade on a stick? Maybe it was a branch of a tree with a piece of tinsel wrapped around it? Possibly you’ve been mesmerized by one of those floating jellyfish on Burn Night?

Well – if the jellyfish is your thing then you probably need to come back for the advanced class next year. But random objects hanging from sticks covered in lights and glittery things… that’s totally our thing! That, my friend, is what we call a “raving stick” and no self-respecting raver should venture out onto the playa at night without one.

Come for an interactive, playa punch-infused lesson in the art of raving stick making, featuring group discussions and plenty of one on one time with our experienced teachers. We’ll round off the afternoon with a delightful presentation on the history of the raving stick - you simply won’t believe some of the famous names you’ll hear!

Raving stick materials will be provided on the day by Celtic Chaos, but attendees are more than welcome to bring along their own personal additions. And the best part is that each person gets to leave with the raving stick that they make... but not until they partake in a collective stick-shaking rave-off inside The Castle!

events.description: No summer camp week is complete without a dance. Join the camp staff at 8:15 and C as we recreate the most magical camp on earth right here at BRC for the ultimate end to your summer camp experience... something we refer to as "theme day dance". Join us for dance lessons - electric slide, hustle, and more - and a dance floor to groove the night away with your best camp friends. Bring out those short shorts ladies and gents because DJ Chedda da Shredda and DJ Kiwi Herman gonna have yo' booty shakin'.

events.title: Summer Camp: Tuolumne Tuck In

Kids and adults join the camp staff as we tuck you in with milk and cookies and some bedtimes stories. PG and R rated stories depending on age/interest......

events.title: Summer Camp Volleyball Tournament!
events.description:
Remember all those campy games from summer camp? Camper versus staff rivalries? Need some good old fashioned exercise? Join the camp staff at 8:15 and C as we recreate the most magical summer camp on earth right here at BRC. Daily tournaments include volleyball, tug of war and life size jenga. 

Naked volleyball you say? Why yes, this BRC summer camp is also the camp you always fantasized about.....

events.title: TwistHanger
events.description:
We all know that one of the primal urges when at Burning Man is "What is it, and can I climb on it?" This year, People’s Art Congress will try to fill that urge in the most interactive way we could think of... with a contraption we like to call TwistHanger. 

Our structure combines the fun and excitement of climbing on stuff, with the age-old fun of twister... Then in true Burning Man spirit, we add competition, lights and lasers making it usable both daytime and nighttime.TwistHanger features over 500 square feet of climbing holds of varying difficulty, making the structure functional and entertaining for both beginning and advanced climbers. We then take it to the next level with three interactive climbing games!

Lakes on the Playa is our Village and we are all camps that call the Great Lakes regional burn, Lakes of Fire our home at home. We want to bring a taste of the fun, warmth and hard work that we all come from back home and share some moments with Black Rock City. Come for some touch-less sunscreen & friends , stay for the music, dancing and fire art! We are an all day / all night village that has something for everyone. We are a BED Safe Camp and strive to start conversations about consent and boundaries with the community. Take a ride on Tarna the flaming Jackalope Mutant Vehicle during her debut year on playa. On the outside, it's a metallic art car with a DJ sound stage, complete with lighting and flame effects. On the inside, it's a plush lounge and cozy gallery space.

With deep couches, a plush cuddle puddle and caring greeters you'll always feel welcome. We start our mornings with coffee, tea, fresh bakes treats and sweet DJ beats. By lunch time we are serving up free hot dogs, libations, and ice-cold towels for your sweaty brow (and other bits). In the afternoon our healers hold time and space for you to celebrate self and bring more light, love and flexibility into your life. history.description: At Camp Tea Punk we bring the dusty essentials: beans, bags & beats. To be clear; not soy, blow and punches but coffee in the morning, afternoon tea/sweets & melodic tunes when the vibe needs it. Blend in, literally, as we gather a global blend of different coffees or teabag like you've never seen before. Freshen up the coffee breath with our supreme gum collection or join in on the chaos that is called Burner Bingo. As you can read we love the letter 'B' but we want to 'C U'.

events.title: Blend In: Global coffee blend served hot as you R
events.description: We ask fellow burners to bring in coffee from all over the world as we serve a different special blend on monday, wednesday & friday morning. As people join the dusty blend, there will be enough for everybody. Every morning we blend all participant's names together into one big blend as we make an anagram of it. So buttom's up and cheers to the "Dr. Anal Honk Jelly Dick Feneel blend" thanks Fred John, Ellen, Kelly & Fred.

events.title: Burner Bingo, Blow & Beats.
events.description:
Burner Bingo
We bring back the 'go' in 'Bingo'. Grab a card, look at your numbers and listen up. Because it's not just crossing of numbers. Every number is connected to an object that you have to fetch in order to cross it off. Number 6? A spoon. Number 18? Canned beans. Number 58? A thong. Get your shit together. Fake bingo? Take the whole camp to Daft Punk at the trash fence.

Try Some Blow! (Blow Better, Blow Responsibly)
Before you go and make people faint with that bad coffee breath, please refresh. With over 50 different flavors of bubble gum to choose from, guests are invited to select their favorites or try new flavors. Blow us away with your skills with our "Blow Better Wall of Fame" by making it bigger and blowing it better than anyone else, while we catch it on film. The winner of each of our Bubble Gum Sessions will win a "Blow Better" t-shirt and a Bazooka Bubble Gum hat. Want to take your gum with you? Sorry, we can't do that. It's ours. We'll take it. No, seriously. GIVE THAT BACK!”

Beats
Our house DJ Daan Jongen (the initials gave it away didn't they?) will play some melodic beats varying from funky disco to organic house to melodic techno.

history.description: Why do you do what you do?  (aka WDYDWYD?)   Visit our WDYDWYD? installation at Center Camp to see portraits of burners answering this question for the last 20 years. history.description:
Human beings crave connection with other human beings.  Step onto our dance floor, take a partner in your arms, hear the music and move together, a beautiful conversation in dance.   At our camp you can take lessons, practice dance at our socials, and meet partner dance enthusiasts happy to share a dance or a conversation.
Our camp exists to share our love for connection with each other and with the music, so we bring that love. Hard.

Camp Beaverton is an intentional, experimental, and experiential Burning Man community theme camp. We are a group of queer women/trans/genderqueer/lesbian/bisexual/heterosexual/etc... or folks who are simply as wayward as the playa is dusty. We celebrate sexuality, self exploration, and respect for one's journey through this life. Our goal is to provide a safe(r), brave(r) space that centers queer women, trans folks, and nonbinary identities on and off-playa. We encourage education, participation, inquiry, conversation, and self-reflection. We extend our goals to the greater Black Rock community by hosting workshops and social events.

history.description: In 2010 several creative characters came together to embark on a journey that would change their lives. That trip was the "MoRoadtrip" 21 artists, from 8 countries, traveling 21 days from Austin to Burning Man on a 60ft bus called the "MoBus". Freshly inspired after a life changing trip a few "Mo" came together to form a "Transitional Culture of Mo." Meeting artists and creatives from the many walks of life led to "MoCarnivals", A "MoFarm", events, festivals, collective living, academic/activist discourse, a theme camp and lifetimes of friendships. We continue as an ongoing cavalcade of cosmic characters cultivating a common culture of creativity and convivial community.

The Mo of Motropolis invite you to embark on the quest to explore the meaning of the being Human. Take the Hero’s Journey and enter “The MoLabyrinth of the Divine Self”.

Motropolis arose from an epic adventure of our acquisition of a massive 60ft land-yacht the “MoBus” to take 22 adventurers from 5 countries, with little previous interaction to the burn and and eventual evolution into a tribe of survivors. A culture forged from the deep appreciation and love for the possibilities of a Humanistic, sustainable and interdependent culture of life. Motropolis’ core lies in the basic understanding of “Mo” representing “Humanity and in being so, recognizing the Humanity of others.

When Ragnarokk fell into the sea, we fell deep. Now reborn as Seashell Cartel, we are a sunken society of sea creatures, pirates, mermaids, and misfits living beneath the waves of the playa. We believe in mystery, magic, and the beauty that grows when you give things space to transform.

Ours is a world of coral crowns, morning mermaid rituals, barnacled bars, and glittering deep-sea dreams. We dance in the grotto, we marry under kelp, we drink at the Bait Shack, and we welcome all curious travelers who want to explore the weird and wondrous ocean floor with us.

Dive in. The tide is rising.

events.description: He rounded the corner of the Burning Man camp to see the party in full swing. People of all shapes, sizes, and ages gathered, smiling and laughing as the tantalizing aroma of a well-cooked meal wafted through the air. Suddenly, a gasp, then a scream… Cyber-Punk is dead! Who did it? Join us in this wildly entertaining dining experience. 2.5 hours, limited to 40 persons, each with a role to play! Prizes to be won! Tickets can be picked up at the No Boundaries camp on a first come first serve basis. Walk-ons can join in the place of no-shows up to the capacity of 40 players.

history.description:
The Sacred Song Teahouse is a temple for devotional singing on the playa.

There are many traditions of devotional singing, sometimes known as bhajans or kirtan, which help to quiet the mind so that the heart can open to the divine, allowing us to taste the blissful reality that is our true nature. Rather than being a performance in which the audience listens to musicians, it is a participatory spiritual practice in which everyone is encouraged to sing and express their inner joy.

The Sacred Song Teahouse is a Burning Man camp dedicated to creating and maintaining a serene temple oasis for joining our voices and diving into the Divine... together. We welcome the keepers of tea wisdom to join us in our temple space to sooth our throats with their mystical infusions. Together we create Magic!

events.title: A Sound Language for Love
events.description:
"Speaking & singing, the vocal clothing of silence. Undress vocal vibrational veils, to touch sound's transformative secret - unconditional love

We are conditioned and unconditioned
We are both at the same time
""Both at the same time"" Chloe Goodchild

Soundmaking and singing open up a multidimensional relationship with yourself and others, inspired by your feelings and a willing open heart, in a way that no other form of communication can.  And it's free!

Together we will explore what it takes for each of is to evolve and embody a language for love.  What would that sound like?  You are about to find out.  The following poem gives you a clearer sense of the world you are entering.

The flute of interior time
Is played whether we hear it or not
What we mean by “love” is
its sound coming in
When love hits the farthest edge of excess
It reaches a wisdom
...
It penetrates our thick bodies
It goes through walls
Its network of notes has a structure
as if a million suns were arranged inside
This tune has truth in it
Where else have you heard a sound like this?

A Kabir Poem, Robert Bly Translation

(Excerpt from Chloe Goodchild's ""The Naked Voice"")"

The Black Rock boat people will be offering coffee each morning. The public area will be open each day for your enjoyment.

events.title: Happy Hour - Lost Isle of Hearts Tiki Bar
events.description:
HO Happy Hour - costumes are encouraged, but feel free to wear whatever you didn't have to throw overboard while packing!

This year's theme in honor of MetamorphoSeas is Lost Isle of Hearts Tiki Bar!
Be ye Pirate, Sea Siren, Dashboard Hula, Scurvy Knave, or Thirsty Castaway come and join us for shots and grog! Remember, "Time flies when you're having Rum!"

events.title: Heart-On! Body Art
events.description:
HO will be serving up our now famous Heart Body Art with many options to choose from - stencils and airbrushing (Tatt-On!s), an array of colored ink and stamps (Ink-On!s), themed stickers (Stick-On!s), heart bracelets (Strap-On!s), heart shaped crop (Welt-On!s), nail polish (Nail-On!s), lollipops (Suck-On!s) just to name a few. We also have the wildly popular fortune telling: Predict-On!s

HO will be hosting the giant 5' gumball machine. This self serve feature will be set to free play and filled with a mixture of heart themed and event themed prizes in every capsule. Some random, lucky Black Rock Citizens will receive our Key to the City prizes...We don't exactly know what your unofficial Key will officially get you out there in the dusty streets, but feel free to fill out the unobtainable, unofficial Official Forms if you'd like, and report your strange gotten gains back to us!! 
--Individual results may vary.--

Adjacent to the Ball-On!s (gumball machine) is the free standing HO Photo Prop area. Use any of the zany accoutrements available in our dress up box (hats, mustaches, masks, huge sunglasses) and have your picture taken in the oversized heart shaped cutout!

history.description: Brain Freeze / Got stickers camp will again be serving up frozen margaritas and stickers. Along with our various forms of entertainment, no one will get bored.

Temple Oasis is a decompression spot and camp for those who have gathered at, worked at, or been a Guardian at the Temple.

An Oasis on the playa from the heaviness of the Temple and our service to it; a place to find others who are welcome to talk or sit in knowing silence as we unwind our experiences.

events.title: Create a Temple Memorial
events.description: Sit in our shade, create a Temple memorial piece. Basic art supplies provided.

history.description: Please come join Temple Oasis and unwind from those stressful times out at the Temple or just share a story about your experiences.
Temple Guardians Oasis and Safe Space

events.title: Temple Guardian Reunion Potluck
events.description: Ever work on or with a Temple?  Want learn more? Bring something to share and join Temple Guardians and Temple Builders, past and present!

history.description: Temple Homage Camp supporting the Temple and Temple Guardians

events.title: Make Your Own Collage
events.description: Come make art at Runs With Scissors Interactive Collage Space at Temple Homage Camp and make an offering for the temple.  We've got the magazines, scissors, glue and posterboard for you to make your own vision board, art piece, or temple offering - or contribute to a collective collage art/drawing/poetry book.  We are open 24 hours - come any time!

history.description: We hold Homage to the Burning Man Temples and Builders and what they represent and our main goal is to interact and welcome to all of those who consider all sacred sites within Burning Man.

events.title: Purple Rain Party - Encore!
events.description: Hosted by our in-house DJ Tupoc Biggie Small Latte Vanilla Frappaccino

events.title: One-Hit-Wonders Tunes-Everyone-Knows-the-Words-To
events.description: Dance Party and Sing, too!  Hosted by our in-house DJ Tupoc Biggie Small Latte Vanilla Frappaccino.

events.title: Sanctuary Rangers, Guardians, Bereaved, orConfused
events.description: Anyone is welcome.  Respite space to decompress, or let us know if you would like to speak with someone.  We are here to listen, support, and help you get your groove back.

events.title: Tarot by Jewel
events.description: Deepen your understanding of life's journey through a Tarot reading by Jewel. Explore your past, present, and future through the ancient wisdom of Tarot.

events.title: Write a Collaborative Poem!
events.description: Come join us for a creative collaboration to compose a group poem. See how our interconnections play out in the creative process!

events.title: Won't You Be My Neighbor? Mr. Rogers Social
events.description: Come on over for a morning beverage, wear your best loved cardigan and meet your neighbors.

history.description: We are a family and community, a California-based collective of dreamers, artists, adventurers, and passionate doers, that loves throwing fun off the wall parties as much as we love connecting on deeper levels. We are professionals at being, playing, curating unique experiences, and faffing about - whether it's flow, dance, music, magic, bubbles, movement, fire spinning, food, drinks, art, live jams, deep talks, tiny things or a whole lot of silly nonsense. We're a diverse group of eclectic individuals that operates with love and respect for the 10 Principles of Burning Man. We create interactive and magical experiences together as we inspire others to flow, love, and be their free and fearless selves. We also take lost and found items, including people. ;) Come play and get lost with us!

events.title: Lost + Found Night Market Block Party
events.description: A community gathering of yummy food stalls, drinks, curated tunes, lasers, bubbles, fire arts, circus shenanigans n more

events.title: Lost + Found Jungle Jamboree: The Safari Sideshow
events.description: Come join our zippity zoo zircus fam, dance to hip hop and throwbacks, drink our jungle juice and see where it takes you
