events.title: Twilight Nightcap
events.description:
There are few things better than sharing stories of your epic encounters in deep playa to a willing ear. The Twilight Nightcap is your local watering hole dedicated to helping you wind down with refreshments to keep your belly warm and heart full as you regale us and your closest 50,000 friends with the prior day's adventures. We're stocked with cold beer, whiskey, tea, coffee, and even some cup noodles to recharge your soul. Once the eyelids start to get heavy, feel free to lounge on our suspended hammocks until you're ready to hit the Playa again for another round of immediacy and participation. 
The Twilight Nightcap is open during twilight hours M-F (5a-7a, 7p-9p), and sometimes in between!

events.title: C.S.Firefly and the Dream Navigators (Cirque Show)
events.description:
The Dream Navigators have arrived aboard their time traveling ship, the C.S.Firefly. Immersive and rich Cirque Theatre not to be missed, as the Dream Navigators opens a exquisite time-portal, straight from your Waking Dream into the Dream Navigators' Fantastical World ~ Rich, velvety, astounding and enchanting 🎪 🔮 🔥

Dream Navigators is brought to you by the cirque duo 'CirqueSanity'. The event is an exceedingly entertaining 40 minutes of mesmerizing aerial acrobatics, magical object manipulations and Spectacular Fire Artistry & Sizzling theatrics, that could ONLY ever be found on the Playa!

One (scheduled) show only. BYO rug/pillow to sit on. Show starts at 10:30pm. Arrive early to score a prime pozzie, and enjoy the festivities at LOST+FOUND CAMP! 6:45 & D

history.description: Flow Therapy is a sacred space for flow, self-actualization, and fucking around for fucking ever... a space for everyone to lose their inhibitions and become the best versions of themselves. We are huge advocates of Flow, the timeless, selfless, expressive state of being, when our inner critic is silenced and our highest self comes to play. We're a family and community, a California-based collective of dreamers, artists, adventurers, and passionate doers, that loves throwing badass parties as much as we love to connect on deeper levels. We are professionals at being, playing, and faffing about - whether it's dancing, music, yoga, fire spinning, cooking, making art, or a whole lot of nonsense. We're a diverse group of eclectic individuals that operates with deep love and respect on the 10 Principles of Burning Man, that create interactive and magical experiences together as we inspire others to dance, flow, love, and be their free and fearless selves. What is your flow?

events.description: We are bringing Winter to the playa with our Winter Wonderland themed prom. Bring a date and come dressed in your best prom attire and dance the night away to some of the classics! Don’t forget to take an awkward prom picture in our photo area.

history.description:

We're a diverse group of eclectic individuals that operates with deep love and respect on the 10 Principles of Burning Man, that create interactive experiences and magic together.

Play is good for the soul - come meditate, do yoga, boogie down, play with fire, learn to spin (contact and dragon staff, poi, hoops, fans, palm torches, levitation wand, rope dart), fly on an aerial rig, party 'til the break of dawn, jam out, or whatever else your heart desires. Our resident DJ’s will be playing anywhere from 90's throwbacks and deep house to Disney and lyrical tunes. Prepare to have your minds blown and get ready to dance the night away. BYOC.

events.title: Guided Meditation w Hand Pan Melodies
events.description: Join us for a guided morning meditation accompanied by beautiful hand pan melodies. Come relax and give rest to your mind, heart, body and soul.

events.title: Swim Good
events.description:
Many say that the act of swimming is the skillful art of intentionally propelling oneself through a body of water. However there are those that hold the belief that swimming is actually a state of mind. Join this class if you believe in the power of group therapy and fun. Bring your own pool.

Instructor Calvin HeKa is certified in Basic Life Support and CPR.

events.title: Tea Soul Trap
events.description: Come drink tea with Alice and her friends in Wonderland, eat dim sum, and listen to soul and trap music before we venture out to the Playa for sunset with our resident art car and hand pan guru. Kimonos encouraged!!

events.description: A magical happy hour of live DJ sets with hula hoop dancing, aerials, spinning and manipulation (contact staff, dragon staff, poi, hoop, etc.), lights, essential oils, live painting, hand pan, drums, piano, and other musical instruments, with a fire spinning circle at sunset to welcome the moon. After dusk, our fire spinners and friends will venture out into the Playa to drop, stop and spin. Bring your toys and come play with us!!

history.description: Welcome to Naked Rainbow, the Strip Club for your Soul. Expose your dreams. Flash your fears. Bend over, spread your cheeks and give us a bare-assed view of your inner self. Our safe, open, meaningful and interactive environment plies you with mimosas, Harry Potter cocktails and good conversations to get you naked -- spiritually naked, that is. Share your aspirations on the Tree of Dreams. Unburden your woes on the Tree of Prayers. Take a quiet moment out of your day to pray or meditate. Align your mind and spirit with Mimosa Vinyasa (Wed 5-6PM BYOM). Connect to each other at our modern partner-dancing workshops in costume (Tutu Tuesday 4:30-6PM + Bunny Thursday 3-4:30PM)! Join us for our Harry Potter cocktail hour dressed in your favorite color of the rainbow (Friday 5-7PM BYOC, starting with Andy’s standup routine)! We dare you to come sit in the Bad Advice Chair. You may even find yourself in the middle of an impromptu flow jam or fire spinning session. Even if it’s something as simple as dancing to our live beats or relaxing in the shade of our visually stimulating Dome, we hope you leave the Naked Rainbow with the most vibrant hues of your soul revealed.

events.title: BUNNY MARCH THURSDAY Modern Partner Dancing
events.description: Learn to New Style Hustle with Jason Lam - to jazz, house, you name it. Learn modern partner dancing with other bunnies on the playa!! ;) Bring your ears, tail, and a partner if you have one. If you don't, come anyway!! Here's a preview of what you'll learn: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gZg_n50k-JI. After the workshop, join us for the pregame and camp hop for the Billion Bunny March Against Humanity. At the end of the March, our fire spinners will be spinning at The Man.

events.title: HARRY POTTER Cocktail Hour!!!
events.description: Join us for magical concoctions and cocktail potions!! Come dressed as your favorite Hogwarts house or your favorite color of the rainbow. We will begin festivities with Andy's standup show, follow that with shots and flash tatts, and end it with some fire spinning before heading out to deep playa for sunset. BYOC.

Come join us and experience a haven of tranquility. 

Unleash your creativity with paint and canvas, or simply relax in the shade with the gentle breeze of fans and misters while indulging in snacks, water, and tea to keep yourself energized for the rest of the day. 

Our camp is equipped with musical instruments like a rain stick, didgeridoo, and bongos, perfect for impromptu jamming sessions that soothe the soul. 

As night falls, prepare to be mesmerized by a captivating light show that transforms Kosmic Korner into an otherworldly realm, or find yourself a comfortable spot in the Zen Den and let the peaceful ambiance of the Zen Den lull you into a restful night's sleep

A visit to Hack-a-Cola is a reprieve from the heat empowered by a sampling of a wide variety of unique, handcrafted flavors of soda. Hand us a cup and we'll mix cold carbonated water with one or more of our syrups to make a refreshing soda on the spot. We may even put a scoop of ice cream in your soda to make it a float! We tweak our recipes and invent new flavors throughout the week. Inquisitive visitors can learn how to fulfill their own soda making dreams with the guidance of our knowledgeable, helpful soda jerks. We aim to provide a welcoming space where everyone will feel comfortable to stay a while and enjoy the company under our plentiful shade.

events.title: Dropping into the Burn
events.description:
"Many of us come to the Burn hoping for a transformational experience. But what do you do when it's Day 4, and you feel like you haven't dropped into the flow of the Burn yet? 

Why is everyone around you having magical, connected, life-changing experiences, while you still feel like you're stumbling around some dusty festival? 

You might be wondering: Has Burning Man lost its magic? Is this place overrated? Is there something wrong with me?

No, no, and no. 

You're right where you need to be. And this workshop will help you see that.

If you can allow yourself to let go of any anxieties around getting the most out of this Burn, this workshop will help you open up, drop into the week, and surrender to the magical flow of connection.

We will go through different activities to help you draw out your desire, let go of expectations, open up to vulnerable and intimate connection, surrender into trust, and invite in synchronicity.

Hope is not at all lost. Let's Burn!"

Traditionally Chi Gong incorporates breath, visualization, intention, and light stretching to open up your body, mind, and meridians (energy channels of your body and spirit). Chi gong is also a martial art, and the foundation for many Chinese martial arts including Kung Fu, Tai Chi, Xing Yi, etc. 
This workshop has all those fun stretchy things, spiritual vibes, but it be funky 🤩 . Drop in, connect with your fellow humanimals in touch and play, solo or with partners, and soak in morning playa sunshine for a well-tuned day. "

events.title: Destroying Whiteness
events.description: Destroying white supremacy is a common "Bandwagon" that lots of folks are on these days (or is it not as common as we'd like to think?). What about whiteness? Why should we address destroying whiteness? And what is the difference between that and white supremacy? In this interactive, body-centered workshop, we won't get too caught up in jargon or definitions. What we WILL do is ask big questions, feel big feelings and help one another to disrobe from the legacy of whiteness in order to be more present, authentic and grounded humans. All colors and cultures welcome to participate however it is important to know that this is a white-identity centered workshop.

events.title: Somatic Gateway Balancing
events.description: Somatic gateways are physical locations for energy flow in the body.  They are cousins to the chakras, bandhas and mudras, but are distinct from them in character and location.  They represent our most vital bodily functions, and as such provide focused locations for power, energy and pleasure.  We will explore the following gateways:  anal, sexual, abdominal, heart, throat, mind and consciousness.  Each gateway can cycle between expansion and contraction, with benefits across the full range of motion.  Energy flow can be affected by the intention set for each gateway.  We will examine the effect of the physical and energetic state of each gateway, and how they combine and express themselves.  Once the gateways are exercised and relaxed, we can transition away from energetic blocks to finding balance.  No partner required. Note: This will not be a class on kundalini yoga or chakras, though you are encouraged to explore these ancient spiritual practices as the opportunity arises.

events.title: An exploration of accepting grief
events.description: I have been deeply exploring grief for the past few years as a brother of mine took his own life at the age of 58 two years ago and then a year and a half later, my 36 year old son was poisoned with fentanyl and died suddenly last September. There is nothing you can do to prepare for these kind of losses in your life, but you can move through the grief process much easier if you are allowed to grieve in the way that best suits your personal needs and beliefs without being shamed or blamed. Our culture in America does not know how to grieve. We have not been taught how to grieve. I have spent time in India, and in Varanasi, where families have a joyous procession to the Ganges River to burn their family member on pyres and release the beloved departed’s soul  to the afterlife and back into the birth-death-rebirth cycle after a short grieving process. They have been taught from birth that grieving happens in a shot period of time and they accept this as a rite of passage.  In the United States, we are shamed by death. We hide our beloveds who have died, we either immediately beautify them by embalming their bodies and dress them up in their favorite outfit for the rest of the family to view or we freeze them until the crematorium can arrange for the necessary paperwork from the local appointed authorities, or after the Coroner has unceremoniously dissected their bodies to determine the cause of death, if it is unknown. This is a devastating period for the family to go through who has just lost a loved one. The mind cannot even process what has happened and then the Governmental authority  is intervening in a process too gruesome to fathom. What follows after this, is the period of time that all the friends and family try to console the grieving family members,  mostly without success. Perhaps there are even deeper levels of connection in oneness or even eternal unity with the cosmos. Stardust Particle to Stardust Particle? 

This workshop is less about theory and more about state change. We will go through a powerful process that will leave you in a remarkably fertile state to notice the miraculous beauty and magic of every person you encounter. "

events.title: Massage as an Act of Care and Support
events.description:
"Thai Intuitive Massage as an Act of Care and Support

This workshop is designed to provide the participants with basic tools in Thai massage, so that they can use them directly and already start to practice during the festival.

When in extreme desert conditions and overstimulated by the impulses we receive there, there is an essential need to create an oasis of care towards our own bodies and minds and support our close ones.

What you can expect:

We will explore basic principles of touch such as palming and the ability to sense and hear your body and your partner’s, as well as the processes of rocking and sinking into each other’s presence.

We work with principle called “single moment-single activity”, in order not to overstimulate our nervous systems and play with the energy line which is related to groundless and centeredness.

The massage takes place thinly dressed on a floor mat. No specific props will be used, but I recommend bringing your yoga mat and a small towel with you.

Through soulful and conscious touch, we'll leave the session feeling nourished and in a relaxed state of centred balance."

events.title: Latihan - Tune in to yourself and others
events.description:
" ""I tune in. Inside myself. I let the music be a medium to go deeper, and listen to the movements that come. I follow them. I feel bodies around me. Some brushing, some asking. Some are exploring the limits of their own environments. Others want to connect. Briefly, longer. I meet some. I move away from others. I tune in the physical sensations. Learn to accept them and let go of stories that sometimes float through my mind. Coming back to the sensations. I feel bodies around me. I have grown to know them now. My tribe. I don’t know them all, or not so well. But I know the tribe. I love them and they love me. These sensations are saying – we accept you. 

And then when new movements arise, I move away. It is time to let go of the security the bodies provide, fly on my own, move into pure darkness and uncertainty. Not knowing where I am going on my own. Not knowing how long I will be alone for. And embracing it. Taking risks. Trusting.

And before I know it, I encounter new bodies. More souls who want to go where I go, eager to connect if I desire. I couldn’t see them and they couldn’t see me. But by moving away I connected anew.

Latihan is the practice of life. Of embracing instinct. Of embracing trust."""

events.title: Autogenic Training/Selfhypnose
events.description:
The technique involves repetitions of a set of visualizations that induce a state of relaxation. AT has been shown to be an effective tool in preventative medicine, stress-related disorders and panic attacks. It can relieve tension, lessen anxiety and enhance performance and its evidence-based unique and the world's first western developed mediation technique. 
Autogenic Training is much more than just a relaxation technique. It is a neurological and psycho-physiological tool or therapy for psychological and medical self-healing.Autogenic Training takes you through a series of validated and prescriptive mental exercises that target specific physiological reactions in the brain and body that underpin optimal health and well-being. 
Through the power of self-suggestion you are taught how to consciously and intentionally control your Autonomic Nervous System. AT is for anyone who wants to benefit from gaining the self-help tools to manage stress in the present and to develop long term strategies to reduce stress and anxiety. It is also of benefit for qualified or trainee psychotherapists who wish to gain a deeper trust in their relationship with 'self' and for those in the caring professions who want to learn new techniques for self-care.
 It's a self- hypnotic technique developed by the German psychiatrist Johannes Heinrich Schultz and first published in 1932. Studying the self-reports of people immersed in a hypnotic state, J.H. Schultz noted that physiological changes are accompanied by certain feelings. Also it got used to alleviate many stress-induced psychosomatic disorders and is a great start into meditation in general. Its training restores the balance between the activity of the sympathetic (flight or fight) and the parasympathetic (rest and digest) branches of the autonomic nervous system. 
This has important health benefits, as the parasympathetic activity promotes digestion and bowel movements, lowers the blood pressure, slows the heart rate.

events.title: Autogenic Training-heal our mind&body
events.description:
Autogenic Training (AT) involves repetitions of a set of visualizations that induce a state of relaxation. AT has been shown to be an effective tool in preventative medicine, stress-related disorders and panic attacks. It can relieve tension, lessen anxiety, and enhance performance. As the world's first western developed mediation technique, AT is a neurological and psycho-physiological tool or therapy for psychological and medical self-healing. 

AT takes you through a series of validated and prescriptive mental exercises that target specific physiological reactions in the brain and body that underpin optimal health and well-being. Through the power of self-suggestion you are taught how to consciously and intentionally control your Autonomic Nervous System. AT is for anyone who wants to benefit from gaining the self-help tools to manage stress in the present and to develop long term strategies to reduce stress and anxiety. It is also of benefit for qualified or trainee psychotherapists who wish to gain a deeper trust in their relationship with 'self' and for those in the caring professions who want to learn new techniques for self-care. The technique was developed by the German psychiatrist Johannes Heinrich Schultz and first published in 1932. 

Each session can be practiced in a position chosen amongst a set of recommended postures (for example, lying down, sitting meditation, sitting like a rag doll).On a micro level of regeneration, Autogenics retrains cells, glands, the brain and organs to behave as they are ‘meant to’, that is, to work in harmony and to restore the natural order. We are now coming to understand AT’s role in neuro-plasticity, gut health, epigenetic modulation and the placebo response. The future for AT world-wide in becoming a mainstream therapy for the self-regulation of body-mind healing and optimal functioning is exciting!

events.title: Belly2Belly
events.description:
Partnered breathing meditation focused on generating intimacy, emotional openness, and physical bonding in a safe, guided, non-sexual way.

"Belly2Belly partnered breathing meditation is a deceptively simple process that rests on multiple dimensions of neurobiology, pranayama, focused sensory awareness, tantric ritual, intimate communion, witness consciousness, sound entrainment, sequenced relaxation, psychological regression, shadow work, neurolinguistic programming, wizardry and primate zoology.

The exercises are designed to dissolve the Western experience of separate self into rhythmic waves of sensation and feeling that are shared with a partner in real time.

What results is a profoundly felt sense of peace and connection, a natural biochemical high that neuro-mirrors intimate love, meditative samadhi and mystical oneness.

The Belly2Belly practices were developed by David Cates in his healing work with sexual trauma. The results were so  potent that David adapted many of the exercises to share in groups.

In groups, we focus on generating intimacy, emotional openness, and physical bonding in a safe, slow, guided non-sexual way. We reawaken our primal need for human connection, animal to animal, body to body, heart to heart, without the stress or uncertainty of sex. By trusting our bodies and each other, we reclaim our original innocence... and remember we are safe."

The fruit which comes from exploring male to male intimacy on an energetic and physical level is that all of our male armor/guarded defense systems vanish and we develop a greater level or capacity for intimacy with all people including women.

We invite you to this gathering of Spiritually Minded, Open, Fluid, LGBTQ, Polyamorous, Polysensuous, Polycurious, Monogamomish people. This is a safe, fun way to meet new people who are also participating in Open Relating and to gain some practical tools for your relationship or future relationship(s)!

To chose to live and relate in an open or polyamorous way requires a community of like-minded souls. Without community we do not have the necessary support we need as couples and individuals to love as big as our hearts desire.

Why we each consciously choose to live in alternative ways then the ones that were passed down to us from earlier generations is very personal. Some do it to increase the variety of sexual partners and others do it as a spiritual path to embrace the light and shadow of opening up.

There are many ways to make it work. Some people have stated agreements meanwhile others rely on embodied principles and some are just totally radical. Regardless of your personal preference, most of us were not raised with role models for this alternative way of relating. So we must come together to role model and mirror one another.

As the definition and practice of relating is expanding beyond what we were taught unconsciously by our parents we want to invite you to join the conversation. How do you navigate these waters? Utilizing the core tools of Tantra: Breath, Sound, Movement and Touch we are slowing down, and we are being together just as we are. As we slow down and link up breath and sound we create all these exquisite feedback loops- body to body, belly to belly, heart to heart, and we invite each other into more and more presence, trust and relaxation.

Embodied Intimacy guides everyone gently from a state of separation and isolation towards safety and oxytocin fueled connection. The result is a simple felt presence, real time intimacy and heartfelt shared truth. The story and drama of the mind subsides and a new level of being is found in its place. In-To-Me-I-See. Sound by Sound, sigh by sigh, breath by breath it all unfolds, melts and unwinds. At the speed of love we learn how to live from the wisdom of our heart instead of the worry of our minds.
"

events.title: Samasati Meditation

Appreciating my life means waking up every morning and looking into the mirror, and saying to myself, 'I am so happy to be alive!' Thank you Osho, for helping me to create this meditation." I designed this meditation so that it can be done in a group or by yourself. The first six stages are an oppertunity to practice dying consciously, a rehearsal for the end of your life. The Ceremony leaders do not consider themselves to be Shamans, yet we find it is the best way to describe the ritual being used in this healing ceremony so we feel good about using this term to describe the practice, not the leaders. Shamanism is the practice of inducing trance in order to achieve a state of non-ordinary reality in order to communicate with the source energy that flows through all of life, healing spirits, animal spirit guides, angels, and ancestors. This practice also calls upon the elemental forces for cleansing and healing of mind, body, and spirit. Pranic Journeying takes us into a place of non-ordinary reality where deep release of mental, emotional, and physical blocks may occur. In this state we are open to receive deep esoteric truths, connect with our helping spirits and ancestors, and merge with our higher self and higher consciousness. The journey is unique based on the individual although the group undergoes a unique journey together as well. Each journey can be very different as the healing intelligence of spirit knows just where to take us to safely clear the energy in alignment with our intentions. There are many ways to induce a shamanic trance: drumming, dancing, singing, ingesting plant medicine and breath work. It's practicing using our genuine curiosity to better understand and become a connoisseur of another person's world through present moment awareness while breaking through the assumptions and projections we have about each other. events.title: Cocoon Workshop
events.description: The Cocoon is performed architecture. Inside the Cocoon we physically create the space and structure with our bodies. Chanting, dancing and other ritualistic strategies will generate a massive collective energy. No experience necessary!  For the generally creative and outgoing. It manifests a collective spirit as we create a sacred space for transformation and rebirth. Inspiration, identity and rebirth take morphing, sculptural form. The Cocoon is a hand-crafted stretchy fabric enclosure created by Sherry Aliberti, an architect and performance artist based in New York City. Structurally, these postures represent a scale model of an architecture and materiality based on the forces of the body. The Cocoon Project is a multi-disciplinary collaborative performing the Cocoon with movers, live projected visuals and soundscape. The performed-installation conveys a primordial one-ness of many bodies within the sheer membrane. CocoonNYC performs site-specifically in galleries, music venues and alternative spaces. The Cocoon experience can be emotionally powerful for every age and/or background.

events.title: Moving Meditation Contemplative Dance
events.description:
Dancing with the Mind of Meditation
This Contemplative Dance workshop offers you an introduction to a variety of movement meditation techniques. We'll sense and feel the way that energy moves through the body with Qi Gong practice. We'll explore somatic training and the Body/Mind practices of Developmental Movement and Experiential Anatomy. We'll investigate our relationship to form, space, and each other through Viewpoints Space Awareness and Mudra Space Awareness. 

This class is a laboratory where we'll be working with the energy that animates our bodies. We'll be exploring how energy moves when the body moves and how mind can direct energy. We'll learn to harness the power of the breath and focus of the mind to attain higher performance outcomes.

The work is toward attaining a greater depth of expression of personal energy, achieving grace and ease in a variety of movement patterns, developing an equanimity of all body parts as initiators and supporters of movement in space, and gaining the ability to dance ecstatically with great amounts of energy without loss of awareness of where you are and what is around you. 

Everyone is welcome from dancers seeking to bring contemplation into their dance - to those wishing to bridge their sitting practice to their walking meditation practice to the rest of their active lives - to people who have never danced or meditated before.

supports other people's journeys. I allow people room to be present and feel into their bodies, in that each posture is held for an extended period of time. It is not about appearances, our neighbors, the next posture. Each session would include an intention of focus that I would explain before beginning. What is more than being present? By holding, rocking, and cradling each other, a direct path is formed to deep and visceral experiences of nurturance. Some of the movements we do induce mutual trance states by using repetitive circular motion. A hug that evolves into a spiral that is so safe and supported that we enter graceful states of consciousness. If you are looking for ways to enhance your relationship with your partner, this may be useful. Relating in non-verbal, non-linear fashion can have an effect of breaking through barriers of relating on new and different levels. People report that using these methods deepens and re-invigorates their relationship.

events.title: Relating from Our True Nature
events.description:
Relating from Our True Nature

This workshop is designed to be simultaneously deep and playful. We begin with a deep dive into our truth—our true nature—which is simply a letting go and a knowing of who we always already are, beyond our ideas about ourselves and others: a simple direct undeniable knowing of our clear deep heart-mind-being. 
We will ground ourselves in this present moment and connect with our higher self and cultivate our intentions, desires, and wishes for the night.
Using movement, stillness, and humor we bring awareness and acceptance to ourselves and our conditioning.
Through simple spontaneous body movements you embody and express your truth(s) and your true being. 
Finally we move into connecting and relating with each other while staying connected with our self. This process will be facilitated with some simple relating exercises and is a chance to see through our ego and conditioned habitual ways of relating and being. We invite a sense of humor to simply seeing ourselves and the conscious and unconscious games we play. 
Bringing awareness to our patterns opens the possibility of playing with them and responding from our clear deep heart mind space, rather than reacting. Respond from awareness rather than react from habits. We live from our true nature rather than our conditioning. We dance.

events.title: Birth: Protecting and Reclaiming Sacred Space
events.description: A discussion that acts as a crash course in reproductive justice, history of midwifery, birth options in a modern context and how to take back power in your birth experience. Open to all people who are curious about what happened to birth in North America and how to navigate and protect the sacred birth space. This workshop is for people who are YEARS away from thinking about children, parents, folks interested in reproductive justice and those who want an opportunity to ask all the questions they have never had the chance ask!

Make consent the 11th principle! The burn can't exist unless everyone has the freedom to express themselves without fear of assault. That’s a simple fact.

events.description:
Have you ever wondered why what was meant to be a simple conversation turned into an argument? 
Or how to deliver straight-forward feedback without hurting someone’s feelings? 
Perhaps you have always wondered how you are perceived by others...

If you’ve wondered about these questions then this workshop is for you! Join us at Hotel California for an interactive workshop designed to increase participants' interpersonal and communication effectiveness via learning and practice. This workshop will draw on principles of non-violent communication (NVC). Bring your words, an open mind, and open heart.

events.title: Breathwork and Bungees
events.description:
Breathwork is a simple breathing technique that assists in processing trauma, developing healthier thought patterns, and creating a new perspective on old behavior. This two-stage rhythm helps calm the brain and allows participants to experience a more tangible connection to their bodies. This practice allows participants to become more aware of buried emotion and deep-seated trauma while identifying the necessary steps toward healing those wounds. Because breathwork doesn’t depend on conscious thought, it is able to successfully circumnavigate the defense mechanisms and roadblocks typically encountered during conventional talk therapy and, often after just one session, participants are able to see and feel the nurturing effects.

Breathwork isn’t magic, though it sometimes can feel exactly that. This breathing techniques ultimately distracts the mind long enough to provide participants with a respite from its incessant chatter and desperation to “figure it all out.” Results vary from person to person, but most clients report a reduced level of anxiety, a sense of being consciously present and connected, and in many cases having had “a spiritual experience” — often for the very first time. Self-judgment is reduced, self-love is achieved, and most importantly, participants gain awareness that they have the power to generate the same sense of relief that they had previously only been able to find by using ineffective coping mechanisms.

events.title: ...But what does it all mean?!
events.description:
An inspired group discussion aimed at discovering the objective meaning of Burning Man, if that even exists...

Through the candid & genuine exploration of what Burning Man means to us as individuals, we will thread together each commonality & discover our true collective perspective; thereby enriching our understanding of the event, ourselves and each other!

This will be held on Wednesday before dusk, with half the week passed to rediscover our passion, and half the week left to foster what we learn!

events.title: How our theme camped morphed into an off grid home
events.description:
This will be year 24 for me on the playa. We've been a registered theme camp for 10 years. Our main attraction is a trampoline suspended inside a dome, by a giant web of bungee cords. One year, having the tramp set up in my yard to work on it prior to BM, I had an inspiration. With a little modification, and a slightly larger footprint, we could make this into a pretty cool house. At the time, my wife was a student at UNR. She was in the a program designed for new business development. We put a team together, and after a lot of hard work, won a statewide competition, and got some seed money. EnviroHaven was born!  After a proof of concept prototype, we had some interest from potential clients. One of these were for an off grid parcel in Pershing County, Nevada, the same county Burning Man is in. A year later, the happy homeowners moved in.
Our Haven home requires 25% less materials to build than a similar sized conventional home. It uses space very efficently. We built another one in a neighborhood in Reno (grid tied), that we lived in. Our 1600 sq. ft. home used a total of 67 gallons of propane for an entire year! Our average electric usage was around 10 KWH per day. This equated to a monthly bill of less than $40. Energy efficency was incredible! Plus, the upper floor master bedroom has a 360 degree view. A most enjoyable home to live in.
Come discover the full story. Feel for yourself the beginnings of this amazing metamorphoses in our unique playa home.

events.title: Last Burner Standing
events.description:
Our camps main attraction is a trampoline suspended from a giant web of bungee cords. The tramp will move in a multitude of directions, and is very reactive to the movements of those who are on it. It will swing, tilt, bounce, gyrate, jiggle, and even rotate in a huge circle. Every action has a reaction, and every motion has an emotion. 
When burners first enter our dome, they're not quite sure what they are looking at. Climbing a single scaffolding allows entry through the bungee wall, and onto the trampoline. The first impulse is to jump, it's a trampoline after all. But the jump is not what's this is all about. The tramp will shift around in reaction to the participants movements. The first thing that happens, is everyone falls down. Then they start laughing.The braver ones will get up and start moving around. This causes more chaos, and everyone ends up in a big pile. Once again, the more adventurous ones get up again, and this time, they start to figure it out. Jump around, and try to make the others fall. The game is on, and the last one standing wins.

We've done this at all hours, and the most hilarious are at dawn, after a long night out when you are most wobbly anyway. Feel free to come by any time for practice runs. We would schedule this for that hour, but we never know who will actually be up then. So we've decided to schedule this for Saturday afternoon, when the week is winding down, and everyone is truly burned.

It's a great way to end your burn.

events.title: sustainable infrastructure-compost toilets
events.description:
Expanding all participants knowledge of using human manure as a productive fertilizer in gardens. Discussion of the different methods currently used to process human poop. Dispelling false ideas specific to composted human waste. Engaging the participants in thinking about new or modified methods to efficiently building composting toilets. Using Fly Ranch current Bio-filter toilets and compost toilets as discussion points. Explaining the porta-potty nightmare, the Burning Man event is challenged with. Discussing how compost toilets may help the event in the future. Explaining the safety issues related to using human poop as a garden supplement.
Sharing simple effective methods that create a functioning composting system.

history.description:
As urban communities like BRC threaten migratory birds, concerned citizens are banding together to protect endangered animals and habitats. This led to the formation of the Black Rock Desert Migratory Bird Refuge (BiRDMBR), a new outpost of the Desert National Wildlife Refuge. 

With the creation of the Black Rock Desert Migratory Bird Refuge, birds will have a home in the Great Basin during their migrations as well as habitat preserved for year round residents including cougars, beavers, badgers. 

BiRDMBR plans an extensive permanent Visitor Center with interpretive panels and interactive activities to engage participants of all abilities and ages. 

Join us in our Visitor's Center watering hole and nest for activities like Personalize Your Pee Jug, Bird Bingo, Nature Journaling, and more.

We've been a presence at Burning man for 20 years, as Joyism and as a part of Silicon Village, with many people coming up to the art car recognizing it from the past, and coming by our area later to explore as they search for coffee and interaction.
Our coffee kitchen regularly generates lines of people from every corner of the Playa for hours every morning, with hundreds served. We take our coffee seriously!
This year, hundreds of people will interact with our "One Pill makes you Smaller, and One Pill makes you Tall" exhibit, and our "Joyism Cares" tent hands out sunscreen, condoms, pain relievers, hydration and advice.  We may have wifi available for those in dire need.  Come say Hi!!!

history.description: Joyism is a camp of some 50 people, whose major contribution is to provide coffee in the mornings between 8 and 11 AM. Several hundred people come by every day. It is clearly a very valuable commodity. We have to bring in a large quantity of water, and we have at least five urns simmering at any one time. People come from several blocks away. Joyism camp is also the informal home of the Joyism artcar, the temple of our new religion Joyism, and from which we serve up, live bands on the front, margaritas for participants of critical tits, and Playa weddings. We also have a climbing wall for users of all levels.

Turtle camp is a quiet shady spot where SIMON the TURTLE can rest between playa cruises. Come visit SIMON in his "TURTLE CAVE", and cruise the playa in the luxury of SIMON's plushy turtle shell!

Home of SIMON the Turtle Car, Turtle Camp is a one-hearted collective of people with shared values of wisdom, integrity, kindness and authentic connection with each other and our surrounding community. It is our intention to help others slow down, to be present, and to fully experience the flow of life on the Playa with curiosity and joy.  

Turtle Camp Mantra
by Garrett Brill
Take it slow
You'll find your flow
Wherever you roam, you'll be at home

history.description:
The Black Rock Piano lounge is a place where people from all over the world come to meet, enjoy and play great live music.  We bring two of the best piano's to the playa (and tune it several times throughout the week) in one of the coolest lounges.  Live music is played by both camp members and any fellow Burner who stops by to share their talent.  Music plays 24 hours a day and we host parties throughout the week.

The magic of the Black Rock Piano Lounge is that we connect people who have never met before and create amazing live music.  Our 40 by 20 lounge is designed to be open and friendly.  We have several fist time musicians mix with experienced professionals to create a safe environment for everyone to create and share.

history.description:
NYC Deli will be be serving Seinfeld-esque laughs and scrumptious New York Deli breakfast food 10am-12pm Monday through Saturday during the Burn. Bacon Egg and Cheese is most popular but we also have great Vegan, Veggie and Gluten Free breakfast sandwich options too! Coffee and water served also. Like last year: there is an air conditioned public picnic area to enjoy your meal! 

In addition to the food: NYC Deli also offers Staten Island! Staten Island is an 85-person public cooling center kept at 70 degrees 10am-5pm Monday through Saturday. Most burners use it to sleep or quietly socialize. There is no programming or events inside: just ocean noise playing over a speaker. Ice is available! Staten Island is NYC Deli's response to 2022's heat.

Please stop by! 🥯🐀🗽❤️‍🔥

Come wake up to egg and cheese sandwiches with or without real or fake meat, bagels with cream cheese, coffee and tea. We also will have Vegetarian/Vegan/GF options. All served in a sassy Seinfeld-style service.

history.description: Hailing from the sunny Mission District of San Francisco, we invite everyone to enjoy the dusty comforts of our playa outpost. Pull up a bar stool at Flanagan's Pub - open day and night - for a refreshing beverage. Cozy up on one of our couches beneath the ample and breezy shade structure. Let loose on the dance floor. We're a relaxed and fun-loving crowd from all over - San Francisco, Tahoe, Reno, Los Angeles, Washington DC, Boston, New York, Seattle, Portland, Ireland, Germany, Belgium and beyond. Often serving tunes and always serving drink, the Mission Country Club has been calling Black Rock City home since 2004.

Nowhere; Probably is a camp that is designed to be a safe-haven from Society for any who are willing to participate. We are actively considerate of those experiencing unorthodox consciousness, be that temporarily, "neuro-divergent", or otherwise. Our main goal, aside from creating community, art, and more participation, is to show and empower the curious and courageous how to do more with less waste.

Nowhere; Probably is a place where "self"-expression, creation, and exploration are encouraged. We are here to support, help, and learn from each other. We do not need to limit ourselves in the scope of our expression, as our resources come at a seemingly infinite and ever increasing rate. We take what has been ignored or cast aside by Society and use it for living and creating.

events.description:
OMG! MUSIC WITH WORDS! Now in its 10th year on the playa, A Plus D bring BOOTIE BRC, the internationally-infamous bootleg mashup party, back to Black Rock City!

Bootie BRC celebrates (and satirizes) pop culture both past and present, keeping your brain guessing and body dancing with creative song combinations. Mixing and matching every musical genre, era, and style into one big dance party, it's the soundtrack for the A.D.D. generation -- with free mashup CDs given away like candy!

Launched by DJ duo A Plus D in 2003 in San Francisco, Bootie was the first club night dedicated solely to the burgeoning artform of the bootleg mashup, and is now the biggest mashup event in the world, with regular parties in several cities on four continents. Bootie BRC is presented in part by the BRC Weekly, Black Rock City's independent newsweekly. 

Bootie ... because one song at a time just isn't enough.

history.description: This year, The Heart Collective is combining its Squish Lounge, Healing Sanctuary, and Nourishment Lab into one structure: the < < < Nourishment Lounge>>> a one-stop shop for integrated energetic, nutritional, and somatic support. We host services from skilled and ethical practitioners, from massage to reiki to tuning forks to buffing. Come by to receive healing care offered on a first-come-first-serve basis by a rotating cast of practitioners from across the globe, or visit our alcohol-free space with nourishing and hydrating elixirs (both open throughout the afternoon on days later in the week). From sundown to sunup, we welcome burners to our communal fire, a sacred space that helps us greet the darkness and support us through the night.

Our space is a friendly, playful, sacred theme camp full of people who believe in the healing and life-giving power of water, community, and consensual, platonic, & relational intimacy. 
We provide three primary daytime offerings, all available to the public: A Nourishment Lab, where burners coming by are offered a variety of creative, nutrient-packed, non-alcoholic elixirs in the hot afternoons; the playa-famous Healing Sanctuary, where for 6 hours a day, Wed-Fri, dusty travelers can come get their weary bones tuned up or toned down, or receive bodywork, energy healing, and other wellness support; and our Squish Lounge, where curious folks can spend shady time relaxing with friends, enjoying a playshops, or - at night - simply a quiet place to come down or squish out~

This camp is a safe heart filled space that wants to promote and encourage you to take exquisite care of your mind, body, heart, and spirit, so that you can experience the burn from a place of wholeness and bring more of your own talents and gifts to the playa. It is our great honor to provide healing services at our sanctuary, squish in our consensual cuddle lounge, hydrate with superb elixirs at our nourishment lab, serve tea in our lotus lounge and most of all, love you up the heartist way we know how to. Work Heart. Play Heart. Rest Heart.

After that we create some goals. After you have this plan we plant a intention but burn all papers. Explain that thing was just a exercise of reflection but you need to be free to go with the flow :) (really works and is a life changed)

events.description:
BAF is a wave of movement that merges blind folded contact dance with body painting. As we create gentle movements into one another, the naked bodies (optional) become the paint brush and the canvas. The intention is to imagine the body as water drops melting into the desert while honoring our inner child.
Ecstatic music guides us to create a radiant color mandala on a canvas placed on the ground. Closing in savasana to integrate the energies soaked in and recognize the vulnerability and love of the collective held together to become a brand new artwork of light.

We will be playing games to connect with one another and ourselves, as well as going deeper into the waves of sensation that we experience as disconnection or pain. All is welcome in this space. Discover ancient secrets of breath, sound, and movement to take your orgasm into whole new worlds.

events.description: If you can say it you can play it! DRUM TALK is a school for students who want to discover and develop their voice on the West African djembe. Learn the Language of the Drum with Dan Bailey who teaches traditional West African polyrhythms, chants and djembe techniques specializing in Baba Olatunji's world renowned drum language. Using this method of vocalizing rhythms, drumming becomes accessible to everyone. By seeing, hearing, saying and playing the rhythms this approach appeals to all learning styles. Get clear tones while protecting your hands and taking care of your drum.

events.title: Ecstatic Sound Oasis

Ecstatic Sound Oasis is a co-creative sonic art movement where the participants immerse themselves in a non-ordinary state of mind, synchronizing their heartbeats into one harmonious pulse of deep connection with mother earth. 

This subtle meditation weaves heart activating cacao elixirs with sacred ritual practices of self-loving embodiment.

Shamanic breathwork is utilized in order to merge with the orgasmic chant of each individual, aiding in the journey, and creating dialogues between ancient beats and the singing bowls.

The vibrations will guide the life-force energies to embrace and expand love and compassion towards the heart of the BRC.

Attendees will leave with an augmented and upgraded capacity for emotional and energetic self regulation, as well as a keen awareness of how their newly harmonized moment-to-moment vibrational state is creating the reality that they step through.

Explore reasons for wanting to tie or be tied up, the safety factors involved, how to choose the right ropes and lengths. We teach foundational ties, and some intriguing variations, as well as explore a dynamic use of bondage from the sensual to the artistic. No previous rope experience is necessary.

"

events.title: Mermaid Spa Day
events.description: Welcome to the first ever Playa Mermaid Meetup! For experienced merfolk or anyone who's ever dreamed of becoming a mermaid or merman, join Mermaid Soluna at the Steam Bath for a full mermaid makeover! Bring your camera for a photo op in your new tail. Bring bubbles, spa goodies and sparkly thing-a-ma-bobs to share! Learn tips and tricks from a pro mermaid, discuss how we can de-moop our oceans, and just relish in the amazing wetness of the steam bath! After we've gathered all the mers, we jump on the nearest art-boat for a cruise around the playa.

events.title: Pink Floyd Ecstatic Dance
events.description:
Through the gates of dawn to the endless river, take a journey through time and space as we immerse ourselves in a flow of instrumental excerpts from over 40 years of the Pink Floyd discography.  Be inspired to dance and meditate, release your inner animal and break through your walls. From the dark side of the moon to the heart of the sun, the tiniest atom to the great interstellar expanse, the pulse of life to the great beyond, let us leave behind our divisions.  The eclipse brings darkness, yet the light ever returns.  We will always shine on, my bright ambassadors!  When the time comes, my only thought will be, I wish you were here.  ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ 
A note from the arranger:  This has been a project long in the making.  I have often felt the call of the dance from Pink Floyd’s music, momentary spans from so many different songs that called out to be joined together in one great epic track.  What you will hear has been carefully selected, shaped and spliced together to create a seamless experience, from a meditative beginning, ever amplified with a gentle rise in intensity, until we reach a riotous celebration of life and energy at the peak.   Like life itself, we release completely, winding down to a great finality.  What is at the end of our journey?  Have we lived our lives as completely and fully as we ever desired, as we look back from that long road?  We can only answer these questions for ourselves.  I invite you to take this opportunity to reflect on these things, and be yourself, as completely and fully as possible.   Let us live in a world we call can share.  With Love, Blue Jay

Eugene is as eager to talk about the challenges as to share in the joys.. This will be a thoughtful, provocative and fun gathering. There is no expectation of touch or contact, and each participant is given tools for finding and holding their own personal boundaries. This is an opportunity to let go of the busyness in our lives and in our heads, and really sink deeply into our body wisdom and experience our authentic selves.

It's waiting for you - right around the corner at your neighborhood dance or yoga studio - to inhabit your beautiful body and choose your amazing human life.

history.description: F Camp is a collection of individuals all passionate about the future of Environmental, Health, Love, Technology, and Governance.  We have a major focus on sustainability, reusability, and community, and have designed our entire camp with these three focuses in mind.  In our central Ashram we host events, workshops, discussions, and music that allow us to set our intentions, collaborate, and discuss how to shape our futures. Our camp realizes the importance that having a healthy mind, body, and spirit are needed to realize the intentions we set, thus we serve elixirs, meals and host an array of meditation, yoga, and spiritual ceremonies to invigorate us and provide the foundation for collaboration and discussion.

history.description: Fermented Reality celebrates fermentation in all its forms - of foods, drinks, the mind, and the body! This year, we're hosting events to ferment the SELF, ONE ANOTHER and the COMMUNITY. In the mornings, join our healing and energizing sessions, including yoga, latin HIIT, or a mindful cacao ceremony. Swing by our happy hours for fermented food, drinks, funky house tunes and laughs. Participate in games we can guarantee you've never seen before: Can you prevail in our Dickle Fencing ring? Or give our pickle glory hole wall a try–you never know what you might get! Participate in the inaugural Kimchi Circus and don your gowns for an evening at the Preserved Prom. We hail from 10 countries and 6 US states and would love to meet you and share stories on the playa!

events.title: Dickle Fencing Tournament
events.description: You can’t miss this 2-round event, which has gained popularity at our camp reunions and other burns over the years. Watching this sport while you wait your turn is nearly as fun as competing! Contestants strap on pickle dildos (“dickles”) and battle to knock off two ping pong balls that are attached with velcro to their competitor’s “balls,” while staying within the perimeter. We have added a melee round: 4 enter, only 1 emerges victorious! No hands allowed!

events.title: Pickle Glory Hole Bonanza
events.description: Guests are invited up to our 20-foot psychedelic mural/glory hole wall. On the other side, you may encounter pickles, other foods like whipped cream, and a lovely human with whom to exchange confessions, hopes, dreams, etc.. Optionally, adult guests can creatively interact with a pickle before eating it for a shot of whiskey, awarded at the host’s discretion. We'll host two “official” rounds over the week but the glory hole wall will be wide open, 24/7.

Campers will prepare burlesque and drag acts, and we’ll encourage and support gender-fermented impromptu shows by the attendees. An entire Prom Court (king, queen, duke, duchess, various minor Lords) will be chosen and crowned throughout the night.

Post-class we will serve spicy ginger kombucha shots to get your juices flowing. - Dreamy Restorative Yoga: 60-min class with calming soundscapes and soothing essential oils offered between poses. Post-class, we will serve breakfast yogurt & kefir parfaits (vegan and dairy options). - Enzyme Energizing HIIT Class: 60-min clothing-optional workout to energize and ignite! Josue will lead an upbeat workout class, filled with moovin, groovin, sweatin, and latin flair. Post-class, we will serve kombucha spritzers to freshen up. - Awakening Cacao Ceremony: Mindfulness meditation with ceremonial cacao, experiencing the cacao with intention through the five senses. (Fun fact: Cacao is fermented!)

Each performer will have their themed musical intro act, and thereafter will remain in-character as they join the crowd and interact with guests while sharing food. Expect clowns, mimes, jesters, dominatrices, drag queens, gnomes and more. Guests will be encouraged to take on a new persona and join ‘een. Participation is expected to accelerate over time, culminating in a true hootenanny.

events.title: Black Rock Studios Movie Review Club
events.description: Part interactive theater, part film aficionado gathering. Join Black Rock Studios at the French Quarter for this riveting discussion about a film that doesn't exist, at least not outside of our waking dreams.  We'll all pretend we saw it as we wing it with our most erudite of analysis and offer our best film critic opinions, worthy of Siskel and Ebert if they too decided to skip actually watching the film and made it up as they went along.   We'll also reenact some of its best moments from the greatest film you never actually saw but instead pretended to see.

events.description: We invite all of Black Rock City to join us in our march from the French Quarter to the ashes of the Man, and back. A smaller procession will continue on to the Temple with remembrances. The mood is joyous, humorous, melancholy, sultry, and respectful, all at once. It is a time in which we honor the dead by living life to the fullest. Before the parade, there will be an impromptu brunch in the French Quarter, and everyone is encouraged to bring whatever they would like to cook or share. Musicians are all welcome to join the main line. Mutant vehicles and other participants are all welcome to join the second line. If you are not bringing an instrument, feel free to bring libations or hydration to support the march.

PASSWORD FOR URL: fundamental.

Tierra Bomba teams up with with the Mayan Warrior to host a massive sound meditation with Alexandre Tannous (soundmeditation.com), aiming to inspire the Burning Man community around the spiritual aspect of meditation and the mystical aspect of sound.
Throughout the experience, Alexandre will play a series of ancient and new instruments and recordings that positively affect the spiritual growth of all living beings, while Paolo Montiel (NERD Studio) will play an innovative light show inspired by the golden spiral and the sacred geometry.
The sound meditation music will then slowly blend into a DJ that will drive attendees into a night filled with magical sounds and lights.

The sound meditation is an integrated practice that combines a shamanic ceremonial setting with an Eastern emphasis on breathing exercises and visualization. Specific musical instruments played during the meditation allow participants to use sound as a therapeutic tool to disconnect from discursive thinking and delve into a transcendental state. The goal is to enable participants to disengage their undesirable habitual patterns and to empower positive cognitive change. Most of the instruments used in a Sound Meditation are overtone-emitting instruments such as gongs, Tibetan singing bowls, bells, metallic discs, etc. These instruments have been used in meditation and sound healing for centuries in many cultures and continue to be used.
Alexandre has conducted ethnomusicology fieldwork for 18 years in over 40 countries. His research investigates issues of acculturation, community, musical identity in an urban setting, and the concepts of talent, charisma, and leadership in music.

French Maids have become indispensable to the spiritual progress of Black Rock City, no more so than in 2017 with the unprecedented proliferation of altars, most of which have ceased to function properly. Reports have come in that these altars are of no spiritual benefit whatsoever. In fact, the consensus among the BMOrg is that the spiritual growth of Burning Man has somehow been stunted. It’s been scientifically proven that the spiritual efficacy of altars is greatly diminished by even trivial amounts of dust. No matter how much dust your radical ritual kicks up, French Maids will be there to ensure a spiritual journey unencumbered by dust.

You too can be one of the sexiest clean freaks on the playa—please bring: feather dusters, rags, dustbusters, service carts, vacuums, white gloves, latex gloves, enema kits, lube, and any other useful cleaning equipment. In a 90 minute class the model will do several different poses allowing you to practice your skills.  Our instructor will share insights on how to capture light, shadow, muscle and form - as well as sharing examples of nude figure art to inspire your imagination and inner artist.  Paper and pencils provided and you're free to bring your own materials if desired.

history.description:
Gymnasium celebrates the ancient Greek tradition of nude exercise and competitions, a fun and practical way to keep your clothes from getting covered in dust. Our clothing optional camp hosts a variety of events include naked oil wrestling, nude yoga, an aerial rig, pottery and an interactive art wall where everyone is encouraged to contribute and participate.   We welcome attendees of all genders, races, sexual identities and athletic abilities to join us - a smile is the only thing you need to wear. 

www.GymnasiumBurningMan.com

events.title: Naked Art, Fun & Games
events.description: While our naked oil wrestling contests are taking place, we'll also have a variety of art, fun and games including naked bocce ball, a slack line (with instructor), giant human hamster wheel (can you spin yourself around the playa?), frisbee and a 25' long interactive art wall where you can paint with any or all of your body.

events.title: Naked Greek Pottery Making Class
events.description: Who doesn't like getting their fingers into it and getting a bit dirty? The ancient Greeks did! Pull up some Playa, channel your long lost Greek nonna and get creative with some clay. Create a bowl, small vase or even a shape that represents your mind. Naked pottery is a great way to meet some new friends, relax and unwind, or even a safe quiet place to try being naked in public for the first time!   Clay and shaping materials provided.

events.title: Naked Hatha Yoga & Pranayama
events.description: A reinvigorating traditional Hatha class to nourish your body and loosen any blockages you have. We'll also explore a range of breathing techniques (Pranayama) that will help purify your system and encourage a freer flow of energy around your body. For maximum benefits, try not too eat to much before!  We have a large padded area (also used for our naked oil wrestling) and a few yoga mats available for use.

events.title: Naked Oil Wrestling

history.description: Celebrating the traditions of ancient Greek sports, arts and philosophy with naked oil wrestling, competitions, yoga, pottery making and philosophical conversations in our Taverna.

events.title: Naked Oil Wrestling
events.description: Come test your skills on our wrestling mats in the classic Greek tradition of naked oil wrestling.  You provide the naked body, we provide the oil.  Your can choose your own wrestling partner, or we'll match you up with other playa citizens eager to give it a try.  Competitive ladders to select daily winners,  and large wipes and wine for all participants.

events.title: Naked Yoga

events.description: A great deal of Greek pottery features naked characters.  We mix that up a bit by creating pottery where the sculptors have the option to be naked.  We'll provide the clay, instructions and some inspiration from the beauty of the playa and participants who join this fun event.

events.title: Naked Philosophy and Wine
events.description: Join us in our Taverna for some conversation and wine.  We'll have thought starters for discussions, or bring your own topics you'd like to share and discuss as you relax in the shade and enjoy a glass of wine.

history.description: We want to recreate the atmosphere of the gymnasium in its original, Ancient Greek meaning, as a facility for training and competition in public games, as well as a place for socializing and engaging in intellectual pursuits. The term originates from the word [gymnós] meaning "naked", because historically in Ancient Greece one exercised naked, and we would like to revive this aspect too, as we think that by doing athletic and fun activities naked, participants will experience bonding aspect of such events stronger.

events.title: Butt-Cheeky Run
events.description: Come get your burn started – with the sun’s soft caresses on your butt cheeks! The Ancient Greeks always trained and competed naked – in fact the ’gym’ comes from the word ‘gymnos’, meaning ‘naked’ in Greek. Come experience the freedom of running together in the altogether! Or at least come and see what a great spectator sport it is:) We’ll do a warm-up at the camp and then run wild in the ‘hood and all the way to the Man!

events.title: Discus-ish Throw in the dark… and in the buff
events.description: Discus (well, LED-lit frisbee) throw competition followed by ultimate frisbee game (or regular frisbee, depending on the mood). Bare your body, but wear lights! The Ancient Greeks always trained and competed naked – in fact the ’gym’ comes from the word ‘gymnos’, meaning ‘naked’ in Greek. Come experience the amazing freedom of running and jumping and exercising free of clothing! Or at least come and see what a great spectator sport it is:) This is our only night event, but don’t worry about cold – movement will keep you warm!

events.title: Kerameikos (Ancient Greek pottery)
events.description: Ever wondered how those ancient vases were produced and decorated? Find out at our pottery school at Gymnasium, and you’ll be able to make some ceramics (kerameikos) of your own! It’s a three step process: first, we'll make the vases of different shapes using coil building techniques; then, we will let the clay dry to apply the slip and carve designs. (You can use the break for lunch or try some of our big toys, such as aerial rig or gymnastics wheel). At the last stage, the pots have to be fired after Burning Man, but we could ship your masterpiece to you, if you’d like! Otherwise, we’ll use it to decorate our camp and use the most appealing ones to award the winners of our athletic events next year.

events.title: Naked Oil Wrestling
events.description: Wrestling is one of the most fun sports you can ever try. It’s also one of humanity’s oldest and was among the major events of the original Olympics. Long before we were kicking balls around we were rolling around in the dirt, putting each other in headlocks! It doesn’t matter if you’re a complete novice who’s never tried it in your life or an experienced fighter, come along and experience this amazing bonding experience in Gymnasium, Black Rock City’s Ancient Greek wrestling school!

events.title: Naked Philosophy
events.description: Nudity has the power to surprise and shock, yet why, on reflection, can something as mundane as the naked body inspire simultaneously so much passion and revulsion? To be naked in 21st century western society demands intense self-examination, the questioning and reappraisal of conventional conventions and morality. In this sense, naturism, as the cultural and political movement of nudism is often known, is an inherently philosophical practice. And what better way to do philosophy than naked? We’re sure your college seminars would have been much more fun nude. Come and join us for lively discussions, debates and story-telling. We’ll be discussing naturism, body image, sharing experiences, debating body modification, if and how laws should be changed – really everything related to the human body.

events.title: Naked Piggy-Back and Wheelbarrow Run Race
events.description: are with us for this fun athletic event! Bring your friends, but choose wisely, as you’ll have to bear them on your back, bareback… or vice versa. Great bonding experience guaranteed! The Ancient Greeks always trained and competed naked – in fact the ’gym’ comes from the word ‘gymnos’, meaning ‘naked’ in Greek. Come experience the amazing freedom of running and jumping and exercising free of clothing! Or at least come and see what a great spectator sport it is:) PS In ancient Olympics this would have been an equestrian event, but BMORG wouldn’t let us bring horses…

events.description: Nude yoga and acro-yoga – for a better flow and connection :-) We'll end the session with drinking wine in your favorite poses, as Ancient Greeks sometimes drank wine in acrobatic poses at their symposiums. Then you could stay for our philosophical discussions sessions. Free your body, free your mind!

events.title: Greek Dance workshop
events.description: Let's dance like it's... Bacchanalia! Well, not only, but you'll have fun learning ancient and modern folk dances from Greece. You'll learn the distinction between the calm and lyrical Apollonian dance and the passionate, "orgasmic" Dionysian dance.

events.title: Naked Oil Wrestling
events.description: Wrestling is one of the most fun sports you can ever try. It’s also one of humanity’s oldest and was among the major events of the original Olympics. Long before we were kicking balls around we were rolling around in the dirt, putting each other in headlocks! It doesn’t matter if you’re a complete novice who’s never tried it in your life or an experienced fighter, come along and experience this amazing bonding experience in Gymnasium, Black Rock City’s Ancient Greek wrestling school!

events.title: Naked Philosophy
events.description: Nudity has the power to surprise and shock, yet why, on reflection, can something as mundane as the naked body inspire simultaneously so much passion and revulsion? To be naked in 21st century western society demands intense self-examination, the questioning and reappraisal of conventional conventions and morality. In this sense, naturism, as the cultural and political movement of nudism is often known, is an inherently philosophical practice. And what better way to do philosophy than naked? We’re sure your college seminars would have been much more fun nude. Come and join us for lively discussions, debates and story-telling. We’ll be discussing naturism, body image, sharing experiences, debating body modification, if and how laws should be changed – really everything related to the human body.

Great bonding experience guaranteed! The Ancient Greeks always trained and competed naked – in fact the ’gym’ comes from the word ‘gymnos’, meaning ‘naked’ in Greek. Come experience the amazing freedom of running and jumping and exercising free of clothing! Or at least come and see what a great spectator sport it is:) PS In ancient Olympics this would have been an equestrian event, but BMORG wouldn’t let us bring horses…

events.title: Nude Yoga + Wine

Then you could stay for our philosophical discussions sessions. Free your body, free your mind!

history.description: Gymnasium: We want to recreate the atmosphere of gymnasium in its original, Ancient Greek meaning, as a facility for training and competitions in public games, as well a place for socializing and engaging in intellectual pursuits. The term originates from the word [gymnós] meaning “naked”, because historically one exercised naked, and we would like to revive this aspect too, as we think that by doing athletic and fun activities naked, participants will experience bonding aspect of such events stronger and will only feel more comfortable and confident in their own skin.

events.description: Come play beer-in-hand soccer at the one and only BRC Arena Camposanto Soccer Stadium. Fire Soccer a distinct possibility. Camposanto es territorio futbolero. In 2012 we used a glow in the dark ball and black light to stretch the futbol games into the night. In 2013 we built the first official stadium of Black Rock City. “El Monumental” . In 2014 we took the world cup to playa with a little twist, no nations, no flags, just the joy for the sport… at a very fancy stadium. In 2015 and 2016 we had a professionally measured futbol 5 field. We do take special care of the field the whole year in order to have one of the best sport arenas of Black Rock City. Pink Dragon is a sonic sanctuary born from the dust, dedicated to the radical ritual of dance and connection. Rooted in the spirit of Burning Man and inspired by the pulsating heartbeats of cities like Los Angeles and San Francisco, Pink Dragon is where music meets transformation.

events.title: Group W Friday Morning Sunrise Cocktail Party
events.description:
Group W did our first Friday Morning Welcome The Sun Cocktail Party in 2002 and we've never looked back, or gotten a full night's sleep on the Playa Thursday since then!

Whether you need one of our AWESOME MIXED FROM SCRATCH BLOODY MARYS to start your day RIGHT or a shot of whisk(e)y as you stride back to your camp in Glory, we will set you up!

At Group W we pride ourselves on have excellent booze and great fun!  We serve our guest great drinks with or with out alcohol, mimosas and a vast array other drinks. 
Why: So we can spend all day Friday slinging drinks at friends new and old. 
Where: Near Pi (3.14 and Eleckto. Put your nose in the air and set it for booze! When: Starting at Sunrise Friday, and lasting until all is drunk or the generator runs out of gas. 
Remember, to have a hard day of drinking you need to start EARLY. 
Bring your own cup, you'll get more!

And ask our friends at Math Camp for a pocket protector.

events.title: Math Camp Lectures, Discussion, Presentation, Etc
events.description:
Math Camp at BRC is a Safe Place for Mathematics.  Whether you need to do you math homework, practice your Thesis Defense, discourse on your favorite topic Mathematics, or ask that question that is still puzzling you, this is the place.

We love people coming it and giving talks on topics they love!

If you have a question related to Mathematics we will try to answer it, and if write it on a white board and someone often will provide a solution.

We have Mathematical toys and games for your amusement.

So whether you are a Mathophile or a Mathophobe, you are welcome here.

Group W has a fine bar, so if you need a drink before you derive, this is the place!

events.title: Plunderground's Museum of Oddities and Fire Lounge
events.description:
Plunderground is beyond excited to once again bring our creative genius to Black Rock City. We have decided to shake it up a bit in the spirit of keeping things fresh. This year we will be combining aspects of our ever popular Museum with our bar and tower to create a truly magical interactive bar/gathering place. We will also be bringing our Fiery Flowers and Zen Garden fire art piece to light up the night sky with flame and intention.
Our tower is a 3 level, 24’ high, Ringlock scaffold system with 2 poofers set on two corners above the uppermost observation deck. These poofers will be actuated by participants in the bar as part of our interactive offerings. Entry to the lower level of the tower will be from a magical entrance from the bar.
There will be several hands-on interactive components of our museum scattered through the bar area including our 3D sandbox. Our very own mannequin “DJ Chernobyl, aka Chernobyl Boi”, will be spinning tunes to create a groovy, funky atmosphere while participants mingle and interact.
Our Fiery Flowers and Zen Garden art piece has 3 poofers which are actuated with a plunger and the base is a flaming sand in which participants create designs in the flaming sand.

events.title: Bike Repair Seminar
events.description: BRCH3 believes in encouraging the playa denizens toward both self-sufficiency & stewardship of our environment. One of the largest sources of moop is the “disposable” bikes that many buy for 1-2 burns and then send to the landfill because it no longer works as it should due to playa dust and corrosion. New for 2022, BRCH3 will be hosting a bike maintenance & basic bike repair seminar. The goal will be to increase knowledge about maintaining one’s bike without needing to rely on others & increasing the longevity of burner bicycles, thereby reducing the unnecessary waste-consumption cycle of many repeat burners.

events.title: Bike Repair Station (MON-FRI)
events.description: Is your bike jammed up? We service hundreds of bike fixes on playa and new for 2022, we will include limited e-bike servicing. For 5 hours a day, we’ll provide repair services along with parts including tubes, pedals, lubricant, brake cables, and the occasional seat or two. Outside of these hours, we provide a self-help “radically self-reliant” station where people are able to repair their own bikes while we’re not actively servicing bikes.

BRCH3 will have extra lights & decor to make bikes representative of their owners and last through rough and tumble playa dust. The hosts will encourage decommodification in favor of personalized expression.

events.title: Boudior Photo Booth
events.description:
Bring your sexy body and sexy outfits over to the BRCH3 Boudoir Studio and celebrate your beautiful playa self. More than just a photo booth, every visitor to the studio receives a custom individualized session with an experienced photographer and professional equipment, lighting and set. Every participant receives an archive-quality no-run no-fade print of the shot of their choice and can opt-in to receive all of their photos from their session via a secure encrypted archive sent after the burn. 

We welcome all individuals and couples to sit for a session and capture their inner and outer beauty to share (or not) however they choose. Women, men and gender-nonconforming individuals of any (adult) age, race, background, culture and body shape or type are graciously welcomed and encouraged to participate, the goal of our art is to capture the inner beauty and sexiness in all of us. This year we’ll be coordinating with BRCH3’s Motorboat Monday and Red Dress Exchange events during which time models in theme attire will be given priority access, however no specific outfits or attire (or attire at all) is ever required.

Other bonus pop up times or by chance or appointment.
