The Tiniest Camp is a place where people can connect and have meaningful conversations. We offer an intimate and cozy environment.
You won't find any grandiose installations or flashy decorations. Instead, you'll find a humble gathering of burners who are there to share stories, ideas, and experiences. The focus is on creating a space that allows for genuine interactions and deep conversations.
It is a testament to the idea that bigger isn't always better. We place a strong emphasis on creating a welcoming and inclusive environment, and create a space where everyone feels comfortable and valued, regardless of their background or beliefs. 
At the Tiniest Camp, you can disconnect from the distractions of modern life and truly engage with the people around you. It's a beautiful thing to witness.

Want to look at the sun?  Want to look at the sun and NOT go blind? We got you, and we'll even paint you up once you're done.  Greet the dawn with qigong.  Or put the more entertaining parts of your anatomy to work by learning just how dancers make those tassels spin.

Or, just kick back in the shade, trade a bad idea for a bad drink, and relax at the worst bar on the Playa (since 2010!).

events.title: Bad Idea Bar
events.description: Ever have a really bad idea? A really, really stupid idea? We want ALL of them. We love bad ideas and think they are worth a drink or three. Stop by anytime the bar is lit. Prizes awarded.

events.title: Bismuth or Bust
events.description: Bismuth is a metal with crazy crystalline properties. Apply heat and turn a featureless lump of dull grey metal into elaborate beautiful crystals. The process is fascinating to watch and the results are unique and beautiful. Listen as we babble on about relevant topics in science or just make up facts as we go. We'll show you how and you'll leave with a crystal of your own, supplies permitting. Mon-Fri 2-3pm Dark Wednesday.

events.title: Body Painting
events.description: Brush painting, designs or semi abstract; you can also use our paint and materials to paint others of your party

events.title: Can't say NO Thursday
events.description: Don't let sleep deprivation get you down. Say Yes to everything asked of you on Thursday and be amazed where it takes you. Prizes awarded for Hot Mess, Train Wreck, and Best of Shit Show.

events.description: Dressed in our Playa Christmas best we’ll be playing Christmas tunes, handing out candy canes and serving Holiday themed shots at the Bad Idea Bar and in the street. Come get your holiday cheer on and get your picture taken with Santa.

events.title: Flat Earth Society vs. Science debate
events.description: A debate for the ages.  Is the earth really a giant flat disk?  How have we not fallen off it yet? Is science real or made up?  Pick a side and put forth your best arguments.

events.title: Hate your liver?

We reward bad ideas with drinks like the Chumbawamba, Len’s pee bottle, and The Destroyer. Virgins to the Bad Idea Bar should ask for the Dirty Reach around.  Now with 100% more Malort!

More experienced practitioners are welcome as well, Steve might just hand the class over to you. Afterwards we are likely to open up the Bad Idea Bar for some bad ideas and beverages.

events.title: Meet the Artists Tour Broadcast on BMIR 94.5 FM
events.description:
Coming at you directly from the Playa on BMIR - Burning Man Information Radio! An "unholy" alliance between the ARTery and BMIR, the Meet the Artist Broadcast will be hosted once again by Diablo, Dazzle! & G-Spot. 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ 

There is a ton of AMAZING Art this year and we're gonna tell you about SOME of it, while interviewing a FEW of the incredible artists who dreamed it all up and created these fantastic works.

 ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ 

You can turn in to BMIR 94.5 FM while on the Playa, stream on-line worldwide at http://www.BMIR.org/ or (best of all) come follow the tour on your bike! Which Art Car to follow? None other than The Queen of BRC: "Christina" and Captain Flipper. Just look on the Esplanade near the ARTery/BMIR for a gorgeous 58' yacht with blue "waves" on her hull.  http://bit.ly/ChristinaArtCar

 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ 

Have you ever stopped and wondered about some of the art out on the playa, and thought: "What the Fuck were they thinking!?!" Now you might just find out . . . 


All YOU have to do now on Thursday August 30th, 2018 just before 11:00 a.m. is remember to: 


TURN ON! ~Your radio 

TUNE IN! ~To 94.5 FM on the Playa (or stream on-line @ http://www.BMIR.org/) 

or DROP EVERYTHING ~You Dusty Burner & come follow us out into the desert on your bicycle . . . 


You won't regret it,

Diablo

history.description:
It's a bird, it's a plane, it's a tethered hot air balloon flying 75 feet high in the sky!

Climb aboard and experience a unique journey while being serenaded by live instrumentals mixed with electronic beats high up in the sky. Enjoy stunning views of Black Rock City and take in the joys of life on our ground-level dance floor.

Craving some pampering? Step into our old world circus lounge where you can snuggle up, dive into cinematic wonders, and recharge with treats, massages, and a sprinkle of delightful surprises.

It's a bird, it's a plane, it's a tethered hot air balloon flying 50 feet high in the sky!

Get on and take a ride, be serenaded by live instrumentals or electronic music sets in an intimate setting, while enjoying the beautiful views of Black Rock City. 

Need a little TLC? Come into our balloon lounge where you will be treated very nicely. Water, massages, and fresh fruit are waiting to nourish you.

If there is only one healthy thing you do all week make it this!

Whether you decided to camp with HOVerlandia or elsewhere, ALL are invited for a potluck/happy hour to reconnect with old busmates and meet new friends who also HOVered in :-D

Embark on a journey of rejuvenation with HealAF, a one-of-a-kind camp at Burning Man, where we combine traditional Asian techniques to help burners recover and replenish on the playa. Our camp offers an array of healing modalities, ranging from Tai Chi and sound baths to hyperbaric oxygen therapy and moxibustion.

Take a break from the dusty playa to experience the restorative powers of ancient Asian healing arts in our Kezhan-inspired lounge.

The Whomp Wagon, Jimmy's origins are sketchy. Legend has it that he was the main ride used by the most popular beat boys of the 1800's. Both DJ's, Lewis and Clark have been rumored to travel from settlement to settlement disrupting society with loud music. Jimmy eventually died of dysentery and the wagon was lost for years! Historians say the trail ended somewhere deep in the Nevada desert! THE WHOMP IS BORN, Found in the deep playa under a cloud of Dust, Dirty Beats & Lasers The Whomp Wagon was born! THE FUTURE The Whomp Crew now pushes our journey into the future with one inclusive vision: To create a platform where musicians of all genres can perform and share their gift for everyone. Burning Man changed our lives for the better and forever! The Whomp Wagon is our gift to Burning Man!

events.title: Recycle Your Aluminum Cans!
events.description:
Making drinking plans for your camp? Do those plans include lots and lots of aluminum cans? Want to unload all those empty cans on playa while also helping the kids of Gerlach? 

Well then come on down to Recycle Camp and SHOW US YOUR CANS! At Recycle Camp we will take all of your aluminum cans of your hands as part of our gift to the playa. We are located directly behind the Center Camp Café on 6:00 and are open every day 9am to 5pm. Please no drop offs: participate! When you get there, we will help you quickly separate your cans before riding THE CRUSHINATOR, our magical bicycle-powered can crushing apparatus that crushes your cans flat so we can store as many as possible before scrapping the aluminum off-site. All of the money we generate from aluminum recycling is donated directly to the Gerlach school system. Everybody wins!

We can only accept ALUMINUM cans. Please no glass, plastic, steel, or tin cans, so please keep all of your water bottles, tetrapaks, soup cans, and coconut waters separated. A good rule of thumb for figuring out if something is aluminum: if you can't crush it by hand, then we don't want it! Some stout beers like Guinness also have a plastic widget inside that cannot be recycled with the aluminum, please remove it beforehand or we can show you how. 

PROTIP from the Recyclenaut Aluminati: bring a MESH bag to collect all of your cans in. Plastic garbage bags don't allow your cans to dry out and create a foul, sticky sludge. If you store them in a mesh bag before bringing them over to Recycle Camp it helps make things a little less juicy for you when we they get sorted and crushed. Be smart, plan ahead, Recycle Camp wants YOU to come CRUSH it with us!!!

events.title: Recycle Your Aluminum Cans!!!
events.description: Black Rock City is a "Pack It In, Pack It Out", Leave No Trace city. There are no trash cans or recycling bins. You are responsible for disposing of waste properly. Do you want to reduce the amount of recycling you will have to pack out? Start by bringing all of your beverages in aluminum cans. Follow that by separating your your aluminum cans and other recyclables from any landfill trash. Bring your aluminum cans to Black Rock City Recycle Camp. We are located in Center Camp at 6:00, directly behind the Cafe. The camp is "Open" and ready to accept your aluminum cans Monday through Sunday, 9am to 5pm. Bring your clean, separated aluminum cans only. We definitely don't want your trash. We do not accept any other recyclables, you can take them to one of the 24 hour recycling stations on your way back to Reno, check out your Survival Guide for more information. We provide a sorting area to check your cans for anything that isn't aluminum. You can ride the bike powered can crusher and crush your cans. After your cans get crushed, you will put your crushed cans into the large containers at the camp. All proceeds from the aluminum are donated to the Gerlach K-12 School in Gerlach, NV. Come join in the fun while doing a good thing for the planet and Black Rock City..!!!

All proceeds from the aluminum are donated to the Gerlach K-12 School in Gerlach, NV. Come join in the fun..!

By focusing the community's tremendous artistic, technical and spiritual energy, we can go beyond leaving "no trace" and leave instead, positive traces on the land. Come see our many bike nature and geology tours, sustainability BRC and planet solution speakers, DIY workshops, Aztec Burner dances, or volunteer training and gatherings! Come and volunteer on our LNT and compliance outreach teams or participate in a Gerlach LNT our hot-spring patrol, jump on our MOOP train and test your MOOP grabbing skills!

events.description: Come learn about the vast Black Rock Desert and what makes it come alive. Dave Cooper, local and former manager of the Black Rock NCA will talk about playa dust, wilderness areas, historic emigrant trails, wildlife, wild horses, & more. Come with questions!

events.title: Playa Sunrise Bike Tour
events.description: The “golden hour" after dawn is prime for wildlife spotting. Tour the deep playa, find “Golden MOOP” at the trash fence. Cameras, binoculars and field guides welcome.

events.title: MOOP = ART
events.description: Make a cyanotype sunprint of playa MOOP you have collected. Supplies for 20. Come early & bring your MOOP!

events.title: Empowerment & Growth with Connection with Animals
events.description: Learn to allow animal consciousness to support your path. Be ready to share what growth you are ready for and we will bring the energy of that from animal consciousness. With Maud Skywalker.

events.title: The Burnt Giant Sequoia Groves
events.description: Join WildPlaces Director, Mehmet McMillan, to learn about the fire in the California Giant Sequoia groves in 2021 and how traditional indigenous stewardship practices are being taught to restore the land.

events.title: Lust for Light with TEDXer/Author Marlin
events.description: In one human lifetime our connection to the stars was lost due to light pollution, learn the impact on the biosphere, and how you can save the night.

events.title: Shine Your Light On Me!
events.description: Low cost, but high-tech ways to get off fossil fuels to charge small devices on the playa and off. DIY gurus Darrell and Michael will demo a beginner set up. See a solar charging system that costs about $150.

events.title: Why Knot?
events.description: Learn to tie a few useful knots and lashes (and a few that are just for show), their names, and where they are best used. Lengths of rope available so you can practice.

events.title: Leave Big Pharma in the Dust
events.description: Alex Howe, aka Bush Ninja, has studied traditional medicine throughout Southern Africa and the USA for more than a decade and focuses his teachings on practical herbalism tips for every day humans. This playshop will help you with the BM principles of decommodification and self-reliance in meeting medicinal needs. He'll demonstrate how to make a natural healing balm for the skin and lips, perfect for playa, and give other practical herbalism tips. Some will be gifted in limited supply!

events.title: Aztec Dance to Honor Mother Earth & the 4 Directio
events.description: Aztec dancers with rare, traditional instrument accompanists will renew our connection to earth, wind, fire and water. Dances will be explained while connecting us to nature; we will end with a friendship community dance circle which all are encouraged to join.

events.title: Live Salsa Party
events.description: Salsa music party hosted by the Aztec Burners. Come at 9 PM for the one hour salsa lesson.

events.title: Guided Meditation with Maud Skywalker
events.description: Manifesting the ecosystem of the planet returning to balance + tuning into the power of your self-reliance to help the planet.  After the meditation, participants will be invited to share how they felt and any decision they might have made.

events.title: The Lorax, A Performance Piece
events.description: An impassioned recital of Dr. Seuss' best title, for small and big Burners great pleasure. To gain inspiration for our planet’s salvation come through and partake of this treasure.

events.title: Nuclear Power Generation
events.description: What is it, pros and cons, let's discuss.  Bring your questions. With nuclear engineer, Steve Hunt.

events.title: Bee-Cause: Beekeeping 101
events.description: With 30-year apiarist, Jeremiah Conley: morphology, biology,  environmental threats, harvesting & safely storing.  Bring questions, handouts provided.

events.title: Coffee on the Man
events.description: As if last night wasn't enough, the Man just keeps on giving. Kick-start your day with a hot hit of caffeine with Earth Guardians at our annual "Coffee on the Man" (or what's left of him). There, on a pocket of hot coals, we brew up authentic Nevada Basque-style Cowboy Coffee in large enamelware pots. We have enough water for 15 gallons and serve it piping hot until it's all gone. It's plain old black Joe, although we will have powdered and evaporated milk as creamer and Sweetleaf for sweetener. Be sure to bring your favorite coffee cup. And maybe a camera for the sunrise, although your eyes'll probably do just fine.

events.title: How to do an Energy Inventory of Your Camp
events.description: An energy inventory of the your camp's electrical equipment is needed to be successful in the reduction of your camp’s carbon footprint, locating electrical waste and is also needed in sizing a solar or wind generation system. It is also a means to reduce your home’s carbon footprint and save money. Handouts will be provided. Recommend writing material and a calculator.

Come, volunteer and participate in our daily talks about Black Rock and Leave No Trace or just grab a MOOP bag!

events.title: Adventures of a Nature Conservationist
events.description: From Brazil to Congo to Sumatra, the pressures on nature, on our rainforests, oceans and wildlife remain the same - us! It's is my life purpose to help change this and to help others also to BE the change. Through conservation work, starting a humanitarian charity, teaching yoga, meditation and wellness and seeing the beauty in everything, I aim to spread the love and help the world find its compassion and oneness. Talk by Suzanne Ford.

events.title: Alternative Energy Demo Garden
events.description: Food served baked in a solar oven. An assortment of alternative energy devices will be on display including DIY solar ovens, commercial solar ovens, a rocket stove, and an evapotron for gray water; come sample our treats!

events.title: Applying Behavioral Economics to Eat Less Meat
events.description: Even if you are not ready to go vegan. Not only are you what you eat, but the planet is what we eat. According to the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), the livestock sector is “one of the most significant contributors to the most serious environmental problems, at every scale from local to global”. Leading behavioral scientist, Kelly Peters,  talks about the shift to plant-based diets using tactics drawn from the field of behavioral science.

events.title: Aztec Dance to Honor Mother Earth & 4 Directions
events.description: Aztec dancers with rare, traditional instrument accompanists will renew our connection to earth, wind, fire and water. Dances will be explained while connecting us to nature; we will end with a friendship community dance circle which all are encouraged to join.

events.title: Behind the Green Curtain Bike Tour
events.description: An interpretive bike tour of some of Black Rock City's Green camps featuring solar installations, grey water set ups, recycling efforts, plastic-free living, solar cookers and much more, Come see what innovators are doing to make Black Rock City more environmentally friendly.

events.title: Bitcoin as an Economic Battery
events.description: How Cryptocurrency Mining Can Fund and Revolutionize Renewable Energy Build-out  - Despite massive government subsidies and a push towards renewable energy sources, every day, billions of watts of existing renewable energy are wasted across the United States and the globe by curtailment from the electric grid. This is due to the variable nature of wind and solar compared to high density “on demand” power sources from fossil fuels. Come learn how energy demanding crypto mining actually presents a unique and robust economic solution for wasted, curtailed and stranded renewables, allowing providers such as wind and solar farms to make money and fund additional build-out by purchasing the previously wasted energy. Presented by Jesse Phillips.

events.title: Bokashi Composting
events.description: Bokashi is a technique developed by Japanese scientists to make it easy for city dwellers to deal with their food waste. Bokashi composting is an anaerobic process that relies on inoculated bran to ferment kitchen waste, including meat and dairy, into a safe soil builder and nutrient-rich tea for your plants.

events.title: Composting at BRC
events.description: Food waste can be 40% of your total waste at BRC. We explore techniques suitable for the Playa and the need to Leave No Trace, so that food does not become a stinking heavy mess. When food scraps are dealt with properly, there are not smells or flies and it's easy to pack out to a proper compost.

events.title: DIY Wick Gardening Demo
events.description: Grow veggies in a small area all year round using less water with wick gardening. Build it once with recycled materials and use it for years. Also, plans for composting in a container that gives you compost tea. Your plants will love you!

events.title: Earth Guardians Live Music Showcase
events.description: Music as medicine hosted by Nathyn Knott & friends. We are the change: shifting, reflecting, healing, inspired by our connection to earth & nature.

events.title: Earth Guardians Open Bar
events.description: Come try a “LNTini”, “Playarita” or “Fairy Shrimp” cocktail!

events.title: Earth Guardians Salsa Music Party
events.description: Salsa music party hosted by our own  Aztec Burners. Come at 9 PM for the 1 hour salsa lesson.

events.title: Earth Party - Greening the Burn / LNT Cocktails
events.description: We are legal!  Help Earth Guardians celebrate 21 years on the playa this year. We will celebrate all of you Green, Eco and LNT superheros with earthy libations from the EG bar and some Earth-produced nosh to celebrate the high valued LNT /green burners! All LNT/Green camps invited!.  Without you, Black Rock City would not be sustainable!

events.title: Earthquake in Super Slo-Mo
events.description: It’s the biggest revolution in Earth Science since plate tectonics was figured out in the 60’s. Mel Zhang, University of Colorado Boulder, will talk about the "slow earthquakes" known as slow slip events (SSEs): what they are and why they are important.

events.title: Ecozoic Café: Earth Metamorphosis
events.description: Ecozoic is the geologic era that Earth is entering – when humans live in a mutually enhancing relationship with Earth and all community of life. We invite you to experience yourself within the journey of the universe. Through empowering the self and others, humankind will apply positive solutions to the difficulties of these times and emerge creative skills to find ways to survive as well as nurture sustainable harmonious relationships with the Earth community .

events.title: Embracing Darkness
events.description: How changing our relationship with light can impact the trajectory of climate change - Want to know the impact making light has had on the planet? How our superstitious fear of the dark has wreaked havoc on the environment in ways we never see yet it is as plain as the light bulb in front of your face. We all love LED's on the Playa and even though there have been great advances in the software that programs them, what advances have been made on the LED itself? Here is the opportunity to see the world's first 2200K, 1900K and 1700K LEDs that are helping preserve the Dark Skies the world over. They are a game changer in the realm of municipal street lighting specifically addressing  the 2016 AMA public statement of the harm to human health being caused by lights that are 3000K and higher.

events.title: Energy Storage: The Latest Key to 100% Renewables
events.description: A brief overview of grid scale energy storage and the current hurdles faced with implementation. Talk will include overview of current technologies, regulatory hurdles, should I stay plugged into the gird or go independent, mass implementation in our short remaining time and how we get there.

events.title: Experience Deep Time on the Playa Bike Tour
events.description: This is your opportunity to contemplate Deep Time while on the playa. Your journey will be led by geology experts Drs. Elizabeth Miller (Stanford U) and John Dilles (Oregon SU). Bike to the outer playa to contemplate the history of this place we call home, from the deep time geologic framework to the ice ages, first human inhabitants in the region, post-glacial warming and inexorable warming of the Anthropocene era. Burn baby burn! P.S. Deep Time = Geologic Time.

events.title: Fighting Plastic Waste in Morocco and Africa
events.description: Break Free From Plastic - Mamoun Ghallab, has lived a zero waste life-style for 6 years and is a Moroccan activist fighting plastic pollution. He will share the story of how environmental NGOs are acting to reduce plastic waste in countries where there is no separate waste collection and recycling. In Africa, fighting plastic pollution is about proving that other production and consumption models are necessary and possible. That’s how we can #BreakFreeFromPlastic !

events.title: Finding Optimism in a Burning World
events.description: Kerry Nickols, professor of marine biology at California State University Northridge, will discuss climate change and its impacts on the oceans and share how an all-women expedition to Antarctica pulled her out of climate despair.

events.title: Geology of the Black Rock Desert
events.description: Ever wondered about those amazing land forms around Black Rock City? Come and learn how they were formed and what they're about. Come and learn about the rocks from Cathy Busby, our expert geologist from UC Davis.

events.title: Getting Deep Into Hot Water
events.description: Hot springs ARE living systems.  Come hear geologist Glenn Melosh explain how they form, where they occur, and how the earth expresses itself with hot water.

events.title: Here Comes the Sun
events.description: Get an overview of options for solar cooking: which models can be bought and some that can be made. Pros and cons. At least 5 models of solar cookers/ovens available to see.

events.title: How Nature Heals
events.description: We've all heard that spending time in nature is good for us, but do we know why? Forest therapy guide Hana Lee Goldin explains the science behind how nature facilitates health and wellness, and will teach us how to practice forest bathing to reap all its potent benefits (forest not required).

events.title: Ice and Earth's Climate over Thousands of Years
events.description: Eleanor Middlemas, University of Colorado Boulder, will put our current climate into historical context, i.e., a time when much of North America was under a mile-thick ice sheet. How much ice melt is caused by humans, and what will an ice-free Arctic & Antarctic mean for our planet?

events.title: Juice Lab & Snow Cone Saloon
events.description: Join Jai and Zobek for a kid-sponsored bar serving brightly colored juice in various states of matter (liquid and frozen!). Come and share LNT tips.

events.title: Leading the Way Locally on Climate
events.description: Morgan Goodwin, vice mayor of Truckee, CA will speak about his efforts to make his town a leader in the global effort to combat climate change, and offer insight into how you can be more leaderful in your community.

events.title: Leave Big Pharma in the Dust
events.description: Alex Howe, aka Bush Ninja, has studied traditional herbalism in South Africa for the last 5 years and will help you with the BM principles of decommodification and self-reliance in meeting medicinal needs. He'll demonstrate how to make a natural healing balm for the skin and lips and give other practical herbalism tips.

events.title: Mapping the World for Food and Water Security
events.description: Mapping the World for Food and Water Security in the 21st Century - Is there enough fresh water for food?  Danny Foley (USGS) discusses how to use water more efficiently for agriculture.

events.title: MOOP Champagne Train
events.description: Hitch a ride in style to the outer limits of BRC on the EG Champagne MOOP Train. See what treasures you find to put in your free, hand-made MOOP bag.

events.title: More Than Just One Word on Plastics
events.description: Plastics: we love them and hate them. Rebecca Braslau, organic chemistry professor at UC Santa Cruz, will discuss the history of plastics, what they are made of, health, environmental and societal issues, and exciting developments in emerging biosustainable and biodegradable plastics.

events.title: Native Voices Speak For the Planet
events.description: Join the Aztec Burners on The Red Road exploring ancient knowledge applied to contemporary living to be in harmony with Mother Earth. Topics include how Burning Man informs the Indigenous approach to planetary solutions to our environmental crisis and also to ceremony.

events.title: Permaculture for Any Space
events.description: Come learn about vertical, urban/small space farming, what to grow and how. Tips for maximizing your space to grow healthy food in your very own Zen food forest.

events.title: Playa Nature Bike Tour
events.description: The playa seems featureless, but the lake bed is a complex environment. Facilitated by a nature therapy guide, search for clues to the shape of the constantly changing surface. See how our city and art affects the environment, and how Burning Man strives to Leave No Trace.

events.title: Playing With Worms
events.description: DIY worm farm. Worms are the perfect pets and a great, odorless way to reduce your organic waste at home, no matter if you live on a 900 square meter property in Wyoming or a 1-bedroom apartment in Brooklyn. During the workshop, learn how to build your own worm farm (you can make it as big or as small as you want), where to get your worms from and how to ensure the little critters will have a comfortable life at your place.

events.title: Procession to the Temple
events.description: Join Earth Guardians & Aztec Dancers in procession to the temple to offer a blessing and connect to Mother Earth.

events.title: Space Debris: Pollution in the Final Frontier
events.description: Since 1958, western civilization’s rapid economic and military evolution has grown the population of stable Earth-orbiting objects from one - the Moon - to tens of thousands. The vast majority of these objects fall around Earth like forgotten cannonballs from an ancient war, ready to strike an unlucky passerby days, months, years, decades, or centuries after being launched. In this talk, Alan Smith, who works in space traffic management, will trace through the history of humanity’s use of space, from Sputnik, to weather satellites, to geosynchronous communications satellites, to the Global Positioning System, and the mega-constellations currently being fabricated. With each object moving in different directions at speeds many times faster than an assault rifle bullet, we’ll also explore what can be done to address this seemingly-intractable problem.

events.title: Speaking Truth to Plastic, One Sip at a Time
events.description: Plastic pollution is a global crisis in our soil, water and air. Plastic pollution affects the health of our planet, animals and ourselves, but solutions abound. Join Jackie Nuñez the founder of The Last Plastic Straw and Program Manager for Plastic Pollution Coalition, learn how to reduce your plastic footprint and become part of the solution to plastic pollution.

events.title: Stay Green, Clean, and Beautiful on the Playa
events.description: Zero waste and plastic-free is possible at BRC. Come learn a few tricks and tips for Playa and off-Playa life from dozens of burns, ancient recipes, and new ideas from around the world. Learn how to make your own wipes, how to protect your hair during the event (+ the one ingredient shampoo to clean and nourish your hair), try the one cup of water "shower" for instant refreshment and leave with the recipe of the magical cream to moisturize, remove your make-up, help you against the cold if temperatures drop at night. You're welcome to interact and share your own magic too.

events.title: Sustainable Energy : Past Present Future
events.description: A Family Discussion - Concentrating on solar solutions and the state of energy storage.  A discussion with Tom Taska.

events.title: The Black Rock Desert: Our Inspiring Home
events.description: Come learn about the vast Black Rock Desert and what makes it come alive. Dave Cooper, local and former manager of the Black Rock NCA will talk about playa dust, wilderness areas, historic emigrant trails, wildlife, wild horses, & more. Come with questions!

events.title: The Future of Burning Man is in Our Hands
events.description: Futurists Annette Gardner and Eric Barela will engage participants in envisioning alternative futures for Burning Man 2050. Will an unlimited number of Burner avatars frolic on a 24/7 virtual playa?  Will all camps--small and large--be required to use only solar energy?  Come and co-create your preferred future of Burning Man.

events.title: The Future of Mobility on and off the Playa
events.description: Biking, micro mobility and sharing economy: What can cities learn from burning man (and vice versa) to make future mobility more liveable and sustainable? Join Kajetan Berning in this discussion.

events.title: The Kraken is Real:The Largest Squid on Earth
events.description: The Kraken is Real: A Mission to Find and Protect the Largest Squid on Earth - Hear Matthew Mulrennan, a marine scientist and ocean conservation technologist from Venice, CA describe innovations to explore and protect the ocean, including diving into an audacious expedition to find and film the colossal squid, the largest invertebrate on Earth, in the deep-sea near Antarctica.

events.title: The Lorax, A  Performance Piece
events.description: An impassioned recital of Dr. Seuss' best title, for small and big Burners great pleasure. To gain inspiration for our planet’s salvation come through and partake of this treasure.

events.title: TORQuE PARK DUCKs Or Science 101.
events.description: Chris Maloy uses this mnemonic to teach the basics on how to evaluate scientific information that comes your way. He'll also go over 5 numbers that are constants that can not be violated. Learn how to evaluate scientific claims so you can be a better citizen on the planet.

events.title: World’s Largest Fire Blanket
events.description: Senior Earth Guardian and Leave No Trace Master Educator Mike Bilbo will discuss the history of burn scars on the playa, Leave No Trace solutions, and Burning Man's stewardship through large scale solutions known as burn platforms. Learn also what is the latest protocol for building a fire when camping in back country areas. Then off we go via bike tour to see the world's largest fire blanket. How big is it, what is it made of? We will investigate.

events.title: Beyond the Five Senses
events.description: Explore how to remove the drama and stress from your life by remembering that the human experience entails much more than the three dimensions of our five senses. Join this discussion and “remember” lessons from ancient Mexican knowledge that seems to surpass modern psychology in terms of mental, emotional, spiritual and physical well-being. Taught by Teco as covered by Maestro Xokonoxtletl, in his book, Juicio a España, Testigos Aztecas.

events.title: Burning Man and the Environment
events.description: Since 1991, Burning Man has evolved and innovated to protect the Black Rock Desert. Learn the history starting with the installation of the perimeter fence, fire blankets and evapotrons. When was the Leave No Trace protocol brought to the playa? When was the first year for the Burner Express buses? What else is Burning Man doing to protect the Black Rock Desert and the planet?

events.title: Children design a better future
events.description: Children are amazing inventors! They will present their inventions for recycling, waste and moop, designed in BRC. Come support the kids!

events.title: Circular Thought, Ancient Solution/ Modern Problem
events.description: Linear thought has resulted in the most powerful and richest country the world has ever witnessed. But at what cost? Join a discussion that is lacking in mainstream society,  a discussion in which we can remember that circular thought can bring about a balanced lifestyle, and a healthy environment.

events.title: Creative Campaigning to Win Big
events.description: Creative campaigns that use compelling imagery and messaging to create a clear narrative of a problem and solution are key to mobilizing the public around advocating for change. Come learn how the environmental movement is continuing to advance environmental and human rights protections across the world’s largest agricultural supply chains, despite (or perhaps because of) ineffective government, using compelling imagery, story telling, data visualization, and people power to drive action.

events.title: DIY Wick Gardening Demo
events.description: Grow veggies in a small area all year round using less water with wick gardening. Build it once with recycled materials and use it for years. Also, plans for composting in a container that gives you compost tea. Your plants will love you!

events.title: Do You Have Solastalgia?
events.description: It is distress caused by environmental changes like climate or events such as volcanic eruptions, drought or fire? PTSD? Grief for any reason? Come join the circle to learn or share drug-free tips to cope with sadness. We will collect all ideas and send you a copy of our happiness recipe book to comfort you anytime in the default world.

events.title: Earth Guardian Procession to the Temple
events.description: Join Earth Guardians & Aztec Dancers in procession to the temple to offer a blessing and connect to Mother Earth.

events.title: Earth Guardians Live Music Showcase
events.description: Hosted by Nathyn Knott and friends featuring conscious music, poetry and dance inspired by our connection to the earth and nature.

events.title: Earth Guardians Salsa Music Party
events.description: Salsa Music Party hosted by our own Earth Guardian Aztec Burners.

events.title: Ecoshanti, Spirituality and the Environment
events.description: Spiritual ecologist, Juan Vazquez, will explore core values that enable us to sustain deep and eco-friendly lifestyles, that help us in turn to live in harmony with the planet. Juan has participated in the last five UN Conferences on Climate Change as well as the RIO+20 Conference on Sustainable Development.

events.title: Eco Socrates Cafe
events.description: Are environmental issues a separate problem or are they connected to other challenges in society such as racism, inequality, sexism, and the current economic system.  Can we regulate the problem away or do we need a systemic change and is there enough time?  Let's discuss and try to clarify this topic while supporting each other. Facilitated  by Teco.

events.title: Eco Socrates Cafe with Jairo
events.description: Are you concerned about climate change and the environment?  How about our CO2 footprint? One of the 10 principles states our community respects the environment and we are committed to leaving no physical trace of our activities wherever we gather. Let's discuss and try to clarify this topic while supporting each other.

events.title: Feed your Soil, Save the Planet
events.description: In these dynamic times of the Anthropocene, human activity is driving degenerative change to planet earth and its protective atmosphere.  Simultaneously the life giving soil of this planet provides massive carbon storage potential that if taken advantage of can mitigate climate change, reduce agricultural water use, and stabilize agrarian economies.  While corporate food farms continue on with exploitation of soil, water, and people for the economic benefit of a few, the sun grown Cannabis farmers of America are coalescing under the pressure of vigorous environmental regulations to promote regenerative farming practices that if implemented at a landscape scale can save the planet. Join speaker Hollie Hall, to learn about regenerative Cannabis farming practices that heal planet and people.

events.title: Geology of the Black Rock Desert
events.description: Ever wondered about those amazing land forms around Black Rock City? Come and learn how they were formed and what they're about. Come and learn about the rocks from Elizabeth Miller, our expert geologist from Stanford.

events.title: Glue, Screw, Patch. Repair It: Don't Replace it!
events.description: How to fix things that break, are worn or want to be re-purposed. Sometimes you have a favorite thing you just want to keep a little longer or most of the object is still good but a portion is loose or broken making the whole thing useless . This workshop will show you how to extend the life of an object.  Bring something to fix if you wish.  Hunger (playa name), the workshop leader,  has worked as a product designer and artist for over 40 years and enjoys fixing things.

events.title: Greening the Burn / Leave No Trace Cocktail Time
events.description: We celebrate you - Green, Eco and LNT superheros  - with earthy libations and nosh. Without you, BRC would not be sustainable! from the EG bar and some Earth-produced nosh to celebrate the high valued LNT /green burners! All LNT/Green camps invited!.

events.title: How Hemp Can Save the World
events.description: Hear the history of hemp from ancient times, how it became illegal and now is making a comeback worldwide. A global perspective of a plant that could disrupt the textile industry. Get an overview of hemp as medicine, food and as a building material while seeing samples of tinctures, slaves, hemp seeds, hemo Crete to feel, raw hemp fibers and textiles.

events.title: How to Stay Green, Clean, and Beautiful!
events.description: Zero waste and plastic-free is possible at BRC. Upcycled beauty bags along with homemade beauty and hygiene products demo (wipes, sunscreen, lotion and so much more) for playa and off-playa life. Tips and recipes from dozens of burns, ancient recipes, and new ideas from around the world.

events.title: Juice Lab & Snow Cone Saloon
events.description: Join Jai and Zobek for a kid-sponsored bar serving brightly colored juice in various states of matter (liquid and frozen!). Come and share your LNT knowledge and tips for a sweet treat.

events.title: Leading the Way Locally on Climate
events.description: Morgan Goodwin, town council member and former mayor of Truckee, CA will talk about the global effort to combat climate change, and how getting elected to local office is one of the most powerful things you can do to join the effort.

events.title: MOOP Champagne Train
events.description: Hitch a ride in style to the outer limits of BRC on the Earth Guardian Champagne MOOP Train. See what treasures you may find to put in your free hand made MOOP bag.

events.title: More Than Just One Word on Plastics:
events.description: Plastics: we love them and hate them. Rebecca Braslau, organic chemistry professor at UC Santa Cruz, will discuss the history of plastics, what they are made of, health, environmental and societal issues, and exciting developments in emerging biosustainable and biodegradable plastics.

events.title: Our Future is in Our Hands
events.description: Really. No kidding. Annette Gardner, Assistant Professor and Futurist at UC San Francisco will engage participants in taking the long view (10+ years) to envision a better future for the earth and its inhabitants. Mars is not an option for most of us. We can make a difference. We have to.

events.title: Playa Nature Bike Tour
events.description: The playa seems featureless, but the lake bed is a complex environment. Search for clues to the shape of the constantly changing surface. See how our city and art affects the environment, and how Burning Man strives to Leave No Trace.

events.title: Playa Sunrise Bike Tour
events.description: The “golden hour" after dawn is prime for photography and wildlife spotting. Tour the deep playa, find “Golden MOOP” at the trash fence, contemplate our place in the cycles of deep time. Cameras, binoculars and field guides welcome.

events.title: Playa Sunset Bike Tour
events.description: Join desert experts on a 5 mile journey exploring the subtle geomorphic wonders that form Black Rock City’s backdrop. See how our city and art affects the environment, and how Burning Man strives to Leave No Trace.

events.title: Simple Rocket Stove Construction Workshop
events.description: DIYers! Learn how to make a simple rocket stove that uses recycled paper pellets or twigs for fuel. Davis will go over the steps for making the stove out of recycled tin cans and then have the supplies so you can make one for yourself to take back to your camp. Limited to 10 that can make a stove but open to all for instructions. Sign up at Earth Guardians.

events.title: The Black Rock Desert: Our Inspiring  Home!
events.description: Come learn about the vast Black Rock Desert and what makes it come alive. Dave Cooper, local and former manager of the Black Rock NCA will talk about playa dust, wilderness areas, historic emigrant trails, wildlife, wild horses, & more. Come with questions!

events.title: The Black Rock Desert: Our Inspiring Home!

Learn also what is the latest protocol for building a fire when camping in back country areas. Then off we go via bike tour to see the world's largest fire blanket. How big is it, what is it made of? Learn the history starting with the installation of the perimeter fence, fire blankets and evapotrons. When was the Leave No Trace protocol brought to the playa? When was the first year for the Burner Express buses? What else is Burning Man doing to protect the Black Rock Desert and the planet?

events.description: How do we nurture hope for a healthy future and face the struggles inherent in making a difference?  Using a motto of "educate, empower, engage", this session will explore core foundations of our beliefs and obstacles to civic engagement and how we can overcome thought traps, create cycles of hope, and identify ways to participate in sustainable solutions.

events.title: Plastic-Free Burning Man
events.description: Author/World's leading anti-plastic Blogger Beth Terry will share her journey from self-confessed plastic junkie to empowered plastic-free activist and explain why we can't recycle our way out of this mess. Her message is powerful and full of positive suggestions that can reduce your plastic footprint.

Explore examples of how schools, colleges, government agencies, and community programs are building tangible projects, resource tools, networks, and outreach efforts that increase education, training, and public awareness campaigns.  Realize how you can make a difference.

events.title: Voices from the Occupation of the Malheur NWR

In this talk Mike Marxen from US Fish and Wildlife Service  will explore words and stories from the occupation that were used to provoke, challenge, resolve and heal. As we gather here and legally "occupy" this desert, what do public lands mean to you?

BLM was checking for permit violations and we were along as both LNT advisors and cultural ambassadors.  It's a great opportunity to have 'boots on the ground' and share LNT love and we’re doing it again this year!  This is a training for our volunteers on the team, and a meal will be provided for the training.

events.description: All aboard the MOOP train! Can you see and pick up MOOP as we move through the city? Give back to BRC, we'll travel to the trash fence and around the city deMooping!

events.title: More than just one word on Plastics
events.description: Plastics: we love them and hate them. Rebecca Braslau, organic chemistry professor at UC Santa Cruz, will discuss the history of plastics, what they are made of, health, environmental and societal issues, and exciting developments in emerging biosustainable and biodegradable plastics.

events.title: Mushrooms as Allies for Surviving
events.description: Paul Stamets will put the co-evolution of fungi and life on this planet into perspective and unveil the research that he and his team have conducted which makes a strong case that, by pairing with our fungal friends, we can restore habitats, clean water, support and renew foodwebs, and strengthen ecosystems at a time when habitats and humans are in collision.

events.title: Music of Nathan Knott
events.description: A wandering neo-psychedelic folk singer, multi-instrumentalist and genuine song and dance man singing inter-dimensional songs steeped in American blues, soul, funk, old timely, freakfolk, gospel, and big beat rock n roll and and performing with a kind of generosity and sincere breadth of emotion all too rare these days. The result is a kind of hypnotic feel good music that holds the ability to transport us through calculated sound, emotion, words/story.... to that warm feeling of coming home into this electric moment, the ever present and infectious NOW!

events.title: Panel Discussion: Plastic-Free vs. Zero-Waste:
events.description: Plastic-Free vs. Zero-Waste: When eco-choices are not simple. Join Beth Terry (author My Plastic-free Life), Bea Johnson (Zero Waste Home) and others to explore the complexities of living sustainably. Bring your questions.

events.title: Plastic-Free Burning Man
events.description: Author/World's leading anti-plastic Blogger Beth Terry will share her journey from self-confessed plastic junkie to empowered plastic-free activist and explain why we can't recycle our way out of this mess. Her message is powerful and full of positive suggestions that can reduce your plastic footprint. An optional tour of her (nearly) plastic-free campsite is featured after the talk.

events.title: Plastic-Free Living as Spiritual Practice
events.description: Blogger and author of the book Plastic-Free, Beth Terry will talk about how reducing her addiction to plastic became an integral part of her journey toward a more mindful, present, and compassionate way of life.  Let's share our ideas for minimizing our plastic footprint while maximizing our connection to each other and the planet.

events.title: Playa Dynamics Bike Tour
events.description: The playa under our feet seems featureless, but this vast lake bed is a dynamic, complex environment. Join an expedition searching for clues to the processes that constantly reshape the surface. How does our temporary city and art affect the environment? See how Burning Man endeavors to Leave No Trace.

events.title: Puppet Show
events.description: An entertaining half hour for the kids with puppets completely made from recycled materials. The message is Leave No Trace with an emphasis on not leaving micro trash behind. Kids attending will get their very own handmade MOOP bag.

events.title: Simple Rocket Stove Construction Workshop
events.description: DIYers! Learn how to make a simple rocket stove that uses recycled paper pellets or twigs for fuel. Davis will go over the steps for making the stove out of recycled tin cans and then have the supplies so you can make one for yourself to take back to your camp. Limited to 10 that can make a stove but open to all for instructions. Sign up at Earth Guardians.

events.title: Simple Solar Cooker Construction Workshop
events.description: Learn how to make a simple solar cooker. The Hunger (playa name) will go over the steps for making one for yourself.  He will have 6 kits ready to make for the first six to show up and 12 sets of instructions for the ones who did not get to make their own.

events.title: Sunrise Playa Bike Tour
events.description: The crack of dawn is the 'golden hour' for photography and the best time to see wildlife. We'll tour the deep playa, search for “Golden MOOP” at the trash fence, and examine how art installations affect the environment. Cameras, binoculars and field guides welcome.

events.title: Sunset Playa Bike Tour
events.description: The playa under our feet seems featureless, but this vast lake bed is a dynamic, complex environment. Join desert experts to discover the subtle wonders that form the backdrop to Black Rock City. How does our temporary city and art affect the environment? See how Burning Man endeavors to Leave No Trace.

events.title: Sustainable Garden Practices
events.description: Learn how to have a beautiful, healthy, lush garden without the use of pesticides. Learn how to attract beneficial insects and why they are so important. With a few simple steps, no matter where you live, you can grow a beautiful, sustainable & abundant garden to enjoy!

events.title: The Black Rock Desert: Our Inspiring Home!
events.description: Come learn about the vast Black Rock Desert and what makes it come alive. Dave Cooper, local and former manager of the Black Rock NCA will talk about playa dust, wilderness areas, historic emigrant trails, wildlife, wild horses, & more. Come with questions!

events.title: Triumbudrum Yoga Dance
events.description: With dance, music, props and costumes the 6 members of this modern dance troupe will use their bodies to tell a story on the theme of sustainability, demonstrating the impact on the environment and our outcry to be more mindful of our footprint on the planet.

events.title: T Shirt Bag Workshop
events.description: Annie will demonstrate how to make a T shirt bag that you can then use as a MOOP bag or as a grocery shopping bag back in the default world to minimize your use of single-use plastic bags. We will have the supplies so you can make and decorate your own bag to take away with you. We will also demonstrate how to make your own toothpaste and wet wipes.

events.title: World's Largest Fire Blanket
events.description: Senior Earth Guardian and Leave No Trace Master Educator Mike Bilbo will discuss the history of burn scars on the playa, Leave No Trace solutions, and Burning Man's stewardship through large scale solutions known as burn platforms. Learn also what is the latest protocol for building a fire when camping in back country areas. Then off we go via bike tour to see the world's largest fire blanket. How big is it, what is it made of? We will investigate.

events.title: Zero Waste Home
events.description: The world acclaimed author of Zero Waste Home, aka the “priestess of waste free living”, Bea Johnson, will share her tribulations and secrets to reducing her family’s trash to a quart jar per year. Through this upbeat presentation, you'll discover the amazing advantages that the zero waste lifestyle has to offer: they might be very different from what you’d expect!

events.title: Life Coaching Workshop
events.description:
Did you ever notice that you and Al Roker (the weatherman) sound a lot alike?  For example, he says, “tomorrow it’s going to rain; for the next five days it’ll be hot & muggy”.  And, you say things like, “today sucked and I’m a procrastinator”, or “I’m not a morning person”, you know, “I’m cloudy with a chance of a storm”…as if you have nothing to do with it, it’s just how you and it is…

But doesn’t weather reporting yourself into “not a morning person,” just gives you a doctor’s note from being nice until noon?

We are all sneakily weather reporters in our lives, pretending we have no say over how we are going to be or how things are going to go.  But what if it’s not so?

Uh oh is right. What if you are actually the author of your life?  

I mean, who else is?  In this workshop, you’ll begin to redefine a new and powerful context from which to run your personal and professional life, where you have a say over the weather.

events.title: One-On-One Life Coaching

One-on-One coaching helps awaken you to not just one or two of your dreams, but to ALL of them. Our rigorously trained coaches will give you a 30 minute bootcamp and empower you to cause the change you deeply desire once and forever, getting to the heart of your highest ideals.

IMAGINEnation is a camp dedicated to the power of dreaming and radical honesty.
Our coaches provide daily life coaching workshops and one-on-one coaching to the people of the playa. We are offering 30 minute sessions, Monday thru Saturday 12-4pm to help you sort out your life.
Whether it's finding a job you love, fixing your relationship, losing 30 pounds or simply being ready for the next exciting chapter in life, the work you will do with your coach will provide immediate inspiration, serious results and lasting knowledge.

Our Life Coaches have been through a rigorous training process and utilize The Handel Method, which is also the foundation of the work we teach at MIT, NYU and Stanford.

Together we dig deep, play big and don’t stop until goals are fulfilled and lessons learned. We care, we love what we do and we walk our talk.

events.title: Lineage
events.description: Lineage; in honor of the lineage break your lineage. How to take down your bad traits in 6 weeks This course deals with individual personality traits and styles of behavior. Participants will investigate the source of their own personality, and learn skills for developing effective traits and abandoning negative traits, which do not serve them.

events.title: Weather Reporter vs. The Author
events.description:
To put it very simply; when someone is being a Weather Reporter, it is as if they have no control over the circumstances that exist, it just is the way it is because of influences out of their control. Being an Author is looking at things as the creator and being responsible for outcomes. 

This is especially valuable in a group like this where people are counted on to produce serious results, as the conversation is about clearing away self-limiting thoughts and replacing them with positive and proactive ones. However, this isn’t a one-time cheerleading session, but rather an introduction to a simple yet revolutionary way of thinking about things that people can take with them. Each person will begin to redefine a new and powerful context from which 
to run their professional and personal life.

Favela Camp is extremely happy to invite you to an exhibition By Extraordinary Brazilian artist Lucas Lamenha.

About
With the aid of graphical elements and characters that not only reflect the chaos inherent to modern world’s surplus of information but also represent the identity of his work, Lucas Lamenha cultivates repetition and provokes the public by bringing storytelling as the key element to his thematic, transforming studies, research and memories into stories told with spray, acrylic   and marker about a ludic, original and colourful universe invented by the artist 

The uniqueness of his strokes and his outstanding style imprint generalities, such as numbers, music, astronauts, dilemmas, idiosyncrasies, love and peace, that translate some of Lucas’ essence, past and present into paper, canvas and objects.

Download the iBurn App! Your best resource to navigate the activities, theme camps, art installations, and scheduled events on the playa -- all without wifi -- it's GPS enabled! Download the 2025 version of the gifted (free) iBurn app pre-event, or swing by our camp to download on our wifi. It's like having an elf read you the What/Where/When in a dust storm! 32,000 Burners used iBurn last year -- make sure you are one of them.

Come download the iBurn app -- a gift to help you navigate BRC! iBurn can be your compass, your activity guide, your art interpreter, and your savior in a dust storm. Even without wifi, iBurn can help you find your way home, your next adventure, and more. Bring your phone and answer the Burning Man trivia question for indespensable access.

Burning Man Earth / iBurn app is a geo data project started by Larry Harvey and Rod Garrett in 2005 to provide digital mapping and navigation solutions. Although dedicated to BRC it can easily me adapted for solutions for refugee camps or disaster situations.

iBurn is a 10 year project to give burners access to events, art and camps in relation t their own GPS location. It is a free app for iPhone and android but does not connect to the outside world but is downloaded to your phones memory before you get to Burning Man.
All you need is a clear view of the sky.  https://iburnapp.com/

history.description: We will have a branch from the giving tree art car that we have not used on the at car for sometime now. We will be mounting this 8' long horizontally arched branch 15' high off one of our frontage street corners, with 12' long GREEN vines hanging from the branch blowing in the wind like a flag. It looks just like the art car so people will know what camp we are when the art car is away from camp.

The Giving Tree Experience gives hope to inspiration! It's an art car I built for burning man in 2017 and lil did I know it would make the waves we have so far with spreading that positive impact while making so many smiles along the way! It's a 25' tall 26' wide 28' long willow tree. With a short bus tiny tree house inside! Guest of all ages can ascend the later to the roof top deck that is 8' wide by 16' long where you will find all kinds of tree people smiling and laughing! Also you will find another tree trunk in the middle of the upper deck where you can climb further up to the crows nest, when you reach that point you will be captain of the the giving  tree as you steer the actual helm into your own imagination. Then jump in one of four hanging papasan baskets for a nice relax!

-Saturday, August 29th : 1pm - 2:30pm 
-Sunday, August 30th : 11:30am - 2:30pm
-Monday, August 31st : 11:30am - 2:30pm

events.description:
The Principles Beyond the Playa - Running a nonprofit like a burner

What is this thing we're doing in the dust? How does it apply to the default world? How can we take the lessons we learn here and use them to make the world a better place? 

Three Executive Directors of non-profits, who are all long time burners, give their thoughts at this incredible talk.

Chill out with performers from across Burning Man’s Global Network!  We’ve put the call out to the far-flung corners of the Burner-verse asking them to share their talents with you.  Stop by for a potpourri of performance, participatory surprises and meet Burners from around the world.

Burning Man culture thrives year-round through the hard work, creativity, and dedication of Burners across the world.  Over 280 volunteer Regional Contacts in 38 countries help facilitate communication amongst local Burners and with Burning Man Project. Regional groups and community leaders host 85 unique regional events annually ranging from single day and night urban events to multi-day overnight immersive experiences. Communities also work together to create Burning Man-inspired activities and initiatives including public art, film festivals, parades and civic projects. Learn more at http://regionals.burningman.org/.

history.description: The home to the ARTery, Burning Man's Art Headquarters on playa and Everywhere, a point of connection between Black Rock Citizens and off-playa, worldwide Burning Man-related projects and culture. events.title: Everywhere Opening Celebration
events.description: Come one, come all, to a celebration of the year-round global Burning Man community! Burning Man Arts & Civic Engagement, Burning Man’s Global Network, Burners Without Borders, and Black Rock Labs invite you to join us for our annual celebration at our shared pavilion space,  located at 6:15 and Esplanade, as we kick off what promises to be an amazing week on the playa. Why? Because together we are EVERYWHERE, and we have amazing global stories to share! This celebration will end in a procession to the Man Base to celebrate the the official opening of the Man and surrounding pagoda to commemorate the Golden Spike. Bring your own cup and a ritual or offering to share with others, and join us for the whole evening!

history.description:
The Lamplighters began in 1993, with a small group of participants placing a dozen or so kerosene lanterns on the ground each evening, illuminating a pathway towards The Man. 

The Lamplighters are more than a handful of volunteers; they are a team of well over 100 participants every evening. To accomplish this considerable task, we ask for your help, and we invite you to be a part of this community, this event, and our tradition. 

The Lamplighters begin EVERY EVENING of the event in their center camp workspace at around 5pm. The ceremony begins around 6, and soon the work is done. No experience is required. We welcome virgin and seasoned burners alike. One thing is certain though. We can't do it without YOU.

events.title: Be a Lamplighter
events.description:
Lamplighting and Sacred Ritual!

The Lamplighters are one of the longest-running moving art projects on the playa, and one of the many longstanding daily rituals of Black Rock City. Drawing from lamplighters of ancient cities, the Lamplighters gather volunteers from the city each night and maintain, light, and hang over 900 kerosene lamps in a procession that goes through the heart of Black Rock City. Come and join us! All are Welcome!

history.description: Come be a part of the longest running art project on the playa. Come down to center camp at 5pm to light the city.
Lamplighters Village – Come help us light the city any or every night at 5pm.

Lamplighter Village is where the core Lamplighters live. These are folks who make it there business to light the lamps of Black Rock City every single night!! Rain or Shine. White Out or No White Out. But you don’t have to live in Lamplighter Village to be a Lamplighter — participants are welcome and encouraged to join the Lamplighters on one, two, or several nights of the festival. This year in BRC there are more lanterns to be lit than ever before and we re going to need more Lamplighters than ever before, and that’s the cold hard truth!Come relax in the shade of our lounge, enjoy a little late afternoon misting, or gander at the Man himself from our observation deck. Then join the rest of the robed ones as we head over to our Center Camp Chapel workspace every night at 5:00 p.m. to prep the lanterns for ritualistic distribution throughout the city!Lamplighter Village is HQ for the first major part on the playa. Join us Monday Night at 10 p.m. for the annual "Bring Your OWN Cup" Lamplighter Sangria Soiree, and find out just what goes on under those robes.And if your teeth are feelin’ a little loose mid-week and you fear you might be catchin’ a case of the ol’ scurvy… Come on by for a heapin’ healpin’ of Hot Sauce’s XXX cajun veggies served up in one of the best Bloody Mary’s you’ll find on the playa. Yep, Wednesday is the new Sunday AND our Bloody Mary Brunch. Bring your own cup! and make it a big ‘un.

events.title: Burn Perimeter Training
events.description:
Your city needs you! Volunteer to help hold the line of safety and keep the Fire Burning!

Do you love fire?

Do you love helping people be safe?

Do you look snappy in an orange vest?

Do you want to give back to the Burning Man community in a meaningful way?

If you answered yes to any of these questions, we have a volunteer opportunity for you!

We burn a lot of big art at Burning Man.

To do that safely, we set up a burn perimeter around each burn to keep the citizens of Black Rock City safe.

These perimeters are formed with volunteers stationed in a circle surrounding the art. With a smile and a flashlight, these great folks help to maintain the safety areas around all of the wondrous art that is set ablaze each year.

This is not VIP seating at a burn, as you will be vigilant and looking away from the burn. But you will be helping to make sure we can keep the burning in Burning Man!

Attend this hour of shaded training, and then you can sign up for the burn perimeters that you want to help on.

If the Temple has a special place in your heart, join us and help hold the space so that others might experience the wonder that brings us back.

events.title: Temple Guardians Training
events.description:
Come learn how to be a Temple Guardian!  

Have you had an experience at the Temple that changed your heart and your life?  Have you seen the magic of the Temple experience echo out in to the world?  Come learn how the Temple Guardians contribute to the Temple by holding space for those who visit.  This training will challenge the way that you see the world and will introduce you to the many perspectives on the Temple and the way that people use it.

history.description:
The mission of the Temple Guardians is: To hold the space of the Temple, maintaining an environment that allows equal access for everyone to have the experience and expression that they need, and keep the Temple itself, as well as the participants who visit it, safe.

The mission of the Temple Guardians Camp is to hold space for and to serve the Temple Guardians. We do this by creating a warm and welcoming place for Guardians and potential Guardians to gather. We host the training sessions and social events. And as the experience of being a Guardian can be powerful and overwhelming, our camp is a place for them to find a compassionate ear and a knowing Heart.

Good Air is a Black-centered camp rooted in joy, rest, and radical care. Our name comes from a phrase our aunties yelled—"Don't let the good air out!"—and we've built a sanctuary in BRC that reflects that love and intention. With about 25 campers, we focus on community, co-creation, and cultural grounding. This year, we're also an art support camp for Jen Reed and The Apple Core, the first piece of Compost Playground. Our space includes a front door portal, communal living room, shared infrastructure, and a commitment to radical inclusion, participation, and environmental responsibility.

history.description: Camp 6 Minutes is home to The Scarab and The Cloud art cars and offers a vibrant space to dance, create, and connect. We're all about good music, playful energy, and spontaneous conversations. Whether you're lounging in the shade or joining a dance session, our camp invites you to be yourself and talk some good-natured shit. Come hang, laugh, and recharge with us.
Our camp is a collective of cloud enthusiats dedicated to transporting you to Cloud 9. We leave every 6 minutes.

ART 20 / IQ Test / Dragnet Interrogation...WE do it all! Come and visit the trash fence and see our 13th project on the fence. There will be 75 tennis rackets adorned with fun recycled folk art pieces. In camp we will give you an IQ Test with wacky question and expect fun weird answers. Also we can interrogate you using sound bite from the old Dragnet TV/Radio show. Always fun this is my 20th visit to BRC and always bring the fun!

BlinkingManCamp97 returns! Stop by for a wacky IQ TEST (everyone passes) or get an interrogation by iconic Joe Friday. We ALWAYS have unique swag. After the fun head out to the Trash Fence and visit our ZOOZ - 70 animals inside tennis rackets, project 12 out there by our camp. DRAGNET, it's not just for breakfast any more.

WELCOME BACK! For the 11th time the deep playa trash fence will be much more than a fence. 85 posts will be decorated with folk art, and recycled and repurposed items dangling from TIKIs. As you ride along the fence you will connect and enjoy the tikis and wonder what the heck are some of them? About 15 people have contributed art and the tradition continues. Also from time to time we will run an IQ test (wacky and fun) and returning for the first time DRAGNET INTERROGATION! It was last seen on the playa in 2009. Stop by we have unique swag and you will enjoy the unique experience.  And the TIKIZ will definitely bring a chuckle and a guffaw.......BlinkingManCamp - on the playa since 1997!

The Jive Joint is a full improvised, unrehearsed, and interactive music and comedy experience you dont want to miss! Come to the Center Camp Plaza for "Genius Hour"  starring Super Tall Paul, Rossome, and Sethward!

Icarus Camp Support Camp for Ad Astra

Stone Circles have stood as timeless sentinels - sacred spaces created in reverence and mystery.
Here at Burning Man, we honor this enduring legacy.
We gather in modern ritual, not to replicate the past, but to reignite its spirit.
A Circle of luminous, reflective Monoliths rising from the dust, designed as a portal beyond boundaries, beyond time.
Dedicated to alternative forms of flight. Come fly the friendly playa, of come ply the friendly skies.
Icarus Camp is dedicated to alternative forms of flight.
